name: XII Puchar Bielan w biegu na orientację
Krosová 12°
description: Krosová 12° is a 12 km or 6 km running race on a hilly 6 km loop around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race challenges runners with demanding, hilly terrain, making it ideal for those who enjoy trail running and hills. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running off-road amid beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. Recommended running gear and accessories are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km loop with elevation gain
Choice of 12 km or 6 km course
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course distances: 12 km and 6 km, both on a hilly loop. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for changeable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and a choice of two distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 17 November Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová commemorating an important day in Czech history. It offers two main distances: the certified 10 km Freedom Ten and the 5 km Revolution Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the races starting in the morning. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová, which is easy to reach by public transport and shared Nextbike bicycles.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km Freedom Ten course
5 km Revolution Five
Routes through Ostrava-Hrabová, with good public transport connections
additional: On-site check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The individual races start in the morning. Public transport is available on lines 27, 39, 41 and 77, with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared Nextbike bicycles are also available. The race includes several course distances, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition, with results from previous editions.

name: Sametový běh
location: Odolena Voda, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 30. 9., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 200,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 11. 11., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 300,- při registraci on-line od 12. 11. do konání závodu, platba převodem nebo v hotovosti při prezentaci

description: The Velvet Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering races for all age groups, including a family run for parents and children. The event takes place at the football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal and light refreshments after the race, including tea and mulled wine. The organizers ensure the course is safe and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Race-day registration opens at 08:45 at the event venue. Light refreshments are available after the race, including tea, mulled wine and homemade buns. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Parking is available by Penny Market. The organizers provide course and event safety. Categories are divided by age and gender, including the Fighters, Champions and Legends categories. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments and fun activities for families. Registration is available on site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17 Run in Přerov is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the opportunity to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test themselves on an interesting course. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the city of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 9 km cross-country race, with children’s categories also available
Part of the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Online registration and results available
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offers various courses including cross-country, and attracts a wide range of participants from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter course that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00, and participants can compete in several age categories. Race facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers. After the race, the results are announced and prizes are awarded. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 5,000-meter course (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories are divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers are available. The results will be announced at 12:30 in the sports hall buffet, with prizes awarded. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women; participants run 4 laps. Roots and stones are marked for safety. Refreshments are available at the finish, and there is a raffle. The ceremonial start is signaled by a pistol shot fired by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17 Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the SK Městská policie Kadaň sports club. The race takes place in Rooseveltovy sady and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community. The race information and further details are available to download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: The race runs through Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň
A course suitable for different age groups
A friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community
additional: The race information is available to download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with Bc. Jiří Vlasák as its contact. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g. 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The venue is in Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh městem Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city centre on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km route consisting of five laps. A shorter 200-metre lap is prepared for children and young athletes. The event is suitable for the general public and is organised by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city centre
200-metre children’s lap
9.7 km road race
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the V Lipkách residential area, near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organiser is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s.; the contact person is Jiří Brych. Starts are scheduled for 10:00 and 12:00. Registration is available through the sport-reg.cz sports portal.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17 Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in Liboháj Forest Park. The main race is 6 km, split into two 3-kilometre loops, and is complemented by a 3 km fun run. The race is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also offers an additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The start is at the ski slope at 11:00, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj Forest Park, with paths and trails
Main race: 6 km (2 × 3 km loops); fun run: 3 km (1 loop)
Additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Runner registration is from 10:00 to 10:45. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The additional uphill race on the ski slope is for brave runners. The weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery or icy after overnight rain. The course follows paths and trails in the forest park; a special challenge is the uphill race on the ski slope. Part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025

name: Běh o pohár Jehnic
location: Základní škola Jehnice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: VSK Univerzita Brno – oddíl atletiky, Atletika UNI CZ s.r.o., ZŠ v Jehnicích, Fakulta sportovních studií MU a ÚMČ Brno-Jehnice
description: The Jehnice Cup Run is part of the 27th edition of the Brno Running Cup, which comprises eleven races in the Brno area. The race takes place at the Jehnice Primary School and offers courses for various age groups, from the youngest runners to adults. The event is open to the general public and is supported by the Statutory City of Brno. Runners can expect a friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the opportunity to score points in the series.
course_highlights: Courses for the youngest runners, children, youth, and adults, with distances of 1, 1.5, 5, and 10 km
Start and registration at Jehnice Primary School
Drinking water is provided; BBP reusable cups are available to borrow
additional: Registration closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is open to the public without restrictions. Youth and junior runners may enter the 10 km race and score points in the older category. Drinking water is provided only for runners using their own cups, or they can borrow a BBP reusable cup for a 20 Kč deposit. The race takes place at Jehnice Primary School and is part of the Brno Running Cup. A championship for students and teachers of Brno’s universities is also listed.

name: Podzimní cross – Běh 17. listopadu
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Bořice, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice – TJ Sokol Bořice
description: The Autumn Cross-Country – 17 November Run is a traditional trail race through the Dvakačovice-Podborský Forest near Bořice. The race offers two options: a short 5 km race (1 lap) and a long 10 km race (2 laps), with 110 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course follows forest roads and trails, making for an enjoyable cross-country experience. The event also includes children’s races, and traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. It is organized by Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice - TJ Sokol Bořice.
course_highlights: The course follows forest roads and trails
110 m of elevation gain per lap
Each lap is 5 km; the short race is 1 lap and the long race is 2 laps
additional: The event includes children’s races. Traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Podboři - Bořice. According to the organizers, registration opens at 9:00 and the race program starts at 10:00.

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: USP Night Run - powered by Runnersworld Utrecht
description: The USP Night Run is an atmospheric night run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, with distances for both adults and children. The route passes through the beautiful, illuminated Botanical Gardens, creating a unique and spectacular running experience. The event offers an enjoyable and sporty evening, with an atmospheric start and finish area, water stations along the route and at the finish. Teams and companies are also welcome to take part together, with extra options such as running shirts and pasta meals.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs of 800 m and 1.5 km
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start corrals and water stations along the route and at the finish. Optional extras when registering: USP Night Run shirt, cancellation insurance, pasta meal. Company teams can participate in their own running shirts and with drink tokens. First name on the race bib with registration chip. The event supports charities and offers discounts and extras such as a running shirt and pasta meal.

name: Utrecht Science Park Night Run
description: The Utrecht Science Park Night Run is an atmospheric running race taking place on Friday evening, 20 November 2026. Participants run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, including a spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens. Several distances are available, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and kids’ runs. The event is organised by Central Events and supports the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start waves and a race with a prize ceremony. Optional extras when registering include a running shirt, cancellation insurance and a pasta meal. There is also a special kids’ run of 800 metres and 1.5 km. Registration includes options for shirts, insurance, a pasta meal and donations to ALS; proceeds go to Stichting ALS Nederland.

name: Derko Night Trail
description: The Derko Night Trail is the region of Utrecht’s premier running event in the dark, organized by BodyRun and IJ-run together with many volunteers. The start and finish are at Skipiste Nieuwegein, where a lively afterparty is also held. The trail runs through a beautiful nature area and offers various distances for both trail and paved-surface runners. Participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark, adding to its unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail runs on unpaved paths through a nature area
Start and finish at Skipiste Nieuwegein with catering facilities
The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons; headlamps are mandatory
additional: All participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark; it is mandatory for the trails and recommended for the fun run. The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons. Mixed changing facilities and first aid are available. The event aims to reduce the use of cups; participants take their own waste with them. After the event, there is an afterparty at the catering venue by the start/finish. Trail and paved routes, headlamp mandatory, online registration, charities supported

name: Loučení s turistickým rokem
location: Důlce, Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory charity ultrarun in Fulda, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run laps of approximately 6 km, covering up to 112 km, and decide for themselves when to start, take breaks and finish their run. Each lap raises donations for children with half a heart, supporting research and quality of life. The event is open to everyone, from beginners to ultrarunners, and wheelchair users are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Charity laps covering up to 112 km
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: This is a charity run where every lap counts and the entry fee is donated in full. Participants receive a personal fundraising page where supporters can donate for each lap completed. There is a 400-metre children's run in the stadium, with each lap counted. The event is also available virtually, so people can take part from anywhere in the world. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with a personal fundraising page, medal for the first 1,500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Ainringer Crosslauf
description: The Ainring Cross-Country Run is a long-standing event organized by Ski-Club Ainring e.V. in the municipality of Ainring. The start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße. The event gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and running technique on varied cross-country courses. It is part of the club’s diverse sports program and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Schwimmbadstraße in Ainring
Varied cross-country courses in the municipality
Long-standing running event organized by Ski-Club Ainring
additional: The race takes place in the Ainringer Moos and around the Eschlberg area; the start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße; children’s and school races are included.

name: Blumensaatlauf
description: The Blumensaatlauf in Essen is a long-standing running event taking place on November 21, 2026, at scenic Baldeney Lake. Organized by TUSEM Essen, the race offers a fast, flat course that is ideal for personal bests. Runners can choose between a half marathon and a 10 km race, with the event welcoming both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The idyllic route along the lake creates a special atmosphere and an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course at Baldeney Lake
Half marathon and 10 km race options
Scenic running atmosphere with views of the water
additional: Run at Baldeney Lake, registration available, family-friendly, focus on personal bests

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Bönnigheimer Stromberglauf
description: The Bönnigheim Stromberg Run is a traditional autumn race at the foot of the Stromberg, attracting both elite and recreational runners. The event offers scenic courses through vineyards, fields, and meadows, with varied elevation and wonderful panoramic views. The 5-kilometer loop is fast and flat, while the 10-kilometer distance features challenging climbs and an encouraging atmosphere. The race takes place around the Strombergkeller and is known for its lively atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop with just 20 meters of elevation gain through fields and residential areas
Challenging 10 km course with 60 meters of elevation gain and panoramic views over vineyards
2 km schoolchildren’s race around the Strombergkeller, mostly on paved paths
additional: Registration is through the raceresult service provider. Special awards are available for schools, companies, and cultural associations, with attractive prizes such as a case of wine from the Strombergkeller. The course is mostly paved and offers a varied challenge, with around 70 meters of elevation gain per lap. Participants without a stated time will be placed in the final starting block. The event is organized by LG Neckar-Enz with support from the City of Bönnigheim. Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 2 km; cultural activities; children’s and youth races; online registration

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Int. Brubbellauf
description: The International Brubbellauf in Wallenborn is a long-standing running event organised annually by SV Wallenborn. It takes place in November and is open to runners of all ability levels; beginners are also very welcome. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before each start. Results and certificates are available in the “Information” section of the website.
course_highlights: Route through the centre of Wallenborn
A varied programme for all ages and ability levels
On-site late entries available
additional: Late entries are accepted on site until 30 minutes before each start. Distances range from 200 m to 10.2 km, including children’s races, a fun run, a corporate run and walking. The event takes place in mild November weather, with average temperatures of 2–7°C, and is suitable for families, beginners and ambitious runners.

name: Kalmit-Berglauf
description: The Kalmit Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race in Maikammer, Germany, covering 8.3 km with an elevation gain of 505 metres. The race starts at the market square and finishes at the summit of the Kalmit, making it a special experience in the Palatinate. The event is organised by TV 1847 Maikammer - Alsterweiler e.V. and is part of the Palatinate Mountain Running Cup. The challenging course follows asphalt and country roads and is open to various age groups, including youth, senior and masters categories.
course_highlights: Course: 8.3 km with 505 m of elevation gain
Start at the market square, finish at the Kalmit summit
Part of the Palatinate Mountain Running Cup
additional: Course: asphalt, local roads and state roads; participation open to youth, senior and masters categories; online registration until 21.11.2025; on-site registration available; start at 14:15; finish at 15:45.

name: Kunstweglauf Rednitzhembach
description: The Kunstweglauf in Rednitzhembach is organised by the endurance sports club PowerBärs Rednitzhembach e.V. and will take place for the 18th time in 2026. The event brings art and sport together in a unique symbiosis and is centred around the school building in Rednitzhembach, which offers excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The start and finish are right in front of the school, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is an established event in the region south of Nuremberg and offers a friendly, sporty experience in November.
course_highlights: Start and finish directly in front of the school building in Rednitzhembach
Excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and the school café
A running event that brings art and sport together
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day up to 60 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in and around the school building, which serves as its hub, with an assembly hall for the awards ceremony and refreshments. The event also includes results, race information and photos, and is a creative blend of art and running fun in Rednitzhembach.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
location: Rüsselsheim am Lindensee, Groß-Gerau, Hesse, Germany
description: The Lindenseelauf Series in Rüsselsheim at Lindensee is a traditional annual running event. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes around Lindensee. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course. The event is organized by LG Rüsselsheim and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Running routes around picturesque Lindensee
Varied course for different age groups
Friendly, sporting atmosphere
additional: Races in November and January; no series standings in November and January; certificates for the top three in each age group and for teams; awards ceremony after the race

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

name: Nussdorflauf
description: The Nussdorf Run is a traditional running event in Nussdorf near Eberdingen, held annually in November. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to beginner and panoramic runs, as well as Nordic walking. All participants receive a medal and certificate after crossing the finish line, and some also receive trophies or cash prizes. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the broad support of sponsors and volunteers.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
10 km panoramic run with age-group categories for all ages
Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 10:30 a.m. at the Nussdorf community hall, up to 30 minutes before the respective start. All participants receive a medal and certificate. Trophies and cash prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in various categories. Registration for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races is handled through the schools. Various race distances; registration opens on 01.09.2025; participation conditions, results and photos available online.

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is for runners who want to experience a nature-rich route through a protected landscape. Timing has been provided by a modern ALGE system since 2022, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Nature-rich and scenic route
Modern ALGE timing system in use since 2022
additional: Timing is provided by an ALGE system, including a start trigger with an integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, who can be reached at 0177 4691132. Club training takes place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 17:30 to 19:00 at the stadium or the Obersuhl indoor sports hall. Route through the nature reserve, training plans for participants

name: Ring Running Series 2026
description: The Ring Running Series at Hockenheimring offers a unique running experience on November 21, 2026, on an officially measured Formula 1 circuit suitable for personal bests. The flat, fully paved course follows the legendary Grand Prix circuit, featuring highlights such as the Motodrom, the Bernie Ecclestone Curve and the South Curve. Participants can choose between the half marathon and marathon and benefit from a secured course, high-quality refreshments and professional timing. The event combines a motorsport atmosphere with an athletic challenge and is ideal for runners looking for a special course and fast times.
course_highlights: Officially measured course with an AIMS certificate, suitable for personal bests
Flat, fully paved race track with long straights
Passes all the highlights of Hockenheimring, including the Motodrom and Bernie Ecclestone Curve
additional: Race number collection on site on November 20 and 21, with a personalised race number and integrated timing chip. Changing facilities in the pit lane, medical support along the course, high-quality refreshments on the course and at the finish, baggage storage near the finish, jacket drop-off in the start area with collection near the finish, free parking and shower facilities. The finish is on the original Formula 1 finish line. Schedule: marathon start 10:00, half-marathon start 11:00, course closes at 16:00, awards ceremony at 13:30. The event offers live tracking, race number collection, accommodation options at Seehotel Ketsch and a unique atmosphere that motivates runners to achieve personal bests.

11.5 km run with a rolling profile for more variety

The event is supported by dedicated volunteers and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The races take place at various sports grounds and in natural surroundings, which is what makes the series special.

A range of distances for children, middle-distance and long-distance runners
Part of the long-standing Nahe Cross-Country Series, with several stages

Runners wear headlamps on an illuminated course, making for a special running experience in the dark. A varied programme of events for all age groups ranges from the Glühwürmchenlauf for the youngest participants and school races to 5 km and 10 km races. The event winds down in the Winterdörfle, with Swedish fires creating a festive atmosphere.

Events for children, school students and adults
Wind down in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires

Run with a headlamp on an illuminated course; various events for children and school students; finish in the Winterdörfle by fire pits.

The organizers offer the option to collect race numbers in advance and arrange train transport to the start in Eemshaven. The race is known for its scenic course and good organization.

description: The Halve van Monster is an annual running event held in November in Monster. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon (21.1 km), a 10.3 km run and a 5.4 km run. The course passes through the dunes and along the beach, with the start and finish at De Wielepet sports hall. Walking tours are also offered over the same routes in the opposite direction. Each year, the organizers support a charitable cause, giving the event extra meaning.

Run along the beach

The race takes place at Hoornseplas in Groningen and honors American athlete Zac Freudenburg, known for his impressive performances in longer-distance events. The ZFC has a rich history and attracts runners who enjoy challenging cross-country courses in a natural setting. The event is organized by a dedicated student committee that ensures a well-organized and sporting day.

Natural and challenging terrain
Historic connection to athlete Zac Freudenburg

The organizers ensure that clothing brought to the start is transported to the finish, making the run more comfortable. The event attracts many enthusiastic runners each year, who brave the elements in a welcoming and well-organized setting.

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region. Men run a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice, while women run 5 km, turning around earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. Contact details for the organizers are available for more information. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test yourself on a demanding course.

The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the regional running community. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje race series and attracts runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Přáslavice near Olomouc

This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and gives participants the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hill race with a mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series, with a long tradition and history
additional: A hill running race with categories. Registration is available for an entry fee of 50 Kč. The race takes place on terrain with a challenging elevation gain. Results are published regularly, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a nighttime trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory, and the course is marked with reflective elements to ensure safety and create a unique atmosphere. Tea and refreshments are provided for participants after the finish. This race is ideal for fans of night running and trail challenges who want to experience running in an unusual setting with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km nighttime trail course
Course marked with reflective elements
Headlamp mandatory for safe running

The course is 5 km long, a headlamp is mandatory, the course is marked with reflective elements, refreshments are available at the finish, and the race is intended for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slánské běhy is a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Sports Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories, including a 12 km main category and children’s categories. The race is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

Children’s and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný

The race offers two distances, 33.3 km and 16.6 km, and runners can switch between them free of charge. Participants can expect challenging winter conditions, several aid stations and an unforgettable experience on the “hellish” course. Both distances start together at 10:00, and the time limit is 7 hours. The entry fee includes timing, gifts and refreshments on the course and at the finish.

Two distances: 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the option to switch free of charge
3 aid stations on the long course and 1 on the short course, plus refreshments at the finish

The entry fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), chip timing and split times, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main course, beer, soft drink, mulled wine, tea). Marked course, aid stations, bring your own drinking cup, accommodation nearby, registration on Friday and Saturday before the race.

Each race has its own special feature, such as a winter night run or a spring half marathon symbolizing the balance between day and night. After each race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, adding to the friendly atmosphere of the event.

A winter night trail with a heated tent and hot drinks

After the race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, including mulled wine. Bus travel is recommended, with stops nearby. Parking is limited, and participants should follow the organizers’ instructions. Race bibs are collected at designated times before the start.

description: Lysacup is a winter stage running series in the Beskydy Mountains, held mostly on Lysá hora. Each weekend, a stage starts from a different location, and both individuals and teams compete. The start is usually at 10:00, and participants use chips activated for the entire season with a voluntary contribution. The race offers the atmosphere of a traditional mountain run, with the option to take part as a walker too. The overall winner receives a perpetual trophy, and the race is supported by a number of partners and sponsors.

Mountain-running atmosphere with scoring for individuals and teams

Chips can also be bought from other competitors or the organizers. If there are many competitors, the organizers reserve the right to adjust the scoring. The two worst stages are discarded from the overall standings, one from each half of the series. It is also possible to take part as a walker, with an assigned number of points. The overall winner and the best teams receive perpetual trophies. The organizers provide refreshments and prizes from sponsors.

The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both the local and overall standings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with permission from their guardians. The main race starts at 11:00.

description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partially paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers various distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are recorded electronically, and there is a cup classification for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Route around Dutzendteich and Silbersee

Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The Winter Running Series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.

description: The Schalmloop Mariënheem is a popular winter cross-country race that has been part of Mariënheem’s sporting winter calendar since 1986. The race takes place around the Boetelerveld nature reserve, on a recently renewed course consisting of more than 80% unpaved paths and muddy sections. Since 2024, the start has been at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, improving accessibility and atmosphere. The Schalmloop offers distances for all ages and is known for its challenging, varied nature route with gentle elevation changes. The event promises a friendly, active winter day outdoors.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly through the Boetelerveld nature reserve
More than 80% unpaved sandy paths and muddy sections
A varied route with gentle elevation changes and plenty of nature
additional: The Schalmloop offers several distances: 1.3 km (start 11:45), 2.6 km (start 11:25), 5.2 km (start 12:00) and 10.7 km (start 10:00). The start is at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, Raamsweg 47A. More than 80% of the course is unpaved and it can be deceptively slippery depending on the weather. The short loops make the event appealing to spectators. Raamsweg from Raalte is closed during the event; approach via Kroepeweg. Distances: 1.3 km, 2.6 km, 5.2 km, 10.7 km; terrain: unpaved and muddy; date: 22 November 2026

location: Sportpark Calslagen, Kudelstaart, Aalsmeer, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: gratis voor jeugd en G-Run, inschrijving via www.inschrijven.nl
description: The Westeinderloop is a running event organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer, held at Sportpark Calslagen in Kudelstaart. The race offers runners a great opportunity to take part in a competition in a friendly, sporty atmosphere. The route runs through the area around the Westeinderplassen, making for a varied and appealing course. The event is suitable for different ages and ability levels and contributes to the local sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportpark Calslagen
Run through the area around the Westeinderplassen
A varied course with beautiful scenery
additional: Course along the Westeinder, several categories including youth and G-Run, parking at RKDES, accessible by public transport

name: Sperwers trailrun
description: The Sperwers trail run is a challenging trail race set in the beautiful landscape of Exloo, Drenthe. The race offers two distances, 7 km and 14 km, and takes participants along natural paths and through wooded areas. The event is suitable for trail running enthusiasts who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Registration closes on 15 November 2026.
course_highlights: Trail run through wooded areas in Exloo
Natural paths and challenging terrain
Choice of 7 km and 14 km distances
additional: Trail terrain, registration closed, event on 22 November 2026, weather information available

name: Maarten Maartens Trailrun
description: The Maarten Maartens Trail Run is a welcoming trail race held on the beautiful Zonheuvel estate in Doorn, on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The 6, 10 and 20 km routes wind through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest and are mostly unpaved, with the entire course marked with arrows and ribbons. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants can read their time from the race clock. After the race, refreshments are available, and the winners are honoured at the historic Maarten Maartens House. The trail run is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike who enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Routes through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Mostly unpaved course, clearly marked with arrows and ribbons
Start and finish at the historic Maarten Maartens House on the Zonheuvel estate
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 12:30 until 15 minutes before the start. The 20 km race consists of 2 laps, with a refreshment station halfway. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants read their time from the race clock. Prizes are awarded to the first three women and men. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on the steps of the Maarten Maartens House. No electronic timekeeping; refreshments are available after the race and halfway for 20 km runners; prizes for the top three women and men; race numbers can be collected in advance.

name: 405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The event is part of the Monaka race series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to take part and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: A traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
A welcoming atmosphere and friendly setting
The opportunity to take part in various categories and at different performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course distance has not yet been published.

description: The 13th Maków Fifteen is an annual race held in Maków Mazowiecki, taking place on November 22, 2026. The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with the start and finish located at the municipal stadium. It is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club together with local authorities. The race attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Maków Mazowiecki
Two distances to choose from: 15 km and 5 km
An urban course suited to adult and youth runners
additional: Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are displayed instantly on a television at the finish and sent to runners by SMS. The race is filmed in Full HD, and an electronic clock at the finish tracks the time. The organizer provides original race bibs made of synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; the race is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewnickie forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and members of sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewnickie forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Children and young people under 18 may participate only when accompanied by a parent or guardian. A package covering all starts during the year is available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable, but they may be transferred to the next start if the request is submitted by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the start. Running and Nordic walking events; 3-hour time limit; annual packages available.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks and forests. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located on Św. Wawrzyńca Street. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same course over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start and finish by the city beach at Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
Suitable for both run-walking and fast running, and accessible to runners of all abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains unchanged, allowing participants to compare results over the years. In the 2026/2027 season, the Poznań edition also includes races on 11 October 2026, 17 January 2027, and 21 March 2027. The series also features races for children and young people.

name: Freiberger Adventslauf
description: The Freiberger Advent Run takes place on November 28, 2026, in the festively decorated city center of Freiberg, combining sporting activity with the special atmosphere of the run-up to Christmas. The event is a regional highlight, with several races for different age groups and distances. It attracts many runners every year and offers a festive setting with musical accompaniment, including the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz. Registration opens in June 2026 and is in high demand due to the limit of 1,000 pre-registrations.
course_highlights: Festively decorated city center of Freiberg
Musical accompaniment from the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km, including a relay
additional: Race number pickup from 12:00 at Rüleinsporthalle; late entries and changes are possible until 1 hour before the start. All races start at Café Hartmann. Start times: Bambini Run 15:00, 1 km Children's Run 15:15, 3 km Teen Run 15:30, 6 km Fun Run 15:45, 12 km Main Run and relay 16:30. Limit of 1,000 pre-registrations. Registration opens in June 2026; late entries are possible on race day. Start times: Bambini Run at 15:00, Children's Run at 15:15, Teen Run at 15:30, Fun Run at 15:45, Main Run at 16:30.

name: Mesumer Adventslauf
description: The Mesum Advent Run is a long-established running event in Rheine, offering various distances from 1 to 10 kilometres. More than 660 runners took part in the 37th edition in pleasant temperatures and sunshine. The event attracts a broad range of participants, including many athletes from Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten, who achieved excellent results in various age groups. The race offers an appealing competition during Advent for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
More than 660 finishers
Top placings in various age groups
additional: The race takes place in cool temperatures and usually sunny weather. The event includes several distances suitable for young people and children. Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten is strongly represented and supports the event. Races in Rheine-Mesum, family-friendly, flat courses, races for children and young people

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Reichenbach near Lahr/Black Forest is a DLV-sanctioned race eligible for rankings, with distances of 5 km and 10 km. The course follows a 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths, mostly flat with gentle climbs. The start and finish are beside the Schutter, near the Geroldseckerhalle. There is also a 5.5 km walking route through the forest and local districts, offering beautiful views of Hohengeroldseck Castle.
course_highlights: 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths
Flat course profile with gentle, short climbs
Walking route with views of Hohengeroldseck Castle
additional: The 5.5 km walking event starts at 14:10 near the finish area. Based on experience, the start area for the 5 km and 10 km races is very cramped, so arriving early is recommended. The walking route passes historic and scenic points. Courses over paved and forest paths; start and finish beside the Geroldseckerhalle; limited parking; arriving early is recommended.

name: Villmarer Dorflauf
description: The Villmar Village Run is a long-standing race held in Villmar at the end of November. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, and young people may also take part in the adult races. The course is flat, and all events finish in the same area. Children’s and youth races are also held; further details are provided in the official race announcement. Now in its 33rd edition, the race is a fixture on the local running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat course
All adult races finish in the same area
Children’s and youth races in addition to the main programme
additional: The 5 km run and 5 km walk start first, followed by the 10 km run. Typical November weather in Villmar is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. The race takes place in November; exact details about registration and participation are available in the official race announcement.

name: Volksbank WeinstadtCross mit DM Cross und Deutschem Cross Cup
description: The Volksbank WeinstadtCross is a long-standing cross-country running event held on 29 November 2026 in Weinstadt. The event includes school championships, children’s and youth races, and the JedermannCross on Saturday, while the German Cross Country Championships take place on Sunday. The challenging course runs across uneven terrain, through mud and over steep climbs, offering runners of all ages and ability levels a true running experience. The WeinstadtCross is part of the German Cross Cup and attracts participants from across Germany.

name: Oostermaetloop Lettele
location: Kulturhus de Spil, Lettele, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oostermaetloop in Lettele is a friendly running event held at Kulturhus de Spil. It offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The start times are spread throughout the afternoon, with a welcoming atmosphere and an announcer guiding the event. The event is organized by VV Lettele, and registration is easy via mijninschrijving.nl.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km
Start and finish at Kulturhus de Spil
Friendly local atmosphere with announcer Henk Borgmeijer
additional: Same-day registration is available between 11:30 and 13:30, depending on the distance. The 1 km run is free and starts at 12:30, the 2 km starts at 12:45, the 5 km at 13:15, and the 10 km at 14:10. The location is Kulturhus de Spil, Sportweg 1, 7434 RZ Lettele. Distances range from 1 km to 10 km, with start times between 12:30 and 14:10. The course is 90–95% unpaved. The atmosphere is festive, with pieten and marksmen.

name: Simply Move It
location: Hoge Bergse Bos, Bergschenhoek, South Holland, Netherlands
organizer: Mees en Vincent van Simply Move It
description: Simply Move It is a challenging Backyard Ultra running event held in Hoge Bergse Bos near Rotterdam. Participants run a 6.7 km lap every hour, for up to 24 hours and a distance of 160 km. The unique format challenges runners to finish within the hour and start again, with the finish line being personal to each participant. The course consists of trail and singletrack paths with climbs, making it ideal for trail-running and ultrarunning enthusiasts. The event is popular and fills up quickly, with an active community and additional clinics to improve running technique.
course_highlights: Trail and mountain-bike course in Hoge Bergse Bos
6.7 km per lap, with singletrack and climbs
Unique Backyard Ultra format: one lap every hour, for up to 24 hours
additional: The 24-hour edition on 28 - 29 November 2026 is fully booked; you can sign up for the waiting list. There is a WhatsApp group for participant updates and practical information. A Trail Run Clinic will be held on 26 September in collaboration with Salomon and Runnersworld Rotterdam. The event offers solo and duo formats, with a base camp and crew facilities. Participants must follow the safety rules and code of conduct. The final route will be announced later. Trail and ultrarunning, maximum 24 hours, course with approximately 130 metres of elevation gain per lap, duo option available, close to Rotterdam

name: Walvoort Rondje Nederland
price_range: Vanaf €5,50 tot €13,00 afhankelijk van afstand en leeftijd
description: Walvoort Rondje Nederland Evening Run is a fun family run taking place on Saturday evening, 28 November 2026, at the Netherlands Open Air Museum in Arnhem. The event offers youth races split into boys’ and girls’ races to ensure equal opportunities. The atmosphere is enthusiastic and welcoming, with special attention to children and their accompanying adults. Timing is provided using the Ipico system, and ample parking and facilities are available for participants and supporters.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Netherlands Open Air Museum
Youth races split into boys’ and girls’ races
Evening run with a fun, family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Children up to and including 12 years old receive an extra wristband for an accompanying adult, which includes free admission. Other supporters pay €7.50 admission, which can be reserved via the registration form. Parking at the Open Air Museum is free. Changing space and luggage lockers are limited; there are no showers. First aid is available. Timing chips must be returned after the event, otherwise a €10 fee will be charged. Volunteers are welcome: info@rondjenederland.com. The course is at the Netherlands Open Air Museum. Registration is open until 12 noon on 28 November. Accompanying adults with a museum card receive free admission. Timing is provided using chips. The event supports childhood cancer research. There are no showers.

description: The Elderschanscross in Aardenburg is a challenging cross-country race held in a natural setting with varied terrain. The race is organized by Atletiekvereniging De Wielingen, which is known for its wide range of athletics activities. The cross-country race offers a lovely mix of nature and sport, suitable for runners of different levels. The organizers provide a welcoming and sporty day for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with asphalt, dune paths and beach
Beautiful views of the ’t Zwin nature reserve and the West Zeeuws-Vlaanderen coast
Various elevation changes and challenging dune sections
additional: The Kerzantse Kilometer (KEKI) starts around 12:15 after the half marathon and 3 Zeemijl. KEKI entries are accepted only on the day of the event, in person at the sports hall. Parental consent is required when registering children aged 15 and under for photos to be published. Late registration for the half marathon is available on the day from 9:30 at the Cadzand-Bad sports hall. Payment can be made via iDeal, Bancontact, WERO or credit card. Entry fees are non-refundable after 1 January. The event has a long history and attracts runners of different levels. No specific information about registration or costs is available.

name: 57e AV Climax Horaloop
description: The 57th AV Climax Horaloop takes place on Saturday, 28 November 2026, in Ede. The race offers several distances, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles (16.1 km). The course runs through the hills of Hoekelumse Bos and the rolling valley of the Renkumse beek, with a choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails. The Horaloop is an atmospheric and challenging race, with chip timing and a welcoming finish venue at Hoekelum Castle.
course_highlights: Hilly course through Hoekelumse Bos
Rolling landscape along the Renkumse beek
Choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected on Friday, 27 November, between 18:00 and 21:00 at Atletiek Vereniging Climax, or on race day from 8:30 until 20 minutes before the start. There is a 2-hour time limit for the 10 English miles. Water stations are available along the route. There is no supervised cloakroom, but there is a place to leave belongings at your own risk. A changing tent is available; there are no showers. Parking is at Hoekelum farm, with clear directions and traffic marshals. Dogs are not allowed during the race. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the race offers options for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Storekeeper Rijsserbergcross
location: Atletiekterrein AV Rijssen, Rijssen, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Storekeeper Rijsserbergcross is an annual cross-country race, celebrating its 27th edition this year. The race takes place in beautiful, hilly surroundings around the AV Rijssen athletics grounds, where the start and finish are located. Several distances are offered, catering to different ability levels. The cross-country race is known for its challenging course and welcoming organization.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain around the athletics grounds
Start and finish on the AV Rijssen athletics track
Various distances for different ability levels
additional: The race is part of a broader athletics program and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.

name: Nienoord crossloop Leek
description: The Nienoord Crossloop Leek takes place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, in Leek, Groningen. Participants can choose between distances of 5 and 10 kilometers. This cross-country race offers a challenging course in a natural setting, ideal for runners who enjoy a varied trail. For the most up-to-date information, please refer to the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Cross-country course in a natural setting
Held in Leek, Groningen
additional: The race takes place in a natural setting, registration is required, and the event offers a sporting challenge for runners of all levels.

name: UHUT100 Winter - Rhenen
location: Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin, Leersum, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The UHUT100 Winter is a unique ultra trail that takes you across the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The race consists of two loops of more than 50 km each, spread over two days, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose to run one of the 50+ km loops or the full 109 km over both days. The route follows varied single tracks through several nature reserves and is continually coordinated with the managers of these areas. Thanks to live tracking, friends and family can follow the runners during the event.
course_highlights: Two loops of 50+ km across the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: Because of the short daylight hours, the UHUT100 Winter is spread over two days, with a 09:00 start on Saturday and Sunday. Participants navigate entirely by GPX and receive refreshments every 10–15 km. The finish is before 17:00 on both days. All ultra participants receive a live tracker when collecting their race number. The race takes place in November 2026, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose the 50 km distance or the full UHUT100, which covers more than 100 km. The race is characterised by winter conditions and a challenging course through the nature of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting along the Dřevnice River. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. It also includes a 1.5 km family run in costume, a children’s programme, and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family run in costume, with gingerbread as a finish-line reward. A children’s programme and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities in costume. The race pack contains gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied accompanying programme, and a race pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run up Lovoš is a traditional uphill race held in Lovosice, in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a challenging trail run climbing to the summit of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural setting. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with registration available in advance or on site.
course_highlights: Off-road uphill run
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is available from 12:30 to 13:30. The vehicle carrying the bags departs at 13:30, so be sure to watch the departure time. The race is part of the Král středohoří sports event series. Registration is available in advance or on site. The start is at 14:00, and luggage departs at 13:30.
