description: The Cologne St. Nicholas Run is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 29th time on December 6, 2026. The event offers three different races: the competitive 10 km TopRun, the FunRun with a variable distance of 3.4 km to 10 km for all running enthusiasts, and the KidsRun, a 3.4 km race for children. The races follow a course through the beautiful Cologne City Forest on a DLV-measured loop, creating a festive, athletic atmosphere for the whole family. The event is organized by the athletics team of the German Sport University Cologne and emphasizes community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Loop course through the Cologne City Forest
DLV-measured course with a course certificate
Three laps for the 10 km TopRun; variable distance for the FunRun
additional: Start times: TopRun 10:00, KidsRun 11:30, FunRun 11:35. FunRun participants can choose between 3.4 km, 6.7 km, or 10 km. A preferred bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of €5. €1 from every St. Nicholas hat sold will be donated to Lindenthaler Tierpark. Race bibs include B-tags for timing; registration is closed, late registration is possible, and race packet pickup is in Cologne.

name: landesoffener Nikolaus-Waldlauf
description: The 46th open Nikolaus Forest Run will take place on December 6, 2026, at the Arnstorf School Centre. The event offers various races for adults, young people and children on hilly forest trails, with distances ranging from 2.7 km to 7.2 km. The start and finish are at the Arnstorf School Centre, which can be reached by a free shuttle bus. The award ceremonies and shower facilities are also at the school centre. The event is part of the Grenzland Running Cup and includes age-group rankings for schoolchildren.
course_highlights: Hilly route through woodland
Start and finish at the Arnstorf School Centre, with shower facilities
Free shuttle bus to the start/finish
additional: Distances range from 300 m to 8.7 km, with age-group rankings for schoolchildren. Races are offered for children, young people and adults, as well as Nordic walking. The route to the school centre is signposted. Various distances; start at the Arnstorf School Centre; free shuttle buses; shower facilities; winter running event in woodland.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The LSV Porz Winter Running Series kicks off with the race in Ochtendung on December 6, 2026. The event offers various distances, including 0.4 km and 8.1 km, and is open to runners of all ability levels, including students and Nordic walkers. Participants who successfully complete the series receive an award, such as a trophy or a towel. Dogs are not allowed, and the event is not accessible for people with disabilities.

Start location: Ochtendung
Typical December weather, with snow cover on most days

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held every year on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. Various distances are offered: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event attracts runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with special appreciation for children and recreational runners. It is organised by the running group of Melsunger Turngemeinde 1861 e.V. and is a fixture in the North Hesse popular running calendar.

The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Family-friendly event with special care for children

Children receive a small treat (e.g. chocolate wafers) and a medal at the finish, as well as a certificate at the awards ceremony. The event is organised by the MT Melsungen organising team / recreational sports department / running group. Course distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km; registration and results via My Race Result; winter weather is possible.

name: Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf
description: The 46th Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf in Mingolsheim (Bad Schönborn) is a traditional running event held on field and forest paths, with the start and finish at Schönbornhalle. The race welcomes children, youth, adults and masters, offering a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The event is organized by SG Bad Schönborn and warmly invites runners of all ages to take part in this popular fun run.

Start and finish at Schönbornhalle
Natural running environment in Mingolsheim

December weather is typically cold, with temperatures around 3°C; snowfall is possible. The event is a lovely opportunity to celebrate the run-up to Christmas actively.

name: Nikolaus-Lauf in Ochsenfurt
description: The Nikolauslauf in Ochsenfurt is a traditional running event organized annually by Turnverein Ochsenfurt 1862 e. V. The event offers various races for Bambinis, schoolchildren, young people, recreational runners, and a main race. The courses are suitable for all age groups and foster a sense of sporting community in the region. The run traditionally takes place in early December and attracts numerous participants from the surrounding area.

Festive December atmosphere in Ochsenfurt
Annual event with a tradition and community spirit
additional: Alongside the races, the Nikolauslauf also offers a sociable atmosphere, ideal for families and running enthusiasts. Results from previous years are available on the website.

name: Oberschwäbische Crosslaufserie 1. Lauf in Blitzenreute
description: The 1st race of the Upper Swabian Cross-Country Running Series in Blitzenreute is a popular running event that brings runners of all ages together in a natural setting. The event offers a variety of routes for children, young people and adults, including cross-country distances from 1.0 km to 7.5 km. It is organized by SV Blitzenreute e.V. Athletics Department, and registration is available via Raceresult. The series is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied running routes.
course_highlights: A variety of routes for all age groups
Cross-country running in a natural setting
Distances from 1 km to 7.5 km
additional: The race takes place on cross-country terrain. Registration is via Raceresult. No refunds or transfers of race entries are possible.

name: Oelder Nikolauslauf
location: Oelder Jahnstadion, Oelde, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 52nd Oelde St. Nicholas Run takes place on December 6, 2026, at Oelde’s Jahnstadion and invites children, young people, and adults to enjoy a varied running experience. With four different running distances and a Nordic walking and walking distance recognized as a performance course for the German Sports Badge, the event offers a suitable challenge for every age and ability level. The routes pass through the stadium and the surrounding countryside, including challenging climbs in Limberger Forst. The event is a popular St. Nicholas Day tradition and promotes recreational sport in the region.
course_highlights: 0.6 km loop in the stadium for children up to age 7
3 km fitness run on paved farm roads through the Bergeler farming community
11.5 km cross-country run with climbs in Limberger Forst

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Katze in Saalfeld an der Saale is a traditional 15 km road race held in winter since 1982. The course starts at the Langenschader Straße sports field, loops around the local landmark “Katze,” passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm, and returns to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in DLV age groups, making it especially appealing to club runners of all ages. The event is small, usually attracting fewer than 100 participants, and offers straightforward organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road-race course
Loop around the “Katze” landmark in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Langenschader Straße sports field. The event usually has fewer than 100 runners. Results are scored in DLV age groups. December weather is typically cold, averaging 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The race offers online registration, changing rooms, and showers at the venue, and results are scored by age group.

name: Weiterstädter Nikolauslauf
description: The Weiterstadt St. Nicholas Run is a winter running event held on December 6, 2026, in Weiterstadt. Organized by TuS Griesheim, the event offers various distances for children, youths, and adults, including 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The course runs around the Braunshardter Tännchen and features a flat, scenic route through fields and forests, ideal for recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, entry fees, and a chocolate St. Nicholas figure for all finishers.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic route through fields and forests
Various distances for all age groups
Part of the Lang-Lauf Cup series
additional: Run at the Braunshardter Tännchen; online registration available; race number distribution from 09:15; results available online; finishers receive a chocolate St. Nicholas figure

name: Zülpicher Seepark Nikolauslauf mit Fun/Firmenstaffel
description: The Zülpich St. Nicholas Run is organized by the athletics department of TuS Chlodwig Zülpich and Seepark Zülpich. The races take runners through the wintery park, including along the shore of the watersports lake, and offer various events for youth, recreational runners, corporate and club relay teams, as well as the main race. The event takes place at the Seehaus in Zülpich and invites both runners and spectators to a festive St. Nicholas celebration with mulled wine and non-alcoholic punch. Changing rooms and showers are available on site, and race bibs can be collected at the pavilion behind the main entrance.

Start and finish at the Seehaus, with changing rooms and showers

Various race categories, online registration, start and finish at the Seehaus, changing rooms and showers available, fixed date: December 8, 2024.

name: Nijverdalsebergcross
location: Manege 't Oale Spoor, Hellendoorn, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Nijverdalsebergcross is a challenging cross-country race held at Manege 't Oale Spoor, right next to the Sallandse Heuvelrug. The race is part of the Atletiekunie’s national Cross Country Series and offers several fully unpaved laps, ideal for runners who enjoy a tough course. Race numbers can be collected from 8:30 a.m. The event attracts both recreational runners and licensed competitive runners. The atmosphere is sporty, and the event is supported by many volunteers.

Several laps that are 100% unpaved
Course suitable for spikes

There is ample parking, and traffic marshals will be present. Various distances; registration opens on 29 August 2026 via inschrijven.nl and mijninschrijving.nl; prizes for the top three in each category; course suitable for spikes; location at Manege 't Oale Spoor in Hellendoorn.

name: Snertloop De Lutte

description: The 40th edition of the Snertloop takes place on Sunday, December 6, 2026, in De Lutte. This winter classic has been a much-loved event for runners from the region and beyond for four decades. The Snertloop offers challenging and varied routes through the hilly, wooded Twente countryside, with distances for both competitive and recreational runners. Young runners can also take part in special youth races on safe courses. After the event, all participants receive a traditional bowl of snert at the atmospheric event grounds.

The youth distances are 1.2 km for children aged 5 to 8, 1.2 km for children aged 9 to 12, and 2.4 km for young people aged 13 to 15. description: The All4running Cross Circuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held at various locations across the Netherlands, including the Duincross in Den Helder. The races are suitable for a range of age categories, from youth to seniors, and offer a great mix of courses through woods, dunes and sports complexes. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races, with the standings determined by their best four results. The circuit is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organisation and great prizes for the top finishers.

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.

Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
A picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is held on an asphalt course. It is part of a series of runs in Olomouc, with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
location: Smetanovy sady fountain, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. Everyone competes primarily against themselves and runs for the joy of it. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens, by the fountain in Olomouc. It also includes a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens, by the fountain
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Cup competition with scoring adjusted using an age coefficient
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The first three places are announced in each category. The race is part of a cup competition running from September 2026 to August 2027, with the best results from a maximum of 9 races counted. The series cup standings run from September 2026 to August 2027.

name: Čertovský běh Damníkov
location: ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov, Damníkov, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Čertovský běh Damníkov is a traditional uphill road race from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka in the Lanškroun region, held since 1984. The 4 km course runs on an asphalt road with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain and features a challenging uphill profile, especially in the second half. The race is part of the ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 series and is suitable for the general public, including junior categories. The start is at the Damníkov Primary and Nursery School and the finish is at the cultural centre in Anenská Studánka, where refreshments and the results ceremony are provided.
course_highlights: 4 km asphalt course with approximately 150 m of elevation gain
The climb becomes steeper after the railway crossing
The route runs from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka; in December, snow or ice may be present
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 9:00 to 10:10 in the Damníkov Primary and Nursery School building. Changing rooms are available at both the start and finish. Refreshments and the results ceremony are provided at the finish. Anenská Studánka railway station is on the route, approximately 1.2 km before the finish, making it easier to return after the race. The race is part of the ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 series. According to available information, registration takes place on race day during check-in at the Damníkov Primary and Nursery School building; winter weather may affect the course surface.

name: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy - Rybnik
description: The 22nd Barbórka Run in Rybnik is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik and held on December 6. The race is a long-standing tradition and an important sporting event in the region, attracting runners of different age groups. It is part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing professional conditions and timing
A variety of city routes suited to different distances
Part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix series, promoting activity and health in the region
additional: The race will take place on December 6, 2026, with the start at 12:00. Registration is open until November 29, 2026. Various distances and city routes are available.

Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful forest settings. In Katowice, the course runs through the State Forests of the Katowice Forest District, with the start about 700 metres from the finish near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond. The event is open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced runners, who can regularly compare their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of the Katowice Forest District
The start is about 700 m from the finish, near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond
A course suited to runners of varying abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The 5 km main race starts at 11:00. It is not possible to drive directly to the start; parking is available on Karolinki Street, about 1 km from the race office. CITY TRAIL Junior races over shorter distances are also held as part of the event. In Katowice, the finish is located near the “Rybaczówka” centre. The race is part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 season.

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: Bruggenloop Rotterdam
description: Are you taking on the ultimate Rotterdam challenge on Sunday 14 December? Cover 15 KM around sunset across Rotterdam’s iconic bridges.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, with awards for the three fastest participants of the day (men/women) and age-group winners. Certificates, results and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, participants receive a free refreshing drink; coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Bühlerzeller Winterlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.9 km
description: The Bühlerzell Winter Run is an established winter running event in Bühlerzell, Germany, organized by Sportfreunde Bühlerzell. With at least 21 editions, the event offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, including 3 km, 5 km, and 6.5 km. The program is aimed at younger runners, beginners, and experienced road runners, and takes place in typical December weather, with courses usually covered in snow.
course_highlights: Various distances from 900 m to 10 km
Winter running conditions with snow
Start and finish in Bühlerzell
additional: The event offers very short races alongside the 10 km race to include a range of runner groups. Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall, shapes the event. Races over various distances, including walking, take place in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures are around 3°C. Check details with the organizer before registering.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf

description: The Ellewick Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held every December. It offers a 1.5 km children’s and schoolchildren’s run and a 5 km run, each over two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children’s/schoolchildren’s run over 2 laps
5 km run over 2 laps
Route through the village of Ellewick
additional: Photos and videos are taken during the event for use in the press and on social media. Participant data is used to compile the race results and can be deleted on request. Terrain: loop course of 0.5 km or 2.5 km; online registration until 12.12.2025; trophies, certificates and a raffle; weather-dependent conditions, with possible snow cover and temperatures around 3°C.

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: MB Brandschutz-Nachtwächterlauf
description: The MB Brandschutz Night Watchman Run is a winter race in Ottweiler, usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. It offers short road-race distances of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, suitable for both beginners and club runners. The event is organised by the athletics section of TV Ottweiler. Registration is available for individuals and groups, making it easier for teams to sign up.
course_highlights: Short road-race distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Winter race with typical December temperatures around 3 °C; roads are often snow-covered
Starting point in Ottweiler
additional: The race is usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. Younger runners are eligible for the 2.5 km race; higher minimum age limits apply to the 5 km and 10 km races. Group registration is also available, making it straightforward for teams to sign up. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with roads often snow-covered. Winter race, road race, individual or group registration available, age limits vary by distance.

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event held in December on the Wadden Sea island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, as well as special children’s distances of 1 and 2 kilometres. The event combines a sporting challenge with the island’s unique natural surroundings and winter elements. It is a welcoming event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Run between the Wadden Sea and the North Sea amid unspoilt nature
Distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, plus children’s distances
Winter elements and a lively finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants in the 5, 10 and 21.1 km races receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. The race office is at Sporthal Nes, where participants can collect their race pack. The organisers promote sustainability by minimising the use of cups at aid stations and offering ECO cups. Participants must book their own ferry crossing through Wagenborg Passenger Services. First aid is provided by professionals. A shirt for the Kidsrun is available through Eilandverhuur Ameland. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km, plus children’s distances; registration opens on 1 April; winter conditions are possible; location: Nes, Ameland.

name: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra
location: Speelvijver Peddelpoel, Velsen, North Holland, Netherlands
description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running event in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to continue to the next lap. Participants can choose on the day which distance they run. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational lake and is limited to 150 participants. It is organised by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest area has facilities including toilets and picnic tables. After the event, all runners receive hot chocolate as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute time limit per lap
Start and finish at the Peddelpoel recreational lake, with facilities
additional: A maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are transition cups for the fastest runners in the final lap, one per distance. The start and rest area has space for tents, chairs and support crews. All participants receive a keepsake and hot chocolate before they leave. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, a 30-minute time limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, keepsake and hot chocolate after the event.

name: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER
description: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER is a running race taking place in Tuitjenhorn on 12 December 2026. The race is listed on Inschrijven.nl, where participants can register and find more details. The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to take on a sporting challenge while also raising awareness of cancer.
course_highlights: Supporting cancer research
Location in Tuitjenhorn
Registration via Inschrijven.nl
additional: The event focuses on charity and running, with an emphasis on supporting cancer research. No specific distance or course information is available.

name: KNRM West Coast Challenge
location: Hoek van Holland, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands

price_tiers.distance: Duo - hele of halve challenge (halve prijs + sponsoractie)

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance event in which teams of two take turns running and cycling over 130 kilometres from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a 62-kilometre Half Challenge for pairs and solo entrants; solo entrants may be accompanied by a cyclist. The event raises funds for the KNRM, with all proceeds going towards its rescue work. The Full Challenge starts on 12 December 2026 at 04:30 and the Half Challenge at 11:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometres, almost entirely along the beach, passing twelve KNRM coastal stations
The course is unmarked, so participants find their own way
The crossing at IJmuiden on KNRM lifeboats and the changing tides are important
additional: Participants must find their own route because the course is unmarked. Front and rear bicycle lights are mandatory in the dark (04:30–08:00 and from 17:00). If beach conditions are poor, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reserve date of 16 January 2027 in case of bad weather. The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: CHRISTMAS RUN Praha
location: Před Rudolfinem, náměstí Jana Palacha, Prague, Czech Republic

name: Běh okolo náměšťského zámku
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Náměšť Castle is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to experience the beauty of the area around Náměšť na Hané. The club specializes in recreational and competitive running and organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of Central Moravia’s running events and welcomes runners of all levels who want to test themselves in a picturesque setting. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community.
course_highlights: The area around Náměšť na Hané, with views of the castle
A traditional endurance race in the Olomouc Region
Picturesque natural and historic surroundings
additional: In the previous edition, the start was at the KVS Náměšť na Hané grounds; the date and location for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the available information.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Ismaninger Winterlaufserie
description: The Ismaning Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages from December to February. It offers races for different age groups and distances, including 13 km, 17 km and a half marathon, as well as races for schoolchildren and speed races. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of Ismaning and are ideal for runners who want to stay active in winter. A free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station makes getting there easier, and refreshments at the finish invite participants to linger.
course_highlights: 13 km, 17 km and half marathon courses
Separate races for schoolchildren and speed races for different age groups
Free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station
additional: Finish refreshments; participants may bring their own cup. Free shuttle buses from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Races for schoolchildren and speed races for U16 and older. GPX course files are available. The event also includes youth and speed races, with shuttle bus transport from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Results and historical data are available on the website.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Winterlauf
description: The Aachen Winter Run is a traditional 16.1-kilometre race from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg. Held annually in December, it attracts many runners of all ages. The route passes through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen, offering varied and scenic running. The event is well organised, with race bib collection available on several days, a bus transfer to the start and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 16.1 km route from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg
Run through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen
Start at Bürgerhaus Venwegen, with a heated indoor area and refreshments
additional: Race bibs can be collected at various locations on several days before the race. Free bus transport from Chorusberg to the start is available from 8:15 a.m.; taking an early bus is recommended. Bürgerhaus Venwegen is heated and serves as a place to wait and get refreshments. Clothing is transported from the start to the finish. Late entries are not possible. Starting places can be transferred up to one hour before the race via the individual change link or by email. The Winter Run takes place on 13 December 2026; further information about start times, registration and logistics is available on the website.

name: X-MAS Trail
description: The X-MAS Trail in Weiskirchen is a challenging winter trail run through the picturesque landscape of the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park. Three demanding courses with singletrack trails and technical sections lead through moss-covered forests, over small bridges and past rock formations. Participants need suitable equipment and experience handling winter conditions, as runners are self-sufficient. The course is marked with flagging tape and spray chalk, and there is a course briefing before the run. This is not a road race, but a genuine trail run with strict cutoff times.
course_highlights: A high proportion of singletrack, with many technical sections
Winter scenery in the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park, with moss-covered forests and waterways
Sections crossing small bridges and passing rock formations and the spectacular Felsenpfad
additional: Mandatory equipment is required, especially for the longer distances. The course will be confirmed shortly before the race and made available to download. The longer distances are part of the ITRA National League Challenge. Cutoff times are strictly enforced, and sweepers may remove very slow participants from the race. The event is not suitable for walkers. Aid stations are available on the longer distances. A headlamp is recommended and mandatory for the long distance. Winter trails, technical sections, no walkers permitted, mandatory equipment required, course changes possible, no dogs allowed.

name: Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank-Adventslauf
location: Zell an der Mosel, Cochem-Zell, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank Advent Run is an atmospheric race in Zell an der Mosel, traditionally held during Advent. The event offers runners a festive atmosphere and an attractive course through the picturesque Moselle landscape. The race is open to all ages and ability levels, combining sporting ambition with Christmas spirit.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Moselle landscape
Festive Advent atmosphere
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Multiple categories, registration from September to December, event on December 13, 2026

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. It is a true cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from top runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.

description: The Ter Specke Loop takes place in the beautiful, wooded surroundings of Sportpark Ter Specke in Lisse. The distinctive course is flat and sheltered, with the start on Spekkelaan and the finish on the athletics track. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with runners completing one to three laps. Families and the youngest participants can take part in the free 1 km GeZZinsloop, with a medal for everyone afterward. After the finish, runners are welcomed at the Health Square with fruit and water, provided by the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit.
course_highlights: Flat, sheltered course in a wooded setting
Start on Spekkelaan, finish on the athletics track
Distances of 1 km (GeZZinsloop), 5 km, 10 km and 15 km
additional: Registration takes place in the sports hall, with card payment. Separate changing rooms are available for women and men. Valuables can be left in a tent on the track. Massage may be available in the sports hall afterward. Parking is available on Spekkelaan, at the cycling track and on van Lyndenweg, as directed by parking attendants. Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like via the information desk; switching to the long distance is only possible through individual registration. Various distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 1 km kids' run), start and finish at Sportpark Ter Specke, on-site registration with card payment, free kids' run, massage available afterward

name: Urban City Run 053
description: The Urban City Run 053 takes place on December 13, 2026, in Enschede and offers participants a unique 5 km or 7.5 km exploratory run through the city centre. The start and finish are at Performance Factory, and the course takes you past attractive squares, streets and various buildings. This is not a race and there is no timekeeping, so you can enjoy the special moments along the way and take selfies. All participants receive a unique running shirt, which serves as their entry pass and must be worn. After the finish, you can chat together over food and drinks.
course_highlights: Varied course through Enschede city centre, including asphalt, carpet and grass
Run through various buildings and climb several staircases
Start and finish at Performance Factory
additional: Maximum of 2,000 participants. Start waves between 09:00 and 10:00; choose your start time when registering. Minimum age: 12. The running shirt is mandatory and serves as your entry pass. No race number. Parking is available at Performance Factory and Irenegarage (limited and paid). Bicycle parking at Performance Factory is limited. Changing facilities are available; there are no showers. Luggage storage is in the gymnasium and is at your own risk. No timekeeping and no minimum time. Start and finish at Performance Factory, start waves between 09:00 and 10:00, minimum age 12, no showers, luggage storage at your own risk.

name: Wintercross ASV Eibergen
description: The Wintercross ASV Eibergen is a challenging cross-country running event that is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. The race takes place in the beautiful natural area around Eibergen and offers distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The competition encourages runners of all ages to enjoy athletics in a welcoming and sporting environment. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs, ensuring a professional and friendly experience.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km
A natural and challenging cross-country course in Eibergen
Races for youth, seniors and masters
additional: The races start at 10:30 with the 10 km for seniors and masters. This is followed by various youth distances from 1 km to 5 km. The age reference date for youth and masters is the final race and the first race of the competition, respectively. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs from the region. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl, with on-site registration also possible; the event is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held at RCN campsite Zeewolde. It offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both beginners and experienced runners and is organised by TVZ Zeewolde, a sports club with a rich history in multisport and triathlon. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, with an emphasis on having fun and enjoying the event together.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN campsite Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners

Registration is required; the event takes place during the winter months and is suitable for the whole family.

name: Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestre
description: The Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestrecross is a classic cross-country race organised annually by AVR'69 in Reusel. The technical course features several hills and bends and is located at Burgemeester Willekenslaan. The race attracts a strong field, including many Belgian runners, and is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie. Before the race, there is a fun run open to everyone, starting at 1120 metres. The start and finish are at De Oude Brandtoren in Reusel.
course_highlights: Technical course with several hills
Plenty of bends
Located on Burgemeester Willekenslaan in Reusel
additional: Start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren, Burgemeester Willekenslaan 2, Reusel. The cross is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie, a series of 7 cross-country races in region 14 (Kempen). Medals are awarded to the first 3 participants in each race category. The short cross has 2 categories: Men and Women. Pupils without a competition licence or club membership may take part and can also reach the podium. Registration on the day of the race is not possible. Course with hills and bends; registration until 12 December; start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren; various categories, including a fun run for all ages.

The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.

Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity

Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

name: Santa Run
description: The Rotary Santa Run is a fun run where participants dress as Santa Claus and run or walk a course of approximately 3 kilometres for charity. The event was launched in 2008 by Rotary Club Gorinchem and has since grown into a nationwide phenomenon, with dozens of editions in the Netherlands and a few abroad. In 2019, Santa Runs were held in 58 cities, raising a combined total of more than €450,000 for over 100 good causes. The Rotary Santa Run aims for a uniform look and a powerful mass start on the Saturday before Christmas.
course_highlights: Short and simple course of approximately 3 km
Participants dressed as Santa Claus
Uniform nationwide look with simultaneous starts
additional: The Rotary Santa Run is organised by local Rotary Clubs, with support from a starter package that includes Santa suits, medals, race numbers, promotional materials and an online registration module. Each location has a minimum of 240 participants, and the event is preferably held on the Saturday before Christmas. The organisation is a turnkey concept, with an operations manual, an emergency plan and a uniform look. Participants dress as Santa Claus and support good causes; the event takes place in multiple cities and has a strong focus on charity and community spirit.

name: Avondkerstloop
description: The Avondkerstloop is a festive and sporty evening run held annually on the Saturday before Christmas in the illuminated village of Nispen. The unique start is inside the church on Kerkplein, after which participants run through atmospheric, illuminated streets. There are several distances, including a kids’ run, 5 km and 10 km, with medals for all finishers and prizes for the fastest runners. The organizers provide changing rooms, hot showers and a convivial prize ceremony at Café De Gouden Leeuw.
course_highlights: Start inside the church on Kerkplein
Run through the atmospheric, illuminated streets of Nispen
Finish on Kerkplein
additional: Race-number pickup and on-the-day registration are available from 16:00 at Café De Gouden Leeuw. Walkers can register between 14:00 and 16:00 and will receive a route. Changing rooms and hot showers are available at Sportpark de Wallen. Free parking is available in Nispen. Weekly group training sessions take place on Saturdays at 8:30 and Sundays at 9:00, starting from the open-air theatre. There is a maximum of 250 participants per distance. Start and registration at Café De Gouden Leeuw; training on Saturdays and Sundays; prizes for the fastest runners; facilities such as changing rooms and showers.

name: Gaasterlân Run
description: The Gaasterlân Run is a running event in Balk, Friesland, taking place on Saturday, December 19, 2026. The race offers four distances: 7.5 km, 12 km, a half marathon, and a full marathon. The routes pass through the beautiful, flat Gaasterland countryside, with the start and finish at Voetbal Vereniging Balk. The organizers provide aid stations along the course and use chip timing for accurate results. The Gaasterlân Run is a popular event that offers a rewarding challenge for runners of various levels.
course_highlights: Routes through the flat, wooded Gaasterland countryside
Start and finish at Voetbal Vereniging Balk
Aid stations: 1 for the 12 km, 2 for the half marathon, 4 for the full marathon
additional: Race bibs with timing chips. Bib transfers and distance changes are possible via the dashboard. Changing rooms and showers are available at vv Balk. The course is not closed to traffic; participants run at their own risk. Participants must follow the regulations and wear their race bib clearly visible. Morning start; GPS interference may occur in wooded areas. Several distances are available, including a marathon.

name: Capelse Tweedaagse
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Capelle Two-Day Walk 2026 is being organised for the 31st time by the Rotterdam Walking Association. The event takes place on Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 December in the beautiful surroundings of Capelle aan den IJssel. A range of distances is available, from 5 to 35 kilometres, with different routes each day. The walk is a great opportunity to get some fresh air and enjoy nature in December. The start is at the canteen of korfball club KCC, which opens at 8:00 a.m.; the walk starts from 9:00 a.m.
course_highlights: Different routes each day, ranging from 5 to 35 km
Rest stops are included on all routes
Special ferry across the Hollandse IJssel (subject to change)
additional: The canteen of korfball club KCC accepts PIN payments only. Groups of 10 or more receive a 10% discount. Members of the national association and members of other clubs receive a discount on the entry fee. The start office closes at 4:30 p.m. Walking booklets will be stamped and given a coloured sticker. There is a special medal with a pin for participants in both days. Discounts are available for groups and members; starts from 8:00 a.m.; start times are between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m.; routes are available for one or two days; rest stops are included on all routes.

name: Hollands Duin Ultra
description: The Hollands Duin Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through the protected Hollands Duin nature reserve on the coast near Noordwijk. The route takes you through dunes and along the beach, with sandy paths and elevation changes that make the course extra challenging. The start and finish are at Vrijstaat Nederzandt, a welcoming venue right on the beach. There are three aid stations during the race, and all participants receive a tracker for live tracking. This ultra is part of the Dutch Ultra Series and offers a wonderful experience of the area’s natural beauty.
course_highlights: Route through dunes and along the beach on sandy paths
Aid stations at 17 km, 29 km, 40 km and 45 km
Start and finish at Vrijstaat Nederzandt by the beach
additional: Participants receive a GPX file three days before the event. No plastic cups are available; participants must bring their own cup/bottle or can purchase a Trail Running Racecup from the organizers. Race registration is open from 08:00 to 09:00. Participants must finish before 17:00. Parking is available in a large car park 200 meters from the start location. Route through dunes and along the beach, unpaved paths, medal, live tracking, participation in Racecup Trailrunning, maximum capacity of 905 participants

description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.

The races take place in November and December, with the Christmas Run bringing the series to a close.

Routes approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km long per race

description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-standing event in the Langenhain Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, held during the winter season from November to February. The series consists of five dates, when runners and walkers can complete the challenging, varied 10 km or 20 km course. The 10 km route is permanently signposted, while the 20 km loop is marked seasonally. The event is open to everyone; no registration is required and there is no entry fee. Participants start individually and run together without timing, emphasizing the community aspect.

20 km route with a seasonally marked second loop
Refreshments include warm tea along the route and coffee and biscuits in the sports hall

Hoonhorst, the race follows mostly unpaved paths past historic estates and through varied woodland and meadows. This race is a regular fixture in the Sallands Cross Circuit and offers a sporty, sociable way to run toward the end of the year.

The event is organised with the help of service club Tafelronde 168 and athletics club A.V. Flevo Delta, and is open to everyone, including people who are not members of an athletics club. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The race is part of the Noord-Hollands Crosskampioenschap and is known for its warm atmosphere, professional chip timing, and personal touch, with names printed on race numbers.
