description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track

Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit

The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race number. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. A discounted combined entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race number and a prize draw. The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.

Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg in ’t Veld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus 16 km walking
Coffee stop for walkers at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel
additional: Race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday evening before the race or on race day. Timing is recorded using a MyLaps chip in the race number; personal chips are not permitted. Volunteer traffic marshals accompany the race. Immediately after finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert. The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

location: Sportpark SV Heeten, Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Midwintercross in Heeten is a regional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and is organised by SV Heeten. The 54th edition takes place on Sunday, 3 January 2027, at Sportpark SV Heeten. The course runs through the sports park and the woods around Schoonheten, with approximately 70 per cent unpaved terrain and gentle elevation changes. The routes offer green landscapes and wooded sections, and the prize winners are honoured in an annual ceremony after the race. The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a regular cross-country race in the region.

Approximately 70% unpaved terrain with gentle elevation changes
Green landscapes and wooded sections along the route

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event management and sport, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to competition.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides phone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as assistance on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. Available information concerns the fifth edition, held on January 4, 2026; there are no confirmed details about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

Participants start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the city streets, including Piotrkowska Street. It’s an opportunity to start the year actively and run in a festive atmosphere. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.

Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
The route includes Piotrkowska Street
additional: The sources refer to the 10th edition, held on 6 January 2026; they do not confirm a date of 5 January 2027.

name: Ultra CK Maraton

description: Ultra CK Marathon is a demanding ultra race of approximately 51 km with around 1,520 m of elevation gain, held in Kielce. The event also offers shorter races: Czarci Oddech, 15 km with 422 m of elevation gain, and the MTB cycling route Upiorna Trzydziestka, 30 km with 828 m of elevation gain. The event is aimed at enthusiasts of challenges and varied forms of sporting suffering, and is organized by the Świętokrzyskie Mountain Biking Association MTBCross Kielce. The start and race office are located at Hala Legionów in Kielce. Participants in the longest-distance race must carry mandatory safety equipment.

The race office is located at Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce. Participants in Piekielna Pętla are required to carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.

The resort has a swimming area, a beach and sports courts in Nowy Dębiec. Information about distances and routes is from the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Hulst by Lightrun
description: Hulst by Lightrun is a friendly running and walking event held in Hulst. It takes place on the third Friday evening of every month and offers a sociable atmosphere for participants of different levels. The route winds through Hulst’s charming streets, making it a unique experience for runners and walkers. It’s an accessible event that combines sport and conviviality.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes through Hulst’s charming streets
Friendly, relaxed atmosphere
Monthly event on the third Friday evening
additional: The event takes place on the third Friday evening of every month. It is an accessible running and walking event with a sociable atmosphere. A friendly running and walking event, held every third Friday evening.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, with woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills. Distances of 5 km and 9 km are available for different age categories, with timing provided without a chip. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit
additional: Maximum 300 participants per race. Timing without a chip. No showers or changing rooms available. Juniors run approximately 5 km; seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos will be published after the race. Course on unpaved paths; no showers or changing rooms; maximum 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest race in Klijndijk, organised from the Udik village hall. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.

Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area
additional: There is a €100 cash prize for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30.59 for men and 35.43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. The route passes hunebeds and includes forest and road sections. Registration is available in advance and on the day. Prizes are offered for breaking the course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organised by Atletiekvereniging Holten and part of the SNS CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37, in Holten. The varied course includes a few crossings over paved roads and a short stretch of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge. There is ample parking, first aid is available, and a speaker adds to the atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with a few crossings over paved roads
Around 500 metres of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge
Start and finish at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Ample parking, first aid and a speaker are available during the event. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes and includes a few crossings over paved roads and brick paving that can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities including registration at the MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid and sound equipment.

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: Zimní běh na Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on 16 January 2027. The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with significant climbs, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with cosy facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: The 19.9 km main race with 542 m of elevation gain over Velký and Malý Blaník
The 11.2 km accompanying race with 238 m of elevation gain and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations along the route in Býkovice and by the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the Načeradec Municipal Office building, approximately 270 m from the race facilities. Parking is available in several designated areas, marked with traffic signs and assisted by volunteer firefighters. The race is limited to 700 runners. The organisers offer free secure storage for valuables in the changing rooms at the primary school. The accompanying race starts at 10:45. The entry fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. In adverse circumstances, the race may be modified to individual starts or postponed. Online registration is available, with entry-fee refunds possible until 31.12.2026. The race takes place in January and has a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The route runs mostly along forest and field tracks. The main race starts at 10:10.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.

description: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race is a winter running festival held in Gdynia, offering six distances from 5 km to over 76 km. The courses pass through scenic areas with significant elevation gains, combining sporting competition with natural beauty and a unique atmosphere. The event is organized by the ULTRA WAY Foundation and features courses with checkpoints and aid stations, as well as professional timing and participant safety measures. It is an event for runners of varying experience levels who want to take on challenging courses and winter conditions.

additional: The start and finish of all races are located at the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium, ul. Kazimierza Górskiego 10. Buses take participants to the start of the longest distances from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre (paid transport; advance registration required). The time limit for completing the longest distance is 15 hours, and for the 50 km distance it is 11 hours. The DZIKI DUET race is run in pairs. Aid and hydration stations are available on the course (except on the shortest distances). The race has an ITRA 4 classification, UTMB 100K status, and 3 Mountain points.

description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, organized since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on routes adapted to their age. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. The organizers also provide prizes for the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year

The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different ability levels.

Courses suited to runners of different ability levels

The event attracts cross-country skiing enthusiasts of all ages and also offers activities for children and families, such as dog-sled rides and a play zone. After the races, there is an awards ceremony and a quiz with prizes from sponsors. This sporting event has a unique atmosphere, combining competition with community spirit.

description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen featuring a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes run mostly along unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a woodland area of approximately 100 hectares. The start, refreshments and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The lap is just over 7 km, with six laps making up the full marathon. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Route mostly along unpaved paths in the Asserbos
Start, refreshments and finish at the AAC'61 athletics track
Lap of just over 7 km; six laps for the marathon

Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink. Changing rooms are available at the venue at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published afterwards on the club page. Unpaved paths, registration in advance and on the day, changing rooms available.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a series of three running races held in November, January and February around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer running distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1,000 metres on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km, starting at the same time as the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a canteen are also available. The race features official timing and a nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas.

Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
A range of distances for beginner and experienced runners, including youth races on the track

A free massage is available afterwards in the AAV'36 massage room (bring your own towel). Youth race keepsakes are free; other keepsakes and stamp cards for taking part in all three races are available for a fee. First aid is available on the track and course. The canteen is open and a limited number of lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers; course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas; traffic-free course; start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track; changing rooms and showers available; free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht, offering a scenic and varied running experience in the Groene Hart.

Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Groene Hart

Kickers ‘69. It takes place on 17 January 2027 from 11:00 to 14:00, with several running options and a convivial atmosphere for participants of all ages.

description: The Leemkuilcross is one of the most beautiful cross-country races in the Netherlands, organised by NSAV ’t Haasje and AV Cifla. It takes place on a hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal and is known for its challenging nature, particularly the notorious staircase. The race offers several distances for children, young people and adults, and attracts athletes who enjoy a tough cross-country race. Race bibs can be collected at the Berg en Dal tennis club, and parking is limited. The Leemkuilcross takes place annually on the third Sunday in January.
course_highlights: Hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal
Laps around the Leemkuil, with the notorious staircase as a challenge
Distances ranging from 1200m to 8400m
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the canteen of the Berg en Dal tennis club, Molenbosweg 10. Parking is limited. Late registration is possible until just over half an hour before the start of the relevant race, at a higher cost. Prize ceremonies take place immediately after each event. Cancellations are possible up to one week before the event, subject to an administration fee. The course is a hilly, unpaved woodland route with the notorious staircase; registration is possible until one week before the event; prices include registration fees and late registration is available.

name: Watermolenloop
description: The Watermolenloop in Haaksbergen is a popular running race that attracts many sports enthusiasts every year. The race takes place in a welcoming setting, with a varied course that runs through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen. The 2026 edition drew enthusiastic runners early in the morning, despite the chilly weather, which only added to the sporting atmosphere. The event is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH) and is a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners.

A traditional event with a sporting and friendly atmosphere
additional: The Watermolenloop is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH). The event takes place in January and attracts a wide range of runners. It has a sporting and friendly atmosphere, even in cold weather. The race is part of Haaksbergen’s local sporting activities. The Watermolenloop draws sports enthusiasts to Haaksbergen and is known for a route past the Oostendorper Watermill and through the Lankheterbos, with support from volunteers and safety services.

The race office, start and finish are at the Primary School in Burzyn, where changing rooms, bag storage and showers are available. There are overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories.

The race offers courses for adults of approximately 5 to 7 km and shorter courses for young runners from 0.5 to 3 km, which may be adjusted depending on the weather. The race starts in Malé Svatoňovice, where race check-in and the race office are also located. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and is part of a series in which the five best races count towards the score. The organiser prioritises safety, including mandatory reflective gear for all participants.
course_highlights: A 5 to 7 km course for adults in the Jestřebí Mountains region
Short 0.5 to 3 km courses for young runners, which may be adjusted depending on the weather
Start and check-in in Malé Svatoňovice (SŠBPA)
additional: Check-in until 9:30, children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main race starts immediately after the children finish. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in all weather conditions and at participants’ own risk. All runners must wear reflective gear. The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. The races are open to the general public; registration is available 15 minutes before the start. Reflective gear is required, and weather may affect course conditions.

name: 11 Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański
description: The Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański is a challenging mountain race held in Sobótka, covering 42.6 km with approximately 1,130 m of elevation gain. A half marathon is also held as part of the event, covering 23.9 km with approximately 575 m of elevation gain. The course runs through scenic mountain terrain, offering participants unique challenges and beautiful views. The event has a long-standing tradition and is popular among mountain runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance: 42.6 km with ±1,130 m of elevation gain
Half marathon distance: 23.9 km with ±575 m of elevation gain
Mountain course with scenic views and a challenging profile
additional: The event includes two races: a marathon and a half marathon. The attendance record is 714 people (2020). The marathon and half-marathon course records are listed with the athletes’ names and times. GPX routes are available for both distances. The event’s Facebook page provides a GPX track of the course.

name: Zimowy Półmaraton Gór Stołowych
location: Centrum Szkoleniowo-Edukacyjne Parku Narodowego Gór Stołowych, Karłów, Poland
description: The Stołowe Mountains Winter Half Marathon is a challenging 21 km mountain race held in winter conditions in the scenic Stołowe Mountains. The route follows hiking trails with numerous rocks, turns and significant elevation gains. It is often covered in snow and ice, requiring participants to be in good shape and have sound technique. The start and finish are located at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre and the Shelter on Szczeliniec, which can be reached only under your own power. The race is part of a series of mountain running events and takes place whatever the weather, with mandatory equipment and environmental rules.
course_highlights: The route follows hiking trails in Poland’s Stołowe Mountains
Significant elevation gains, many rocks and turns, and potentially heavy snow and ice
The finish is at the Shelter on Szczeliniec, accessible only on foot
additional: The time limit for completing the route is 5 hours. There are 2 checkpoints with refreshment stations and time cutoffs: Parking under Szczeliniec (6.7 km, cutoff 2:30 hours) and Błędne Skały (13.6 km, cutoff 4:00 hours). Participants may use snowshoes. Race packs can be collected at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre in Karłów on Friday and Saturday morning. After the race, a recovery meal, an awards ceremony and a prize draw for prizes from partners are planned. Deposits weighing up to 3 kg can be left at the finish, but valuables and documents must not be left. The start is at 09:00; the finish time limit is 5 hours. Snow and ice may occur on the route in winter; snowshoes are permitted. There are two checkpoints on the route with refreshment stations and time cutoffs.

The race takes place in the scenic Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, offering participants a nighttime atmosphere and a memorable running experience. It is a great opportunity to test yourself on a marathon or half-marathon course surrounded by nature. The event has become a tradition and is attracting growing interest among runners from the region.

The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
Organized by the experienced Ultra Team—runners for runners
additional: According to the available information, the participant limit is 250: 170 for the half marathon and 80 for the marathon. The program includes a race pack, a hot meal, prizes for the women's and men's overall categories, and a medal for every participant.

description: The 20th WOŚP “Measure Up to Diabetes” Run is a charity race in Warsaw, held as part of the 35th Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. It combines sporting activity with support for the Grand Finale’s cause and invites everyone to run together for a good cause. The event is scheduled for January 23, 2027, in Warsaw.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon in Chwałowice, held in a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through forest and countryside, offering a chance to run away from the bustle of the city. One local landmark along the route is Napoleon’s Stone. It’s an event for people who enjoy relaxed running meetups and a cross-country feel.
course_highlights: A forest and countryside route around Chwałowice
Passes by Napoleon’s Stone
A small-scale race with a cross-country feel
additional: Available sources describe previous editions and a historical series of four marathons in 2024; they do not confirm details of the edition scheduled for January 23, 2027.

Winter scenery in Leśnica
A challenge for runners who prefer demanding terrain

description: The Gewoon COOP Crossloop in Luttenberg is a popular, traditional cross-country race and part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Since 1976, participants have run through the forests and hills of Luttenberg on a challenging course that is largely unpaved and includes steep climbs, including the famous climb to the bench. Combining a unique atmosphere, a demanding course and a rich history, the race offers an unforgettable experience for all ages.
course_highlights: Course is 70% unpaved
Notorious climb to the famous bench
Route through forests and over hills, with views of the Sallandse Heuvelrug
additional: Race bibs are personal for the entire season and must be brought to every race. Spikes are not allowed because they could damage the timing mats. Participants receive a unique Sallands Cross Circuit running shirt when they register. The cross-country race features several distances, with start times between 10:45 and 12:40. The start and finish are at Gemeenschapscentrum Elckerlyc, Butzelaarstraat 22. The event offers various distances for all ages, including a final stretch past the Lourdes grotto. The event is sponsored by Charlot Jalink of Gewoon Coop and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Halve Marathon Zoetermeer
description: The Halve Marathon Zoetermeer is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 24 January 2027. The 14th edition offers four distances: the 1.5 km Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The routes pass through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark, Balijbos, and the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker, on a fast, straightforward course. The event is suitable for all ages, with a special focus on school competitions and a business run for teams.

Course through the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker
Clear, colour-coded kilometre markers for each distance

There is a school competition for the 1.5 km Kids Run and a business run for teams in the 5 km. The half marathon has mandatory time cut-offs at certain points on the course to allow roads to be reopened to traffic. Parking arrangements are in place, and volunteers are being sought for the event. Multiple distances, registration details, running shirts available to order, a colour-coded course, and timing and pace limits for the half marathon.

description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running races organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Runners’ Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting atmosphere. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active outdoors through the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. The races take place in different towns between October and March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Off-road running in autumn and winter conditions
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon takes place on a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The races are co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County and are held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, comes from a running calendar; the organizer’s available pages do not yet confirm details of this edition in Grudna.

description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each 7.033 km long, held at different locations around Jelcz-Laskowice and Oława. The event combines running and Nordic walking, with a shared start and electronic timing. Participants can collect their race packets the day before the first stage or on race day. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice and supported by local authorities and partners, including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland.

Courses in different localities: Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików, Miłoszyce

The organizers welcome both younger and older runners, dividing participants into age categories.

A road race and mountain half marathon in the winter setting of Jaworze
Age categories from 16 and up, including M20, M30 and M60

It takes place in January, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organiser provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.

Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski

The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.

Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity

description: The 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Świerklaniec is a special charity event organised jointly with the Świerklaniec Municipality. As part of the finale, the 3rd Run in Funny Costumes takes place, with participants covering a route of approximately 2 kilometres in amusing and unusual outfits. The event combines sporting fun with a rich arts programme and numerous attractions for the whole family. The fundraising goal is the diagnosis and treatment of digestive tract diseases in children. In the evening, the symbolic “Light to the Sky” illuminates the park in Świerklaniec.
course_highlights: Approximately 2 km route through the park in Świerklaniec
Run in amusing and unusual costumes
Symbolic “Light to the Sky” at 20:00
additional: Participants receive a commemorative medal, and the creators of the most original and funniest costumes are rewarded. Adults and minors may take part, with parental or guardian consent required for minors. After the run, numerous attractions are available, including a bonfire with free sausages in exchange for a donation to a WOŚP collection box, dance performances, a food area, first-aid lessons, a children’s play area, and free admission to the Pałac Kawalera. Registration is via a Google form, and payment is made through the WOŚP Tarnogórskie Stowarzyszenie Obywatelskie e-collection box. Minors may participate with the consent of and under the supervision of a parent or guardian; participation is at the participant’s own risk.

name: Bieruński Bieg Utopca
description: The Bieruń “Utopiec” Run is a cross-country race promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, held in Bieruń. The event brings the running community together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Competitors can choose between two distances: 17 km (the main race) and 5 km (running and Nordic walking). The course features varied surfaces, along with numerous uphill and downhill sections. The start and finish are in Bieruń’s Market Square, alongside a Family Sports Picnic with activities for children and local exhibitors.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with varied surfaces
Numerous uphill and downhill sections
Start and finish in Bieruń’s Market Square
additional: The race package includes a personalised race bib, a commemorative T-shirt and a medal featuring a depiction of the “Utopiec” that changes each year. The race office is located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street, about 400 metres from the Market Square. The event also features a Family Sports Picnic with local artists, sports clubs, handicrafts, food products, activities for children and an awards ceremony. Previous editions offered 17 km and 5 km distances, with Nordic walking also available on the shorter distance. The race package included a bib, commemorative T-shirt and medal; the race office was located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street. Details of the 24 January 2027 edition are not provided in the available materials.

Participants can choose from several walking distances and an 11 km run, which was shortened in 2026 due to weather conditions. The finish is in Nowa Wieś Wielka, where the awards ceremony, refreshments and a campfire get-together take place. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the start locations, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and access to aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: The running and walking rally routes pass through the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Aid stations are located in Łażyn and before the finish
additional: Race packs are handed out one hour before the start in the start area. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. Time is recorded before the railway crossing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish to the start locations (Plaża Piecki and Solec Kujawski). Hot drinks, firefighters’ pea soup and a campfire are available at the finish. A mobile bag drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Separate classifications are held for women and men, with awards for the top 5 runners and the top 3 participants in the walking rally. Information in the sources describes earlier editions, including an 11 km run from Plaża Piecki to Nowa Wieś Wielka and bus transport from the finish to the car parks by the beach.

The event follows a regular schedule and has a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.

The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing the city and nature together

description: The X Around the Table Run is a commemorative recreational running event organized by the “Pszczelnik” Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Siemianowice Śląskie. The event involves covering a distance of 1 km, or 117 laps around a table, without touching it. The run takes place in the sports hall of the “Michał” Sports Complex and is divided into two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men. Participants start in heats of 6, and at the end all those who complete the run in accordance with the regulations receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: 1 km distance — 117 laps around a table
The run takes place in the sports hall of the “Michał” Sports Complex
Competition in two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men
additional: Entries are accepted by email until January 21, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. After that deadline, entries can be made on the day of the event from 9:00 to 9:40 a.m. using an entry form. Participants start in heats of 6. Trophies are provided for the winners, and commemorative medals for everyone who completes the run. In the edition described, participants started in heats of 6. The age categories were born in 2013 or later and born in 2012 or earlier, with separate classifications for women and men. This information concerns the 2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg z Puszką dla WOŚP
description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: XX Indywidualny Bieg dla WOŚP
description: The 20th Individual Run for WOŚP in Radom is an annual running event organized to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. The race takes place on city routes that combine sporting competition with bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and comprehensive technical support, ensuring participants’ comfort and safety. The event is for runners of various ability levels and promotes an active lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: City route in Radom
Professional RFID electronic timekeeping
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Timekeeping and technical support are provided by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events with many years of experience. The event uses RFID technology to ensure accurate timekeeping. Results from previous editions and a complaints form are available on the website. The event is part of a broader calendar of races organized by Time-Sport.pl in the region.

description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country trail races held in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km and elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres, respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place on a loop in Modrzew Forest, offering technically challenging routes. Each stage of the series offers a cast medal and a meal for participants, and the overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. The event promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on the running loops
Scenic woodland with technical cross-country sections
additional: The event base is at Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street, Łódź. Mass start with electronic timing. A cast medal and a meal are provided to every participant at each stage. A free stage is available when registering for the whole series. The overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. Parking is limited; parking near the Sanctuary of St Anthony of Padua and Blessed Father Rafał Chyliński, and by the shrine at the junction of Okólna and Wycieczkowa streets, is recommended. A medal and a meal are provided at the finish. In the 2026/2027 season, the overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. The date 24.01.2027 does not appear in the published schedule; the nearest scheduled stages are 17.01.2027 and 14.02.2027.

description: Rondje Roege Baarg is an atmospheric cross-country run and walking event organised by Hardloopclub Onstwedde in collaboration with Stichting Wandelen in Westerwolde. The running routes range from 6.4 to 22.8 kilometres and pass through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, including Ter Wupping, Veele and Wessinghuizen. Walkers can enjoy a marked 10-kilometre route with a refreshment station. The start and finish are at MFA de Bast in Onstwedde, which also has changing and shower facilities. After the event, participants can enjoy delicious snert from slagerij Hemmen.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, with routes of 6.4, 11.3, 18.9 and 22.8 km
Three refreshment stations along the route for runners
10 km walking route marked with yellow arrows, with one refreshment station
additional: Start and finish at MFA de Bast, with changing and shower facilities. Manual timekeeping; results available via uitslagen.nl. Dogs are not allowed. Snert is served to all participants after the event. Walkers can start between 10:30 and 11:30. Walkers can get their walking book stamped. An emergency phone number is available for walkers. Walking route of 10 km; running distances from 6.4 km to 22.8 km; start and finish at MFA De Bast; changing and shower facilities; advance registration open until 24 January; participation at your own risk; dogs are not allowed.

name: 19e Rhoonse Griendentocht
description: The 19th Rhoonse Grienden Tour is a beautiful walking tour that takes place in Rhoon on Saturday, January 30. Organized by the Royal Dutch Walking Association (KWbN), it gives walkers the opportunity to enjoy a healthy and rewarding walking experience in beautiful surroundings. The tour is suitable for both beginners and experienced walkers and promotes physical activity and well-being.
course_highlights: Walk through the Rhoon nature reserve and surrounding area
Options to take part on two days
Discover local landscapes and historic surroundings
additional: Participants who want to take part on both days can register for both days using the form: first register for Saturday, then use “+ add participant” to register for Sunday as well. Wandel.nl is an initiative of KWbN, the Netherlands’ largest walking organization, which inspires and supports walkers. Two-day participation, registration forms, membership discounts

The course runs through picturesque surroundings, with the museum in Radeč as the start location. The event is suitable for all ages and for runners who want to enjoy a winter run in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the museum in Radeč
Part of the Winter Running League, with the entry fee valid for the entire series
Race courses for children and adults

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age groups. The event is co-funded by the City of Poznań budget. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

The race features beautiful, scenic routes that encourage outdoor activity in a winter setting. The organisers place particular emphasis on the cross-country nature of the course and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

description: Gliwice Park Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amateur Running Enthusiasts’ Club “Pędziwiatr.” The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation and take place on Saturdays in Gliwice’s municipal forest. Each lap is 4,219.5 metres long and runs mainly on forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, or approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon, in either the running or Nordic Walking event.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5-metre lap through Gliwice’s municipal forest
The route runs mainly on forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt
A drinks refreshment point at the start/finish line after each lap
additional: Events take place once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants can choose 1 to 5 laps (approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon) and may take part in both disciplines. After the event, participants return their race numbers and receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a snack bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. There is a “persistent participants” classification for those who take part in at least 9 events. Race numbers are valid for the entire year and assigned to individual participants. Anyone changing disciplines must register again and collect a new race number. The organizer publishes separate regulations for the park events and e-Prowokacja. description: Przybij Piątkę is a winter 5 km race organised by Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl. 90% of the course is on unpaved surfaces, and the route is not officially certified. The race is free, and every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal. Trophies will be awarded to the top finishers. The participant limit is 200.

90% unpaved surface

description: The Winter Running Series in Hamm is a traditional running event held at the Hamm-Ost sports centre by Jahnstadion. The officially measured out-and-back course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the spa gardens in Bad Hamm. The series includes several races over different distances, including 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon, with individual-race and series rankings. Timing is provided by the Race Result system, and awards are presented to the fastest runners as well as age-group prize winners.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back course in accordance with international competition rules
The course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and Bad Hamm spa gardens
Start and finish on the tartan track at Jahnstadion
additional: Timing is provided by the Race Result system using a chip in the race bib. A €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib with chip (refunded upon return), and a €1.00 donation goes to the support association for the hospice in Hamm. Youths and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). Awards ceremonies take place approximately 45 minutes after the finish in the marquee at Jahnstadion. The event comprises a series of three 10 km races held in Hamm’s natural landscape and spa gardens. Registration is online, timing is provided by Race Result, and awards are given to the top participants and series winners.

The races run through the wintery Hilden City Forest and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds. Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, and late entries are possible on site.

description: Rondje Oeken is a welcoming, small-scale running event held in the beautiful countryside around Oeken and Brummen. The route passes along rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths, and is fully marked and largely traffic-free. The event is open to all levels, from beginners to keen runners, and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, where ample parking is also available.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery with rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths
Fully marked and largely traffic-free course
Start and finish at De Vroolijke Frans, Knoevenoordstraat 51, Brummen

You can register using the registration form on the website, either in advance or on the day. The event is welcoming and focused on a friendly atmosphere, sportsmanship and safety, with experienced volunteers and first aid on site. The course varies from unpaved paths to trail; there is a children's run, and registration is available on the day. The start is at De Vroolijke Frans.

name: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop
description: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop is a welcoming and well-organized running race in Uithoorn, known for its varied and safe course. The race attracts many participants each year, including long-distance runners and children, and is supported by a large group of volunteers and traffic marshals. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and offers a festive day of sport, with a focus on participants and a special anniversary atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and safe course
Special atmosphere and good organization
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The race is supported by around 125 volunteers and more than 50 traffic marshals. Participants are catered for with water stations along the course, fruit and a memento at the finish. At the 40th anniversary, special treats were handed out, including cream cakes and flower bulbs. There are multiple distances, including a children’s race and special categories, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl; the course runs through Uithoorn and the surrounding area, with traffic marshals and measures to minimize disruption.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances ranging from 1.4 to 15 kilometers
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; late registration is available on race day from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at Semmelweisstraat 46, IKC De Wooldermarke. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday between 3:00 and 5:00 p.m. or on race day. The race number includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall on Woolderesweg, which closes at 1:15 p.m. A running shirt and medal can optionally be ordered during pre-registration and collected with the race number or after the finish. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with the start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as cash and gift vouchers. The race takes place on 31 January 2027 and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a series of cross-country races in the Oss region.

The races take place on Sundays at 10:00, offering an active way to spend the weekend amid scenic surroundings.

name: Bieg Wedla
description: Bieg Wedla is a non-profit running event organized by enthusiasts from the PTTK Warsaw-Praga Branch. It takes place in the picturesque Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw. The routes follow a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths, and participants can enjoy the special atmosphere and historic park. The event is held in winter, which gives it a unique character, while the organizers take care to minimize its impact on the environment and local residents. After the race, participants receive medals and gifts, and can also enjoy free pea soup and hot tea.
course_highlights: Running routes on a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths
Picturesque, historic Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw
Routes covered with compacted snow and sand, providing winter running conditions
additional: Starts are held over various distances: Nordic walking at 10:00; O-run from 10:30 to 12:00; running routes of 1.86 km (for children and young people up to age 15), 5.43 km, and 9 km; and a 250 m route for children up to age 7. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected in the days before the race at the Decathlon City store in Warsaw, or on event day at the Drukarz Sports Club. After the race, participants receive medals and a gift. Free pea soup (including a vegetarian option) and hot tea are available on site, but water is not provided. Parking is available in public spaces around the park; vehicles are not permitted to enter the park. Archived results confirm that the event has been held regularly from 2011 to 2026. The distances and schedule provided are for the 2026 edition; registration and fee details for 2027 are not available.

additional: Entry is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The league runs from October 2026 to April 2027, with several event dates. This is the 2026/2027 season series. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

name: Zimowy Bieg Zbója
description: The Zimowy Bieg Zbója is a mountain race in Bielsko-Biała inspired by the legend of the Klimczok outlaw. The course follows scenic but demanding mountain trails, offering participants exceptional views and an intense challenge. The 18 km and 13 km distances, with substantial elevation gain, will test every runner’s strength and determination. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season in a winter setting and experience the atmosphere of a true mountain race.
course_highlights: 18 km course with 996 m of elevation gain, starting below the Szyndzielnia cable car
Klimczok summit as the course’s high point
A fast, rugged descent that demands stamina and courage
additional: The Zbójnik 18 km starts at 09:00, and the Piechur 13 km at 09:45. GPX files of the routes are available to download. The entry fee depends on the payment date, not the registration date. Payment by PayU, PayPal, or bank transfer is available. Organizer: Alpas Artur Sarosiek, Bielsko-Biała. Registration for the 2027 edition is open. Detailed elevation figures and route information are based on descriptions from previous editions.

description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event held on the first weekend of February. It offers several distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, and shorter distances such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic locations such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its welcoming organisation, beautiful natural scenery, and a broad field of participants, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 metres off-road across the Kootwijkerzand
Route through a Natura 2000 area, passing Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, with its highest point at 100 metres above sea level
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. There is a welcome with coffee or tea and a treat, followed after the race by pea soup with rye bread and bacon, or a vegetarian option. The 10EM starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. Start corrals for the 10EM are assigned based on expected finish time. The marathon is limited to 700 participants and registration closes once this limit is reached. There is no on-the-day registration. The 10EM has a maximum of 4,200 participants. There are several refreshment stations and medical support. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live runner tracking. Several distances, including the Kidsrun, 8 km and marathon; event in February 2027; registration opens in October 2026.

name: Blaauwbek Marathon
description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is an atmospheric winter marathon around Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transport from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course across the airfield. In addition to running events, there are 10 km and 20 km walking routes and special distances for children. The organizers provide warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around Oldambtmeer, with beautiful scenery and trails
Separate start and finish locations, with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course across the airfield for the 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The finish closes at 16:30 for both marathon distances. Children start the 5 km at 15:30. Walkers can start independently after receiving their route. The event offers various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after several years’ absence and is marked by a winter theme and a convivial atmosphere.

name: Erpelkappersloop
description: The Erpelkappersloop in Axel is a traditional race organized annually by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an enjoyable, sporty experience in beautiful surroundings. It is part of a series of events organized by the club, which is known for its varied and well-organized running activities. The Erpelkappersloop promises a sociable and challenging running experience during the winter season.
course_highlights: Organized in Axel, a charming location
A traditional race with a sporty atmosphere
Part of a series of events organized by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas
additional: The race takes place on February 6, 2027, and is aimed at a broad range of runners.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country race set in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race takes place in Ees and offers two distances: a short route of approximately 5 km and a long route of approximately 9 km, both along unpaved paths through woodland and heathland. The route passes along narrow paths, several glacial pits and the storm-damaged forest with fallen trees, making for an adventurous run surrounded by nature. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course, except for two crossings of cycle paths
Route through narrow heathland paths and several challenging glacial pits
Passage through the mysterious storm-damaged forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. No shower or changing facilities are available. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and convivial race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, a festive after-party takes place in the Sarto clubhouse, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: The course runs partly through Stadsbos 013
A 5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
Children’s race of 1,111 metres
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via your personal dashboard. Bib transfers and resales are permitted via the official platform. After the finish, there is a convivial after-party in the Sarto clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to creatively dressed participants, and there is a costume prize for the children’s race. Timing is recorded via a chip in the bib, with results available online shortly afterwards. Registration is via the website; the course runs partly through Stadsbos 013; expect a festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organised during carnival in Tilburg.

name: Běh po cyklostezce
description: Běh po cyklostezce is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in Úpice, near the tennis courts by the Elbe River, and is part of the Winter Running League. The main race starts immediately after the children’s categories finish, creating a friendly atmosphere for all age groups. Participants can enjoy a run in a scenic setting, with high-quality organization and a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the tennis courts in Úpice
The course follows the cycle path along the Elbe River
Part of the Winter Running League, with children’s categories
additional: Check-in until 9:30. The main race starts immediately after the children’s categories finish. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in February 2027. Registration is available on-site or via the website. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, and the start is by the tennis courts in Úpice.
