The event takes place in Żory, with participants competing on different routes suited to various skill levels and team or individual formats. It engages whole families and promotes outdoor activity, bringing sport together with adventure and nature. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive routes that require fitness, navigation skills, and teamwork.
course_highlights: PROFI route: 130–150 km, midnight start, running, cycling, water stages, and special tasks; 16-hour time limit
OPEN route: 60–80 km, two-person teams, running and cycling with technical challenges; 6-hour time limit
BIEG route: approximately 20 km orienteering run in forest areas; 5-hour time limit
additional: Routes for different categories: PROFI (two-person teams, 130–150 km, 16-hour limit), OPEN (two-person teams, 60–80 km, 6-hour limit), ROWER (individual competition, 40–50 km, 5-hour limit), BIEG (individual 20 km orienteering run, 5-hour limit), RODZINNA (recreational 5–8 km route, no classification, free entry). The event is organized in cooperation with MOSiR Żory and Hufiec ZHP Żory. Participants must demonstrate navigation skills and physical fitness. The PROFI route starts at midnight. The event has a family-friendly, adventurous character. Details of the 2027 edition, including routes and fees, have not been confirmed in available sources. The 2025 edition was based at the MOSiR Sports and Entertainment Hall in Żory.

name: XI Kuźniański Półmaraton Leśny
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Kuźni Raciborskiej

price_tiers.distance: Kuźniańska Leśna Zadyszka - bieg na 10 km
Dyszka z kija - marsz nordic walking

description: The 11th Kuźniański »Rafamet« Forest Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. The main race, a half marathon (21.0975 km), follows scenic forest trails, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and fresh air. The event also includes a 10 km race and a 10 km Nordic walking event, creating a unique sporting atmosphere. It is organized by the Municipal Centre for Culture, Sport and Recreation in Kuźnia Raciborska, which invites everyone to share in this special event.
course_highlights: The route follows forest trails
Enjoy nature and fresh air
Scenic natural surroundings
additional: The event includes three activities: a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 10 km Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Municipal Centre for Culture, Sport and Recreation in Kuźnia Raciborska. The event takes place at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. Registration is conducted separately for each activity. The start is scheduled at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. An available source for the 11th edition gives the date as 11 April, which does not match the stated event date of 10 April 2027.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of cross-country races organised by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association. The event combines a passion for running with an active lifestyle, promoting health, integration and the joy of physical activity. The races are open to all age groups and ability levels, and participation in the Grand Prix series is free. The organisers foster a supportive community that inspires people to get moving, making the event welcoming and accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A series of cross-country races in Mysłowice
Several races make up the Grand Prix edition
Results and standings for each race are published by the organiser
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation is free. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels. The race regulations are available on the organiser’s website.

name: XVIII Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury Sportu i Rekreacji w Wiszni Małej
description: The 18th Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka is a 10 km race held in Ligota Piękna, in the municipality of Wisznia Mała. The event takes place annually and attracts runners from various places, offering a sporting competition on a scenic route. The start and finish are near Ligota Piękna, and the event is organized by the Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre in Wisznia Mała. The race takes place in April and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic surroundings of Ligota Piękna
Organized by the local Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre
additional: Registration for the 18th edition closed on April 7, 2026.

name: Zorientowane Kozy
description: “Zorientowane Kozy” is an orienteering race held at the Quarry in Kozy, combining a sporting challenge with active exploration of the area. Previous editions featured competitive courses A, B and C, as well as the recreational R course, designed for people with different levels of experience and for families. The courses run through the former quarry and surrounding forests, where significant elevation changes, steep slopes and variable runnability make careful map reading just as important as pace. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed; this description is based on previous editions of the event.
course_highlights: Terrain of the former quarry and surrounding forests
Forest trails, significant elevation changes and steep slopes
Competitive courses and a recreational option for families and beginners
additional: In the 2026 edition, the recreational R course was approximately 2 - 2.5 km long and had no timed classification. The competitive courses had a 75-minute time limit; timing was conducted using the SportIdent system. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Kayher Kirschblütenlauf, 1. Lauf des VR Cups
The Royal Copenhagen City Half
description:
A flat half marathon on closed roads through Copenhagen. The route starts at the harbour in Nordhavn and passes Kastellet, Amalienborg, Nyhavn, the Black Diamond and Lille Langebro before finishing at Royal Arena in Ørestad. Flat asphalt with under 16 metres of elevation, long straight stretches and few turns—suitable both for your first half marathon and for chasing a new PR.

The first edition in April 2026 had 2,758 finishers from 66 nations. Around 10,000 runners are expected in 2027.
additional:
Start at 09:30, 2 minutes from Orientkaj Metro. From the finish, it’s 10 minutes by metro to the airport.
The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a digital certificate, refreshment stations approximately every 5 km and free baggage transport from start to finish.
Prices: DKK 695 until 16/1-2027 · DKK 895 from 17/1 · DKK 1,095 from 28/2. Minimum age: 15.
Please note: This is the spring race on 11 April 2027, not the Copenhagen Half Marathon in September.

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop GOEDE DOELEN!!
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.5 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: Cruyff Legacy 14K
description: The Cruyff Legacy 14K is an annual running and walking event held at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam. The event brings thousands of participants together to take action for the Johan Cruyff Foundation, which creates opportunities for children with disabilities to participate in sport. The 2026 edition was a great success, with more than 8,000 participants and an impressive amount raised. The next edition takes place on Sunday, 11 April 2027, a special day putting sport and social engagement at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam
Run and walk through the city
An event with a social mission to support children with disabilities
additional: The Cruyff Legacy 14K raises awareness of sport for children with disabilities. It is supported by main sponsors including AFC Ajax, OTTO Work Force, PWC and Basic-Fit. The 2026 edition raised €851,639. The organisers invite participants to join this socially minded sports day. Race in Amsterdam, scheduled for 11 April 2027; supports sport for children with disabilities; participants can choose between running and walking.

name: De Oude Weideloop
description: The Oude Weideloop is a running event in Wagenberg suitable for young and old. There are four distances: a 1 km and 2 km family run, plus the 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km consisting of two 5 km laps. The start and finish are at Van Elsenplein, and the course runs through various streets of Wagenberg. The event features musical support and timekeeping, with prizes for the best men and women in all categories.
course_highlights: Family run of 1 km and 2 km, suitable for all ages
5 km course through various streets of Wagenberg
The 10 km consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Start/finish at Van Elsenplein in Wagenberg. Changing rooms and a first-aider are available at the sports fields. First-aid stations are located along the route. The information point opens at 11:00 for race-number and T-shirt collection. Grandparents or parents may run for free with their child or grandchild during the family run. Timekeeping by Startnummerexpress. Musical support during the run. Prizes for the first three men and women in all categories. Registration is via the official website, and the event is aimed at residents of the municipality of Drimmelen.

name: Enschede Marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Enschede Marathon, the oldest marathon in the Netherlands and Western Europe, takes place on 11 April 2027 in Enschede. The event offers a fast course, excellent support, plenty of music and tens of thousands of enthusiastic supporters. In addition to the full marathon, there are also a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and various kids’ races. The marathon supports KWF Dutch Cancer Society through the “Run Against Cancer” campaign, which encourages participants to collect donations.
course_highlights: Fast course in Enschede, starting and finishing on Boulevard 1945
Excellent support and plenty of music along the course
Tens of thousands of supporters create a vibrant atmosphere
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday 10 April from 10:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday 11 April from 07:30 onwards at the Connect-U registration office in Enschede. Race numbers can also be sent by post within the Netherlands for an additional € 5,-. The marathon features a Club Challenge in which clubs and their members can compete for prizes. There are various categories for men and women, and a special “Run Against Cancer” campaign through which participants can receive a free race entry by raising at least € 500 in donations. Multiple distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and kids’ race; registration discounts; charity support; electronic timing; race held since 1947

name: Halve van Helmond
description: De Halve van Helmond is a welcoming running and walking event held annually in Helmond and Stiphout. The main distance is the half marathon, consisting of two 10.55 km laps on a fully paved course, with the start and finish in the centre of Brandevoort. There are also shorter running distances of 10 km and 5 km, a corporate race, a kids’ run and a unique 2.5 km run, so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event is known for its friendly organisation, scenic routes past sports parks and an enjoyable sporting experience for both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: The half marathon consists of two 10.55 km laps on a fully paved course
Start and finish in the Brandevoort shopping centre
Aid stations every 2.5 km and a route past the sports parks of local athletics clubs
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day at wijkhuis ’t BrandPunt in Helmond (Brandevoort). There is a staffed cloakroom and changing rooms. A limited number of race entries are available for on-the-day registration for the running events; places are limited. The half marathon has a maximum time limit of 3 hours. Participants who have not started their second lap after 1 hour and 30 minutes will be withdrawn from the race. Running shirts can be ordered free of charge when registering, while stocks last. Race numbers can be collected on 11 and 12 April. Route information and timings will be shared online. The event takes place in Helmond and Stiphout.

name: IJsselloop
price_range: € 35,00 voor het loopshirt, andere prijzen niet vermeld
description: The IJsselloop in Deventer is the city’s largest running event and takes place annually on the second Sunday of April. With more than 9,000 participants and a unique atmosphere along the IJssel, the event offers a suitable distance for everyone, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The course passes iconic bridges and follows the river, finishing on the beautiful Brink square. Organised with the support of many volunteers and AV Daventria 1906, the event encourages people of all ages to take part, with participation more important than winning.
course_highlights: A unique course along the IJssel with views of the river
Cross the Wilhelmina Bridge and the railway bridge in Deventer
Finish on the Netherlands’ most beautiful square, the Brink
additional: Generous time limits by distance: no time limit for the 5 km and kids’ run, 1.5 hours for the 10 km, and 2 hours for the 15 km. On-the-day registration is available for the G-loop and kids’ run. The 5 km prize-giving is at 15:30 and the 10 km prize-giving is at 14:45 in the barracks garden (Boreel, Houtmarkt). Race number with timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. Clinics and training opportunities through AV Daventria 1906. Distances range from the kids’ run to 15 km; registration runs from 25 October 2025 to 21 March 2026, with limits for some distances. Start and finish in Deventer, with clinics available to prepare.

name: Middelseeloop
price_range: Kidsrun gratis, 2,5 km € 3,50, 5 km € 5,00, 10 km € 7,50, medaille toeslag € 3,00
description: The Middelseeloop is a friendly running event in Leeuwarden, held in the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighbourhoods. The event offers five different distances, including a 1-kilometre kids’ run, as well as 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 12.5 km walking routes. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running or wants to get to know the neighbourhood better. Activities for children take place all day around the start and finish, and all participants are offered an ice cream afterwards.
course_highlights: Routes through the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighbourhoods
Five distances: 1 km kids’ run, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 12.5 km walk
Start and finish at IKC Middelsee, Felling 2, 8912 CG Leeuwarden
additional: Register before 16 March to have your name printed on your race bib. Activities for children take place all day at the start-finish location, including a climbing wall, a football darts board, stilt walkers and Circus Saranti. Walkers will find a surprise along the way. After the event, all participants receive an ice cream from Diana’s IJspaleis, made possible by Zwanenburg. Distances for children, adults and walkers; registration until 11 April 2027; start and finish at IKC Middelsee; participants can enjoy an ice cream after the event.

name: LOOP Leeuwarden
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
description: LOOP Leeuwarden is the largest running and walking event in Fryslân, attracting thousands of participants each year. The routes pass through Leeuwarden’s atmospheric city centre and surrounding natural areas, with the start and finish at the iconic Oldehove. The half marathon is the longest distance and offers a challenging mix of city and countryside running. With a wide range of distances, there’s a suitable challenge for every runner, from 5 km to 21.1 km.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Tyršův ostrov and athletics stadium, Nymburk, Czech Republic
description: Běh lipovou alejí is a traditional road race in Nymburk, held since 1996. The race features a 10 km loop course, running mainly on paved paths on Tyršův ostrov and on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track. It is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who have their own categories and courses. The race is organised by Sportovní klub POLICIE Nymburk, z.s., and takes place at the athletics stadium in Nymburk.
course_highlights: A 10 km loop course running mainly on the paved paths of Tyršův ostrov
The opening and closing sections, approximately 1,800 m in total, are on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track
The course complies with IAAF/AIMS rules for measuring courses outside a track
additional: Children’s and youth categories have separate starts from 8:30 to 10:55, with course distances ranging from 100 m to 2,700 m. The main 10 km race for men and women starts at 11:15. Registration for the children’s and youth categories is available only on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The course is measured and can be run individually using GARMIN and STRAVA segments.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Horní Stropnice, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Martin Brožka a tým Sportcentra Novohradské hory
description: The Mountain Runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held amid the beautiful scenery of the Novohradské Mountains, with their hub in Hojná Voda. They offer a variety of courses, from children’s categories and shorter runs to a challenging 63 km ultra trail with 2,050 m of elevation gain. The races are suitable for a wide range of runners, from amateurs to experienced athletes, and also include a canicross category. The start and finish are both in Hojná Voda, where you can also register on race day. The event is organised by Martin Brožka and the Sportcentrum Novohradské hory team.
course_highlights: Ultra trail: 63 km with 2,050 m of elevation gain
Canicross Classic: 19 km with 660 m of elevation gain
Zážitek: 12.4 km with 430 m of elevation gain
additional: You can register online at maraton.cz or in person on race day in Hojná Voda. Race numbers are distributed from 9:30 to 10:30 for adults and from 12:00 to 13:45 for children. Detailed course maps are available in the Mountain Runs Course section, along with course videos for each category. A prize raffle with valuable prizes, including accommodation and a subscription to the Svět běhu magazine, is planned for participants.

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Louka pod bývalým lyžařským můstkem, Hrušov, Senohraby, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organised by TJ Sokol Senohraby. It takes place in a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov, Senohraby. The race is part of the Ladův kraj Cup and offers a springtime sporting experience with various courses, including a special stream crossing for younger pupils. Participants can also look forward to a mobile café serving hot drinks and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and encourages sporting activity among children and adults.
course_highlights: The courses run through a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov
A special stream crossing on the 1.8 km course for younger pupils (born in 2011–2012)
Natural terrain with gentle uneven sections and a springtime atmosphere
additional: A mobile café serving coffee and hot chocolate will be on site. Bringing a change of shoes is recommended because of the stream crossing on the younger pupils’ course. The courses follow traditional routes, and marking is done the evening before the race. The terrain may be uneven in places due to animal activity. A mobile café serving hot drinks is usually on site.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Pikovice, Hradištko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kros Sázava is a running race held in Pikovice, by the football field, in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gains, all entirely on natural terrain. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain with beautiful views. The routes are 15.5 km, 10 km and 5 km long, with elevation gains ranging from 120 to 500 metres, offering a varied experience for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Long route: 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain
Medium route: 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain
Hobby route: 5 km with approximately 120 m of elevation gain
additional: All routes run entirely on natural terrain. A photo gallery of the course is available at krosovypohar.cz/kros-sazava/fotky-z-trasy/.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast 10 km road race that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďárské vrchy. The route starts in the center of Žďár nad Sázavou, follows cycle paths to the end of the Pilská Reservoir, and then returns, offering beautiful scenery and minimal elevation gain. The race has a mass start and is precisely measured, making it ideal for runners looking for a fast, enjoyable race in the picturesque Vysočina region. It is organized by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s., with Vojtěch Bořil as the race representative.
course_highlights: Road route along a paved cycle path with minimal elevation gain
The route runs from the center of Žďár nad Sázavou to the Pilská Reservoir and back
A short 200-meter section on Dvorská Street with controlled road traffic
additional: Registration is also available on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 at the start area behind the House of Culture. Parking is available at the Municipal Office and in nearby areas. The awards ceremony will take place at 12:30. The route follows a cycle path with minimal elevation gain; the race has a mass start and is precisely measured.

name: Korunou za korunu
location: Cihelský rybník, Nové Město na Moravě, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.
description: Koruna za korunu is a short cross-country race around the dam of Cihelský Pond in Nové Město na Moravě. The race is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy a pleasant running experience in the natural surroundings of the Vysočina region. The course is 3.2 km long, and spikes may be worn. The race is organised by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., which provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organisation.
course_highlights: A short cross-country race around Cihelský Pond
A 3.2 km course in the natural surroundings of the Vysočina region
Spikes may be worn
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, and the main category starts at 11:20. The race is organised by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., and the contact person is Petr Hubáček. The race is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The main category starts at 11:20. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities.

name: Běh u Chlumce
location: Chlumec, Ústí nad Labem District, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Plné vstupné: 50 Kč Startovné 50 Kč platí pouze dospělí.

description: We invite you to the traditional NaPOLEon run in Chlumec, an event for the whole family. The race takes place in the beautiful Chlumecko countryside and offers courses of varying lengths and difficulty, so everyone can find a suitable route. The event is friendly and suitable for all ages, with registration available in advance or on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Courses of 500 m, 1 km, 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km loop)
Beautiful Chlumecko countryside
Start and finish in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec, under a shelter
additional: You can register in advance by emailing chvatalova@mesto-chlumec.cz or in person on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00. The start and finish are under a shelter in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec.

name: 14 Bieg o Złote Gacie

price_tiers.distance: Bieg o Złote Gacie 10 km i Prawie 5-ka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 65 zł - przelew przez stronę zapisów do dnia 8 marca 2026 roku

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 75 zł - przelew przez stronę zapisów od 9 marca do 8 kwietnia 2026 roku (decyduje data wpływu pieniędzy na rachunek bankowy Organizatora)

description: The 14th Run for the Golden Trousers is an annual road race held in Brzeszcze, scheduled for April 11, 2027. The traditional route is 10 km long and runs along Nosala Street. The event also includes a 5 km children’s race and Nordic walking. It is a family-friendly sporting event that promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: 10 km main race route
5 km children’s race
Start and finish on Nosala Street in Brzeszcze
additional: The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 11:00. The children’s race starts at 10:00 at the KS “Górnik” Brzeszcze Stadium. The main race and Nordic walking start at 11:30 from Nosala Street. Available source information concerns the 14th edition on April 12, 2026, not a confirmed edition on April 11, 2027. In 2026, the main race and “Almost 5K” were scheduled to start at 11:30 on Nosala Street; the entry fee was 65 zł until March 8 and 75 zł from March 9 to April 8.

name: 14 Półmaraton Jeleniogórski
location: Plac Piastowski, Cieplice, Jelenia Góra, Poland
description: The 14th Jelenia Góra Half Marathon is a unique race set in the picturesque landscape of the Karkonosze Mountains, with views of the mountains. The half-marathon course is certified by the PZLA and passes through charming parts of Jelenia Góra and Cieplice. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy the excitement of sport and spend time actively outdoors. The organizers invite runners to take part in several distances, including the half marathon, 10 km, Cieplicka Piątka, Uzdrowiskowa Mila, and races for children.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km half-marathon course certified by the PZLA
Scenic views of the Karkonosze and Izera Mountains
Start and finish at Piastowski Square in Cieplice
additional: The race office is located in Zdrojowy Park by the Animation Theatre. The event takes place on 11–12 April 2027 (in 2026, it took place on 11–12 April). Available distances include the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km, and races for children. The half-marathon course is certified by the PZLA. The 2026 program also included 10 km, 5 km, and 1.6 km races, as well as junior races. The race office was located in Zdrojowy Park by the Animation Theatre, and the Sunday races were scheduled to start at Piastowski Square in Cieplice. Free changing rooms and baggage storage, as well as a post-race meal at the finish, were to be available.

name: 18 Półmaraton Dąbrowski
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The 18th Dąbrowski ArcelorMittal Poland Half Marathon is an annual running celebration in Dąbrowa Górnicza, attracting both elite athletes and amateur runners from across Poland and abroad. The 21.097 km course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. It is fast and relatively flat, while also scenic, taking runners through some of the city’s most beautiful spots. The event offers substantial cash prizes and professional organization, with refreshment stations, medical support, and pacemakers. The race has a unique atmosphere, and the participant limit of 2,000 reflects the event’s popularity.
course_highlights: Certified 21.097 km course
Fast and relatively flat, ideal for personal bests
Scenic route through some of the most beautiful spots in Dąbrowa Górnicza
additional: Refreshment stations with water and isotonic drinks, medical support, and pacemakers to help runners maintain their pace are available on the course. The participant limit is 2,000. A course map showing refreshment stations and notable locations is available. The organizer provides free parking in designated areas, except for the parking lot in front of CENTRUM Hall and Aqua Park Nemo. Source information for the 18th edition refers to the race held on 12 April 2026. The race office was located at the CENTRUM Sports and Entertainment Hall; the participant limit was 2,000.

name: 40 Bieg Sokoła
description: Bieg Sokoła is an annual running event organized by the Sokół Gymnastics Society in Bukówiec Górny, promoting physical activity and the Włoszakowice Municipality region. The event includes races over various distances, including 15 km, 5 km, 2 km, and 1 km, as well as the Polish Doctors’ Championships over 15 km. The start and finish are located at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny. The event is known for its professional organization, electronic timing, and friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses of 15 km, 5 km, 2 km, and 1 km
Start and finish at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny
Electronic chip timing
additional: Participant check-in and race-number collection take place on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:15. Each participant receives a timing chip, which must be attached correctly to be included in the results. Participants must bring identification for check-in. Runners who start under the influence of alcohol or intoxicating substances are disqualified. Available information concerns the 40th edition, scheduled for 12 April 2026; it does not confirm a date of 11 April 2027.

name: 41 Biegi o Puchar Kocich Gór
location: Kobyla Góra, Ostrzeszów County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The National Races for the Kocie Góry Cup are an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Kobyla Góra. The competition attracts runners from all over Poland, offering the chance to compete on courses of varying difficulty. It is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and discover the charms of the region. Registration is via an online form, and the organizers warmly welcome both amateur and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses in Kobyla Góra
A nationwide competition
The event includes cross-country championships for people with disabilities
additional: In the previous edition, registration was handled through the UltimaSport online form.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Stadion Miejski im. Kazimierza Deyny, Starogard Gdański, Poland
organizer: Miasto Starogard oraz Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Starogardzie Gdańskim
description: The 42nd Bieg Szpęgawski z AQ is one of the oldest road races in Pomerania, held since 1983. The race is intended for both amateur and professional runners, as well as young people. The certified 5 km course is historic and symbolic, leading from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański. The organizers provide coach transport to the start and a baggage drop for participants. This event has a rich tradition and attracts runners aiming for records and personal bests.
course_highlights: Certified, fast 5 km course
Historic and symbolic course from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański
Coach transport to the start provided by the organizer
additional: The organizer provides coach transport to the start between 10:40 and 11:20. Transport is not guaranteed after 11:20. Road traffic is completely stopped at 11:45. A mobile baggage drop and a baggage drop under a tent at the start are available. Bags can be collected after the race, at approximately 13:15, at the Deyna Center. The organizer provides free coach transport to the start. A one-mile race is also available. The information provided relates to the 42nd edition in 2026; the date April 11, 2027, has not been confirmed by sources.

name: Bieg Mestwina
description: Bieg Mestwina is a running event held in Przywidz and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The race offers two main routes, 5 km and 10 km, through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia. It attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting an active lifestyle and local running culture. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization, continuing the tradition of the largest running event in northern Poland.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in Przywidz, surrounded by Kashubian nature
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: Bieg Mestwina is one of many events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes various distances and locations across Kashubia. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. The series also features children’s and youth races, as well as other accompanying events. In the edition described in the sources, the children’s races are free and require no registration. Open, age-group, and Przywidz municipality resident classifications are listed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized by a group of running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in scenic locations, with an emphasis on the visual appeal of the courses, making it attractive to nature lovers and people who enjoy outdoor activities. It has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running in Poland. In 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates 10 years of activity, underscoring its established place in the running calendar.
course_highlights: Cross-country races in scenic gardens and green spaces
Courses on natural terrain with two loops
Organization that emphasizes the visual appeal of the locations
additional: The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and course aesthetics. Events take place in various locations, including the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th birthday. The series includes 5 km runs and walks; children’s races are also held in Warsaw.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix
location: Orlik w Psarskiem, Psarskie, Śrem County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Śremski Sport, Gmina Śrem i Nadleśnictwo Konstantynowo
price_range: 40 zł za jeden bieg online; 120 zł za pakiet czterech biegów; 50 zł w dniu startu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of trail races held in the scenic forests around Psarskie, near Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved cobblestones, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, which also houses the race office and is the venue for the warm-up and official opening. Participants can expect a medal, a recovery meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Śrem Municipality and Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.4 km over forest paths and paved cobblestones
Start and finish at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, with a modern building and changing rooms
A run through scenic woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie at around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The event is funded from the Śrem Municipality budget as part of its programme for preventing and addressing alcohol-related problems and drug addiction. Information about fees and the series is from the 2025–2026 edition. In this edition, the start was scheduled for 12:00; participation in at least three of the four races was required for the final classification.

name: DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run
description: The DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run is a 10 km race held as part of the DOZ Maraton Łódź. For the 2026 edition, the start is scheduled for 9:00 near Atlas Arena, with the course running through the city streets. It is suitable both for runners taking on this distance for the first time and for those looking to test their fitness at a large city running event. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.
course_highlights: 10 km distance through the streets of Łódź
Start near Atlas Arena, according to information about the 2026 edition
The race takes place during the DOZ Maraton Łódź weekend
additional: Information about registration and race-pack collection in the available sources relates to the 2026 edition; race packs were collected at Atlas Arena.

name: Ekonomiczna Piątka
description: Ekonomiczna Piątka is an annual race organized by the Poznań University of Economics and Business, held in the area around Lake Malta. The 5 km course runs on asphalt, making it appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The event combines sport and socializing, offering a chance to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around Lake Malta
Asphalt surface
Scenic recreational areas of Poznań

name: IX Bieg Wiosny
description: The 9th Spring Run is an annual running event held at the Tustań Forester’s Lodge in the Naruszewo municipality. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 10 km runs along forest roads, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The event combines sport and recreation, attracting runners from across Poland. Commemorative medals, trophies and gifts for the top finishers await participants at the finish. The organizers also provide recovery meals and music, creating a friendly atmosphere for everyone taking part.
course_highlights: The running routes follow forest roads in the Tustań Forest District
Available distances: 2.5 km, 10 km and a 5 km Nordic walking event
The scenic area of the Naruszewo municipality makes for an enjoyable sporting challenge
additional: The main race starts at 11:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish, while the top finishers receive trophies and gifts. Recovery meals and music are provided. Around 157 runners from across Poland took part. In the 2026 edition, the 10 km race followed two 5 km loops. This information relates to earlier editions and does not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: IX Mazurski Bieg na Kulke
description: The 9th Mazury Kulka Run is an annual running event held at the scenic Kulka Holiday Resort near Szczytno. The course has been slightly modified and passes through the beautiful Mazury region, with the start and finish located on the resort grounds. The event is open to runners of various ability levels, and participants can look forward to a positive atmosphere, a medal, and a post-race recovery meal. The event also has a charitable purpose, supporting Kornelia through fairs and auctions. The organizers provide activities for children and young people, as well as the option to stay overnight at the resort.
course_highlights: A scenic course starting and finishing on the grounds of the Kulka Holiday Resort
A slightly modified course through the heart of the Mazury region
An atmosphere full of positive energy and sporting adventure
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 08:30 to 10:30 at the Race Office. Race-day registration is available until the limit of 250 participants is reached (16 places currently available). After the race, a recovery meal prepared by the resort’s cooks will be served. Children and young people can enjoy the resort’s activities under the supervision of instructors, depending on weather conditions. Overnight accommodation is available in 4- and 5-person rooms with bathrooms at Kulka Resort; book by 2 April 2026 at m.bolkowski@szarpie.pl. The event is charitable, with fairs and auctions in aid of Kornelia. For the 2026 edition, the time limit is 105 minutes and the participant limit is 250. The event also features activities for children and a recovery meal.

name: Leśna Pętla Niepołomice
description: Leśna Pętla Niepołomice is a family running and cycling event held amid the forests of Niepołomice Forest. In the previous edition, runners could choose 5 or 10 km, while cyclists competed over 20 km; an easier route was also prepared for children. The information available in the sources concerns the 2026 edition and does not confirm details of the edition planned for 11 April 2027.
course_highlights: Forest routes in Niepołomice Forest
A 5 km loop, with the option to enter the 5 or 10 km race in the previous edition
A 20 km cycling distance and an easier route for children in the previous edition
additional: The available information describes the edition held on 12 April 2026, not a confirmed edition on 11 April 2027. In 2026, a combined classification for the cycling race and 10 km run was also planned.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting competition held in Międzyzdroje. In the 2026/2027 season, participants can take part in runs of approximately 5 and 10 km, as well as Nordic walking events of approximately 5 and 7 km. The league is known for its healthy competition and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Participation is free, and people aged over 14 may take part.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. To qualify for the league’s overall standings, participants must take part in at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km runs, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must be under their supervision. The league final is scheduled for 11 April 2027. Registration is available at protiming24.pl.

name: Perły Małopolski Skała
location: Skała, Kraków County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Perły Małopolski Skała is a trail race held in the area around Skała and Ojców, as part of the Perły Małopolski mountain running series. Participants can choose from three distances: approximately 5, 10, and 20 km, making the event accessible to runners with varying levels of experience. The routes pass through scenic corners of Małopolska, near or within national parks. The Skała edition is scheduled for April 11, 2027.
course_highlights: Three distances: approximately 5, 10, and 20 km
Trail routes in the area around Skała and Ojców
Part of a series that takes runners through scenic corners of Małopolska, often near or within national parks

name: Podkowa Biega
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bohaterów Warszawy, ul. Jana Pawła II 20, Podkowa Leśna, Poland
description: Podkowa Biega is an annual race held in Podkowa Leśna, promoting sport and physical activity among residents of the town and surrounding area. The main 10 km race runs through the town centre and along the scenic paths of Młochowski Forest, showcasing the diverse character of this garden city and its historic landmarks. The event brings the local community together, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and supports the promotion of the town and local businesses. Alongside the main race, shorter races for children and young people are also held, with distances suited to participants’ ages. All running and physical activity enthusiasts are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre route through the centre of Podkowa Leśna and Młochowski Forest
A mixed-surface route on asphalt and forest paths
Views of some of the garden city’s most beautiful spots and historic landmarks
additional: The main race has a time limit of 2 hours. The course is not certified by the PZLA and is marked with tape and markers. Timing is electronic, using chips. Children’s and youth races cover distances from approximately 100 m to 1 km, depending on participants’ ages. The start and finish are at Bohaterów Warszawy Primary School, ul. Jana Pawła II 20. In the edition described in the regulations, the children’s and youth races are free of charge, and the main race has a time limit of 2 hours. The start and finish are at Bohaterów Warszawy Primary School, ul. Jana Pawła II 20. These details come from materials for the 2026 edition and may change in 2027.

name: V Bieg Hazoka
description: The 5th Hazok Run is an annual running event organized by MK Team Events and held in Siemianowice Śląskie. The race is part of the MK Team Grand Prix series and attracts runners from the region, promoting an active and healthy lifestyle. Participants can expect professional organization and a unique sports-festival atmosphere. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to the whole family.
course_highlights: Running distances of 5 and 10 km, plus 5 km Nordic Walking
Around 75% of the course follows forest trails
Children’s races over distances from 50 to 800 m
additional: The event also includes children’s races and a Nordic Walking event. Participants receive commemorative medals. The event is part of the MK Team Grand Prix series. The courses are not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). Price information applies to registration for the 2026 edition.

name: XIV Bieg Wojciechowy
description: The 14th Wojciech Run is an annual running event held in Serock, attracting runners of different ages. The race takes place on scenic urban routes, with timing provided by Time-Sport. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to families and the local community. Serock offers a rich range of recreational and sporting activities, further highlighting the character of the event.
course_highlights: The running routes pass through the center of Serock
Scenic views of the lake and green spaces
Professional timing provided by Time-Sport
additional: The event includes children’s races. Timing is provided by Time-Sport. The event takes place at the Market Square in Serock. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Timing is provided by Time-Sport. Registration for the 14th edition closed on April 6, 2026.

name: XRUN Szczyrk Run
description: Mercure SZCZYRK RUN is a mountain trail race held in picturesque Szczyrk, with its base at Mercure Szczyrk Resort. Runners can choose from a variety of distances, from short courses for children to demanding ultra-distance routes with significant elevation gain. The courses follow atmospheric Beskid trails, offering beautiful views and a classic mountain-running experience. The event is well organized, with clear time limits and starts spread over two days, making participation more comfortable. It is an ideal choice for mountain-running enthusiasts who value a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: 45 km course with 2,400 m of elevation gain; 9-hour time limit
15 km course passing Klimczok, Trzy Kopce, and Przełęcz Karkoszczonka
Distances range from 150 m for children to 45 km for experienced runners
additional: The start and finish for all distances are located at Mercure Szczyrk Resort. The time limits are 9 hours for the 45 km course, 7 hours for 25 km, 5 hours for 15 km, and 5 hours for 6 km. Starts are spread over two days: Saturday (7 km and children's distances) and Sunday (longer distances). Children's age categories are for ages 3 to 15. Detailed course maps and descriptions are available on the website. The program also includes a children's race. The official website lists the date as 20 June 2027, not 11 April 2027.

name: XVI Bieg Raszyński
description: The 16th Raszyn National Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Raszyn. The course consists of three laps of approximately 3.33 km, running through the streets of Raszyn amid detached houses. The race is certified by PZLA and takes place on flat asphalt, making it suitable for fast times. The participant limit is 600, and the event attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Three laps of approximately 3.33 km through the streets of Raszyn
Flat asphalt surface
additional: The participant limit is 600. The start and finish are in Raszyn: the start is on Szkolna Street and the finish is at 1 Unii Europejskiej Street. The race office is open from 17:00 to 20:00 on 7–9 April and from 8:00 to 10:30 on race day. The time limit is 2 hours. Nordic Walking over 5 km is also organized for residents of Raszyn Municipality, with a separate classification and a 10:45 start. Children can take part in the accompanying races free of charge. For the 2026 edition, the participant limit is listed as 600 and the time limit as 2 hours. The program also includes children’s races and Nordic Walking.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušovské vrchy is a traditional cross-country race organized by the volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov. The race starts at the football field and offers a course approximately 10.7 km long with 418 meters of elevation gain, making for a challenging and interesting run through natural terrain. Children can take part in a shorter 2 km race with 80 meters of elevation gain. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series and attracts runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course with 418 meters of elevation gain
Start at the football field in Bratrušov
A 2 km children’s course with 80 meters of elevation gain
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series. The number of starters is usually around 65 in the adult categories and around 24 in the children’s categories. The organizer is the Bratrušov Volunteer Firefighters Association, which organizes the race regularly.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Praha-Zbraslav railway station, Zbraslav, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY is a challenging mountain race in Prague, offering a 7 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain. It takes place on trails with three demanding climbs and descents, giving the race its distinctive difficulty and challenge. The race starts at Praha-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners looking for an intense trail experience in an urban setting. It is organised by VAŠE LIGA under the direction of Petr Lundák, who ensures the event is professionally run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with 500 m of elevation gain
3 demanding climbs and descents
Mountain cross-country race in Prague
additional: The race starts at Praha-Zbraslav train station. It is a mountain cross-country/trail race with significant elevation gain and demanding sections. The organiser is VAŠE LIGA; Petr Lundák can be contacted. The race is part of the VAŠÍ LIGA series. The start is at 18:00 at Praha-Zbraslav train station.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
location: Sportovní areál OLYMP CSMV, Stromovka, Praha 7, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run of Olympus is a cross-country and trail race held at the OLYMP CSMV grounds in Prague’s Stromovka Park. It offers courses of 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km through natural surroundings with varied terrain. The race is suitable for the general public and is organised by PSK Olymp Praha. Registration is online only, and the event is traditionally popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail courses
Course distances of 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km
Set in Prague’s Stromovka Park at the OLYMP CSMV grounds
additional: Registration is online only and closes at midnight on 8 October 2026. The organiser does not accept entries on race day. The first category starts at 16:00, and the main category starts at 18:55. According to the available context, the main category is scheduled to start at 18:55.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and offers runners an asphalt course 3.343 km long, which they must complete three times. The first lap is slightly shorter, giving the race its distinctive character. Winners in each category will receive sweet gifts, and the awards ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km loop on asphalt paths through Smetana Gardens
The course is run three times; the first lap is 28 m shorter
Start and finish by the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens
additional: Bags can be left in the start and finish area. Registration takes place at the race venue; runners must present a chip card with sufficient credit. The race is run according to road-running rules, and everyone takes part at their own risk. The winners’ announcement and prize-giving will take place next to the Music Pavilion. The race offers age categories and a fitness run with no age distinction.

name: Bieg Kreta
location: Kletno, Stronie Śląskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Kreta is an elite mountain ultramarathon held in the Sudetes, offering two routes: the classic 148 km and the extreme 377 km Hardcore. The route follows the famous Sudetes Triangle, covering the three highest peaks of the Sudetes, across varied terrain, mud, snow, and ice. The race runs day and night without long breaks. It is a challenge for experienced runners who want to take on a legendary route and the history of this ultramarathon. The race traditionally starts in Sobótka, and participants are provided with aid stations and mobile support.
course_highlights: The route covers the Sudetes Triangle: Ślęża, Śnieżka, and Śnieżnik
Varied terrain: asphalt, cobblestones, forest trails, rocky sections, and muddy sections
Extreme elevation gain of up to 12,000 m over the 377 km distance
additional: The race traditionally starts on Wednesday at 17:00 from Winiarnia Celtica in Sobótka (ul. Czysta 1). Participants can leave their cars in the parking lot and book accommodation. Mandatory gear for the route: a charged phone, a flashlight with spare batteries, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 l, a hooded rain/windproof jacket, a route map, and a GPS tracker. The organizer plans gear checks and aid stations where participants can access their own drop bags, as well as mobile support. The Classic route is open to people aged 18 and over who have no medical contraindications to long-distance running; the limit includes 80 places for participants who register and pay the entry fee by the required deadline, plus 25 places allocated by the organizer. Candidates for the Hardcore option are vetted by the organizer.

name: Rondje Almkerk
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Krčská 10
location: Krčský les, Prague 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The race offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy running in nature in a friendly atmosphere. The route follows forest paths and offers beautiful views and pleasant terrain. The event is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: The route runs through Krč Forest in Prague 4
Forest paths with natural surfaces
Picturesque views and peaceful surroundings

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity running event held in Flora Park. Participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The run starts at 21:00, and registration opens at 19:00. The event is both a sporting challenge and a way to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. Participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband, adding to the safety and atmosphere of the night run.
course_highlights: The course runs through Flora Park in Olomouc
A choice of 2.5 km or 5 km course
A night run with an entry option that includes a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is available through the GoOut.cz portal. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, but are not entitled to a headlamp or sports headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp or headband. A cloakroom and baggage storage are available on site. Refreshments and medical services are provided throughout the event. The accompanying programme includes a concert and other activities.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kateřinský běh Hrabovou is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová, held in spring. The main course passes the historic Church of St. Catherine, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers 5 km and 2.5 km races, including children’s races and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Participants can enjoy not only a sporting challenge but also an accompanying program and refreshments after the race.
course_highlights: The course passes the historic Church of St. Catherine
Main race: 5 km; shorter course: 2.5 km
A 5 km Nordic Walking event is available
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. Registration and the start take place on Bažanova Street in front of the Hrabová Municipal District Office. The entry fee includes a medal for participants who register by 13 April 2026, participation in the Hrabová and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for the 5 km race), a reusable race number with a chip, SMS results service, refreshments after the race, changing rooms and toilets, and an accompanying program. Participants are advised not to wear headphones during the race, and their race number must be attached to their chest. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes.

name: Singelloop Leiden
description: The Singelloop Leiden is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Leiden. The race starts and finishes at Lammermarkt, near Molen de Valk, and takes participants along a challenging route beside Leiden’s canals. At approximately 6.5 kilometres, it is an accessible race for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. It is organised by Stichting Singelloop Leiden, which continues the city’s long tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lammermarkt, next to Molen de Valk
Route of approximately 6.5 km along Leiden’s canals and historic bridges
Run counter-clockwise via Valkbrug, Rijnsburgersingel, Morspoort and Witte Singel
additional: Race numbers are available from various advance-sale outlets from 20 March to 15 April for 7.50 euros. On race day (16 April), a race number costs 8.50 euros and is available at petit-restaurant De Valk. After the race, participants receive a medal upon presenting their race number. The race is held over a route of approximately 6.5 to 7 km, with registration available via the website. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 16 April at 19:30.

name: Szczyt Wytrzymałości
description: Szczyt Wytrzymałości is an extreme mountain race held on a loop of approximately 4.5 km around Mount Równica in Ustroń. The course features significant elevation gain of around 420 metres per loop, making it physically and mentally demanding. Competitors can choose one of two categories: the 12-hour category, where the number of completed loops counts, or the 24-hour 8848 Everest category, symbolising a climb of Mount Everest. The race is for warriors who want to test their endurance, character and determination on a challenging, technical course.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 4.5 km with +/- 420 m of elevation gain per lap
Narrow trails, steep climbs and technical descents
A course described as one of the most demanding loops in Polish mountain running
additional: Two race categories: 12H (12 hours to complete as many loops as possible) and 8848 Everest (21 laps, approximately 95 km, a 24-hour limit, symbolising a climb of Mount Everest). The race takes place on a loop around Mount Równica, known for its difficult conditions and significant elevation gain. The course demands great endurance and determination, and the race is a rite of passage and a test of character. Source information describes the 2026 editions, so details about the date of 16 April 2027 are unconfirmed. At the December edition, the start, finish and race office were located at Gościniec Równica.

name: Henkell 0.0% Vinothon – Wiesbaden·Rheingau GenussMarathon
description:
The Henkell 0.0% Vinothon – Wiesbaden·Rheingau GenussMarathon returns on April 17, 2027. Following its successful debut in April 2026, with around 1,500 participants, the Vinothon is back for its second edition.

Schloss Henkell is the event area and the finish line for the marathon and half marathon, making it the central hub of the Henkell 0.0% Vinothon. Three courses wind through one of Germany’s most picturesque landscapes, right through the internationally renowned Rheingau wine region, passing prestigious wineries, historic sites and impressive monuments.

Choose from the 12.5 km Rheingau course, the 21.1 km half marathon or the full 42.2 km marathon. Along the routes, participants can enjoy numerous food and refreshment stations serving culinary specialties from the Rheingau and Wiesbaden.

The running event is rounded off with a Pasta Party on the eve of the race, followed by the Finisher Party and the Rheingau Wine Mile at Schloss Henkell.

Join us to celebrate the second edition!

name: Amerongse Koploop
distance_verbose: 25 km, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 0.75 km
description: The Amerongse Koploop is a friendly and challenging trail run through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park, between Amerongen and Leersum. The event offers several distances for both children and adults, including kids’ runs, trail runs and hiking routes. A portion of the entry fee goes towards nature conservation, and participants receive a voucher for local refreshments. After the event, all participants receive a sustainable medal, and there is a lively square at the start and finish where they can relax and enjoy the atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park
Distances ranging from 750 metres for children to a 25 km trail run
A lively square with local specialities and an included refreshment voucher
additional: Pre-registration closes on Thursday 16 April. On-the-day registration is possible, with an additional administration fee payable at the registration desk. Race numbers can be collected in advance on Friday evening. Timing is electronic; there is no rush at the start. Trail and walking distances vary; registration is available in advance and on the day. The location is Nuytgroep, Amerongen. Local refreshments include beer, coffee and fries. Medal and electronic timing.

name: Kamerikse Weteringloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.7 km, 1 km, 0.7 km

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships, held alongside the 24th Haná Half Marathon, is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletický klub Olomouc. The race takes place on the athletics track in Olomouc and attracts runners from across Moravia and Silesia, who compete for championship titles. The event is known for its excellent organization and an atmosphere that supports both elite athletes and amateurs. The race starts at 9:00 in the morning and is part of the club’s wider athletics program.
course_highlights: The course follows the athletics track in Olomouc
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
An atmosphere that supports both elite runners and amateurs
additional: The race is part of the club’s wider athletics program, which includes youth categories and para athletics. The organizer is Atletický klub Olomouc, which has a rich tradition and experience organizing athletics events at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships are also held as part of the event.

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Park Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Javorkou is a traditional spring running race with a long history, held every April in the beautiful setting of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The fast main race covers 6 km on firm park paths and is mildly undulating, making it suitable for strong performances. The race is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers categories for children, a main race, and team relays. Race facilities are located by the outdoor stage next to the Javorka restaurant.
course_highlights: 6 km loop course (with shorter options) on firm park paths (gravel, paving)
Mildly undulating course profile, suitable for fast running
Course markings in different colours by category
additional: Registration is available online in advance or on race day, no later than 20 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The race takes place on Saturday: the first children’s categories start at 9:30, the main race at 11:30, and the team relays at 12:10. Race facilities are located by the Music Pavilion in Javorka Park, next to the Javorka restaurant. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup series.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Žehrovický Kalspotkros is a 6.2 km cross-country race with a rolling profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging natural terrain. The course is suited to cross-country enthusiasts who appreciate a mix of hilly sections and natural scenery. A long-standing regional event, it welcomes runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 6.2 km cross-country course
Rolling profile with hilly sections
Natural scenery in Kamenné Žehrovice

name: Listonošův krpál
description: Listonošův krpál is an uphill race in Prague-Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with 150 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, making for a dynamic and exciting racing experience.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.88 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Uphill race on terrain in Prague

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jedlová Mountain summit, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Price of the Tolštejn Estate Jiřetín pod Jedlovou–Jedlová is a 6 km uphill race with 340 metres of elevation gain, finishing at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup, the race offers runners challenging and beautiful terrain. The route passes through picturesque countryside and is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts and anyone looking for a challenge. This traditional event attracts runners from across the country.
course_highlights: 6 km route with 340 m of elevation gain
Finish at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Main Entrance, Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The ČSOB Safari Run is a running race held at Safari Park Dvůr Králové, offering a unique running experience in the surroundings of the African and Walking Safaris. The race is open to the general public and offers three distance options: a 2 km family run, and 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are located by the safari park’s main entrance, and the routes run mostly along paved asphalt roads. The entry fee includes free admission to the safari park on race day and supports the protection of maneless zebras.
course_highlights: The 10 km route follows the same 5 km route twice through the African and Walking Safaris
The 5 km route runs through the African and Walking Safaris
The 2 km family race runs through the Lion Safari
additional: A race bib with a built-in chip, which runners keep. The entry fee includes a contribution to the protection of maneless zebras and free admission to the safari park, valid only on race day. After finishing, runners receive a voucher for refreshments (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, and a small snack (water and fruit). The family run includes activities for children at the stand of main partner ČSOB. The entry fee includes admission to the safari park on race day. The race supports the conservation of maneless zebras.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
location: Dražovka Forest Park, Hořovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run through Dražovka is a traditional running race in Hořovice, offering runners of all ages the chance to enjoy a run in the picturesque Dražovka forest park. The course follows forest paths through varied terrain, providing interesting challenges and beautiful natural scenery. After the race, refreshments are available at the finish, including hot drinks and homemade pastries. The event is suitable for runners with a reasonable level of training, who take part at their own risk. Registration is online, preferably through the Brdský pohár.
course_highlights: Forest paths through the varied terrain of Dražovka forest park
Start by the children’s playground on Lesní Street in Hořovice
Refreshments at the finish, including tea, coffee, homemade pastries, and fruit
additional: Registration is online, preferably through the Brdský pohár. Runners take part at their own risk. Hot refreshments and homemade pastries are available at the finish after the race.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov, Klatovy District, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Husínský Cross is a traditional and prestigious cross-country race held every spring since 2012 in Tajanov near Klatovy. The race was established to replace the cancelled Klatovská patnáctka and takes place in the birthplace of Czech running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer, who serves as chief referee. Men run three laps, while women and girls run two. Each lap is approximately 3.6 km long, with two-thirds on forest trails and one-third on smooth asphalt. Since 2022, the original, longer route around the perimeter of Husín Forest has been used again.
course_highlights: Approx. 3.6 km lap, mostly on forest trails with some smooth asphalt
The course runs around the perimeter of Husín Forest
Men run 3 laps; women and girls run 2 laps
additional: The race is part of the Ešus liga series in the Klatovy district. The course records are 38:22 for men (2012) and 29:56 for women (2018). The race starts by the tennis courts in Tajanov. The organiser is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the Ešus liga series.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Náměstí, Bakov nad Jizerou, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional road race with a long history, held in Bakov nad Jizerou. The certified course is exactly 21.097 km long and follows a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality. It offers several refreshment stations. The race starts in the town square at 10:00 and is open to a wide range of runners across different age categories. It is organized by TJ Bakovský půlmaraton with the support of the municipal office and other local organizations.
course_highlights: Certified course measuring 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality
Refreshments at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration is also available on race day at the venue for 400 Kč. Check-in takes place from 8:00 to 9:45, approximately 150 m from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. Cash and in-kind prizes are offered, including bonuses for breaking records. The course records are 1:05:01 for men and 1:17:46 for women. According to the available description, advance registration has a lower entry fee than registration on race day.

name: Run for ProCit

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Na místě 600 Kč registrace 8:30–10:00 · hotovost i karta

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Na místě 600 Kč registrace 8:30–10:00 · hotovost i karta

description: Run for ProCit is a charity family run held in Borský Park in Plzeň, supporting families of children with autism. The event offers three distances: a children’s run of up to 600 metres, a 2 km run suitable for Nordic walking, and a 5 km run. Dogs are welcome (canicross), and the course follows flat loops with an optional colour zone. Entry fees go directly towards educational and sport-and-relaxation stays for families with children on the autism spectrum. The atmosphere is relaxed and free of competitive pressure, making the event suitable for all ages and for runners with strollers or trekking poles.
course_highlights: Flat loops in Borský Park
Optional colour zone along the course
Dog-friendly run (canicross) and Nordic walking with an instructor
additional: On-site registration is available from 8:30 to 10:00, with payment by cash or card. The entry fee includes a commemorative medal and prizes for the three fastest runners. The programme includes children’s runs at 10:00 and 10:10, the 2 km start at 10:15 and the 5 km start at 10:45, followed by the results ceremony and a raffle at 11:30. The run is also suitable for runners with strollers and walkers with trekking poles. This charity event supports families with children on the autism spectrum; runners with dogs are welcome.

name: ŘepoRun
description: Řepo Run is a running race held in Prague, offering courses for children and adults. The race route goes through the area around Řeporyje and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the enthusiastic group of runners Run Labe Run, who want to offer a high-quality sporting experience. All participants receive a race pack and a medal after finishing; the winners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route goes through the area around Řeporyje
Children’s races: 200 m, 600 m and 1,300 m
Chip timing using a chip on the race bib
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:00 to 11:45, depending on the category. Time is measured by a chip on the back of the race bib, which does not need to be returned. A bag drop and changing room are available. Using public transport is recommended due to limited parking. On-site registration is possible until capacity is reached.

name: Děčín RunFest
description: Děčín RUNFEST 2027 is a spring running festival in the heart of Bohemian Switzerland, offering a fast, certified course along the Elbe River and a family-friendly atmosphere at the event base on Mariánská Meadow. The race is for a broad running community, from elite distance runners to beginners and children. The festival combines athletic performances with a community spirit and an accompanying program that appeals not only to competitors but also to their families and friends. Mariánská Meadow provides an ideal setting with beautiful views of Děčín Castle and the Elbe River.
course_highlights: Certified, extremely fast course along the Elbe River
Event base at Mariánská Meadow with views of Děčín Castle
Family-friendly atmosphere and accompanying program for all age groups
additional: Registration and results are managed through the RaceTeam system. The race is inclusive and also offers activities for supporters and families. Places in the main races often sell out in advance, so early registration is recommended. The program also includes Nordic Walking.

name: Kotva race
description: Kotva Race is an OCR race held in Děčín, offering a challenging obstacle course for competitors born in 2011 or earlier. The race is known for its demanding course, and competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Registration is available online and on-site for an increased entry fee. Competitors must sign a liability waiver and follow the race rules.
course_highlights: A challenging OCR course with obstacles in Děčín’s natural surroundings
Open only to competitors born in 2011 or earlier
Competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 11:30 to 12:15 for the children’s race, for an increased entry fee. Competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian and sign a liability waiver (REVERZ). Information about the courses, prices, and registration published on the website applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 17 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Žákovský běh Bakovem
location: Atletická dráha u základní školy, Bakov nad Jizerou, Czech Republic
organizer: Školní sportovní klub při ZŠ Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Bakov Schoolchildren’s Run is a traditional children’s running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou since 2002. Races take place on the athletics track by the primary school, with courses run in laps of approximately 300 metres. There are several age categories, from preschoolers to juniors, including relays. The event is held alongside the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and appearances by prominent athletes as guests. There is no entry fee, and registration takes place at the venue on race day.
course_highlights: Laps around the primary school’s athletics track, approximately 300 m per lap
Run on a paved path; running spikes may be used
Categories from preschoolers to juniors, including 4 × 300 m relays
additional: Registration takes place on race day in the theatre hall on the square and closes 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. There is no entry fee. Relays have four members, including at least two girls; relay categories are determined by the age of the oldest member. The race is part of the Bakov Half Marathon programme, which starts at 10:00. The top finishers receive diplomas, medals and gifts from sponsors.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK
location: Městský park střed, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: Valašský trhák is a half marathon held in the heart of Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, which comes alive with a sporting atmosphere every spring. The race runs through the town park and offers runners an enjoyable experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Zlín Region. The event is suitable for the general public and brings a traditional sporting occasion with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A half marathon in the town park of Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Beautiful natural and urban surroundings in the Zlín Region
A sporting atmosphere in the heart of the town

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín–Jedlová Uphill Race is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club, held in the beautiful surroundings of Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. It is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running and features a challenging 5.7 km course with 340 m of elevation gain.
