The race starts at the Jiřetín pod Jedlovou sports complex and finishes at the summit of Jedlová Mountain. It is suitable for a wide range of age categories and offers cash prizes for the top competitors as well as special prizes for records.
course_highlights: Course length: 5.7 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest paths
Start at the Jiřetín pod Jedlovou sports complex (434 m above sea level); finish at the summit of Jedlová (774 m above sea level)
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three in each category and for breaking the course record (500 CZK). The fastest man and woman based on their combined times from this race and the race at Studenec receive a 1,000 CZK prize. A running-themed raffle is held, with race numbers entered into the draw. Runners must wear their race number visibly on the front and participate at their own risk. Basic medical care is provided.

name: Dehtářská 10°
description: Dehtářská 10° is a running race in the Vysočina region, open to the general public and all age groups. It offers 5, 10 and 20 km courses through beautiful countryside with gentle elevation changes. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and its emphasis on personal achievement. It starts at the Kletečná recreational resort near Humpolec, with on-site registration on race day. The main 10 km race has approximately 85 metres of elevation gain and starts at 14:00.
course_highlights: 5, 10 and 20 km courses
Approximately 85 m of elevation gain in the main race
Beautiful Vysočina countryside around the Kletečná recreational resort
additional: Runners can register on race day at the venue from 11:00 to 13:30. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels. Capacity is limited, and registration often fills up quickly.

name: Běh O pohár století
description: The Běh O pohár století is a running race held in the picturesque Castle Park in Pacov. The race features a challenging course full of hills, descents, and turns that tests runners’ endurance and technique. The event is part of Český běh, a Czech Athletics Federation service focused on promoting running and running races in the Czech Republic. Registration is online only, and the race is suitable for the general public, including children.
course_highlights: A 3.2 km course with hills, descents, and turns
The race takes place in Castle Park in Pacov
Children’s races are also held
additional: Registration is online only. The race is part of Český běh, which also offers other running services and races. The course runs along a cinder track and country paths.

name: 19 Mini Cracovia Maraton im. Piotra Gład...
description: The Cracovia Marathon is the most important running event in Kraków and Poland’s largest spring marathon. It has been held since 2002. The 42 km and 195 m course passes through historic and modern parts of the city, including the Main Market Square, Wawel Royal Castle and Nowa Huta. The event attracts runners from around the world and is held under the slogan “with history in the background.” The marathon weekend also features accompanying races, including the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon, the 10 km Night Run, roller-skating events and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
The route passes modern venues such as TAURON Arena Kraków and the ICE Kraków Congress Centre
additional: The marathon weekend also includes the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the 10 km Night Run, the Cracovia Marathon on Roller Skates (the full marathon distance, to be completed in a maximum of 3 hours) and a 4.2 km Nordic walking event. Athletes with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim-push and active-wheelchair categories. In the edition described in the source, registration was open until 10 April or until the entry limit was reached; a “School in the Run” classification for students was also planned. Information about fees and registration applies to the edition described, and not necessarily to the 2027 edition.

name: II Leśny Lament
location: Ośrodek Sportowo-Rekreacyjny „Grzybówka”, ul. Podgórna 50, Rybnik, Poland
description: II Leśny Lament is a trail run in Rybnik, based at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre. The route follows forest trails, making the event a chance for runners to enjoy off-road running and test themselves on natural terrain. Previous editions featured 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats.
course_highlights: Forest trails and natural terrain
Start and base at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre in Rybnik
Previous editions offered 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats
additional: Previous editions of the event took place at 50 Podgórna Street in Rybnik.

name: 7 Nocna Dycha
description: Nocna Dycha Brzeg is a 10 km road race held in Brzeg, Opole Voivodeship. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), guaranteeing official measurement and high quality. The race attracts night-running enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete on a certified course in the city centre.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
PZLA certification guaranteeing official distance measurement
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
additional: 1,196 runners took part in the 2026 edition.

name: 7. 6 godzin pełnej MOCY
location: Stadion OSiR Targówek, ul. Łabiszyńska 20, Warsaw, Poland
price_range: Bieg indywidualny: 260 zł; sztafeta: 640 zł (ceny z edycji 2026)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu indywidualnym wynosi 260 zł (dla członków Stowarzyszenia 230 zł)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu sztafetowym wynosi dla całej sztafety 640 zł (dla sztafet w 100% z członków Stowarzyszenia 540 zł)

description: The 7th edition of the “6 Hours of Full POWER” race will take place on 17 April 2027 at the OSiR Targówek stadium in Warsaw. The event features individual and relay races lasting 6 hours, run on loops approximately 400 m and 422 m long. Participants compete in two groups simultaneously, with results combined. An official split time is recorded at 50 km. The event also includes the Mazovia Relay Running Championships.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a stadium course with loops measuring 400 m and 422.382 m
Official split time at 50 km
Two groups compete simultaneously, with combined results
additional: Participant limit: 70 individual runners and 16 relay teams. A relay team may consist of 4 women, 4 men, or be mixed (at least one woman). The organizer assigns participants to start groups. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the POLSKIE ULTRA Sports Association after completing the registration form. The 7th edition took place on 18 April 2026 at the OSiR Targówek stadium, ul. Łabiszyńska 20. Information about the edition scheduled for 17 April 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: 9 Dziesiątka Babicka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Stare Babice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy na biegi dziecięce do 31 marca 2026

description: Skynet Dziesiątka Babicka is the largest running event organized in the Municipality of Stare Babice near Warsaw, aimed at running and healthy-lifestyle enthusiasts. The centerpiece is the main 10 km race on a certified course, following flat asphalt roads with an uphill section in the final 100 meters. The event also includes children’s races over shorter distances, without timing and divided into age categories. Participants receive race packs containing a bib with a chip, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start and finish are located at 32 Rynek Street in Stare Babice. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course
Entirely asphalt and flat, with an uphill section in the final 100 meters
Start and finish at Stare Babice Municipal Office, 32 Rynek Street
additional: Race packs can be collected at Stare Babice Primary School, 40 Polna Street, on April 17 (17:00–20:00) and April 18 (7:00–11:30). Each pack contains a race bib with a chip, safety pins, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start line will close 10 minutes after the starter’s gun. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours, with an additional 10-minute allowance for runners who pass the 9 km mark after the cutoff. The children’s races start at 9:45, are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. Awards ceremonies take place on the main stage immediately after each children’s race.

name: Bieg Daniela
description: Daniel’s Run is an annual running event held in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality. This is the fifth edition of the event, which combines sporting competition with the joy of movement and good fun. Participants can take on a course full of sporting energy, regardless of their experience level. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy the atmosphere of running together.
course_highlights: Previous editions included 5 km and 10 km races.
Juniors and people who practice Nordic walking also took part in the event.
The run takes place in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality.
additional: Daniel’s Run takes place in Smolarnia and is a sports and recreation event that promotes the joy of movement and good fun. It is a local event organized by the Strzeleczki Municipal Office. In previous editions, runners competed for personal bests or simply for the satisfaction of finishing the race with a smile. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed on the official website; the running calendar lists an indicative date of 18 April 2027 and a distance of 10 km.

name: Bieg po Zdrowie
organizer: Zespół Szkół nr 1 im. Powstańców Śląskich w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 11th Run for Health is an annual running event organized in Kędzierzyn-Koźle by the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex. The race takes place on an urban course with professional RFID timing, ensuring precise results. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and participants can expect smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among local residents.
course_highlights: Urban course in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Professional RFID timing
Organized by a local school – the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex
additional: The event uses electronic RFID timing provided by Time-Sport.pl. The organizer provides comprehensive technical support and timing. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: II Żelechowska Nocna Piątka
organizer: Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo oraz Miasto i Gmina Żelechów
description: The 2nd Żelechów Night Five is an annual race held in Żelechów that kicks off the running season in the town. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively. The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive character and an added attraction for participants. It is organised by the local authorities of the town and municipality of Żelechów together with the Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo group.
course_highlights: Evening road race in Żelechów
5 km distance
First stage of the 2nd Żelechów Running Triad
additional: The race takes place in the evening and is organised by the Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo group. The event is part of the local sporting calendar and aims to promote physical activity among residents. Registration for the race is open. The stated date, 17 April 2027, does not match the organiser’s account of the edition held on 18 April 2026.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The competition takes place on Chełmska Mountain in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. The event combines recreational and competitive sport, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Chełmska Mountain
Timing with reusable chips attached to shoes
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: Information in the sources describes the event held on April 18, 2026; the date April 17, 2027, has not been confirmed. A license was not required for the 2026 edition.

name: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce
description: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce is an annual road race held in Głogów. Its scenic course runs along the Nadodrzański Boulevard and through the city’s Old Town. The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere for participants. It is organized by the ZG RUN Sports Club with the support of the local community and the School of Economics in Głogów. It is a great opportunity to compete and spend time actively in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes through scenic Głogów Old Town
The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive nighttime character
The start and finish are located on Nadodrzański Boulevard
additional: You can officially and safely purchase a race package from another participant. Races for children are also organized. Event locations listed include Nadodrzański Boulevard and the School of Economics in Głogów.

name: OSHEE Bieg Nocny
description: OSHEE Night Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque heart of Kraków, at the Main Market Square. This unique sporting event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering a nighttime atmosphere and professional organization. The course runs through the city’s historic streets, making the race not only a sporting challenge but also an unforgettable adventure. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety along the course.
course_highlights: 10 km course in the center of Kraków
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
The course runs through the historic streets around the Main Market Square
additional: Telephone support is available Monday to Friday, 8:00–15:00, at +48 12 616 63 02. Organizer: Sports Infrastructure Management Board in Kraków.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
location: Park Kultury i Wypoczynku and Lasek Południowy, Słupsk, Poland
organizer: Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country race organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event takes place in the Park of Culture and Recreation and the Southern Forest, and aims to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate. The race combines sporting competition with helping those in need, engaging the local community and sponsors. This is the event’s fourth edition, and it has developed a charitable and community-building character.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Park of Culture and Recreation and the Southern Forest
Charity race supporting the treatment of a child with a cleft palate
High-quality organization thanks to support from local sponsors
additional: The race is a charity event, and the funds raised support Mateusz Gulbitowicz’s treatment. It is organized by a local school and supported by many regional sponsors. Previous editions raised more than 7,000 złoty for charitable causes. In previous editions, the race supported Mateusz’s treatment and rehabilitation; the funds were transferred to the Siepomaga Foundation’s account.

name: Sportowa Gra Miejska
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 4, Osiedle Paderewskiego, Katowice, Poland
description: The Sports City Game in Katowice is an extreme urban adventure taking place on April 18, 2026, in the Paderewski Estate and around the Three Ponds Valley. Participants can choose from three routes, including a family route with special tasks for parents and children. The game combines physical and logic-based challenges, offering a unique way to explore the city by completing a variety of tasks. The event attracts both fans of physical activity and those who want to discover the city in an unusual way.
course_highlights: Three routes to choose from, including a family route with special tasks
Explore the Paderewski Estate and the Three Ponds Valley
Physical and logic-based challenges at checkpoints
additional: Registration will be available on the day of the event. A two-person trip to Prague, Vienna or Budapest will be drawn after the awards ceremony. The event base is at Primary School No. 4 in the Paderewski Estate. Three routes have been announced, including a family route for parents and children. Event base: Primary School No. 4. Registration is set to open on March 9.

name: Wiosenna Hała
description: Wiosenna Hała is a walking orienteering marathon organized by KS Hała in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, in the village of Ruda. The event offers courses of varying difficulty, with the event base at Widok 1. Participants tackle challenging routes with numerous checkpoints, making it an event for fans of navigation and endurance. The start takes place in the afternoon, and the time limit for completing the course is 14 hours. Wiosenna Hała is a great opportunity to test your skills in the outdoors and compete with other orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: TP50 course with 40 checkpoints
14-hour time limit to complete the course
Event base in Ruda, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
additional: The late-arrival time limit on the course is 14 hours. The TP50 course has 40 checkpoints. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy Hała. The event base is at the primary school in Ruda, Widok 1, 27-230 Ruda. A cycling course is also listed.

name: Amberger Frühlingslauf mit Halbmarathon und 10 km
Hammer Charity Frühlingslauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Ruhrseen Halbmarathon
description:
On April 18, 2027, a running event awaits you that perfectly combines nature, emotion, and a sporting challenge. Set off from the idyllic Hengsteysee, run alongside sparkling waters and the majestic Ruhrsteilhänge cliffs, and through peaceful woodland sections—a course that will challenge and inspire you at the same time.

Whether you choose the half marathon or 10 km, this run is your moment. Your experience. Your spring highlight. Secure your place at the starting line now and be part of an unforgettable day at Hagen’s Hengsteysee!
additional:
A great race pack awaits you:

Race materials sent by post

High-quality finisher’s medal

3 course refreshment stations

3 toilet stations along the course

A generous finish-line refreshment area

Showers at the outdoor swimming pool

Lockers on site

After-party immediately after the run

name: Sportpark 21 Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.1 km, 0.7 km, 0.5 km

name: Cascaderun
description: The Hoogeveense Cascaderun is an annual running race in the centre of Hoogeveen, known as the biggest and best run in Drenthe. The race offers a flat, fast course over 5 and 10 miles, ideal both for running a fast time and for a first race experience. With thousands of enthusiastic runners, plenty of spectators, live music along the route and an iconic finish on Hoofdstraat, it is an atmospheric event for all levels. There are also special events, including the DuoRun, UNICEF Children’s Run and Giga-G for athletes with a disability.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through the centre of Hoogeveen
Officially measured 5- and 10-mile races with plenty of spectators
Iconic finish on Hoofdstraat, with live music and refreshments
additional: Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 10 April 2027 from 09:00 to 16:00 at Het Klooster, and on Sunday 18 April 2027 from 10:00 to 12:30 at De Tamboer. Official chip timing, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and professional finish photos are available to download free of charge. The Cascaderun awards a medal once every 5 years; the next time will be in 2028. Start areas are on Raadhuisplein and are indicated by letters on the race number. There are separate desks for the 5-mile race, 10-mile race and UNICEF Children’s Run. There are water stations along the route (5-mile race: 5 stations; 10-mile race: 7 stations) and toilets at the start and along the route. The first few kilometres can be crowded; runners are advised to keep right and pass on the left. Registration opens in November 2026, start areas on Raadhuisplein, water stations and refreshments along the route, official timing, festive afterparty

name: Marathon Groningen
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: PCC Maalwater Run
description: The PCC Maalwater Run and Walk in Heiloo offers a varied running and walking programme with distances for all ages. The start and finish are at the PCC and Trias grounds, where there is also an inflatable play castle for children. By taking part, you support Sport@School, a SportRaad Heiloo project that makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. The event is open to both recreational walkers and runners, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds
Distances range from 1 km to 16 km for walking and running
Inflatable play castle for children in the middle of the athletics track
additional: Children can play on an inflatable play castle under supervision during the event. Participants support Sport@School, a SportRaad Heiloo project that makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds in Heiloo, with activities for the whole family.

name: Wetter- en Wille Run
location: Wetter- en Willepark, Burgum, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Wetter- en Willerun is a race through and around the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum, with distances of 5 km and 10.5 km (quarter marathon). The event attracts enthusiastic runners and supports a local charity, with proceeds benefiting the community and promoting a healthy lifestyle. Alongside the races, there is also an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour and a new 25 km route. The event is known for its scenic course and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum
Distances of 5 km, 10.5 km (quarter marathon), and a new 25 km course
Includes an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour before the race
additional: Proceeds from the race go to a local charity. A new 25 km distance has been added. The race is an annual event with a large group of enthusiastic participants and has sold out in previous years. Routes of 5 km and 10.5 km, an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour, proceeds go to local charities, held in Wetter- en Willepark.

name: Ride & Roast
location: Fort aan de Klop, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Utrecht is an atmospheric running event held at Fort aan de Klop. Participants can choose a 5 or 10 kilometre route, which is flat and fast, with a finish at a beautiful location. After the race, there’s a relaxed get-together with music, drinks and a delicious plant-based Beyond Meat burger—ideal for a quick recovery. There’s also a 1-kilometre kids’ run for the youngest runners. The event combines sport with a summery, laid-back atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop finishing at Fort aan de Klop
Beautiful location on an island in northern Utrecht
Kids’ run of approximately 1 kilometre for children up to and including 12 years old
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 13:15 on race day or in advance between 13 and 16 April at All4running Store Utrecht. There is no supervised cloakroom; bicycles can be parked in a temporary bike storage area. Chip timing is provided via the race number, which can be recycled after use. There is an awards ceremony for the kids’ run and the main distances. After the race, a plant-based Beyond Meat burger and drinks will be available. Partners include All4running, Karhu, Virtuoos supplements, Shokz headphones and Runbites sports nutrition. Flat course, registration in advance and on the day, post-race food and drinks, kids’ run, prizes for winners, discount offers for participants.

name: Bolatická 20
location: Local swimming pool, Bolatice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatek účastníka pochodu 30kč (děti do a včetně 15 let zdarma).

description: Bolatická dvacítka is a traditional running race and walking event held every year in the area around Bolatice. The race offers 20 km and 10 km courses, which run mainly through forest terrain, combining cross-country sections and asphalt. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool. The route is marked in yellow, and the race takes place in normal road traffic, so participants must follow the rules. The event is suitable for runners and hikers and is followed by an informal gathering with country music.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly through the forest around the Strahovské ponds and Chuchelnický forest
A combination of cross-country sections and asphalt roads
The route is marked in yellow
additional: On-site registration for runners is open from 8:00 to 8:55; those registered in advance only need to collect their race number. The walk starts between 7:30 and 9:00. After the race, from 12:00, there will be an informal gathering with the country band CARAVANA. The race takes place in normal road traffic, and participants must follow the rules of the road. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool.

name: Běh kolem Hluboké 25 km - Krajský přebor v silničním běhu
description: The Run Around Hluboká is a traditional regional road-running championship over 25 km, held in the picturesque setting of Hluboká nad Vltavou. The race offers a high-quality course suitable for experienced runners and competitors vying for regional titles. The event is part of the South Bohemian Region athletics calendar and attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: 25 km road course
Picturesque surroundings of Hluboká nad Vltavou
Part of the regional road-running championship

name: CRAFT Brněnský půlmaraton a Brněnská desítka
location: Brno Velodrome, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The CRAFT Brno Half Marathon and Brno 10K are traditional running races held in the centre of Brno, with the event hub at the Brno Velodrome. The event is open to the general public, from elite runners to recreational athletes, and also includes children’s races. The races have international significance and regularly attract runners of all ages. In addition to the half marathon, 10.5 km and 5 km routes are available, including a relay option.
course_highlights: Event hub at the Brno Velodrome
Road routes of 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5 km through the city centre
The race is suitable for the general public, including children and veterans
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club project. The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. The organisers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s. The event also includes children’s races and relays. The race is a traditional event of international significance, attracting runners of all ages.

name: Chřibská – Studenec
description: We invite all runners to the 15th edition of the Cena města Chřibská Studenec Uphill Race, held in the picturesque, rugged terrain of the Lužické hory. The race is suitable for elite competitors as well as recreational runners and serves as a qualifier for the World Mountain Running Championships for youth. The start is in the town square in Chřibská and the finish is at the Studenec lookout tower. The course is 6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Course through the rugged terrain of the Lužické hory
6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the Studenec lookout tower
additional: Registration from 8:30 at the Chřibská Municipal Office. Prizes for the first three finishers in each category and a running raffle. According to the information provided, the start is at 10:00 in the square in Chřibská and registration begins at 8:30 at the Municipal Office.

name: Petřín třikrát jinak
description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where runners tackle Petřín Hill in three different ways: an interval start up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, a mass-start uphill run, and an interval climb up a slope on an unpaved path and steps. The total time is the sum of the times from all three races, with bonuses for the top competitors. Children can compete in ten age categories on courses around the Hunger Wall below the tower. The race also offers a relay in which a team of three runners completes all three disciplines.
course_highlights: Interval-start climb up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower
1 km uphill run with 118 m of elevation gain, with a mass start
Interval-start 1 km climb up a slope on an unpaved path and steps
additional: Race registration and facilities are in tents near the Petřín Lookout Tower. Interval starts are every 30 seconds, with a break after every 30 runners to allow them to descend from the tower. Children’s races cover 200 m, 365 m and 730 m, with the awards ceremony immediately after the finish. Relay teams consist of 3 runners, each running one discipline, and start together with the individual competitors. Time bonuses also apply to relays. Children’s races include ten age categories, with courses around the Hunger Wall. A three-person relay is also available, with each runner completing one section of the race.

name: Šaratický běh
location: Šaratice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Šaratice Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in the village of Šaratice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to test themselves on a fast, well-marked course. The main category is scheduled to start in the morning, making for an enjoyable race day in a community setting. The event is organized by the Municipality of Šaratice, which ensures high-quality organization and support. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar and is open to the general public.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Start and finish by the municipal office in Šaratice
Race in the South Moravian Region with a pleasant setting
additional: The first category starts at 9:00; the main category starts at 10:30. The event is organized by the Municipality of Šaratice. Contact by phone: 606 333 997. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Association’s services for runners and running events.

name: Charitativní běh Karlštejn
location: Karlštejn Castle, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Karlštejn Charity Run is a sporting event organized by Charita Beroun, offering runners the opportunity to combine a sporting experience with supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Gothic Karlštejn Castle and the Velká Amerika quarry, creating a unique combination of adventure and trail running. The start is right in the castle courtyard, and the event is suitable for anyone who wants to run with heart and support Charita Beroun. This year, the run will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, from 10:00 a.m.
course_highlights: Start right in the courtyard of Karlštejn Castle
Trail run around the Gothic Karlštejn Castle
The route passes the Velká Amerika quarry
additional: The event is charitable, and the entry fee is donated to Charita Beroun. The run is suitable for all runners who want to combine athletic performance with supporting a good cause. The organizer is Charita Beroun, located at Cajthamlova 169, Beroun.

name: 15 brodů Bílého potoka
location: Javůrek, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: 15 Fords of the Bílý Potok is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful valley of the Bílý Potok, passing the settlement of Šmelcovna. There are three routes: a 22 km long route with 16 fords, a 15 km medium route with 7 fords, and a non-competitive 7 km short route for those who want to enjoy the race atmosphere. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. It is well marked and suitable for moderately fit athletes. The race is ideal for recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and the challenge of fording streams in one of the most beautiful places near Brno.
course_highlights: Off-road route with 16 fords on the longest, 22 km option
Mainly forest and meadow paths, away from paved roads
A steep 1.7 km climb at the end
additional: The time limit for the long route is 3 hours. The route is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons. Most fords can be bypassed using a footbridge or a log. You can change your route distance during the race. The route surface includes unpaved terrain, gravel paths and asphalt. Three route distances are available: approximately 7 km (non-competitive), 15 km with seven fords, and 22 km, which includes an additional loop and a climb. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours.

name: Silniční běh kolem Hluboké nad Vltavou
location: Stadion TJ Hluboká, Hluboká nad Vltavou, Czech Republic
description: The road race around Hluboká nad Vltavou is a traditional 25 km road race that starts and finishes at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads through picturesque villages such as Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv. The race is ideal for runners looking for a combination of athletic challenge and a beautiful experience in the South Bohemian Region. It is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice under the leadership of Růžena Smolíková.
course_highlights: 25 km route along paved cycle paths and third-class roads
Passes through the villages of Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv
Start and finish at the TJ Hluboká stadium
additional: The race is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads. The start and finish are at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The organizer is Růžena Smolíková, who can also be contacted by phone.

name: Paskovská devítka
location: Paskov, Frýdek-Místek District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Hlavní závod a běh pro paskovský zámek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: Hlavní závod a běh pro paskovský zámek 100 Kč

description: Paskovská Devítka is a traditional running race organized by the town of Paskov, now being held for the eighth year. The event is open to the general public, from young children to adults, and features several categories, including the 9 km main race, youth races, and a non-competitive run for Paskov Castle. This year, the registration and start location for the main race have changed. The race starts at 9:15. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region and also brings traffic restrictions along the route to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9,000 metres
Youth races: 940 m, 480 m, and 160 m for the youngest participants
Non-competitive run for Paskov Castle: 3,000 metres
additional: The race takes place in Paskov, with traffic restrictions on Nádražní, Mírová, Fučíkova, Krátká, U Potoka, Bezručova, Boženy Němcové, Jiřího Wolkra, and U Parku streets from 9:00 to approximately 12:00. Each competitor takes part at their own risk. The race is suitable for all age groups, including the non-competitive run for participants born in 2014 or earlier.

name: Běh okolo Češíku
location: Lesní hřbitov, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50,- kč dětské kategorie (předem na účet i v den registrace na místě)

description: The Běh okolo Češíku is a running race held in the beautiful Hradec Králové forests near the Forest Cemetery in Hradec Králové. The event offers children’s categories with shorter courses and a main race for adults. It is suitable for families and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a day of sport in nature. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The forest “Finnish” running trail in Hradec Králové
The course runs through beautiful woodland
Close to the Forest Cemetery and an outdoor fitness area
additional: Registration is available online until 15.4.2026 or on site on race day. Children’s categories start between 09:30 and 10:15, followed by the main race between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published within 24 hours after the race. The program includes children’s races without timing and a main race for adults.

name: Prunéřovský půlmaraton
location: Cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice, Kadaň, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.
description: The Prunéřov Half Marathon is a certified running race held on the cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice. The course is an out-and-back route, and runners complete two laps with minimal elevation gain, making for a fast and enjoyable run. The race is part of the Summer Running Cup and also offers shorter distances for children and young people, with different distances and turnarounds. It is organized by Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s., which takes care of high-quality organization and runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Certified out-and-back course
Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice
additional: The race is part of the Summer Running Cup. Children’s races with shorter distances (250 m, 750 m, 1,500 m) are also available. Registration and payments are handled through the naZávody.cz system, which offers start-list management, automatic age categories, statistics, and other features. Runners can edit their registration themselves, transfer it to another person, or invite other runners.

name: Kudowska Sztafeta Górska
description: Kudowska Mountain Relay is an international running event held in the scenic areas of Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event includes a 3x25 km relay for teams of three and a solo run of approximately 75 km. There are also races over 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km, as well as Kids Trail races for children. The start and finish are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, and the routes follow varied mountain trails, offering exceptional views and challenging climbs.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny
The 3x25 km relay is divided into three different stages
A solo run of approximately 75 km with a challenging mountain profile
additional: The start and finish of all races are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, by the Teatr pod Blachą. The race office is located in the Mineral Water Pump Room in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event takes place on 10–11 April 2027. Entry-fee waivers are available to athletes with a high ITRA ranking. The organizer does not provide accommodation but recommends Kudowa-Zdrój as a place to stay. There are also races for children in three age categories and over three distances. Volunteering opportunities are available; the coordinator is Sylwia Niezgódka. The event is scheduled for 10–11 April 2027. Online registration is available; the organizer also announces fee waivers and preferential rates for selected athletes with an ITRA ranking.

name: 8. Gdańsk Maraton
description: Energa Gdańsk Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The marathon route passes some of the city’s most distinctive landmarks, including the European Solidarity Centre, the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island, the Baltic Philharmonic, the Neptune’s Fountain, the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre, and ERGO Arena. The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The event uses staggered start waves, and participants can expect a full race pack and extensive support along the course.
course_highlights: The route passes the European Solidarity Centre and the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island
Views of the Baltic Philharmonic, Neptune’s Fountain, and the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre
The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, with a visit to ERGO Arena
additional: The marathon starts in waves. The start line will close 5 minutes after the final starting signal. Holders of a Gdańsk resident card receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, medical support, course refreshment stations, a hot meal at the finish, and gifts from sponsors. The official marathon T-shirt and backpack are available for purchase. The event is scheduled for 24–25 April 2027; the website lists the marathon, a 5 km race, a relay, and the Junior Marathon. Entry fee details are not provided in the available sources.

name: 15 Półmaraton Henrykowski
description: The 15th Henryków Half Marathon is a trail race that passes through scenic parts of Lower Silesia, including Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest. The start and finish are by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków, adding a historical and cultural dimension to the event. The route combines asphalt and gravel surfaces, offering runners varied terrain. The event promotes physical activity, regional culture and local tourism. Participants can expect a commemorative T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: The route passes through Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest
Asphalt and gravel surfaces
Start and finish by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 on race day. Race numbers with timing chips are issued at the race office upon presentation of a QR code. Participants receive a technical T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal. Bag drop and toilets are available at the start. Overall and age-group classifications are provided for the 21 km and 10 km races and the 10 km Nordic Walking event. Cash prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the half marathon. The route is not certified by PZLA. A 10 km race and 10 km Nordic Walking event are also available. Information about the 15th edition refers to 19 April 2026; there is no confirmation that the event will take place on 18 April 2027.

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Ekspozycja Historyczno-Dydaktyczna przy Górze Śmierci, Paszczyna, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Dębica, Gmina Dębica, Akademia Piłkarska Gminy Dębica „Chemik Pustków” i Kępa Sport
description: The Memorial Run around Góra Śmierci is an annual sporting event held in Paszczyna to commemorate the victims of Nazi labor camps and promote a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci and includes children’s races over short distances, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a 10 km main race. Main-race participants receive a race package, and classifications and prizes are provided for both children and adults in various age categories. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: 10 km main-race route around Góra Śmierci
5 km Memorial Nordic Walking march
Children’s and youth races over distances from 50 m to 1,000 m
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:30 and closes 15 minutes before the start of each distance. The main-race entry fee includes a race package. Prizes are awarded for places 1–3 in the main race, as well as in the age-group classifications. OPEN category winners are not also awarded in the age groups. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci in Paszczyna. Registration is handled by KępaSport.

name: Bydgoski Bieg Urodzinowy
description: The Bydgoszcz Birthday Run is an annual running event held in Bydgoszcz, taking place on April 18, 2027. The race starts at 11:00. The participant limit is 1,500, and the first 1,300 people to register will receive a T-shirt. The route will be announced soon. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels.
additional: Participant limit: 1,500. A T-shirt is available to the first 1,300 people to register. A T-shirt is provided for the first 1,300 registered participants.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Arek Tołłoczko i Rafał Malitkowski, przy wsparciu Stowarzyszenia na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon route follows forest and country roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with an emphasis on camaraderie and the recreational nature of the race. The organizers, including Arek Tołłoczko, invite runners to take part in four editions of the marathon each year, offering varied conditions and beautiful views. The start and finish are on Polna Street, and the route is well marked and prepared for runners.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km route along forest and country roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Picturesque views of forests and fields, with a peaceful, uncrowded atmosphere
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club; the event is not mass-participation, with a relaxed approach to competition and prizes; convenient parking; four marathons held each year (in winter, spring, summer, and autumn). Descriptions of previous races indicate a marathon distance of 42.195 km; the organizers have not provided confirmed details for the edition on 18 April 2027.

name: Cross na sześć łap
description: Uniejów Cross on Six Paws is a unique race for dog-loving sports enthusiasts, held in the picturesque Warta River areas near Uniejów Castle. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes, combining sport, adventure and time in nature. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, a canicross world champion, who brings his experience and passion to the course. At the finish, medals, trophies for the top finishers and refreshments await both runners and their four-legged companions. The event is open to anyone who wants to spend active time with their dog and enjoy a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometres are available
Run as a duo with your dog, surrounded by nature
additional: At the finish, participants will receive medals, trophies for the top finishers, refreshments and water, as well as treats for dogs. The event takes place by Uniejów Castle. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS Canicross World Champion. Advance registration is required. The previous edition also featured children's races over 100 and 300 m. The event ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS Canicross World Champion.

name: Dziki tor run
description: Dziki Tor Run is the inaugural edition of a race held on the motocross track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. It’s a unique opportunity to test your endurance on natural, challenging terrain where enduro motorcycles compete every day. The course has no technical obstacles, but its natural slopes and bumps challenge participants. The race is open to both beginners and more experienced runners looking for a thrill.
course_highlights: Motocross/enduro track with natural terrain
No technical obstacles, but challenging slopes and bumps
Course in Mieroszów on Hoża Street
additional: Distances: 4 km (one lap) for beginners and 8 km (two laps) for more experienced runners. Registration is open until 15 April at 23:59. The race starts at 11:30. The event takes place on the motocross track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. Available calendars list an estimated date of 19 April 2027, one day later than the stated date of 18 April.

name: IV Białołęcki Bieg Leśny
description: The 4th Białołęka Forest Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The race takes place on a forest course, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and varied running conditions. The organizer, the Małopolskie Szlaki Foundation, provides professional event services and RFID timekeeping. The participant limit is 500, and the start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: Forest course in Warsaw’s Białołęka district
Professional RFID timekeeping
Participant limit of 500
additional: The participant limit is 500. The event takes place in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The organizer provides electronic RFID timekeeping. The start is at 10:00. The participant limit for the 2026 edition was 500. Registration closed on April 13, 2026; timekeeping was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: IX Bieg Jelenia
description: Bieg Jelenia is the open Tychy cross-country championships, held in the scenic Paprocany forests. The course is approximately 7–8 km long and consists of two 3.5–4 km loops, following forest tracks and terrain with natural obstacles such as roots, mud, fallen branches and soft sand. The event is co-financed by the City of Tychy and also includes Bieg Jelonka for children and young people. The race starts at the Paprocany Recreation Centre in Tychy.
course_highlights: A 7–8 km cross-country course over two loops
Natural obstacles: roots, mud, fallen branches and soft sand
The scenic Paprocany forests
additional: Bieg Jelonka for children and young people also takes place during the event. The start and finish are at the Paprocany Recreation Centre (Parkowa 17, Tychy). The race is co-financed from the City of Tychy budget. Bieg Jelonka for children and young people accompanies the event. Available information about the ninth edition points to 2026, so details of the specified edition and the 2027 date may not be confirmed.

name: Poznań Półmaraton
location: ul. Roosevelta near Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie, Poznań, Poland
description: The PKO Poznań Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Poznań, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering an exciting sporting experience and an opportunity to test your fitness. The organizers make sure the event has a family-friendly atmosphere, also offering an activity zone and races for children and young people. The event is well organized and highly regarded in the running community.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through the streets of Poznań.
In 2026, the race started on Roosevelta Street, near the Poznań International Fair.
The previous edition’s course ran through Łazarz, Grunwald, Junikowo and Ławica.
additional: Registration for the 19th PKO Poznań Half Marathon will open in December. The rules and price list are being finalized and will be announced soon. The organizers are providing an activity zone and races for children and young people as accompanying events. The course and program are being prepared, and participants are encouraged to follow the official information channels. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open in December; the entry form is being prepared.

name: TAURON 23. Cracovia Maraton
description: The Cracovia Marathon is Kraków’s most important running event and Poland’s largest spring marathon over the 42 km and 195 m distance. Held since 2002, it attracts runners from around the world, representing more than 80 countries. The course passes through historic and modern parts of Kraków, with the start and finish on the Main Market Square, beside landmarks such as Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall. The event also offers a weekend full of sporting attractions, including the 10 km Night Run, the Mini Cracovia Marathon, roller-skating races and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
Views of the Old Town at night during the 10 km Night Run
additional: The event also includes the Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the Cracovia Marathon on Skates (the full distance around the Błonia, with a maximum time limit of 3 hours), a 4.2 km Nordic walking event and the 10 km Night Run, with a time limit of 1.5 hours. Participants with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim push and active wheelchair categories. The event is international in character and is held under the slogan “with history in the background”.

name: VI Oleśnicki Bieg Leśny
location: Miodary, Oleśnica County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Oleśnica Forest Run is a trail race held in the picturesque area of Miłowice. The event attracts runners who enjoy natural forest terrain, offering a challenging course with varied surfaces. Open to all, it is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and compete with runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: Forest course with varied surfaces
Picturesque views and natural surroundings
Trail challenges for runners
additional: The available information about the sixth edition concerns an event scheduled for 19 April 2026; it does not confirm a date of 18 April 2027. In the 2026 edition, children’s races were scheduled for 10:00, the half marathon for 10:30, and the 10 km race and Nordic Walking for 11:00.

name: XVIII Bieg Piaśnicki
organizer: Gmina Wejherowo i The North Event
description: The Piaśnica Run commemorates the victims of the German occupation of Poland during World War II. The running and Nordic walking routes pass through places where thousands of innocent people were murdered. The event aims to honor the victims, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the local community together. The program also includes cultural events such as exhibitions, lectures, and concerts that shed light on the history of Gdańsk Pomerania.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes through historic sites of wartime atrocities
Commemoration of the victims of the German occupation of Poland
Cultural events: exhibitions, lectures, concerts, and meetings with historians
additional: The event includes runs and Nordic walking. It promotes a healthy lifestyle and community integration. The event is commemorative and educational. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed in available sources.

name: XXXIII Memoriał Uliczny im. Michała Flud...
Běh Čedoku
description: The Čedok Run is a 3.7 km race run mostly on asphalt in Prague 4. This run is part of the SABZO series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a fast, pleasant race in an urban setting. The course is suitable for those who prefer asphalt and want to experience a competitive atmosphere as part of the running community.
course_highlights: 3.7 km course
Mostly asphalt surface
Urban setting in Prague 4

name: Mûzelloop Jirnsum
description: The Mûzelloop Jirnsum is a friendly running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the small river Mûzel in Jirnsum. The routes pass historical and natural landmarks, including the old lower course of the Boarn River and the Sneker Oudvaart. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run and distances of 5, 8.3 and 10 km, with aid stations along the way. The event is organized by a foundation with the help of volunteers and sponsors. It has a warm local atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special trophies for the best Jirnsummers.
course_highlights: Routes along the small river Mûzel and the old lower course of the Boarn River
Aid stations on the 8.3 and 10 km routes; refreshments at the finish for the 5 km
Historic surroundings, including the Jirnsummersyl lock and a connection to the Sneker Oudvaart
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00 in the large hall of the 2 Gemeenten. No showers are available. Ample parking is available nearby at the 2 Gemeenten, opposite the transmission tower on Rijksweg. The routes are marked with arrow signs and chalk arrows, and traffic marshals are stationed at key points. All children receive a memento. Prizes are awarded to first, second and third place in each distance, with special trophies for the best Jirnsummers. The event is limited to 300 participants, and online advance registration is the only way to enter. The event takes place in April 2027, with distances for children and adults, in a beautiful natural setting for runners.

name: Rondje Vrachelen
location: Atletiekbaan ATV Scorpio, Vrachelen, Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Rondje Vrachelen is a friendly and sporty evening run in the natural surroundings of Oosterhout, starting and finishing on the athletics track at ATV Scorpio. Participants run a varied course with both paved and unpaved paths through the beautiful Vrachelen area. The run is suitable for recreational and competitive runners, with two distances of 6 km and 10 km. Facilities such as changing rooms, showers and first aid are available, and there is ample parking nearby.
course_highlights: A varied course with paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish on the athletics track at ATV Scorpio
Run through the natural surroundings of Vrachelen in Oosterhout
additional: Registration is open from 1 December 2026 until half an hour before the race starts, online only. There is ample parking at Zwembad de Warande and football club TSC. Shower facilities are available after the run. An AED is available for emergencies. Participation is at your own risk. Registration opens on 1 December 2026, the start time is 19:30, and the event takes place near Wilhelminakanaal Zuid 78, Oosterhout.

name: Okolo stadionu - silniční pětka
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: Okolo stadionu – Road 5K is a traditional 5 km road race held at Vítkovice Stadium in Ostrava. The race offers a fast course suitable for runners looking to test their speed on asphalt. It is organized by Sdružení sportovních klubů Vítkovice, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The main category traditionally starts in the early evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 5 km road course
Loop around Vítkovice Stadium in Ostrava
Fast asphalt surface suitable for personal bests
additional: The first category starts at 17:20, and the main category starts at 18:00. The organizer is Sdružení sportovních klubů Vítkovice, z.s.; contact person: Mgr. Šárka Mokrá, phone 773 004 098. In 2025, the first category started at 17:20 and the main category at 18:00. Details about the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: 399. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running race organized by the Chrudim Recreational Runners Club at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany. The race offers 10 km and 3.6 km courses, suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event is popular for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of the Pardubice Region.
course_highlights: 10 km and 3.6 km routes
Start and finish at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany
Scenic surroundings of the Pardubice Region

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Brno – Špilberk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Brno is a charity running event held at Špilberk, offering participants a choice between a 3 km course (2 laps) and a 6 km course (4 laps). The run starts at 9:00 p.m. and is accompanied by a cultural programme, including a concert. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half goes towards direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event is suitable for runners and walkers and is open to anyone who wants to support a good cause.
course_highlights: The course runs through Špilberk, with a choice of 3 km or 6 km distance
A night run with a choice of entry option that includes a headlamp or a sports headband
An accompanying programme, including a concert during registration
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option that includes a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards receive free entry, but are not entitled to a headlamp or headband. The run has limited capacity for participants’ safety and comfort. A cloakroom and baggage storage are available on site. Medical staff will be present, and participants may also run with a dog (except in Jihlava).

name: Běh okolo Kraví hory

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: The Run around Kraví hora is a traditional race in Brno, offering runners an interesting 2.7 km loop. Men and women run two laps, for a total of 5.4 km, while children can race over a distance suited to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Kraví hora, with refreshments and baggage storage available on site. Men and women start together, and the atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to all age groups.
course_highlights: A 2.7 km loop in the natural surroundings of Kraví hora
Men and women run two laps (5.4 km); children race over an age-appropriate distance
Start and finish by the swimming pool, with refreshments and baggage storage
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45 and the main race at 18:00. Parking is available in a limited number of spaces near the venue. Public transport is available via bus 68 and tram 4 to Náměstí Míru stop. Water is available for refreshments after the race. Competitors start at their own risk. According to the available information, the entry fee is paid on site during registration.

name: ITMBWieczorem
location: Bulwar Poleski, near Dębnicki Bridge, Kraków, Poland
description: ITMBWieczorem is a weekly series of free 5 km and 10 km runs along Kraków’s Vistula Boulevards. The runs take place every Thursday at 20:00, starting and finishing on Bulwar Polejski by Dębnicki Bridge. The course follows the Vistula Boulevards to the Field Redoubt on Tyniecka Street, where runners turn around. From March to April and from October to November, the runs are held only over 5 km. Participation is free and open to people over 14 years of age.
course_highlights: Course along the Vistula Boulevards, with a turnaround at the Field Redoubt on Tyniecka Street
Start and finish on Bulwar Polejski by Dębnicki Bridge
5 km and 10 km distances (the 10 km distance is two laps of the 5 km course)
additional: Participation is free. Time limits: 40 minutes for 5 km and 1 hour for 10 km (the latter is recommended for advanced runners). After completing 25, 50, and 100 runs, participants can order a commemorative T-shirt for 25 zł. A small number of belongings can be left at the start area (the organizer is not responsible for items left there). The runs are organized on a friendly, informal basis, with care taken around pedestrians and cyclists. Registration via a form is required. Participants should bring a printed race number or barcode. The runs take place on Thursdays at 20:00; the 2027 season schedule has not been confirmed.

name: UP THE HILL
description: UP THE HILL is a two-day running weekend on the Swabian Alb, featuring five varied routes for every ability level. The races follow spectacular trails along the Albtrauf, with breathtaking views, and offer a special atmosphere with enthusiastic spectators and a strong community. The event is more than just a race—it is an experience to remember and enjoys international recognition.
course_highlights: Spectacular trails along the Albtrauf
Breathtaking views
Varied routes with up to 2,000 metres of elevation gain
additional: The event takes place over two days, with race-number collection and starts on Friday evening for UTH10 and UTH5, and on Saturday morning for UTH50, UTH25 and the Kids Run. Baggage storage, aid stations and a team competition are available. A high-quality UTH running shirt can be added during registration for €38 until 25.03.2026. The event also includes a Kids Run and competitions in the Silberdistel-Albcup, offering a varied challenge for runners of all levels.

name: Trhovosvinenská padesátka
location: Buškův hamr, Trhové Sviny, Czech Republic
description: Trhovosvinenská Padesátka is a long-distance walk through the Trhové Sviny region and its surroundings, offering two main routes of 50 km and 100 km. The event is intended for both hikers and runners, who can choose their start time. The route passes through picturesque countryside, with several refreshment stations, and finishes at the historic Buškův hamr site in Trhové Sviny. The organizers emphasize safety, compliance with traffic rules, and environmental protection. The walk has a long tradition and is popular with both locals and visitors to the region.
course_highlights: The route crosses the Trhové Sviny region and offers scenic views
Refreshment stations along the route (2 on the 50 km route, 4 on the 100 km route)
Finish at the historic Buškův hamr site
additional: The start time for the 50 km route can be chosen freely between 6:00 and 9:00; the 100 km route is a long-distance event, starting at 21:00 for walkers and 22:00 for runners. Mandatory equipment includes a charged mobile phone, a working headlamp, and reflective elements as required by law. Refreshments along the route include water, drinks, fruit, chocolate, and slices of cake. Sausages are available at the finish. Dogs are allowed, provided the rules are followed. The organizers ask participants to respect nature and comply with traffic rules and the Forest Act. The walk is intended for both hikers and runners and takes place in all weather. There are refreshment stations along the routes; refreshments and overnight accommodation are available at the finish.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim
location: Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim is an OCR race offering a challenging and varied course around Kuřim. The race combines a quiet forest, Srpek Pond, the challenging Zlobice hill, and the mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim Stonehenge. The course is ideally mixed with flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections that will test every brave knight. The main category starts in the evening at 20:30, adding a unique atmosphere to the race.
course_highlights: Quiet forest and Srpek Pond
The challenging Zlobice hill
The mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim Stonehenge
additional: The race is an OCR event and starts in the evening. The course combines flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections. It is organized by Překážkové sporty, z. s., Jan Kolář.

distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
