name: Šanovská desítka
location: Šanov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Šanov Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Sokol Šanov Physical Education Association, inviting all runners to take on a ten-kilometer course through the picturesque surroundings of Šanov. The race takes place at the municipal sports field and offers an atmosphere full of excitement and determination. Starts are scheduled by category from 9:30, and participants can look forward to a friendly sporting environment and the support of the running community. The event is supported by local partners and is suitable for all passionate athletes.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course through the picturesque surroundings of Šanov
Start at the municipal sports field
Category starts from 9:30
additional: Starts are scheduled by category from 9:30 at the municipal sports field. The main contact is Mgr. Aneta Reischlová, who can also be reached by phone at +420 775 618 141. The event is supported by Vapas a.s.

name: Kryry třikrát jinak
location: Schillerova rozhledna, Kryry, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kryry Three Ways is a unique hill-running race held in the town of Kryry. Competitors climb the hill with Schiller’s Lookout Tower in three different ways: a short mass-start hill race, an interval uphill run, and a climb up the 127 steps to the lookout tower. The total time is the sum of the three individual races, with time deductions awarded to the top three finishers. The event also includes children’s races on courses below the lookout tower and a relay for teams of three runners.
course_highlights: 1.25 km mass-start hill race
750 m interval uphill run
Climb up 127 steps to Schiller’s Lookout Tower
additional: Race registration and changing facilities are in tents on Československé armády Square in Kryry. Children’s races are divided into several age categories, with different course lengths. The relay is open to teams of three, with no restrictions on age or gender. Winners in the individual categories and relays receive prizes. The event also includes a parent-and-child competition organised in cooperation with ZŠ Kryry. Part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series; runners can take part in a three-person relay. Overall standings are determined by the combined times from all three stages, with time deductions awarded to the top three finishers.

name: Běh Opárenským údolím
location: Bývalá hospoda Oráč, Opárno, Velemín, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes internet 150 Kč (platba na účet č. 268131511/0300 )

description: The Opárenské Valley Run is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Opárenské Valley, finishing at the former Oráč pub on the village square in Opárno. The route follows asphalt and forest paths, offering a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is suitable for the general public, with refreshments provided for participants. It traditionally starts in the afternoon in May, with transport for participants from Lovosice available.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along asphalt and forest paths
Finish at the former Oráč pub, with access to the building available
Refreshments provided for participants
additional: Backpacks will be transported to the finish after the start. The start and transport for participants from Lovosice (Lovosice město stop, at the junction of Lovošská and Ústecká streets) is at 15:00; transport to Lhotka is at 14:00. Refreshments and access to the building are provided at the finish; backpacks can be transported there.

name: Desítka z Jasének
location: Gras Servis, Hlučín-Jasénky, Hlučín, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100,- při online registraci předem, platba v hotovosti na místě/QR kodem předem

description: Desítka z Jasének is a traditional running race held at the Gras Servis premises in Hlučín-Jasénky. The route runs through the valleys of Jasénka Creek and the Opava River, is approximately 8.6 km long, and is marked with colored ribbons. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and features a unique bridge that runners and walkers cross only once. The start and finish are located at the Gras Servis premises, where refreshments are provided for participants. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: The route runs through the valleys of Jasénka Creek and the Opava River
The route is 8.6 km long and marked with colored ribbons
A unique bridge over the river, crossed only once
additional: On-site registration is available from 13:00 to 13:50. Participants receive a drink and refreshments with their race number; they can decline these when registering. It is recommended that participants arrive at least 15 minutes before the race starts. The race is also suitable for walkers; according to the available description, refreshments are provided for participants.

name: Běh na Velký Javorník
location: Turistická chata Velký Javorník, Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic
description: The race up Velký Javorník is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. It starts at the Velký Javorník mountain hut and offers beautiful views and challenging terrain. All runners are warmly invited to take part in this event, which takes place every year in May.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain
Start and finish at the Velký Javorník mountain hut
Beautiful views of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race traditionally takes place on a Saturday in May. The start is at 10:00 at the Velký Javorník mountain hut.

name: Dubenský běh pro dobrou věc
location: Dubné, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Dubné Run for a Good Cause is a charity running event held in Dubné in the South Bohemian Region, bringing together sport, fun and a charitable purpose. It traditionally supports families with children with disabilities. The proceeds from the 9th edition will go to the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice to help pay for a special van and rehabilitation. The event offers 3 km and 5 km routes and is suitable for all ages. The race starts at the football pitch by Velký hajský pond, creating a pleasant setting for both running and walking.
course_highlights: 3 km and 5 km routes
Start and finish at the football pitch by Velký hajský pond in Dubné
Charity event supporting families with children with disabilities
additional: The event is suitable for all generations and combines sport with charity. The proceeds will support a family with a child with a disability. The event features mixed-gender races over 3 km and 5 km. The proceeds will help the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice, including a contribution toward a van with a winding platform and rehabilitation.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: Rudawy Wiosenny Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Rudawy Spring Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the picturesque Rudawy Janowickie Mountains in Miedzianka. Participants can choose from several distances: 15, 25, 45, and 65 kilometers, as well as a 9 km family run. The event brings the mountain running community together, emphasizing the team spirit of the sport and offering unique routes along forest paths and rocky trails. The festival has been held since 2013 and is known for its beautiful views and challenging routes.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts. It takes place in the picturesque Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum in the Syców Forest District. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which emphasizes scenic routes and natural surroundings. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers promote running and ensure a friendly, sporting atmosphere.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The 12th Commandos Quarter Marathon is a uniformed-services race organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk. The 10.55 km course runs through the grounds of the 650th Anniversary Stadium and the Northern Wood, offering extreme racing conditions for uniformed services and running enthusiasts. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, competition, and the training of uniformed services. The race is scheduled to start on May 16, 2026, at 12:00, with a participant limit of 999.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: Klub Biegowy Dzik, Wojskowe Centrum Sportu DORSZ, 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is an extreme trail race organized by the “Dzik” Running Club Association in Szczecin, at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The 3-mile (4 km and 828 metres) course runs along dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, and forest roads, offering challenging running conditions. The race is free in 2026 and is open to people over 16, with a limited number of places. The start and finish are at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The event brings people together and promotes outdoor physical activity.

name: 4 Lędzińska Piwna Mila
description: The 4th Lędziny Beer Mile is an annual running event held in Lędziny, combining sporting competition with good fun and a local atmosphere. The race covers a distance of one mile, making it appealing to both amateur and more experienced runners. The event is organized by EMJOT Tri Team and attracts participants from across the region. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and get to know the local community.

name: 53 Cross Mysłowicki w biegach przełajowych
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mysłowicach
description: The 53rd Mysłowice Cross is a traditional cross-country race held in the scenic Słupna Park in Mysłowice. Participants run a loop of nearly 5.5 kilometres along challenging forest trails, featuring both climbs and a charming natural setting. The event is very popular, attracting nearly 300 runners, and is supported by UKS Chromik Mysłowice and the Central Museum of Firefighting. Participants can look forward to a unique medal with a moving element, legendary doughnuts, and attractive sports prizes.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and welcome both runners and spectators.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main races and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s events begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows scenic terrain by the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
organizer: Fundacja Mocni na starcie, Biegaj Leszno, Wojewódzki Szpital Wielospecjalistyczny w Lesznie
description: Mariuszowa 5-ka is a race taking place on May 16, 2026, in Leszno, in the Nowy Świat forest district. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks, offering distances of 5.3 km (one loop) and 10.3 km (two loops). In addition to the main races, there is a 4 km Nordic walking event, as well as youth and children’s races over shorter distances. The race office is located in the administrative building of the Regional Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, while the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. The event is small-scale, with participant limits for each event.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: The V Szczecinecka 5K is a running event held in Szczecinek, in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is part of a duathlon and is scheduled for May 16, 2026, at 11:30. Participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping. The event is open to a range of runners and offers a great opportunity for sporting competition and active recreation.

name: VIII Chrzanowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 8th Chrzanów Street Race, known as Pociąg do biegania, is a popular sporting event in Chrzanów, taking place on May 16, 2026. The event offers three distances: a 5 km race for beginners and recreational runners, a 10 km race for more experienced runners, and a 5 km Nordic walking event. The organizers provide professional race management, course safety, and commemorative medals for all participants. It’s a great opportunity to join the sporting community of Chrzanów County and enjoy outdoor exercise.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half-marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city's scenic areas, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.

name: XXVIII Oleskie Uliczne Biegi Pokoju
description: The 28th Olesno Street Peace Runs is an annual running event organized by the Olesno Municipality, attracting runners from various categories. The races take place on the streets of Olesno, with professional timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 16:50, and online registration is open until May 14, 2026. This sporting event brings together a passion for running, local tradition, and a competitive atmosphere.

name: Elpersheimer Pfingstlauf EnergieZentrum-Cup
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 1500 Meter, 0.5 km

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

name: 68. ročník půlmaratónu Kolín - Velký Osek - Kolín
description: The Kolín–Velký Osek–Kolín Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the T.J. Sokol Kolín athletics club. The race gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a half-marathon course from Kolín to Velký Osek and back. The event is part of the region’s athletics calendar and attracts a broad running community. The organizers provide administrative support and communicate with participants through their athletics club.
course_highlights: The course runs from Kolín to Velký Osek and back
Half-marathon distance of 21.1 km
The race is part of the Central Bohemian Region athletics calendar

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Mimoň
location: Park před gymnáziem, Mimoň, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Mimoň is a traditional running event that commemorates freedom fighters and the victims of totalitarian regimes. The race takes place in the park in front of the grammar school and is part of a nationwide series of runs organized to support the recording of eyewitness memories and history education. The event is open to all runners who want to run for the memory of the nation and support a good cause. We look forward to seeing you in May 2027!
course_highlights: A run in the park in front of the grammar school in Mimoň
Commemorating freedom fighters and the victims of totalitarian regimes
Part of the nationwide Memory of the Nation running series
additional: Proceeds from the entry fees go toward recording eyewitness memories, education, and helping heroes. The event is part of a series of races held in various towns and cities across the Czech Republic during May. Organizer contacts are available for registration and further information. The entry fee is a contribution supporting the Memory of the Nation.

name: Běh Lapákem
location: Městský stadion, Kladno, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Lapákem is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held at the municipal stadium in Kladno. The race gives runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a rolling course combining paved roads with forest and field paths. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the Central Bohemian Region. The event is suitable for a broad running community and supports runners in the Kladno area.
course_highlights: Rolling course profile
A combination of paved roads and forest and field paths
Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Kladno
additional: Maratón klub Kladno is an association focused on endurance running and organizing running races. The club also organizes other events, including Lhotecká Kaštanka (15 km) and Závod dvojic (10 km). Organizer contact details are available, including mobile numbers and email addresses. The Běh Lapákem course is suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Běh sídlištěm
location: Police nad Metují, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Housing Estate Run is a public running race organized by the SKI Police nad Metují Cross-Country Ski Club. The race offers an opportunity for all age groups and runners of varying abilities. The route runs through the urban area of Police nad Metují and is part of the club’s event calendar. The SKI Police nad Metují Club is known for organizing various running and skiing races in the Hradec Králové Region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the housing estate in Police nad Metují
The race is suitable for all age groups
Organized by the SKI Police nad Metují Cross-Country Ski Club

name: Jarov-Károv
description: The Jarov-Károv race is a 2.99 km uphill run with 150 meters of elevation gain, part of the Hill Runs in Prague and the Surrounding Area series. This race offers a challenge for runners who want to test their strength and endurance on demanding terrain with a significant climb. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Jarov and Károv, adding to the race’s appeal and distinctive character. The race is suitable for all runners who enjoy mountain running and want to experience a sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: Route length: 2.99 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Part of the Hill Runs in Prague and the Surrounding Area series

name: Brdská 25
location: SK Litavan Bohutín football field, Bohutín, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: hlavní závod Brdská 25 – při platbě do 17.5.2023 : 400 ,- Kč bez trička

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: hlavní závod Brdská 25 – při platbě do 17.5.2023 : 600 ,- s tričkem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: doprovodné závody 300 ,- Kč (NW Brdy a CR Brdy)

description: Brdská 25 is a traditional endurance running race through the central Brdy, open to a wide range of recreational athletes. It offers a challenging 25 km course with more than 400 metres of elevation gain, combining running on traffic-free routes with trail sections around Třemošná and Tok, the highest hill in the Brdy. The event also includes accompanying races such as Brdská 12, Nordic Walking Brdy and Cruiser Race Brdy, including children’s categories. The start and finish are at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch, providing convenient facilities for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: 25 km course with more than 400 metres of elevation gain
Trail sections around Třemošná and Tok, the highest hill in the Brdy
Start and finish at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch
additional: Registration opens at 8:00 for the youth races. The main race starts at 11:00; the 12 km race, Nordic Walking and Cruiser Race start at 11:05. The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and after the race (water, sports drink, cola, banana and salt). Youth categories and children can take part free of charge. T-shirts are available for an additional fee. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race facilities are located by the SK Litavan Bohutín pitch.

name: Běh na Kašperk
description: Běh na Kašperk is a traditional and prestigious race in the Klatovy District, held since 2011. The 3.2 km course starts in the square in Kašperské Hory at an elevation of 750 m above sea level and runs along flat ground between meadows, with beautiful views of Mount Křemelná. It is followed by a steep descent to the Opolenecký Stream and a challenging final 1.7 km climb, with 200 metres of elevation gain, to Kašperk Castle, where the finish is located. After the race, runners can enjoy the atmosphere of the castle and jog back to town.
course_highlights: Start in the square at an elevation of 750 m above sea level
Flat section along the green trail with views of Mount Křemelná
Final 1.7 km climb with 200 m of elevation gain to Kašperk Castle
additional: Registration takes place in front of the cinema building from 9:15 to 9:45. The start and finish may shift slightly, so no course record is recorded. Organised by the town of Kašperské Hory. Contact: Ms. Renata Hartmanová (tel. 777 848 756), her daughters, and Mr. Šimurda Sr.

name: Běh pro kočku
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Lázně Toušeň, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro kočku is a charity running event held at the football pitch grounds in Lázně Toušeň. It raises awareness of homeless cats and supports a selected cat shelter. The event offers an 8 km main race along the Elbe between the Toušeň and Čelákovice bridges, as well as a 4 km accompanying route suitable for walking. There are activities for children and adults, along with cat-themed merchandise for sale, with proceeds supporting the shelter. The run is suitable for all ages and emphasizes fair play and a responsible approach to racing.
course_highlights: 8 km main race along the Elbe between the Toušeň and Čelákovice bridges
4 km accompanying route around Malvíny Lake, also suitable for walking
Start and finish at the football pitch grounds in Lázně Toušeň
additional: Registration is also available on the day of the race. The start is at 11:30; opening and activities for children begin at 10:00. Seating is available at a restaurant with a summer terrace and a children's playground. Cat-themed scarves (250 CZK) and T-shirts (300 CZK) are available to buy, with proceeds supporting the cat shelter. The event supports the O.S. Tlapky Mochov shelter. Activities for children are part of the event, and proceeds from sales of cat-themed items support the cat shelter.

name: Hanácká kojetínská desítka
location: Fotbalový stadion Morava, Kojetín, Czech Republic
description: Hanácká Kojetínská Desítka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held at the Morava football stadium in Kojetín. The race is part of a series of running events focused on recreational and competitive running that the club organizes in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and organizing endurance races for the general public as well as ambitious competitors. The event offers an opportunity for runners of all levels and is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Morava football stadium in Kojetín
A traditional running race with a long history
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region

name: Brdská 12
location: Fotbalové hřiště SK Litavan Bohutín, Bohutín, Czech Republic
description: Brdská 12 is a traditional running race held as part of the Brdský běžecký pohár, starting and finishing at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch. The approximately 12 km course runs mostly on forest paths and asphalt, in a counterclockwise direction. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 11:05, and participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization by Triklub Příbram.
course_highlights: 12 km course, mainly on forest paths and asphalt
Counterclockwise loop
Start and finish at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The course is GPS-measured at 12.09 km. The organizer is Triklub Příbram. The course combines forest paths and asphalt. Results have been available in the system since 2014. The loop is run counterclockwise. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:05; children’s races are free.

name: Běh alejí
description: Běh alejí is a traditional running race held in the centre of Králíky and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The event offers various categories for adults and young runners, with courses of different lengths and elevation gains. It is known for its good organisation and welcoming atmosphere, attracting runners of all ages. The race is part of a regional running series and offers the opportunity to earn points in the ISCAREX Cup.
course_highlights: Various course lengths from 0.1 km to 1.25 km with an elevation gain of 160 m
The race takes place in the centre of Králíky, among beautiful tree-lined avenues
Part of the ISCAREX Cup, with categories for all age groups
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and awards points based on finishing position and time. Categories span a wide range of ages, from the youngest pupils to veterans. The event is known for its good organisation and welcoming atmosphere, including a raffle and support for runners. According to the available description, the start and registration take place in the centre of Králíky; the race is also open to young runners.

name: FUN&RUN 2026
description: Fun&Run is a charity run organised by the Prague Pride association and the Czech AIDS Help Society, taking place on 17 May 2026 in Stromovka Park in Prague. The run fights homophobia, biphobia, intersexphobia, transphobia and the stigmatisation of people living with HIV. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes, with 10 km runners completing one additional loop. The event features an accompanying entertainment programme, and proceeds support the queer community and people living with HIV in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The 5 km route runs entirely through Stromovka Park
The 10 km route includes an additional loop between points 3 and 47
The course will be marked on site
additional: The event programme includes venue opening and registration from 12:00, a warm-up with John Reed Fitness at 13:45, the 10 km race start at 14:00, the 5 km race start at 14:10, a high-heel run at 16:00 (advance registration required), and the awards ceremony at 17:00. The event is held under the auspices of Hana Třeštíková, Deputy Mayor of Prague 7. A charity event supporting the LGBTQ+ community and people living with HIV.

name: Jarov - Károv
location: Jarov u Prahy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Jarov-Károv race is a 2.99 km uphill run with 150 metres of elevation gain, part of the Runs in the Hills in Prague and Surroundings series. It gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain with a significant climb. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and running challenges in the natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The race is a regular fixture on the region’s running events calendar.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.99 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Uphill run on natural terrain

name: Peřimovská desítka
location: Peřimov, Jičín District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Peřimovská Desítka is a traditional running race held in the village of Peřimov in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers athletes of all levels the opportunity to run a 10-kilometre course through the village and its picturesque surrounding countryside. The event is part of the local cultural calendar and attracts runners from the wider area. It is organised by the Peřimov Municipal Office, which also arranges other accompanying activities and community events.
course_highlights: A 10 km course through the natural surroundings of Peřimov
Picturesque scenery offering a chance to discover the local landscape
Part of the local sporting and cultural events
additional: The event is organised by the Peřimov Municipal Office. It is part of the local calendar of cultural and sporting events. Information about other activities and the weather is regularly updated on the village’s official website. Contact details and office hours are available for anyone seeking further information. The race takes place on roads open to traffic.

name: POKONAJ LUCYFERA - Półmaraton
description: POKONAJ LUCYFERA – The Half Marathon is a mountain race in Nasielsk, taking place on May 17, 2026. The course consists of a 7 km loop through scenic but challenging forest terrain, with numerous uphill climbs and technical descents. The event offers four challenges to choose from: Lucyfer 21 km (3 loops), Boruta 14 km (2 loops), Rokita 7 km (1 loop), and 7 km Nordic Walking. This race is for people who value endurance, strength, and determination, and features professional timekeeping and commemorative medals for participants.

name: 24h Rawicki Festiwal Sportu
description: The 24-hour Rawicz Sports Festival is a unique sporting event held in Rawicz, bringing amateurs and professionals together for a competition that lasts all day and night. Since 2011, the festival has continued to grow, offering a range of sports, with the 24-hour relay race as its main event. It is the largest sporting initiative in the Rawicz municipality and is organized through the cooperation of numerous institutions and volunteers. Participants can also enjoy a range of non-sporting attractions during the festival weekend.

name: 19. Bieg Wiosny - 5 km
organizer: Biegowe Grand Prix Rybnika, MOSiR Rybnik
description: Bieg Wiosny is an annual running event held in Rybnik and part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix. The event features races for children and young people over various distances, as well as a 5 km cross-country race for adults and young people aged 16 and over. The 19th edition of Bieg Wiosny will take place on May 17, 2026, offering participants the chance to compete and spend time actively outdoors.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Olsztyn, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic beauty of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique medal featuring a hyacinth motif.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: VIII Charytatywny Bieg Nadziei
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żorach
description: The 8th Charity Run of Hope is an annual sporting event held at Cegielnia Park in Żory, taking place on May 17, 2026. The event is charitable and supports the John Paul II Hospice in Żory. Participants can run, walk with Nordic walking poles, skate, or ride a scooter, and all proceeds from entry packages go to support the hospice. The run is open to everyone, regardless of athletic ability, and promotes physical activity combined with helping those in need.

name: 32 Bieg Fiata
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Bielsku-Białej, Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak
description: The 32nd Fiat Run is an annual road race held in Bielsko-Biała, taking place on May 17, 2026. The 10 km course runs through the city streets, including Warszawska, 3 Maja and Zamkowa, and finishes at Town Hall Square. The race is open to participants over the age of 16, with a limit of 1,800 participants. It is organized by the Municipal Office in Bielsko-Biała and Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak. The event is a certified PZLA road race with a rich regional tradition.

name: Bieg Po Puszczy
description: Bieg po Puszczy is a unique running event held in the scenic Niepołomice Forest, taking place for the twelfth time in 2026. Participants can choose from three running distances: a half marathon, the Forest 15K, and the Forest 7K. They can also take part in the 40 km Gravel in the Forest cycling race. The course runs along forest trails, gravel roads, and asphalt, offering beautiful views and a chance to connect with nature. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and refreshments and professional medical support will be available along the route. The event is also an opportunity to enjoy time together as a family, with recreational cycling events for children.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: Lone Willow Marathon
description: The Lone Willow Marathon is a marathon held in Jelcz-Laskowice, Poland, organized by Maraton Chwałowice and Arkadiusz Tołłoczko. The race is listed in marathon calendars for the areas around Tyniec Mały and Namysłów, as well as in the sports events directory for the Żórawina region. The marathon course is 42.195 km long and takes place in May, offering participants typical spring weather with temperatures of around 20°C. This sporting event attracts runners from various regions, providing professional organization and an attractive course.

name: Marszobieg Trzech Dzielnic
location: VIII Liceum Ogólnokształcące, ul. Grzegórzecka 24, Kraków, Poland
description: The Three Districts Run-Walk is a sporting event promoting physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and integration among the residents of Kraków. It will take place on May 17, 2026, on the track at Stanisław Wyspiański 8th Secondary School, at 24 Grzegórzecka Street. The programme includes runs and walks for various age groups, including 4 km runs with timing, a 4 km walk without timing, and shorter runs for children. The Run-Walk is not only a sporting competition, but also an opportunity to spend time together and promote an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: 4 km run and walk on the track at 8th Secondary School in Kraków
Children’s runs over 200 m and 500 m
An event bringing together residents of three Kraków districts
additional: The event is organised by the Instructional Team of the Kraków-Śródmieście Scout District, with support from the Councils and Boards of Districts I Stare Miasto, II Grzegórzki, and III Prądnik Czerwony, the “Dom Harcerza” Youth Cultural Centre, and 8th Secondary School. Registration is online. The Run-Walk offers various activities suited to participants’ ages and abilities. The event includes 4 km and 500 m runs for children, as well as a 10 km run. Participants can register online, and the event is supported by local institutions and the community. The programme includes attractions and a hot meal.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail running event taking place on May 17, 2026, in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The route runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor recreation. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
description: “Half marathon… Are you up for it?” is a cross-country race covering 21 km, with an additional 32 km race, held on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run or walk the course with Nordic walking poles. The event also includes races for children and young people. This is the fifth edition of the event, combining sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional event management for a competition with nationwide reach while ensuring a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: V Bieg Ratownika
description: The 5th Rescuer Run is a milestone fifth edition of an event that combines athletic competition with an educational and community-building mission. Participants can compete on professionally prepared 5 km and 10 km courses, or take part recreationally, including Nordic walking and a 5 km run with a pet. A safe and fun 200 m race is prepared for the youngest participants. After the race, a family and educational picnic with numerous attractions celebrates the anniversary edition. The event takes place in Katowice at 180 Francuska Street and promotes first aid and responsibility for others.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Stanisław Komornicz Rector’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of varying ability levels and offers the opportunity to prepare with dedicated training plans. The race takes place on the streets of the picturesque city of Tarnów, giving participants an appealing course and sporting excitement.

name: XI Półmaraton Szelkowski
description: The 11th Szelków Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Szelków that attracts runners from various regions. The event includes a half marathon and additional races, such as the 1st Szelków Five and Nordic Walking. The competition is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Sports Club, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to compete on scenic routes. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part and celebrate sport together.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The 12th Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kuchary Królewskie. The event features various distances for different age groups, including races for preschoolers and schoolchildren, a 10 km main race, a 3 km accompanying race, and a 6 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are by the forester’s lodge, and participants can look forward to an awards ceremony and a prize drawing after the event. The participant limit is 300, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XXIII Bieg Skawiński XIV Bieg Skawiński na Rolkach
description: The 23rd Skawina Run is an annual sporting event with a tradition spanning more than 20 years, held in Skawina. The event combines professional competition with a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes an active lifestyle. The program includes races for children and teenagers, the 9th Tomasz Staszczak Memorial, the 17th Polish Energy Workers’ Championships, the 4th Skawina Nordic Walking event over 10 km, and the 14th Skawina Rollerblading Race over 9 km. The race course runs on a resurfaced, even surface, ensuring comfort and safety for participants.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Gerstewitzer Mühlentaglauf
description: The Gerstewitz Mill Day Run is a long-standing running event offering various distances, from 400 m for children to 10 km for adults. After a pandemic-related hiatus, the run has become very popular and combines sporting ambition with regional Pentecost traditions. The event is organized by SFG Nellschütz e.V. and offers runners of all ages an appealing competitive opportunity in the Lützen region.

name: Dortmunder Friedenslauf
description: The Dortmund Peace Run is a traditional race held on Whit Monday, May 25, 2026, in Dortmund-Kirchlinde. The event offers various race distances through the picturesque Rahmer Forest and is known for its friendly, athletic atmosphere. The event features musical entertainment and motivating drummers along the course. The Peace Run is part of a race series organized by the Road Running Working Group and attracts runners of all ages.

name: Pfingstkronenlauf
description: The Pfingstkronenlauf in Kleinich is a traditional running event held over the Pentecost weekend as part of the TuS Kleinich Pentecost sports festival. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, along with an approximately 250 m Bambini run for the youngest participants, born in 2020 or later. The event takes place at the festival tent by the Hirtenfeldhalle and offers culinary treats such as Backeshähnchen and draft wheat beer, in addition to the sporting experience. The start is at 10:00, and runners of all ages can enjoy a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Pfingstlauf „Rund um Usseln“
description: The Pfingstlauf "Rund um Usseln" takes place on Whit Monday, May 25, 2026, starting at 10 a.m., and is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. The event is organized by Skiclub Usseln e.V. and offers runners an appealing opportunity to run in the Hochsauerland district. The race information and further details are available on the Skiclub Usseln website. This traditional event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Routes through the picturesque Hochsauerland region, reaching elevations of up to 836 m above sea level
A range of distances from 1 km to 10 km, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, with regularly more than 200 participants
additional: The race takes place on May 25, 2026, with starts from 10 a.m. Further information about the course, registration, and results is available on the organizer’s website.

name: Lelieloop
location: Het Turfschip, Etten-Leur, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Lelieloop is organised annually by Road Runners Etten-Leur on Whit Monday as part of De Leurse Havenfeesten. The fast course runs through the streets of Etten-Leur Noord and passes through the ‘De Lelie’ windmill, among other places. There are several distances for different age groups, including a children’s run, a junior run, a 5 km and a 10 km. The start and finish are at Het Turfschip, which also has shower and changing facilities. The Lelieloop is an accessible event for all ages, with a friendly atmosphere and a scenic route through the neighbourhood and past local landmarks.
course_highlights: The course goes through the ‘De Lelie’ windmill
Routes run through the Schoenmakershoek neighbourhood and along the Leurse Dijk
The 10 km and 5 km courses are accurately measured and include a mix of paved and unpaved sections
additional: The start and finish are at Het Turfschip, with changing and shower facilities. Kangoo jumpers and race runners are welcome, but the course is not suitable for wheelchair racers. If temperatures exceed 30 degrees, the Lelieloop is cancelled in accordance with Atletiekunie rules. Every child receives a pancake from the De Lelie windmill after the children’s run. The course is not officially measured and may vary; advance registration is recommended; the run is cancelled if temperatures exceed 30°C.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event created in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they have time to rest until the next full hour. The competition continues until only one runner remains, and they complete the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is an endurance race where not only speed matters, but also strategy and perseverance.

name: Jarní neředínský kros
location: AIR BAR Airport, Olomouc-Neředín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
organizer: Středomoravské sdružení vytrvalostních sportů, z. s.
description: The Spring Neředín Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held at the AIR BAR airport in Olomouc-Neředín. This 14th edition features an 8 km course and a race coefficient of 1.1, reflecting its quality and difficulty. The race starts at 18:00, giving runners the chance to compete in pleasant evening conditions. It is part of the Hanácký Running Cup and is suitable for endurance runners looking for a quality race experience in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: An 8 km course at AIR BAR airport, Olomouc-Neředín
Race coefficient of 1.1, indicating a high race standard
Start at 18:00 in the pleasant evening hours
additional: The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening race over 5 and 10 kilometres that has been part of the series of runs organised by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are measured precisely and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the River Potmarge, where you can enjoy nature in the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building at Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and you can optionally order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the River Potmarge
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration is available until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration. A medal can be ordered optionally for € 3,50. The start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building), Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes measured; online registration until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration; free parking after 18:00.

name: Verkerkloop

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Verkerkloop is an annual race through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The event includes a fast street course with 5 km and 10 km distances for individual runners, a school race for children in various age categories, and a business race for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial estate and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway through. The Verkerkloop is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy, close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast street course through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet
The 5 km distance consists of one lap; the 10 km distance consists of two laps
The route passes, among other places, along Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk, Molenvliet 1, in the Molenvliet industrial estate in Zwijndrecht. The school race is for children aged 6 and up, with distances from 600 to 1,200 metres. Business race teams consist of 4 or 5 runners; the finish times of the first 4 runners are added together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. A maximum of 3,500 participants are allowed. Registration opens on 1 February 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and business activities.

name: Kolem Skalky
description: Kolem Skalky is a 6.65 km cross-country run with 187 metres of elevation gain, held in the area around Šumperk. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers runners challenging terrain and beautiful natural scenery. It is suited to nature-running enthusiasts looking for the challenge of a hilly course. The route combines forest paths and natural surfaces, adding to the appeal of the race.
course_highlights: 6.65 km course
187 m of elevation gain
Cross-country terrain in the area around Šumperk

name: Běh okolo Červeného kamene
location: Janíkovo sedlo, Kopřivnice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Červený kámen (BOČK) is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Janíkovo sedlo in Kopřivnice and gives runners the chance to test themselves on a circuit featuring several challenging sections. It is part of the running season and attracts a broad running community from the region and beyond. The organizers focus on providing quality facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The circuit winds through the picturesque countryside of Janíkovo sedlo
The race features challenging sections across varied terrain
The route is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League and is supported by the town of Kopřivnice and local sponsors. Route maps, GPX files, and Strava segments are available on the website. Videos from previous editions and a photo gallery are also available.

name: 400. Malá cena Monaka – Janderovská desítka
location: Restaurace Monako, Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Monaka – Janderovská desítka is a traditional running race held at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany. It is part of the Malá cena Monaka series, which has a long history and attracts runners of various ages. The course passes through scenic surroundings and offers an opportunity to compete and enjoy the running community. After the race, participants usually gather socially and the results are announced at the Monako restaurant.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic countryside around Slatiňany
The race is part of the traditional Malá cena Monaka series
Start and finish at the Monako restaurant, with a pleasant atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series, which also includes other running events throughout the year. After the race, participants usually gather socially at the Monako restaurant. Exact start times and prices are not published on the website.

name: Trail Modřanskou roklí VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: Trail Modřanskou roklí is a race with a friendly atmosphere, giving runners the chance to clear their heads in the woods near Prague. The race takes place in Modřanská rokle and offers two routes: 8.8 km with 219 m of elevation gain and 15 km with 360 m of elevation gain, for those looking for a greater challenge. The course combines narrow, technical trails, wide paths and a climb up a rock with panoramic views, while the start is easily accessible by tram. The entry fee includes refreshments, a medal and prizes for the top finishers in each category, as well as results service and race photography.
course_highlights: Narrow, technical trails and wide paths
A climb up a rock with panoramic views
A jungle among apartment blocks, within easy reach of the tram
additional: Registration takes place from 17:00 to 17:50 at the start, in the blue tent by the turning circle near the Lipiny reservoir. The entry fee includes an isotonic drink and light refreshments after the race and along the course, as well as baggage storage in the organisers’ tent. You can withdraw from the race up to 24 hours before the start and receive a credit for the entry fee to use for future races. The start is easily accessible by public transport or by car, with parking nearby. Easy access by tram. The stated entry fee includes refreshments, a medal, results service and race photography.

name: Cooper test Přerov
description: The Cooper test is a 12-minute running event organized by the Czech Tourists Club. The test measures runners’ physical fitness and endurance. The event is suitable for the general public and takes place in Přerov, in the Olomouc Region. The Czech Tourists Club is known for its long-standing tradition of organizing hiking and sporting events.
course_highlights: A 12-minute run used as a standard physical endurance test
Organized by the Czech Tourists Club, which has a long-standing tradition
Open to the general public in Přerov

location: Hřiště Tatran, Kohoutovice, Brno, Czech Republic

description: Běh Holednou is a regular race in Brno, offering runners an interesting 5.5 km loop in the Kohoutovice area near the Tatran sports field. The race is open to all categories—men, women, and children of any age. Children run a shorter loop, the length of which is determined before the start. The main race starts at 18:00, with men and women starting together. Refreshments and a baggage storage area are available after the race. Participants take part at their own risk, and registration takes place at the venue before the race.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km loop in the pleasant surroundings of Kohoutovice
Categories for men, women, and children of all ages
Start and finish near the Tatran sports field, with refreshments and baggage storage
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45, and the main race for men and women starts at 18:00. Parking is available directly by the sports field, but space is limited. Trolleybus route 37 goes to the Voříškova stop. Water is provided after the race, along with a tent for baggage storage. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the race.

name: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę
description: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę is a series of cross-country races held in Koszalin, offering participants a unique 5 km route. The race is recreational and sporting in nature, organized by the local group BIEGNIJMY.pl, which has promoted physical activity and sport in the region for years. The route runs through picturesque forest areas, making the race appealing to nature lovers and trail runners. The event has a well-established tradition and is popular with runners of different age groups and experience levels.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forest areas
A cross-country race in picturesque surroundings
Organized by the local group BIEGNIJMY.pl

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The 13th 5 MILE Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9,260 m), organised in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Association of Polish Navy Officers, in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4,630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees and civilian runners who have been verified in advance. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.

name: Michelstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Michelstadt City Run, organized by TSV Weiten-Gesäß, will take place for the 41st time on May 29, 2026. In addition to the traditional individual 5 km and 10 km races, the event offers a new team race in which four team members each run a relaxed 2.5 km lap. The city run is open to all age groups, including school and youth races, and promotes community spirit and the visibility of local businesses. The event is ideal for companies as a group activity and for runners seeking personal bests or athletic challenges.
course_highlights: New team race with 4 × 2.5 km laps
Traditional individual races over 5 km and 10 km
School and youth races for families
additional: The new team race is a special highlight and is suitable for all fitness levels. The team members’ times are added together to calculate the overall time. The event promotes team spirit and offers a healthy change from the working day. Runners can choose from 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and team races; online registration is available. The race is approved by the DLV and is part of the Michelstadt Bee Market.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-reviewed and attractive route through the town of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading recreational sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The route has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group, so participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Route reviewed and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group
Attractive town route in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. Places are still available. The race takes place as part of the town festival. In cooperation with AOK, VfL Ahaus also offers functional training classes. The routes are not officially measured; registration opens on March 15, 2026; places are still available; the event is part of the town festival, which features a varied accompanying program.

description: The Volksbank Run “Around Offlumer Lake” is a long-standing running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race
additional: On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be picked up from 3:00 p.m. at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start at staggered times, from 4:00 p.m. (Bambini run) to 7:00 p.m. (main race). Course: around Offlumer Lake. On-the-day registration available. Parking at the outdoor swimming pool and Offlumer Lake.

name: Liberation Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De deelnamekosten zijn voor iedereen gelijk, ongeacht volledige of halve etappes

description: The Liberation Trail is a three-day trail-running adventure along Normandy’s historic D-Day beaches. This unique experience combines an athletic challenge with a tribute to freedom and history. Participants cover a total of 113 kilometres across key liberation sites, including Utah Beach, Omaha Beach and other landing sites. The event focuses on perseverance and respect, with an emphasis on the significance of the route rather than competition.
course_highlights: Route along the iconic D-Day beaches and historic monuments
Night-time sections by the cliffs of Pointe du Hoc
Start in Sainte-Mère-Église, known for the famous paratrooper John Steele
additional: The trail is flexible: participants can choose the full 115 km route or a selection of half stages totalling 70 km. Base camp is Camping Ferme Hay Day, where participants can relax and share experiences. There is no time pressure; the focus is on personal challenge and respect for history. The event includes several days of trail running, with options for full or half routes, historical tours and camping facilities. Bus transfers from the Netherlands and Belgium are also available. The race takes place from 21 to 23 May 2027.

description: Stonařov Alleys is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1978, held in the picturesque surroundings of Stonařov in the Vysočina Region. The main race follows dirt and forest paths along a stream and along Green Alley to a hunting lodge. The course has a gentler elevation profile and is mostly soft underfoot, with about 30% asphalt. The event offers races for various age groups, from preschoolers to veterans, with distances ranging from 200 metres to 10 km. Every participant receives a commemorative prize, while category winners receive prizes and medals.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows dirt and forest paths, with 30% asphalt.
The route runs along a stream and Green Alley to a hunting lodge.
A gentler elevation profile and mostly soft surfaces.
additional: The start is at the football pitch. Categories are for participants aged 3 and over. Youth runners can take part for free. Every participant receives a certificate and a small pack. The first three finishers in each category receive prizes; youth participants receive medals. The travelling Stonařov Runner’s Cup is awarded to the best man and woman in the main race. According to the available description, participants receive a commemorative prize and certificate, while category winners receive prizes and the travelling Stonařov Runner’s Cup.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain races held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 16 to 240 km, taking runners along scenic and demanding mountain trails. It is organized by the 4 Alternatywy Foundation and attracts runners who value a challenge and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a great opportunity to test your abilities on routes of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultrarunning.

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging 5.3 km road race from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on 30 May 2026. The route follows country roads and farm tracks, climbing a total of 260 metres to the finish at the castle, which offers a wonderful view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women and seniors, with a combined ranking across all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age-category rankings, and a free children’s race for the youngest participants takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 metres of elevation gain
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic views
Challenging section of the course above Edingen
additional: The entry fee includes a bus transfer to the start, transport of clothing to the finish, and drinks at the start and finish. Race numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle from 14:00 on event day. Late registration is possible on event day until 30 minutes before the start. Parking is available at the outskirts of Greifenstein in the direction of Beilstein. A free children’s race will be held at around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The awards ceremony and refreshments—including coffee, cake, cold drinks and bratwurst—will take place in the castle courtyard. In clear weather, the courtyard offers impressive views across the Dill Valley as far as the Feldberg in the Taunus. Register online by 28.05.2026; start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle; no relay or walking event; results available since 2008.

name: Internationaler Biesfelder Dorflauf

description: The International Biesfeld Village Run is a long-standing running event in the municipality of Kürten, taking place on 30 May 2026. The race is known for its hilly course, which challenges runners and carries the slogan “Flat is somewhere else.” Various distances, including races for toddlers and schoolchildren, offer suitable competitions for all age groups. The event is organized by Biesfeld Triathlon e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Biesfeld Community Primary School.
course_highlights: Hilly race in the municipality of Kürten, with challenging climbs
Distances from 0.6 km (toddler race) to 9.2 km (main race)
Start and finish in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School
additional: Race packs will be handed out on race day in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School. No separate timing chip is required, as the chip is integrated into the race bib (RaceResult). A late registration fee of €3.00 applies from 23.05.2026; late registrations are possible on site on race day. Distances: 0.6 km, 2.1 km, 9.2 km; online registration until 28.05.2026; race bib with chip; event in Kürten-Biesfeld

name: Wälster Lauf
description: The Wälster Lauf is a traditional fun run and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organised annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers runners and walkers of all ages an appealing opportunity to get active. The event traditionally opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. Alongside competition, the focus is also on the enjoyment of exercise and community.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Fun run and road race with various distances
Traditional opening event of the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Wälster Lauf offers running and walking on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, children’s races, a fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, and walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. It is a well-established regional running tradition, with courses known for their accuracy and fairness. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

Halden Mohikaner
