additional: The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes. For planning purposes, please provide a non-binding estimate of your group’s participant numbers by 13.06.2026. Participants are advised to bring a completed registration form to speed up registration on site. Participants can choose from 3 km, 6 km, 8 km and 11 km routes. The event promotes a sense of community and enjoyment of nature, with refreshments and prizes for the largest groups.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest roads, woodland trails and field paths in the Friedewald and Moritzburg Hills
Route through the Moritzburg State Stud, past the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel (21.1 km route)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails, passing natural features such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are at the corner of Friedewaldstraße and Sachsenlaufweg. Awards ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available in the neighboring Spitzgrund sports hall. The course closes for all distances at 14:00. Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: Sonnwend-Freundschaftslauf
description: The 3rd Sonnwend Friendship Run in Völklingen offers runners a varied event featuring historic and modern courses. On June 21, 2026, participants can take part in the traditional 10-mile race as well as the 8 km and 10 km races and Nordic walking. The event is supported by experienced runners and takes place near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle and the swimming pool. Lauftrefffreunde Köllertal look forward to welcoming many participants and enjoying a sporting get-together.
course_highlights: Historic 10-mile course
Additional options: 8 km, 10 km and Nordic walking
Start and finish near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle / Völklingen swimming pool
additional: Start times: 09:00 for the 10-mile race; 09:30 for the 8 km and 10 km races and Nordic walking. Support from experienced runners. The event is part of a tradition that fosters community spirit and gives runners an opportunity to connect and celebrate the start of summer together.

name: Wallernhäuser Dorflauf
description: The Wallernhausen Village Run is a traditional village race in Nidda-Wallernhausen, Germany, starting at 9:00 a.m. on Sunday morning. The event offers two distances: a short 1.6 km run and a longer 10 km run. This makes it suitable for younger runners and beginners, as well as runners looking for a classic longer distance. The course runs through the village of Wallernhausen and offers a friendly, family atmosphere away from large urban areas. Now in its 18th edition, the run is a popular local sporting event.
course_highlights: Run through the village of Wallernhausen
Two distances: 1.6 km and 10 km
Friendly village-run atmosphere
additional: Typical June weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. The event is suitable for beginners and younger runners. It takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23 °C and a low probability of precipitation. This is a local event focused on community and the enjoyment of running.

name: Benefizlauf Aachen
location: Waldstadion Aachen, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Benefizlauf Aachen is a long-standing running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at Waldstadion Aachen. The 24th edition offers various distances for all ages and abilities, from ambitious runners to recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer commitment, and support for non-profit organizations. Participants can look forward to a beautiful course in the stadium and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Aachen’s most beautiful stadium
A variety of distances for young and old, fast and leisurely
A running event with a sunny atmosphere and a great vibe
additional: Registration is via my.race|result. The event is organized by volunteers, and helpers are needed for course marshal posts, refreshment stations, and set-up and dismantling. Training opportunities are available for members, including beginner running groups and regular training sessions in the Aachen Forest. Various distances, registration via the website, charitable event

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer race on fully closed and secured out-and-back courses in Hamburg. The route follows firm, paved paths and offers an appealing running experience for runners of all ability levels. The event is part of the 10K Hamburg series, held at various attractive locations in the Elbe metropolis. Registration is online only, and the event is already sold out.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands off the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place annually and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or individual stages, each of which is about 10 kilometers long. The event places great importance on creating an enjoyable running experience and protecting the islands from overcrowding.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” association, which provides bereavement support for children and young people. Since 2010, the association has supported young people facing the death of people close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.

name: Bestenseer Seenlauf
organizer: Heimat&Kulturverein Bestensee e.V. und WSG 81 KWeV
description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The race starts at the Landkost Arena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and woodland. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to age 13 can take part for free.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a long-standing event with a cult following in the Nordheide, taking place on June 21, 2026. The course runs through the heart of Buchholz city center, with large crowds of spectators creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. Various distances offer suitable challenges for all ages and ability levels, from the children’s run to the popular team relay. Running training with certified coaches is also available, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.

name: edge beyond x Duracher Lauf
description: The Duracher Lauf on June 21, 2026, offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels: 5.5 km, 10 km, a Kids Run and a school race. The event focuses on professional organization, safety and an unforgettable atmosphere. In addition to the sporting competition, there will be a large joint awards ceremony, prize money for new course records and a raffle. Teams and clubs can also take part in special rankings and receive discounts.

name: Eichberglauf
organizer: Kultur- und Heimatverein ‚Rund um den Eichberg‘ e.V.
description: The Eichberglauf has been organized for almost 20 years by the “Rund um den Eichberg” Cultural and Heritage Association and offers summer races for the whole family. The 19th race will take place on June 7, 2026, starting at the club’s storage facility at Am Heller. There are six different courses to choose from, mostly on unpaved terrain and through Planitz Forest. The event is suitable for all age groups, with special courses for children and wheelchair users. Participants receive certificates, and prizes are awarded to the top runners, along with team trophies.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place from 20 to 27 June 2026 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. The stages follow varied routes with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea. The event offers a unique running experience, with the start and finish on each island and comprehensive facilities including race-number collection, sports-bag storage and on-site award ceremonies.

name: Grafschafter Ahrtal-Lauf
description: The Grafschafter Ahrtal Run is a traditional running event jointly organized by the clubs SV Dernau, SV Hönningen/Ahr, and Grafschafter SV. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 400 m and 1 km children’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and a 5 km walking event. The start and finish are at the sports ground in Grafschaft-Vettelhoven, and the course follows field paths, some of which are gravel and paved. The event is part of the Ahrtal Team Cup race series and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with changing rooms and showers available on site.

name: KSC Schlossparklauf
description: The KSC Schlossparklauf will take place for the 28th time on June 21, 2026, and will be held in summer for the first time. New this year is a partner run for companies. The event includes a main race, a youth and schoolchildren’s race, and the partner run, with limited participant numbers. The course is a loop of approximately 3.25 km from BBBank Wildpark to the palace and back. The main race covers three laps, while young runners complete one lap. The start and finish are at BBBank Wildpark.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children’s races, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, Nordic walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.

name: Lauf in die Sonne
description: The Lauf in die Sonne takes place on June 21, 2026, in 71397 Nellmersbach and is organized by Hot Socks Leutenbach e.V. There are two race distances, 10 km and 5.8 km, which start together at 08:00. The event offers an extensive breakfast buffet and awards trophies to the top runners. A traveling trophy is also awarded to the best team. Participation is limited to a maximum of 222 starters.

name: Meilenlauf beim WGV-Leichtathletik-Festival
description: The WGV Athletics Festival on June 21, 2026, in Stuttgart offers a varied program centered on athletics. The main event is the Street Mile, a new running format in the heart of the city that is open to all running enthusiasts. The festival also includes the KLEINformat! Charity Run, where every lap supports a good cause, an Elite Mile featuring top athletes, and a Children’s Mile for the youngest participants. The festival brings together elite sport, recreational sport, and social commitment in a unique event in the heart of Stuttgart.

name: Sababurger Tierparklauf
description: The 16th Sababurg Zoo Run takes place on June 21, 2026, in the picturesque Sababurg Zoo and the adjacent Reinhardswald forest. Runners are accompanied by enthusiastic spectators and experience a unique natural setting on carefully selected routes. The run is a charity event supporting the planned AmphibienWelt, which is to become a new nature learning center at the zoo. The zoo run is also part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup and offers routes for different age groups and ability levels.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event held on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers races for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini races, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners every year.

name: Spessarthelden - Laufen gegen Gewalt
description: The Spessarthelden Run Against Violence is a charity run in Bad Soden-Salmünster, organized by Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. and the city. The event sends a strong message against violence and is supported by former German President Christian Wulff as its patron. There are various running distances suitable for all age groups, and the event promotes community and social engagement in the region.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers various distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km introductory race, which take runners through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, ceramic medal as a memento. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and school students, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.

name: Waiblinger Stadtlauf
description: The Waiblingen City Run takes place on June 21, 2026, and gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in various distances. The event is family-friendly and accompanied by a varied entertainment program in Rathausplatz. The VfL Waiblingen athletics department provides food and refreshments. Participation in the children's or youth run also supports Tour Ginkgo, which helps seriously ill children and their families.

name: Běhej lesy Týmovka - týmový závod
description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay running race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night with headlamps, adding to its uniqueness and challenge. In addition to the race, a rich programme of sports activities, cultural events and workshops is planned, while the facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitary facilities and refreshments.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main 7 km course along forest trails and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for a shared sporting activity. It takes place on the last Saturday in June, with the option to take part in other shorter routes and children’s categories.

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň is a family-friendly running event with a joyful, relaxed atmosphere, suitable for both recreational and elite runners. It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km runs and a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race but also a family-friendly entertainment programme and high-quality service from start to finish.

name: Dobratický běh
description: The Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and adding to the joy of running.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities at the Hamelika site near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and the Plzeň Region Running Cup, offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, with an emphasis on a welcoming setting and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to welcoming participants in 2026.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place on June 21, 2026, at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 so runners can experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly along shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timing and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy a unique running experience at dawn.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners alike. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km laps over mildly undulating terrain, highlighting the race’s beauty and challenge.

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is a 3.4 km uphill race with 240 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců series in Prague and the surrounding area. The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Gryf Arena Run
organizer: Starostwo Powiatowe w Gryficach, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu Rekreacji i Promocji w Gryficach, PLMKS Chrobry Gryfice, Zarząd Dróg Powiatowych w Gryficach, Klub Sportowy "RunGryf"
description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The race route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races ranging from 100 to 600 meters, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and Nordic walking event take place in the scenic surroundings of Klon, making them ideal for recreation and community interaction. The event is open and welcoming to all age groups.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by the wayside shrine and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5, at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
organizer: Grupa Ostródzkich Biegaczy „Ostróda Runners”, Klub Sportowy PLAY, Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, comprising two identical loops with a total distance of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and hydration stations are located along the course approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable and supports the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run takes place in the wooded areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied surfaces, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the pavement or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top women and men in each distance receive trophies.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the scenic area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race runs through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. The event also includes free children’s races, making it a family-friendly and inclusive occasion. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and race packages with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The route follows loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a kids’ stage for younger participants. Organized by regional clubs, the event will take place for the 18th time in 2026.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a long-standing stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km each, travelling from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. Due to limited ferry capacity and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organised event.

name: Sommerlauf Baierbrunn
description: The Baierbrunn Summer Run is a traditional race held annually since 2015 that brings the entire Baierbrunn community together. The event is open to professional and recreational runners of all ages and offers various routes through the surrounding forests across varied terrain. After the races for different age groups and distances, a summer party is held for all participants and friends of SC Baierbrunn. The course is marked and closed to traffic, with drink stations along the way.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the medium route is 10 km with approximately 230 m, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m. All routes run exclusively through nature, offering beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque setting.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
Darmstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Darmstädter Merck City Run is a long-established city race celebrating its 47th edition in 2026. The route runs through downtown Darmstadt and has been adjusted due to construction work to include historic locations such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße. The race attracts numerous participants every year and offers a lively atmosphere with live music and an enthusiastic team of commentators. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and appealing route through the pedestrian zone.
course_highlights: Route through central historic locations such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße
Run through the pedestrian zone with a lively atmosphere
Includes Luisenplatz, Ludwigsplatz and Piazza as well-known sections of the course
additional: The event will take place on 24 June 2026, subject to approval. The route has been changed due to construction work, offering an appealing alternative via Ernst-Ludwig-Platz, Marktplatz, Kirchstraße and the Stadtkirche. The event includes seven races with large fields and is run by a dedicated organising team. Route changed due to construction work; race on Tuesday; includes youth and school classes; cultural accompanying events

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, along varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at the Schwiegershausen sports hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to everyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping and promotes community among the regional clubs.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of about 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.

name: Erfurter Campuslauf
description: The Erfurt Campus Run is a sporting event organised by the University of Erfurt in cooperation with Universitätssportverein Erfurt e.V. On 24 June 2026, runners can take part in various races, including a 10-kilometre individual race, which also counts as the Thuringian University Championship in the 10-kilometre road race. There is also a 25 x 400-metre team race and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all age groups and ability levels.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Juist (4. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Stage 4 takes place on June 24, 2026, on the island of Juist, the longest of the islands at 17 kilometers, which impresses with its dunes and the Juist Water Tower. The start and finish are at Kurplatz, and the event offers runners and walkers a unique running experience surrounded by nature and the sea. The race number is valid for all stages and is issued with an integrated timing chip.

name: Firmenlauf Renningen
description: The 1st AOK Renningen Corporate Run takes place on June 24, 2026, in Renningen and offers a great team event for colleagues. The course is approximately 4.6 km long and consists of two 2.3 km laps. The run is part of the BW-Running corporate run series and emphasizes inclusion, shared experiences, and celebrating together. After the run, there will be complimentary refreshments at the finish and an awards ceremony accompanied by music.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava River in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th edition of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km race offers the chance to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward both the top runners and our loyal participants.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The runs follow loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste, with a new stage each day through Saturday, June 27, 2026. Walkers and Nordic walkers are also very welcome. There is also a 750-meter kids’ stage on June 27 in Schützenpark.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Company Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with a focus on team spirit and togetherness. The event is for companies, groups of friends, and running clubs who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timing will be available for the first time for everyone who wants to test their athletic ambition. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food, and drinks offers a relaxed end to the evening.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Corporate Run has been organised by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. A lifetime long.” The run promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is approximately 5.3 km long and runs mostly along unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event takes place on June 25, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. Refreshing drinks and changing facilities are available on site.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run takes place on Thursday, June 25, 2026, and is open to employees and apprentices of companies, public authorities, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop course starting at the Nordsee-Stadion and passing through Speckenbüttler Park. With a participant limit of 500, the run offers teams a great opportunity to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.

name: De Ronde van Nieuwveen
location: W.P. Speelmanweg, Nieuwveen, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voorinschrijving, 8 euro tijdens de wedstrijd
description: The Ronde van Nieuwveen is a running race held in and around the village of Nieuwveen, and is part of the Gemeente Nieuwkoop Circuit. The race takes place on the longest evening of the year and offers various distances for both children and adults. Children up to age 13 can take part in free kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km, while adults can choose from 5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes. The race features a varied course through the neighbourhood and village, with special attention paid to ensuring runners are well spread out along the course.
course_highlights: Course in and around Nieuwveen, starting and finishing at W.P. Speelmanweg
Kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km through the neighbourhood and village
5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes running through and around Nieuwveen
additional: Start and finish at W.P. Speelmanweg, with changing facilities, showers and supervised bag drop. There is a special G-run for participants with intellectual or physical disabilities, who can run with accompanying guides. Parking is available at the town hall, Teylersplein 1, and at De Hogendijk next to the football pitches. Children can participate for free, but advance registration is requested to keep things running smoothly. Course through and around Nieuwveen, various distances for children and adults, free participation for children and the G-run, changing facilities and supervised bag drop.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of exercising in nature.

name: MidSummerRun 2026

late_fee.price: 3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter
3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter

description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organised for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 metres, a 5 km run and a 10 km run along the wild upper reaches of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a Future Fair featuring sustainability partners and a food truck will also be on hand. The MidSummerRun champions environmental protection and sustainability, and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper reaches of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
Sustainably organised race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 across all races combined. Late registration is available from 10 June 2026 and on race day, provided the limit has not been reached. First aid is available on an outpatient basis in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed gathering after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organisation, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover. Various distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. Two aid stations along the course provide refreshments, and timing is done using rental chips. Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00. Timing is done using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be dropped off before the start at the tent opposite the clubhouse. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, relay 23.1 km; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23; online registration until 25.06.2026, on-site late registration available.

name: Bergdorfmeile
description: The Bergdorfmeile is a traditional race over a historic 8.88889 km course in Karlsruhe-Hohenwettersbach, taking place on Friday, June 26, 2026. With around 140 metres of elevation gain, the course is more challenging than a flat city route, but is designed so recreational runners can also take part comfortably. The race starts at 19:00 on Lindenstraße and finishes at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground. Alongside the main race, there is also an approximately 2 km youth race for children and teenagers. Every participant receives a high-quality technical shirt, and timing is based on net time using a chip-equipped race bib.
course_highlights: Historic 8.88889 km course with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain
Start on Lindenstraße; finish at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground
Refreshments at kilometre 5 and at the finish
additional: Race-bib collection and technical-shirt distribution take place on June 26, 2026, from 16:30 to 18:30 at the schoolyard, Kirchplatz, right by the start. Late entries are possible on race day, subject to the participant limit. Bag storage is available from 17:00 at the start; bags can be collected at the finish until 21:00. Showers are available at SV Hohenwettersbach. Timing is based on net time using a chip-equipped race bib, which must be worn on the chest. The finish closes at 20:15. Participants who reach the hiking car park at Lambrechtshof (approx. km 3.8) later than 19:34 will be removed from the results. The event is limited to approximately 1,000 participants, with chip timing and an online results list. The course is challenging, with around 140 metres of elevation difference.

name: Burg-Lauf Eppstein
description: The Eppstein Castle Run is a traditional Taunus running classic, held annually since 1986 and attracting up to 500 runners as well as numerous spectators. The varied 7.777 km course passes through the forest and the historic old town, loops twice around the medieval castle, then climbs Schmerzberg to the finish at the TSG Eppstein sports ground. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a sociable program featuring a cake stand, a Castle Run glass and refreshments. The run is suitable both for ambitious runners and for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the special atmosphere and challenge of the “old German mile.”
course_highlights: 7.777 km course adapted to the topography
Route through the forest and old town, and twice around the medieval castle
Climb to the finish on Schmerzberg, back to the TSG Eppstein sports ground
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00 until half an hour before the start at the “Am Bienroth” sports ground. Chip timing is used. Prizes and non-cash awards are available for the fastest participants, and medals are awarded to student relay teams. Please note the important travel information due to the partial closure of the B455. Eppstein railway station is easily reached on the S2; the start is about a 15-minute walk from the station. The run takes place on varied terrain adapted to the topography. Registration is available online and on the day of the event. Awards, medals and prizes are presented to the winners.

name: Oberhausener Kleeblatt-Lauf
description: The 1st Oberhausen Kleeblatt Run on June 26, 2026, is a new running event inviting runners of all ages to Niederrhein Stadium. Organised by the Rot-Weiß Oberhausen Endurance Team with support from the Oberhausen City Sports Association, the event aims to bring people from across the city together—from beginners to ambitious athletes. The course runs mostly along a lit, kilometre-marked running track beside the Rhine-Herne Canal, offering an attractive route that can be used year-round. After the run, the City Sports Association’s recreation area invites participants to relax, socialise and enjoy the end of the event together.
course_highlights: 7.8-kilometre loop along the Rhine-Herne Canal
Lit, kilometre-marked running track available year-round
Start at Slinky Springs to Fame, with the route extending to Waghalsbrücke
additional: The event is open to all ability levels and aims to become a fixture in Oberhausen’s sporting calendar. After the run, a programme featuring food and drinks will be held at the City Sports Association’s recreation area to encourage community and socialising. Run on a lit route along the Rhine-Herne Canal; various running distances for all age groups; registration until June 21, 2026.

name: Weezer Sommerabendlauf
description: The Weezer Sommerabendlauf is a popular running event held annually since 2019 in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park in Weeze. After cancellations due to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021, the race is once again attracting large numbers of participants, with over 380 starters in 2025. The event offers various race distances, including children’s and youth races, and starts on June 26, 2026, at 5 p.m. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib, and attractive prizes are awarded to clubs with the most finishers.
course_highlights: Weeze town loop over the new Niers bridge and through the animal park
Approx. 300 m children’s race, with a loop starting from Bahnstraße
Start and finish in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park
additional: Registration closes on June 24, 2026, at midnight. Online registration is via raceresult, with payment by SEPA direct debit. Late entries can be paid for in cash or by card on site. Race bibs with chips must be returned on the day of the event; the €3 chip deposit will be refunded. There are no changing rooms or showers; toilets are available in the Bürgerhaus. Eight tickets to the 1Live San Hejmo Festival will be awarded to the club with the most adult finishers (excluding TSV Weeze). The race takes place in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on site up to 45 minutes before the start. Start times are between 6:00 p.m. and 7:30 p.m.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 5
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 km per stage on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog, and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and encounters with nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out well in advance.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Langeoog (5. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place in 2026 from June 20 to 27 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Stage 5 takes runners to the car-free island of Langeoog, renowned for its 14 km-long sandy beach, dunes, tides and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park. The start and finish are centrally located at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße, and the event offers a unique combination of athletic challenge and nature experience.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen takes place on 26 June 2026 from 18:00 and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the nonprofit association Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports ground and leads into the Hörner Bruch woodland, where one lap is about 3 kilometres long. Distances range from 500 m for Bambinis to 10 km for adults, with no individual timing. After the run, participants can wind down the evening over food and drinks.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
description: The Altstadtfest Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place every year on Friday evening, opening the Altstadtfest on the last weekend in June. It is considered the world’s largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience, with a setting found nowhere else, such as the runners’ pack on the Laufer Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km race, including Nordic walking, with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines sporting competition with a social gathering and also supports social projects.

name: Bietigheimer Fackellauf
description: The Bietigheim Torch Run is a special running experience held annually in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The 10 km run covers three laps on a flat, paved field path between Bietigheim and Ingersheim, illuminated by torches. The start and finish are at the Olymp company parking lot, where a unique atmosphere with music, food, and drinks awaits participants. The race starts on June 26, 2026, at 10 p.m. and offers an atmospheric night event for all running enthusiasts.

name: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Gedächtnislauf 2026
description: The Dr. Ernst van Aaken Memorial Run takes place at the Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadium in Schwalmtal and offers a varied running program on a late June evening. OSC Waldniel organizes ten races with more than 1,000 participants across different age and ability groups, from young people to seniors. The event combines track and road races, including a 5-kilometer road race and the 5000-meter “Race of Aces” for stronger runners. Participants can enter individually, as part of a team, or in the elite field, welcoming both beginners and experienced athletes. The race honors Ernst van Aaken, founder of OSC and a champion of the women’s marathon.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The SchiederSee Summer Run is part of the 2025 Lippe Summer Series and takes place on June 26, 2026, in Schieder-Schwalenberg. The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. The scenic course runs around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather expected: average temperatures of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim
description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional running event taking place on 26 June 2026 in Retzbachpark. The event includes races for various age groups, from Bambini to youth, as well as a fun run and main race. The course is a flat loop, mostly on gravel paths, and counts toward the Sport IN Laufcup standings. The races start in the late afternoon, and results are published soon after the races. The event is family-friendly and offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the “Wiesengrund” sports field in Bischheim. The 2025 premiere was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied supporting programme.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf
description: The Osterrönfeld Moor Run takes place on June 26, 2026, in Osterrönfeld and offers runners of all ages a varied running experience. The event includes a 1.17-kilometer children’s run, a 5-kilometer fun run, and the 10-kilometer Moor Run. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and leads through the scenic moorland. Timing is handled using transponders, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies. The event is family-friendly and offers showers and on-site parking.

name: Havendagen Run
description: The Havendagenrun Terneuzen is a sporting race held in Terneuzen city centre. The second edition offers a unique route through the city, with distances of 1, 3 and 5 nautical miles (1.85 km, 5.55 km and 9.25 km). The start and finish are at Veerplein, close to the pontoon. The 1 km Kidsrun for children up to 12 starts a little earlier. The race is suitable for all ages and offers a sporting challenge, with an improved course compared to last year.
course_highlights: A unique route through Terneuzen city centre
Start and finish at Veerplein, close to the pontoon
Run past Stadhuisplein and the Markt
additional: There is a 1 km Kidsrun for children up to and including 12 years old, starting at 18:15. The Havendagenrun takes place on Friday, 26 June 2026. The route has been improved compared to last year for a better running experience. Registration via inschrijven.nl. The event is part of the Havendagen, which features various festivities in Terneuzen.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
description: Excalibur Race MOON Duchcov Castle is an obstacle race taking place from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic grounds of the state-owned Duchcov Castle and its surroundings. Runners will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. The atmosphere is enhanced by a medieval-knight theme that connects the physical challenge with the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and services, are available for runners and fans.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, taking place on June 26–27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gain and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes pass through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Center – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through different towns in the region and offering unforgettable experiences for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku is a 10 km race taking place on June 26, 2026, in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four laps, and all participants start together. After each lap, the 20 runners who took the longest to complete it are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The final lap is run by the top competitors battling for the win. The race is open to people over the age of 16.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will take on two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere filled with thrills. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the southern Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place on 27 June 2026 in Hainrode and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises varied natural surroundings. The event is open to children, young people, adults and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the southern Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for a range of age groups and ability levels
additional: Registration is open until 24 June 2026; the venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time on 27 June 2026. The flat, scenic course is a loop through the Hasetal valley, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail, and is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings list. In addition to the marathon, the event offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and student races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Hasetal valley with scenic surroundings
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail
Start and finish at Löningen market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish at Löningen market square, with information and sales stands as well as an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink car park. Refreshments are organised by the St. Vitus Löningen altar servers. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen,” a marathon brochure, and is usually held in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly welcomes runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers various distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town centre and along the harbour. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race materials can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Courses through the picturesque town centre of Glückstadt
Races along the harbour head and past the Legends Park
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Race materials can be collected at the harbour head on race day from 9:00 a.m. Late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race, with a late-entry fee of €5. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are available at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones may not be worn and animals or jogging strollers may not be brought along during the race. The event offers shower and changing facilities, safety and data protection provisions, as well as medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Idar-Obersteiner Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtjugendamt Idar-Oberstein in Verbindung mit Stadtverband sporttreibender Vereine und TV 1848 Oberstein
price_range: 5 euro für Erwachsene, 2,50 euro für Kinder/Jugend, U8 frei
description: The Idar-Oberstein Old Town Run is a traditional running event in the historic old town of Oberstein, held annually on the last Saturday in June. The event features six different races for various age groups, from U8 children to adults, with distances ranging from 370 metres to around 6.5 kilometres. The route runs through the pedestrian zone below the striking Felsenkirche, a city landmark. The start and finish are behind the Tourist Information in Oberstein. Entry fees are deliberately kept low to encourage broad participation.
course_highlights: Route through the pedestrian zone below the Felsenkirche
Start and finish behind the Oberstein Tourist Information
A range of distances from 370 m to 6.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are not possible after the registration deadline. The event features six separate races for different age groups. Typical June weather is around 23 °C and mostly sunny. Running event in the old town; online registration is available; start and finish at the Oberstein Tourist Information.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a traditional running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time on June 27, 2026. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a Bambini run, Schoolrunning, a fun run, a corporate run, speed skating and the main race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and accompanies participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with a lively atmosphere, plenty of spectators and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Various race distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the centre of Isselhorst, with several laps
Popular corporate race featuring team rankings and outlandish costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to two weeks before the event, subject to a late-entry fee, except for the Bambini and school races. On the day of the event, registration is available on site from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate based on kilometres run. There is an extensive preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” with weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with spectators lining the route, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied programme, music and a party.

name: XTrail Breitnau
description: XTrail Breitnau is a versatile running event in the Hochschwarzwald that brings runners and Nordic walkers of all age groups together for a day. Four different events are offered: the popular XT-Run, with half-marathon and 10 km distances; the XT-Walk, with 12 km and 8 km distances; the XT-Challenge, an obstacle sprint for age groups U8 to U20; and the XT-Kids run for the youngest participants. The courses cross varied terrain, with trails, steep climbs and panoramic views, and include an attractive race pack and professional timekeeping. The event is organized by Skizunft Breitnau e.V. and takes place on June 27, 2026.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course with steep climbs and trails through the Ravennaschlucht
Nordic-walking routes on natural paths through Moos, Föhrwald and Hohwartshöhe
Obstacle sprint with a serpentine climb and a varied course through the Kurgarten
additional: Race-number collection on event day from 08:00–11:00 and 12:30–13:45 at the fire station. Race numbers for XT-Kids and XT-Challenge are issued in sets for each club. Participation conditions and equipment requirements must be observed; for example, trail-running shoes with profiled soles for RUN and Nordic-walking poles for WALK. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish. Participants receive a personal digital certificate; XT-Kids finishers receive a medal. Exclusive trophies and prizes are awarded to overall and age-group winners. Late registration is possible for a fee until June 26 at 18:00, and on event day until one hour before the start. Multiple event types, distances and age groups; online registration; race numbers; refreshments; prizes; possible course changes.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The first stage starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste and leads through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a 750-meter kids’ stage in Schützenpark. Stages take place daily through June 27, 2026, and are organized by regional clubs.

name: 6. Hofer Backyard Ultra
description: The Hofer Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event taking place on June 27, 2026, in Hof, Bavaria. The race starts at 09:00 and is, by definition, open-ended: it ends only when one runner remains or everyone has dropped out. The course follows a 6.706-kilometer loop with around 80 meters of elevation gain over forest and woodland trails and asphalt. The event attracts participants from across Germany and beyond, offering a special challenge for runners who want to discover and push beyond their limits.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Spiekeroog (7. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for more than two decades. The 7th stage takes place on 27 June 2026 on the car-free island of Spiekeroog, known for its unspoilt nature, endless beaches and relaxed atmosphere. The stage starts and finishes on Gartenweg, level with the Kurpark. The event offers a unique running experience in a distinctive island landscape, combining a sporting challenge with the enjoyment of nature.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organized by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., takes place on June 27, 2026, starting at 18:00. Events include a 1 km race for children and 5 km and 10 km races for teenagers and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families, and colleagues. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with free hot and cold drinks in the finish area and changing and shower facilities after the race. A DJ provides entertainment, and after the races there is an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails, and drinks.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
description: The University of Tübingen 100 km relay is a long-standing university sports event held annually in Tübingen. Teams of students and other participants run the total distance of 100 kilometers as a relay. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Tübingen and offers an athletic challenge combined with a sense of community. Refreshments and a program of activities are provided, making the race a special event for runners and spectators.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners each year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there is also a tower stair race, in which participants climb 306 steps inside the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, and promises an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basaltlauf takes place on June 27, 2026, in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses have gentle elevation changes, are well marked, and display kilometer markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organizer provides refreshments at the finish. The race is for both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys being active as part of a group.

name: Citylauf Leonberg
description: The Citylauf Leonberg on June 27, 2026, offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels. The routes pass through Leonberg’s historic old town, Eltingen’s picturesque village center, and the modern city center at Neuköllner Platz, with several fan zones featuring live music and enthusiastic spectators. In addition to the main 10 km race, there is a 5 km race, a 1.4 km school race, and a 0.4 km children’s race. The event is a lively sporting highlight for the whole city, with a spectacular atmosphere at the start and finish.

name: DJK-Willibaldslauf
description: The DJK-Willibaldslauf is an inclusive running event in Eichstätt, taking place for the second time on June 27, 2026. All age groups and ability levels are welcome, with events ranging from a children’s run and inclusive runs to the main race and Nordic walking. The scenic route follows the Altmühl and leads to the cathedral. The start and finish are at the DJK Eichstätt parking lot. The event focuses on community and fun, with no timing, and all participants receive high-quality running shirts and commemorative medals.

name: Fuchsburg Lauf
description: The Fuchsburg Run is organized by TV Vohburg and takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival on June 27, 2026. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes through the region. The races include a 10 km main race, a 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 600 m Bambini race. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and the joy of sport, supported by a dedicated TV Vohburg team.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC) takes place on 27 June 2026 in Diekhof (Laage) and is hosted by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from a stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an attractive challenge for all participants. Registration is open until 24 June 2026.

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
description: The 13th Lubaster Forest Run takes place on June 27, 2026, in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to experience a short but varied forest route. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly, family atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: Ludwigshafener Stadtlauf
description: The Ludwigshafen City Run offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. From Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to youth and beginner races, as well as a public race for adults, there is something for everyone. The event features a friendly atmosphere, electronic timing, and a functional city-run shirt for all participants. The races take place on varied routes in Ludwigshafen am Rhein and are supported by the City of Ludwigshafen and the Ludwigshafen Sports Association.

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, the Müritz, and takes place on 27 June 2026 in Waren (Müritz). The route reflects the full variety of the northern German landscape and has a gently rolling profile, making it ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organised by ESV Waren e.V., a long-standing sports club that, with the support of numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
description: The 14th Eichkater Run on June 27, 2026, in Schöneiche offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short races for toddlers and children to fun runs and the challenging 12 km premier event, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and offer an enjoyable sporting experience for the community. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with late registration also possible on race day.

name: Stadtlauf Abensberg 2026
description: The Abensberg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, at the new stadium in Abensberg. The event is a special highlight of TSV Abensberg’s athletics department, which is committed to promoting recreational sport. By taking part in the city run, you support local running and help foster a vibrant sporting culture. The race is a great opportunity to come together and raise funds for a new tartan track and modern training equipment.

name: Volksbank-Bever-Lauf
description: The Volksbank-Bever-Lauf takes place on June 27, 2026, at Beverstadion in Ostbevern. The event offers various races, including a half-marathon relay and individual races for runners born in 2012 or earlier. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank-Cup running series. Drinks and refreshments are available in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are located directly at Beverstadion.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 7
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk approximately 10 kilometers per stage, enjoying the unique natural surroundings, maritime atmosphere and healthy sea air. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a fair competition in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. Because capacity on the islands is limited, the number of participants is capped, ensuring an exclusive running experience.

name: Lingewaalloop
price_range: Jeugdlopen en jongeren t/m 15 jaar gratis; 5 km €10 voorinschrijving, €13 op de dag; 10 km €12 voorinschrijving, €15 op de dag
description: The Lingewaalloop is a friendly running race organised by Stichting Lingewaalloop Herwijnen, aimed at residents of Herwijnen and the surrounding area. The race offers several distances, including children’s races and 5 km and 10 km events. The course starts and finishes on Vervoornlaan and follows the Waaldijk. The children’s race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, while the 5 km and 10 km runners complete a loop along the dike and Achterweg. Facilities include changing rooms and showers, and there is an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: Children’s race on and around Vervoornlaan
5 km loop via Achterweg, Waaldijk and Katerdam
The 10 km consists of two laps of the same 5 km loop
additional: On-the-day registration and collection of children’s race bibs are available from 09:30 at the De Kol football clubhouse. Changing rooms and showers are available at De Kol sports park. The children’s awards ceremony takes place at the finish; the 5 km and 10 km awards ceremonies are held afterwards in the football clubhouse. Parking is along Parallelweg; do not park at nearby shops. There are ten age categories for men and women, regardless of race licence. The race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, with registration available in advance and on the day, and facilities at De Kol sports park. The 2027 edition has been cancelled due to extreme temperatures.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
description: The Run through the Týniště Forests is a charity race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Týniště nad Orlicí, offering courses for different fitness levels and age groups. The race takes place in a forest, mainly on firm forest paths, with some paved sections. The event includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10 and 21 km. It brings sport, families and support for a good cause together, benefiting RENEDA, a nonprofit organization that helps children facing neurological challenges.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
description: The World Masters Long Mountain Running Championships will take place on June 27, 2026, in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is intended for masters athletes and offers a challenging long mountain run that will test runners’ endurance and strength amid beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail-running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend checking the organization’s official website.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
description: The ROZKOŠný 1/2 Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, following a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir. The event offers a main 21.1 km race and an accompanying 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers. The event also features entertainment, refreshments, and the option of accommodation at the campsite, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators alike. The main category starts at 12:30, and the first category starts at 10:00.

name: Běh lužanskými hvozdy
organizer: Obec Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., TJ Sokol Lužany
description: Běh lužanskými hvozdy is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The 50th anniversary edition will take place on 27 June 2026 and offers a range of categories and race distances suitable for a wide variety of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, prizes in kind, and cash awards for the top finishers in each category.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
description: The Hot Runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which pass through picturesque countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and by the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique opportunity to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the atmosphere of the city’s historic heart.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karłów. The route follows hiking trails and is technically challenging, with numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation gain. Participants can expect changing conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry suitable equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultrarunning and mountain half-marathons.

name: Sudecka 100
description: Sudecka 100 is Poland’s oldest night ultramarathon, held in the mountain setting of Boguszów-Gorce. The race course is challenging and full of excitement, giving participants the chance to test themselves over the 100 km distance. In 2026, the organizers are introducing two new events: the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon, covering 21 km, and the Night Mountain Marathon, covering 42 km. The event attracts runners from across the country and offers generous race packages and numerous attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the course.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and runner-friendly, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian city.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
organizer: Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania Pędziwiatr Gliwice
description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Club and will take place on June 27, 2026. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, running mainly along sheltered park paths. The race is amateur in nature and dedicated to the memory of Marek Dworski. Individual, team, and relay classifications are planned. The race starts at 10:00, at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania „Pędziwiatr”.
