description: The 41st Pönitz Volkslauf takes place on 12 July 2026 in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the scenic Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields and peaceful meadows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances and an awards ceremony at the Pönitz Sports Park. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Scenery of Holstein Switzerland, with hedgerows, fields and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park, with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and finishers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions and spectators. Runners can choose between the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and Nordic walking. Starts are from 8:30. A shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 meters of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from a range of distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and enjoy unspoiled nature among rocks and forests. The event combines a sporting challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Turmlauf is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on July 12, 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. It is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The race is organized by Laufverein Königsee, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and smooth event operations.

name: BÄRENFELS SOMMERTRAIL 63-KM mit MARATHON, HALBMARATHON und 11-KM
description: The BÄRENFELS SOMMER-TRAIL on 12 July 2026 offers an unforgettable trail experience in the unspoilt natural surroundings of Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park. The event features four distances from 11 km to 63 km, with challenging elevation gain, on a scenic circular trail around Bärenfels. Runners and walkers can enjoy the varied landscape of the Nahesteig and look forward to a sporting adventure in a unique natural setting.

name: Dinkelsbühler Staffellauf
description: The Dinkelsbühl relay race takes place on 12 July 2026 in the historic old town of Dinkelsbühl. Each relay team consists of four runners, each completing a lap of approximately 3 kilometres around the old town. The route passes landmarks such as the Alte Promenade, Wörnitztor, Stadtpark and Musik-Pavillon, accompanied by an inclusive drumming group. Children can take part in the Funtasia Kids-Run, with age-appropriate circuits. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a varied programme featuring music, a bouncy castle and refreshments.

name: int. Rosskopflauf
description: The 21st Rosskopflauf on July 12, 2026, in Heuweiler offers varied running routes, from 450 meters for Bambini to the challenging 18.4 km Roßkopflauf with 560 meters of elevation gain. There is also the 10 km Wildtalereck-Run, walking routes, and races for schoolchildren and teenagers. The event is part of the Schwarzwald-Berglauf-Pokal and the Schwarzwald-Laufcup, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated support for children and teenagers.

name: Kappelseelauf Rentweinsdorf
description: The Kappelseelauf in Rentweinsdorf is a popular running event held annually since 2008 and has become a fixture for recreational runners. The event offers a varied program for all ages and ability levels, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to Nordic walking and a half marathon. The diverse routes pass through idyllic natural surroundings around Kappelsee, along Hutseedamm with views of the castle, and through Rentweinsdorfer Hauptwald and Eichelberg. Refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, with drinks, fruit, cake, and bratwurst.

name: Nußlocher Wiesenlauf
description: The Nußloch Meadow Run is a long-standing running event in Nußloch, held annually at Max-Berk-Stadion and in the surrounding area. The event offers 5.3 km and 10 km races on loop courses along paved roads and forest trails. The 10 km course has been measured and approved in accordance with DLV regulations, making the race particularly appealing to ambitious runners. The event is well organized and hosted by SG Nußloch Athletics, which also handles online registration and participant support.

name: Ranntallauf
description: The Ranntallauf takes place on 12 July 2026 at the TV Nöttingen club grounds. The race starts at 9:30 a.m. and offers a 5 km course for runners and Nordic walkers. Afterwards, all participants and visitors are invited to enjoy a communal lunch and a lively family afternoon with food from the grill. The event is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts and families to spend an active, sociable day together.

name: Stadtlauf Düren
description: The Düren City Run on July 12, 2026, offers a varied running experience in downtown Düren, with races for children, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes. The routes pass through urban sections, along the Rur, and through green park areas, with the start and finish centrally located at the Marktplatz. A particular highlight is the First or Burst elimination race on a 500-meter circuit. All participants receive an official MIZUNO participant shirt, a finisher’s medal, and access to refreshments at the finish.

name: Steinenberger Waldlauf
description: The Steinenberger Waldlauf is a traditional running event set in picturesque woodland near Rudersberg. The event offers a range of distances, from 2 km for students to a half marathon, suitable for both ambitious runners and families and beginners. The race features challenging, varied routes with some hilly terrain and is designed as a family-friendly summer sporting event. In addition, every participant supports local clubs and institutions with a donation.

name: Vierländer-Eck Lauf
description: The Vierländereck Run in Bösingen is a running event featuring a main race, a middle-distance race and a children’s race, taking place on July 12, 2026. The course starts at VfB Bösingen’s sports grounds, passes the Vierländereck, runs through the districts of Waldmössingen and Seedorf, and returns to the start. The route is undulating and alternates between asphalt and gravel paths. Refreshments are available along the course and in the finish area, and participants can shower at the sports clubhouse. The awards ceremony takes place afterward at the sports clubhouse.

name: S-Race
description: S-Race is an OCR race in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mainly along surfaced forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Age-group races are available for children. The start and finish are located right by the colonnade, with facilities including changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The route runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Medical Institute, before returning to the start by the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised by Ivan Elischer, who ensures everything runs smoothly and supports the runners.

name: Halda Trail Run
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, through the picturesque landscape of the Halda Stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km long and includes 23 stream crossings, all runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three distance options (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change their distance during the race. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both casual runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes pass through the area around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí region. They run over gently rolling terrain on gravel and forest roads, with very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as the 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT route. The start and registration take place at the complex by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on July 12, 2026, in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Dvě kola při zdi
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run the 7.8 km main course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but can also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are available for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.

name: REWAG-Firmenlauf
description: The REWAG Company Run on July 15, 2026, is one of the largest running events in the Regensburg region and offers a unique opportunity to run, connect and celebrate with colleagues in a relaxed atmosphere. The event is limited to 3,000 participants and attracts numerous companies and runners. In addition to the sporting experience, the run supports Jumpakids, the Regensburg Center for Obesity in Children and Adolescents, with a donation. Registration opens on May 1, 2026, for individuals and groups.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, 15 July 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The event features an appealing approx. 5 km loop on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of approx. 5 km, 10 km or 15 km. Participants can choose how many laps they want to complete on the day, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay race in which the course is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is fit and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a longstanding running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartow pine forest, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has fostered sporting commitment and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres that connect to one another, allowing participants to change the distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both casual runners and ambitious trail runners, and is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons.

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time on July 17, 2026. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to challenging 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great emphasis on safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Choose to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BambiniLauf 18:15, KidsLauf 18:30, TopLauf 19:00, FunLauf 20:15. A requested bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible up to and including event day, with a €5 late-registration fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the BambiniLauf. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and timing chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Schwanberglauf Iphofen-Castell
description: The Schwanberglauf is a traditional 10.4-kilometre race from Iphofen to Castell, taking place for the 42nd time on July 17, 2026. The course combines challenging climbs through vineyards and stretches through woodland with an idyllic finish in Castell Castle Park, accompanied by a wine-festival atmosphere. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels, and its proceeds support social institutions. It is organised by volunteers from TG Kitzingen in collaboration with the SBL team.
course_highlights: Start at the Rödelseer Tor in Iphofen, followed by a steep climb through vineyards
Water stations at kilometres 3 and 6.5, and shortly before kilometre 7
Finish in Castell Castle Park with a wine-festival atmosphere
additional: Race-bib collection from 15:30 at the Karl-Knauf-Halle in Iphofen. Start groups are arranged according to your own 10-kilometre race time. Toilets are available at the Karl-Knauf-Halle. Free bus transfer from the finish in Castell back to the start in Iphofen (departures from 16:50 to 17:45, approximately every 10 minutes). Luggage transport by VW van. Medical services provided by the Bavarian Red Cross. Showers are available in Castell (men at the Meierei, women at the sports club). Every finisher receives a bottle of mineral water from Franken Brunnen. Course: 10.4 km; start in Iphofen, finish in Castell; refreshments along the course; showers in Castell; electronic timing; awards ceremony at the wine festival; online registration; overnight accommodation in Iphofen is recommended.

name: Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf
description: The Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf is one of Germany’s largest Bürgerfest running events and takes place on 17 July 2026 in Freiberg. More than 1,600 runners take part across four different distances, from 600 metres to 10 kilometres. The event boasts a high finisher rate of over 95% and is followed by a Bürgerfest with live music in the market square. The start and finish are in the centre of Freiberg, creating a lively, community atmosphere.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Běh o Neplachovský hrneček is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemian Region. The 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from across the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.

name: Kružberský Tesák
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Reservoir grounds, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The event is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. It also includes Pejskiáda, a fun show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and dog-sport enthusiasts, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Leśna Eko Piątka
description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race held in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports integration and the prevention of addiction among children and young people. The course follows asphalt and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest, with the start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie. Participants receive a race package including a bib, timekeeping, a medal and medical support. The time limit is 45 minutes, and the field is limited to 500 participants.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: XIII Bieg po Chrust
location: Chróścice, Dobrzeń Wielki, Opole County, Poland

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra
description: Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 is a classic Backyard Ultra race taking place on July 18 and 19, 2026, in Kerpen-Blatzheim. In this special endurance format, speed is not the goal; instead, runners must complete a 6.706-kilometer loop within 60 minutes every hour and be ready to start again on the hour. The course runs mainly along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, with the start and finish at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a friendly, close-knit atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen gives runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured, DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with classifications starting from age group M/W 14. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting on July 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and dirt tracks. Each lap includes about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total elevation difference of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited entries and no entry fee. Runners must bring their own refreshments.

name: HAKRO Stadtlauf
description: The Hakro Stadtlauf in Schrozberg is a charity running event that donates €5 for each participant to Jugendhilfe Creglingen. The race is open to all age groups and promotes running together across generations. Individual competitions are organized by registration category, along with a team competition for companies, clubs, families, and friends. The event prioritizes a smooth schedule and asks participants to register in advance by July 16, 2025.

name: Heizomat Altmühlseelauf
description: The Heizomat Altmühlseelauf is a long-running race event held every July around Lake Altmühlsee in Gunzenhausen. The event features several competitions, including a half marathon, a relay race, a public race, a student race and a Bambini race. The courses are officially measured and pass through the scenic surroundings of Lake Altmühlsee. The event gives both individual and team runners the chance to test their endurance and enjoy a day of sport together.

name: Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf
description: The Lautersteiner Panorama Run on July 18, 2026, offers runners breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb. The varied course follows forest-edge trails and open sections around Weißenstein, rewarding the effort with fantastic panoramas. Organized by TV Weißenstein, the event celebrates the joy of sport in nature and a great atmosphere. Runners can choose between a short 4.5 km loop and the challenging 11.5 km main race.

name: Maintal Ultratrail / Bayerische Trail Meisterschaften 30km
description: With its three scenic routes in Franconian wine country, the Maintal Ultratrail offers an enjoyable trail-running experience. The 30 km route with 720 meters of elevation gain leads through picturesque vineyards, nature reserves, and varied forests along the Main. The event is aimed at trail-running enthusiasts of all experience levels who appreciate nature and the shared running experience. The motto for all participants is: fun and experiencing nature come first, not just athletic performance.

name: Sparkasse Kraichgau CityCup Bretten
description: The Sparkasse Kraichgau City Cup Bretten is a popular race that has been held annually since 2004 and attracts many runners from the region. The races pass through Bretten’s beautiful old town, with its alleyways and market square lined with half-timbered houses. Various distances are offered, including schoolchildren’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with medals for all schoolchildren and special prizes for schools and relay teams.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Recke Charity Run on July 18, 2026, is a fundraising event in support of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organised by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke, the run offers two distances: 5 kilometres for beginners and casual runners, and 10 kilometres for experienced runners seeking a greater challenge. The focus is on coming together for a good cause, with the entire entry fee being donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running event held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with the start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly follow wide Veluwe paths and forest trails across varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain, making for a challenging and atmospheric experience. Start times are scheduled so that you run into the evening and finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambience.
course_highlights: Run through the shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain and one-quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, with the finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day so you can run into the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and participants may bring their own cycling companion to provide support along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. Registration includes a finisher’s medal and a Midzomer shirt. On the day, you can switch your entry to a shorter distance free of charge at the event office. The event also relies on volunteers to help with various tasks. Five distances: 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km and marathon; cycling companions are allowed for the half and full marathons; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking and public transport connections.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
description: Try Noční Kuks, a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Stations of the Cross, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the Elbe at night and through the Count’s Alley, lined with 222 trees.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering races for recreational and elite runners over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable component. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not just a sporting event, but a full-day experience for all age groups.

name: Noční běh Rusava
description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské vrchy, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The race is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and runners are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place amid the scenic ski slope and forests around Rusava, creating a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, the Swiss Chalet on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, appealing to both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments along the route and at the finish.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Horní náměstí, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests burst with color. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Nocna zaDyszka is a 10 km race held as part of the 7th PKO Piekarski Half Marathon, which will take place on July 18, 2026, in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, and the participant limit for this distance is 900. The day before, on July 17, the accompanying 5 km Leśna Eko Piątka race will also take place. The organizers invite everyone to take part and expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical laps measuring 42,195 m, while the half marathon is one 21,097 m lap; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The start is at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with support from the City of Szczecin and port partners.

name: 7. PKO Piekarski Półmaraton
description: The 7th PKO Piekary Half Marathon will take place on 18 July 2026 in Piekary Śląskie. This running festival appeals to both running enthusiasts and people just starting out in the sport. The event is organised by the city of Piekary Śląskie, which invites all runners to take part. Details of the course and programme will be available closer to race day.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on July 18, 2026, in the scenic Elbląg Upland area by the Vistula Lagoon. The route follows wild trails through varied elevation and quiet, natural surroundings, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a comprehensive race pack.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, taking place on July 26, 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants attractive views and the opportunity to test their fitness over a distance of 5 km.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Aalener Stadtlauf
description: The Aalen City Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen and offers a varied running event with several races, including the Bambini Run, Schoolchildren’s Run, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and the Youth and Sparkasse Main Races. The event is known for its great atmosphere and sporting challenges. New this year is the Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup ranking, which combines races in different landscapes and offers a special challenge. Registration is now open, and all running enthusiasts are warmly invited to take part and enjoy the urban and natural running experience.

name: Barbarossalauf 2026
description: The Barbarossalauf 2026 returns as a city run to Erlenbach am Main on July 19. The new course starts centrally at the old fire station and follows a flat, scenic route along the Main before passing through Erlenbach’s old town to the finish. The event offers races for different age groups and distances, from children’s races to the 10 km main race, which consists of two laps. The course is ideal for beginners and ambitious runners aiming for fast times, and showcases Erlenbach at its best.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Stralsund-Barth Airport on the Baltic Sea and offers a varied program of seven races for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique setting right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and refreshments will be available on site.

name: Heumadener Volkslauf 2026
description: The Heumaden Volkslauf has been held annually in Stuttgart-Heumaden since 2009 and offers runners three distances: 5.5 km, 10.3 km and, since 2018, a half marathon of 21 km. The course is a long, mostly flat loop with few climbs, passing through the districts of Heumaden, Riedenberg and Kemnat. The start and finish are at the Untere Hasenwedel sports grounds. The event is part of the family sports festival and includes a water station on the longer course.

name: Internationaler Allgäu Volkslauf
description: The International Allgäu Fun Run in Leutkirch has taken place annually since 1970 on Children’s Festival Sunday and has grown into a major sporting event, attracting hundreds of runners from southern Germany and the twin towns. Organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V., the fun run is supported by numerous volunteers, the Leutkirch DRK, the city administration, and other partners. It is a traditional sporting event in Leutkirch and offers a varied program for runners of all ability levels.

name: Jakob Scheuring Lauf
description: The 24th Jakob Scheuring Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Murgstadion Ottenau and includes 1.5 km races for students, as well as 5 km and 10 km races, all with timing and rankings. The course leads from the stadium through the picturesque Salzwiesental, mostly through woods and meadows, and back to the stadium. The event is part of the Sportvereinigung Ottenau sports festival and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and an awards ceremony in the festival tent.

name: neuefinanzkultur Laufevent mit Biosphärenlauf und Auinger Alblauf
description: The Neue Finanzkultur running event in Auingen in the Swabian Jura is an annual major race day featuring various running events, including the Biosphere Run and the Auingen Alblauf. Alongside the sporting competition, there is also a charity walking event in aid of Clowns im Dienst. The event offers timing using a transponder system, awards for the fastest runners in each age group, and special prizes for the largest group. Children can take part in an untimed Bambini Run and receive a medal, certificate, and surprise.

name: run4trees
description: Run4Trees is a running event in Unterhaching taking place on July 19, 2026. The route runs through the idyllic Perlacher Forst, with the start and finish at the Unterhaching fairground. By taking part, runners show their support for climate protection, as proceeds are donated to Plant for the Planet and the TSV Unterhaching youth program. The event combines sporting commitment with environmental awareness and a sense of community.

name: Sommer Rheinauenlauf
description: The Summer Rheinauen Run in Bad Bellingen is a traditional running event organized by TV Rheinweiler. The races run through the picturesque Rhine meadows and offer a varied course for runners of all ages. The event includes several distances and caters to both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. Alongside the sporting competition, the sense of community is also a key focus.

name: Stundenlauf VfL Dettenhausen
description: The 24-hour run in Dettenhausen is a long-standing running event, taking place for the 20th time on 18 July 2026. The event is held at VfL Dettenhausen’s sports grounds and gives both solo and team runners the chance to test their endurance. Participation is free, with a strong emphasis on community and fitness. The course is equipped with a microchip in the race number for easy timekeeping, and overnight accommodation is available directly at the sports grounds.

name: Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf
description: The Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf will be held for the 21st time on July 19, 2026, organized by Lauftreff Unterreichenbach. The event offers runners of all ages and ability levels a varied running experience on well-marked routes that follow the paved Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path as well as surfaced forest and field paths. Races range from the Bambini run and junior races to 5 km events and a half marathon. The team places great importance on a relaxed, sporting atmosphere, supported by refreshment stations and chip-free timing.

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports, it offers a sporting celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad range of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with an emphasis on sportsmanship and inclusion.
course_highlights: Running route through central Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. It has a festive and safe atmosphere, with an emphasis on inclusion and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal; several race options, including a walk and a business run; a colorful and inclusive event during World Pride

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different locations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, experience routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied range of routes amid the picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an experience route, a walk, and children’s races.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in mountain running and offers runners a challenging course in the beautiful Krkonoše Mountains. The event attracts athletes and mountain-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.

name: 14. Dolnośląski Festiwal Biegów Górskich
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 mil, Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, 33 km, Półmaraton, 14 km, 10 km
description: The Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail-running event held in picturesque Lądek-Zdrój. As part of the festival, runners can take on a variety of courses with different distances and elevation gains, from short night races to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain-running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically challenging courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from 16 to 19 July, and participants can look forward to a varied programme of accompanying events and professional organisation.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, along a scenic route through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience level, can find a suitable route. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the remarkable atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, sociable atmosphere.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
description: Piątka Królowej Bony is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and is open to people over the age of 15. Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian. The start and finish are located at 3 Szkolna Street. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and participants can expect professional event support and timekeeping.

name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Golden Fern Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place in picturesque Tymbark. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a demanding route with varied terrain. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different skill levels. This event attracts runners who value challenges and contact with nature.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5–Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with an elevation gain of 130 metres. The race is part of the Runs in the Hills of Prague and Surroundings series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Schwäbisch Hall
description: The AOK Corporate Run Schwäbisch Hall is a popular team event taking place on July 22, 2026, at Optima Sportpark. The course is approximately 5 kilometers long and is run twice, offering a great opportunity to get active together with colleagues. In addition to the run, participants can look forward to a varied program featuring a DJ, a group warm-up, award ceremonies, and complimentary finish-line refreshments. The corporate run promotes team spirit and combines exercise with socializing.

name: Wild and Run
description: The Wild & Run on July 22, 2026, transforms Oberkollbach into a runner’s paradise and is part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup Pforzheim-Calw. The event offers runners a varied route through nature and welcomes both ambitious runners and running enthusiasts to the starting line. The Wild & Run team looks forward to welcoming many participants and creating a sporting atmosphere in idyllic surroundings.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race organized by KRB Chrudim. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on various courses and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers emphasize quality event management and a friendly race atmosphere.

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreational area and water sports center. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually. A photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is designed for experienced runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen
description: The Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen is a long-standing running event taking place for the 20th time on July 23, 2026. The event offers a wide range of races for all age groups, from Bambini and young people to ambitious adults. The race brings the whole city together and places particular emphasis on the joy of running and shared experiences. Whether you’re a beginner, a team player, or a competitive runner, everyone can find the right category here.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiáš’s Kazín–Cukrák Run is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging hilly courses in the picturesque surroundings of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners of all categories, who are automatically included in the overall standings. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges of hilly terrain.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place on 24 July 2026 in Bokel. This long-standing anniversary race is organised by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for enthusiasts of endurance sports and athletics.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: The number of places is limited to 300. The organisational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult; places are limited to 300. Date: 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewer Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee, taking place on 24 July 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to donate instead. The races take place on flat loop courses with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. There are also races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; donations are requested instead. There are races for children and young people. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria, offering races for children, recreational runners and experienced participants. The event takes place in summer and is part of the Bavarian running calendar. Distances range from short races for schoolchildren to main races of about 9 kilometres. Its night-race format gives runners the chance to run under the evening sky, setting it apart from typical daytime races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 780 m to approx. 10 km
Night-race atmosphere under the evening sky
Summer event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria
additional: The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including races for children and recreational runners. July weather is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night. Night race with multiple distances, part of the Bavarian running calendar, held in summer in Bad Staffelstein.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the heart of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a unique therapeutic and recreational forest in Europe with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported race. Times are recorded manually, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf
description: The 38th Heiligenhafen Midnight Run takes place on July 24, 2026, offering runners a special experience with late-evening start times. The main race covers 10 km through the town of Heiligenhafen, along the waterfront promenade and around the inland lake, with plenty of support along the course. Additional events include the Binnenseelauf (approx. 5.5 km), the Midnight Run Double Mile (approx. 3.2 km) for young people, and the Mini Midnight Run (approx. 1 km) for children. The event is organized by TSV Heiligenhafen and is a popular tradition, featuring electronic timing and a lively program on race day.

name: Waldlaufmeisterschaft SV Renquishausen
description: The 37th Waldlauf Championships will take place on July 24, 2026, in Renquishausen in the Black Forest. The race is part of the Silberdistel Runs and offers various distances for Bambini, students, everyone, and the main race. The event is open to all age groups and takes place in all weather conditions. Bib numbers will be distributed from 4:00 p.m., and the awards ceremony will be held at the sports clubhouse about an hour after the last finisher crosses the line.

name: WAREMA Lauf
description: The 19th WAREMA Run in Marktheidenfeld offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels. From the short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to the motivating 5 km company run and the challenging 10 km main race, there is something for everyone. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and lively spirit, which delight both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at the district sports complex, which serves as the event’s central venue.

name: 3Kings3Hills Trailrunning-Festival
distance_verbose: 100 Meilen, Ultramarathon, 50 km, Marathon, 25 km, 14 km, 5 km
description: The 3Kings3Hills trail running festival in the border region near Haidmühle offers challenging trails with steep climbs, fast descents, and flowing sections. Distances range from 6 km to 168 km, with options for all ability levels. The festival combines a sporting challenge with the unique scenery of the Bavarian Forest and Bohemian Forest. Finishers receive a fresh slice of pizza at the finish, along with a keepsake. The event is internationally recognized and awards ITRA points and a UTMB Index.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon 2026
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatras, in Zakopane. The course crosses the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs, each with around 1,200 m of elevation gain, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of Podhale and Orawa, giving participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: DJK Jakobuslauf
description: The Augsburg St. James Run, organized by the DJK Diocesan Association, is a special mass-participation event held as part of Augsburg’s oldest folk festival, the Jakober Kirchweih. The run is open to joggers and walkers and deliberately has no official timekeeping, embracing the motto “Experience over Results.” The event includes children’s races and three distances for adults, including a quarter marathon along the Lech. The start and finish are at Jakobsplatz by the famous Fuggerei, giving the run a historic and atmospheric setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jakobsplatz by the historic Fuggerei
Route along the Lech
10.5-kilometer quarter marathon for adults
additional: The run has no official timekeeping, putting enjoyment and the experience first. The ecumenical event is organized by the Catholic DJK Diocesan Association of Augsburg. The Fuggerei opens to visitors free of charge during the Jakober Kirchweih for the run. Distances are available for children, walkers, and adults; there is no official timekeeping, with a focus on community and experience; start and finish at Jakobsplatz in the Fuggerei.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience amid the island’s natural surroundings and special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as Napoleonschanze, Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, beside the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Past Napoleonschanze, the oldest monument on Norderney
Through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering runners on
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered during registration and is distributed with the race pack. It costs EUR 25 for adults and EUR 20 for children. Late entries are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, and in person on 24 and 25.07.2026. Timing is by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between EUR 3 and EUR 5, depending on the race. A preferred race number is available for an additional EUR 3. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical T-shirt, in-person registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: Freundschaftslauf Hasborn
description: The Hasborn Friendship Run is a long-standing running event organized annually by DJK Hasborn. It offers a range of distances, from short races for young runners to challenging distances such as 5 km, 11 km and 21 km. The atmosphere is welcoming and motivating, with lively crowds and numerous volunteers helping to make the event a success. The run is a sporting highlight in the region and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 100 m to 21 km
Motivating atmosphere with music and refreshment stations
Family-friendly running event with a large number of participants
additional: The run takes place every summer, with a big bridge party featuring music and cheerleaders as a motivational point along the course. Water, sports drinks and snacks are available along the route. The club's running group meets regularly on Wednesdays, providing a good opportunity to prepare for the run. Routes for children and adults; no official times for all distances; an annual event with a special sense of community.

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The route has a modest elevation gain of about 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The course passes through forest and trail sections, by Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events and takes place on July 25, 2026. The course runs right along the beach and offers a unique natural experience along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, perfectly combining a sporting challenge with a North Sea feel. The event is hosted by running-sports presenter Heino Krüger, who guides the day with extensive experience. The Friesian Festival takes place alongside the race, bringing atmosphere, music and culinary highlights.

name: Allersberger Kirchweihlauf
description: The Allersberg Kirchweih Run takes place annually on the last weekend in July in Allersberg and is part of the Raiffeisen Runners’ Cup in the BLV Middle Franconia-South district. The event offers various races, including a 400-meter Bambini run and other competitions for students and adults. The route is a very flat loop that starts and finishes at Allersberg Market Square. Water stations and refreshments at the finish are provided, and the event is organized by an experienced team.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
description: The Mulsumer Speckenlauf is a traditional running event held annually by TSV Mulsum. The event takes place at the Mulsum sports ground in the Wurster North Sea Coast municipality and attracts numerous runners. The course offers a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there is also a children’s sports festival featuring classic events, underscoring the family-friendly nature of the occasion.

name: Rechberghäuser Sommernachtslauf
description: The 14th Rechberghausen Summer Night Run takes place on July 25, 2026, in Rechberghausen. Officially registered with the German Athletics Federation, this event allows participants to run times that are recognized for athletics rankings. The run supports solidarity in sport and offers a sporting challenge in a pleasant summer atmosphere. The event includes two distances suitable for both children and experienced runners.

name: Reichenbacher Citylauf
description: The 31st Reichenbach City Run takes place as part of the Reichenbach Village Festival on Saturday, July 25, 2026. This year, only the Bambini run for children and the school relay races are being offered. The races start and finish at Reichenbach Town Hall and provide a great opportunity for elementary school classes and the youngest runners to get active and have fun together.

name: Tote Mann Berglauf / 10. Oberrieder Kinderlauf
description: The Tote Mann Mountain Run in Oberried is a challenging mountain race covering 11.1 km with 750 metres of elevation gain on forest paths and trails. The 10th Oberried Children’s Run also takes place on a flat course at the Goldberghalle, with distances from 0.4 to 1.2 km depending on age group. The race offers a special atmosphere, a varied course and refreshment stations. The start is on 25 July 2026 from 10:00, with different start times for the children’s races.

name: Crazy Runners Frankenwald Trail
organizer: TSV Dürrenwaid und Crazy Runners Team Frankenwald
description: The Crazy Runners Frankenwald Trail is a family-friendly trail running event in Frankenwald Nature Park, taking place on 25 July 2026 in Geroldsgrün. Organized by TSV Dürrenwaid and the Crazy Runners Team Frankenwald, the event features natural trails and paths with up to 2,000 metres of elevation gain. There are four distance options and a Kids Race, all running mainly on unpaved trails. The event is known for its great atmosphere, starter pack and ITRA points.

tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 5 Km  € 12,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

description: The Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is a friendly running race in the Westland, held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk. The main distance is 10 kilometres on a traffic-free, fast asphalt course through the polder and along iconic dikes. There is also a 5 km race, the 5 van DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent refreshments at the atmospheric finish field.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course through the polder and along dikes
Entirely paved, fast asphalt course with water stations
Iconic finish location in the village of Maasdijk
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:30 at the canteen of korfbalvereniging Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. The 5 km starts at 14:00, followed by the 10 km at 14:10. Changing and shower facilities are available at the korfbalvereniging. Results are recorded using a SAW chip, which costs €4.50 as a one-time fee and is not included in the entry fee. The youth run takes place without a chip. The race is held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk and offers a friendly atmosphere for all ages, including youth activities and special keepsakes for participants.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
description: Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Help Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds. The race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of young Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of varying lengths and age categories, whether they want to race or simply take a walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy the pleasure of movement in a community atmosphere.

name: Běh na Lysou horu
description: The Run to Lysá hora is a traditional race held every year on the last Saturday in July in Krásná–Nižní Mohelnice. This 41st edition welcomes runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, all aiming to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant, at the crossroads leading to Lysá hora; registration and the awards ceremony also take place there. The course follows an asphalt road along a forest service road operated by Lesy ČR all the way to the summit of Lysá hora.

name: Borovská desítka
description: Borovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina Region. The race offers a 10 km course with gentle elevation changes, running mostly through forest and along paved roads. The trees provide shade, making for a pleasant running experience even on sunny days. The start and finish are in the centre of the village, with aid stations along the course and at the finish. After the race, refreshments are provided, followed by an awards ceremony for winners in various categories.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Join us for the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The course follows a scenic route around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and a sense of sporting community. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy exercising outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in Witów in the Podhale region. The course runs along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orava regions, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego
description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, commemorating the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants, who take part in the 5- and 10-kilometer races, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The race starts in waves and takes place in the evening, further highlighting its distinctive character. The organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participants to take part from anywhere in the world.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th St. James Street Run is an annual sporting event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The race follows a certified 10 km course through the city streets, with appropriate security provided by the authorities. The ceremonial start takes place at Pokoju Square, and the race start is on Armii Krajowej Street. The finish is at Pokoju Square in front of the stage. Participants must be at least 16 years old and obey traffic regulations.

name: 9 Bieg Lubliniecki
description: The 9th Lubliniec Run is an annual running event organized by Mafia Team Lubliniec, taking place on July 25, 2026. The main distance is 10 km, and participants can also take part in races for children and young people. The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec. The course will be announced soon, and the event is highly regarded, with numerous awards in the categories of small-scale races and 10 km races.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the location. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Gdynia.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Challenge is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4,219.5-metre course in a municipal forest, starting and finishing by Piast Stadium. The event promotes a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle and encourages regular physical activity under the slogan “Let yourself be challenged to fight laziness!”

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Gänslauf in Herbolzheim an der Jagst is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 18th time on 18 July 2026. The event offers races over 10 km and 5 km, a 1,400 m race for schoolchildren, and 400 m children’s races, and is held as part of the village festival. The course follows scenic, varied circuits, starting and finishing at the Herbolzheim sports hall and passing sights such as the ruins of Herbolzheim Castle. Runners enjoy a mix of paved paths and shaded woodland trails along the Jagst.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km races starting and finishing at the Herbolzheim sports hall
Course consists of 60% paved paths and 40% gravel farm and woodland trails
Shaded woodland sections along the Jagst, with views of the ruins of Herbolzheim Castle
additional: No late entries are possible. Advance registration only. Baby joggers, strollers, and dogs are not allowed in any race. The start and finish are at the Herbolzheim sports hall, near TSV Herbolzheim’s football pitch. The course is marked with green arrows on the ground. Medals are awarded to all participants. The event is part of the Drei-Flüsse-Cup 2026. Events: 10 km, 5 km, 1,400 m schoolchildren’s race, 400 m children’s races; advance registration only, until 16 July 2026; no late entries; baby joggers, strollers, and dogs are not allowed; weather-dependent conditions in July

name: Altmühl-Jura Halbmarathon
description: The Altmühl-Jura Half Marathon is a long-established race in the picturesque region around Greding. The course winds through the varied landscape of the Altmühl-Jura region, offering runners a challenging yet scenic experience. The event is open to runners of all abilities and is organised by the City of Greding. The Greding Tourist Information Office is available as a point of contact.
course_highlights: Altmühl-Jura landscape
Varied and scenic course
Traditional running event in Greding
additional: The point of contact is the Greding Tourist Information Office, which can be reached at 08463 904-20. The event takes place in Greding. Further information and registration are available via the official websites. Terrain: roads and paved cycle paths; online registration; finisher’s medal included, certificates available online; race in July 2026

name: Hausener Volks-Waldlauf (TGS-Hausen)
location: Sportplatz TGS Hausen, Obertshausen, Hesse, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 5 € für Erwachsene, online Anmeldung bis 25.07.2025, Kinder frei
description: The Hausener Volks-Waldlauf, organised by TGS Hausen, takes place on 26 July 2026 and offers races over various distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and shorter schoolchildren’s and Bambini races. The start and finish are both at the TGS Hausen sports ground in Obertshausen. The routes run mainly on well-marked, flat forest trails, with the half marathon covering the 10 km loop twice. Timing is by transponder with gun-time results, and there is a 100 km team competition. The event is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation.
course_highlights: Well-marked, flat forest trails
The half marathon covers the 10 km loop twice
Start and finish at the TGS Hausen sports ground
additional: Late registration is possible on race day up to 15 minutes before the start, with a €5 late-entry fee for adults and no fee for young people or Bambinis. Spikes are prohibited on the sports ground. Timing is provided by R.S.T. Volkslauf GmbH. There is a 100 km team competition, in which runners from the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races may take part (maximum 20 participants per team). Routes on forest trails, gun-time and net-time results, refreshments on the course and at the finish, late registration possible shortly before the start.

name: Rieslinglauf und 17. Rheingauer Halbmarathon
description: The Rieslinglauf and Rheingau Half Marathon are traditional running events that have been held for over 40 years in the picturesque vineyards of Oestrich-Winkel. The routes pass through gentle hills and offer idyllic views of the Rhine Valley. The event includes several distances: 10 km, half marathon, 5 km fun run and a 2,000 m schoolchildren’s run. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Route through the gentle vineyard hills above Mittelheim and Oestrich
Mostly paved route with gentle climbs and around 90 metres of elevation gain over 10 km
Idyllic views of the Rhine Valley
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited to 555. Late entries are accepted in person at the event venue on the day of the event until 8:00 a.m. and incur a €5 late-entry fee, payable in cash. Participants who register in time receive a race T-shirt; for later registrations, T-shirts are available while supplies last. Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the race number. The finish line closes at 11:30 a.m. on race day. Prizes are awarded by age group, along with special prizes for the largest group/club and new personal bests. The route passes through vineyards on mostly paved paths with gentle climbs. Online registration is open until 24.07.2026. The race starts at the sports ground on Vollradsser Allee. The event is limited to 555 participants. Children and young people may take part.

name: Wallenstein-Halbmarathon
location: Altdorf bei Nürnberg, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Wallenstein Half Marathon is a traditional fun run around Altdorf near Nuremberg, taking place on July 26, 2026. The half-marathon course runs through the picturesque Schwarzachtal valley, offering wonderful views, and includes roads, cycle paths, and forest trails. In addition to the half marathon, there is a 12 km fun run and a family-friendly 5 km route for runners and walkers. The event offers well-organized amenities, including refreshment stations and an attractive start/finish area at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park. The city championships for the half marathon and 12 km race will also be held, with prizes awarded by the mayor.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through the Schwarzachtal valley with scenic viewpoints
Refreshment stations at km 7, 11, 15, 18, and at the finish
Route on roads, cycle paths, and forest trails around Altdorf
additional: Start and finish at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park (Heumannstr. 5a). Isotonic drinks and water available at several refreshment stations. Free admission to the outdoor swimming pool for all finishers, sponsored by Stadtwerke Altdorf. City championships and team competitions will be held. Scenic route through the Schwarzachtal valley, team competitions, family-friendly 5 km, race-day logistics and amenities at the Altdorf sports park.

name: 38. Frankenwaldlauf
description: The 38th Frankenwaldlauf in Oßla offers races over 18.5 km and 9 km, as well as Nordic walking. There are also shorter distances for children and young people, including the Oßlaer Gimpel-Lauf. The course runs through the Thuringian Forest and features beautiful natural scenery. The event is part of regional running cups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and an awards ceremony on site.

name: Blutenburglauf
description: The Blutenburglauf takes place on July 26, 2026, in Munich-Untermenzing and offers attractive running routes along the Würm and around the historic Blutenburg. The event includes 5 km and 10 km distances, both taking runners through scenic natural surroundings. Times are recorded electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event is organised by Rotary Club München-Blutenburg Gemeindienste e.V. and offers an entertainment programme in the start/finish area in addition to the sporting competition.

name: Kinderfestlauf Wangen im Allgäu
organizer: Kinderfestkommission Wangen im Allgäu e. V.
description: The Children’s Festival Run in Wangen im Allgäu is part of the long-standing Children’s and Local Heritage Festival, which has been celebrated for over 180 years. The run takes place on the Sunday of the festival weekend and offers children and young people from Wangen and the surrounding area a sporting attraction. Alongside the run, the festival features numerous other events, including a colorful parade, eagle shooting, and a varied program for the whole family. The event combines sporting ambition with a festive sense of community in Wangen’s historic old town.

name: Kusterdinger Hornissenlauf - 4. Lauf des VR-Cups
description: The Kusterdingen Hornet Run is a scenic race with a family-friendly atmosphere and timekeeping, held annually since 1990. The challenging course of around 10 kilometers follows paved forest and cycle paths and finishes on the synthetic track at Kusterdingen Stadium. In addition to the main race, there are races for students, youth and children, a fun run, and Nordic walking. The event is supported by the Municipality of Kusterdingen and Volksbank in der Region. All participants receive medals and certificates, and the top runners are honored.

name: Langauer Inklusionslauf
description: The 3rd Langau Inclusive Run takes place on July 26, 2026, in cooperation with Tri-Team Schongau as part of the 14th Schongau Triathlon. The run is open to everyone wishing to take part individually, in pairs, or with assistance; participation in a wheelchair is also possible. The course is a flat out-and-back route, starting and finishing on Lechuferstraße by the ice rink. Entry is free, and donations to support Langau are welcome. Every registered participant receives a running shirt and a finisher’s gift, and trophies are awarded to the top finishers in various categories.

name: Mercaden Stadtlauf Böblingen
description: The MERCADEN® Böblingen City Run is a traditional running event held annually in downtown Böblingen. On July 27, 2026, runners of various age groups and distances will take part, including the 10.2 km Sparkassen Run, the 5.1 km Lotto Run, and the Bambini and student races. The start and finish are at Alba Bridge/Wandelhalle, providing an attractive, central route through the city. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to runners of all ability levels.

name: Oscheffer TSG-Lauf
description: The 17th Oscheffer TSG Run will take place on July 26, 2026, in Mainaschaff. The event offers various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s and youth race, the Sparkassen Run (5 km), the agilimo Run (10 km), a Bambini race, and a relay race. The races are part of a long-standing sporting event organized by TSG Mainaschaff 1973 e.V., welcoming both recreational and competitive runners. Online registration is now open, and further information is available in the event announcement.

name: Rainer Volkslauf
description: The Rainer Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, July 26, 2026, in Rain and offers runners of all ages a varied and motivating running experience. The 10 km main race starts at 9:30 a.m., followed by 5 km races and the shorter 1 km and 2 km Spatzenläufe. The focus is on the joy of exercise and preventive healthcare, supported by enthusiastic spectators and a varied program of events as part of SC Rain 1928 e. V.’s sports week. Register by June 15, 2026, and a popular Volkslauf T-shirt is included in the race pack. In addition, one euro per participant will be donated to the “Freunde durch Helfen” aid initiative.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, passing through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and lively crowds along the route. The course forms a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections through historic towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites runners to make a strong final push. The marathon is open to adult runners aged 18 and over and is part of a varied running program in the Bottwartal.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages.
