A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
description: The Run to Kozubová is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows hiking trails over challenging elevation changes. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and goes via Polana and the Pod Kykulou saddle to the tourist lodge on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and offering beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
description: Saint Kinga’s Escape is a mountain trail race held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, combining scenic routes through the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with different time limits and Sunday morning starts. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Przechyba mountain shelter, Wielka Przechyba, and Pieniny National Park, finishing along a scenic path beside the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheatre in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Health Resort Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Darłowo Municipality. It includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying events such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. The organizers offer a full program and attractive prizes, and the course runs through charming health resort grounds.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka — Summer Edition is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative medal shaped like a water lily, and the main race starts at 10:00.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: The 4th Chełmiec Mountain Running Festival – Babinicz Run is a running event held in picturesque Szczawno-Zdrój, at the foot of Chełmiec Mountain. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival appealing to runners of varying abilities. The course runs through charming surroundings, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when the weather is typically summery, with temperatures around 25°C and sunny skies.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Holger-Nothacker-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Holger Nothacker Memorial Run is a traditional running event in support of the Schömberg Children’s Hospital. The event offers three distances for different groups of runners: a 3-kilometer course for beginners and students, a 5.4-kilometer loop for recreational runners, and a challenging 10-kilometer loop with 148 meters of elevation gain for ambitious endurance athletes. The course runs around Schömberg and offers a sporting challenge in the region. Staff from the children’s hospital support the event and provide refreshments and drinks.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The races start in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The event is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making it an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and prizes are drawn in a raffle.

name: Altbulacher Berglauf
description: The 24th Altbulach Mountain Run takes place on July 29, 2026, in Neubulach. It is a short mountain-running race with two distances: 800 meters and 2.9 kilometers. The race gives runners the opportunity to experience the scenic beauty of the region in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny days. Please note that the exact organizer details should be checked before registering.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Sulz am Neckar
description: The AOK Corporate Run Sulz am Neckar is a team event taking place on July 29, 2026, at Albeck Stadium. The 5 km course gives companies and teams the opportunity to get active together and strengthen team spirit. In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a varied program featuring DJ music, a warm-up session, and complimentary refreshments at the finish. The event is part of the BW-Running series and is open to runners aged 16 and over.

name: Volkslauf Lauftreff Pfohren
description: The 24th Volkslauf “Rund um Pfohren” will take place on Wednesday, July 29, 2026. The 10 km course, officially measured by the DLV, runs mainly along paved farm roads around Pfohren. In addition to the main race, there are also children’s races, Bambini races, and walking and Nordic walking events. Training runs will be offered from July 7, 2026, on Tuesdays at 7:00 p.m. at the Pfohren sports and festival hall. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the top runners and groups.

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held under the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each loop. Marathon times are recorded with a handheld stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in De Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sport and attracts many participants, including many AVA members. The event offers an enjoyable, sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. It is a fixture in the region and is known for its friendly, accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the distinctive polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty, welcoming atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club, AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The start is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43, Aalsmeer. There is a sociable post-race gathering with coffee or tea in the clubhouse. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, strengthening the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest, which features activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, with a 6.14 km trail per lap. The event is not competition-focused, but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.

name: 6. Bienwald Backyard Ultra
description: The Bienwald Backyard Ultra is a challenging ultrarunning event in Kandel, Rhineland-Palatinate. As one of the Silver Ticket Races, it gives the winners the opportunity to compete on the German team at the 2023 Big Dog's World Championships. The event takes place at Bienwaldstadion and attracts ambitious ultrarunners looking to test their endurance and mental strength.

name: Nordschwarzwald Trophy
description: The Nordschwarzwald Trophy is a sporting event in Schömberg, offering various competitions and running routes in the picturesque Northern Black Forest. The event features varied courses and a warm atmosphere that appeals to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. Organized by Eventservice Stahl, the Trophy combines a sporting challenge with a sense of community in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, features a measured 5 km loop course at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently hilly, with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The run starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned race in the region.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional road race with a flat course along the Rhine. On 25 July 2026, events will be held over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish line, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. The event takes place on 25 July 2026 and offers start times for various events. Results will be available shortly after the races finish. The event is particularly appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Die 10 Kilometer von Dürwiß
price_range: kostenlos, Anmeldung online oder vor Ort gegen Gebühr
description: The 10 km von Dürwiß is a traditional road race held annually on the first Saturday in August by SV Germania Dürwiß e.V. More than 500 runners from Germany and abroad take part, with winning times usually around 30 minutes. The flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop runs through the town center of Dürwiß and is completely closed to traffic on race day. What makes this cult race special are the many spectators and lively street parties along the course, with music and decorations creating a unique atmosphere. The event wraps up with an after-run party featuring DJ Steve and a wide selection of refreshments.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop through the town center of Dürwiß
Five laps for the 10 km main race, on streets completely closed to traffic
Lively street parties with music and decorations along the course
additional: In addition to the 10 km main race, there is a 4,000 m fun run, children’s and youth races from 200 m to 1,000 m, and a 10 km inline skating race with different lap formats depending on age group. The course is completely closed to road traffic on race day, and parking along the route is strictly prohibited. The event wraps up with an after-run party featuring DJ Steve and extensive refreshments. Course back to 10 km, inline skating and children’s races, street parties, after-run party, music, sponsor prizes

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: 5. TCW Backyard Ultra
description: The TCW Backyard Ultra in Wölfersheim is a unique running event focused on camaraderie and endurance. A 6.706 km loop starts at the top of every hour and must be completed within that hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, who is declared the winner. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and motivating community, welcoming runners of all abilities.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a big party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating route through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic fans create an electrifying atmosphere that makes the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, with its illuminated finish arch, rounds off the sporting night perfectly.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer race that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of movement and a sense of community. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a sociable get-together in a relaxed atmosphere. The race is organized by volunteers from TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.

name: Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf
description: The 15th Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf on August 1, 2026, in Aldersbach is a running event with a family-friendly atmosphere and genuine race-day excitement. The event offers suitable challenges for all age groups and fitness levels, from the Bambini run and children’s and youth races to the main race. Nordic walking is also part of the program. The event combines sporting ambition with a shared summer spirit and attracts runners and spectators from the region.

name: Schwindegger Schlosslauf
description: The Schwindegg Castle Run is an annual sporting event in the idyllic community of Schwindegg. Participants run along picturesque paths and through forests, with views of Schwindegg Castle. There are various categories for all age groups, including children and teenagers. The event is also an opportunity to strengthen the community and support the sports club. Before and after the run, a summer festival with food, a drinks stand and a bar offers a cheerful atmosphere for celebrating and socializing.

name: SWE Halbmarathon Ettlingen
description: The SWE Ettlingen Half Marathon is a challenging and varied 21.1 km scenic race connecting several Ettlingen districts at different elevations. The route starts in the idyllic Horbachpark and leads through wooded areas with distant views of the Black Forest before descending into the Rhine Plain and finishing at Horbachsee. Aid stations are available every 3 km, and local residents provide refreshments and an encouraging atmosphere. The race takes place on August 1, 2026, and is organized by SSV Ettlingen 1847 e. V., Lauftreff Ettlingen Department.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Areál Svatý Petr, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 starters, and the race is divided into several age categories for men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including a short and a long course; the long ČSOB 20 km route is included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to the special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains and compete on well-marked routes.

name: Zlatá stezka
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region. It winds through the beautiful landscapes of Šumava and the Bavarian Forest. At 631 km long, it offers a unique experience, linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can explore historic towns, castles, observation towers, and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the region’s natural and historical attractions in the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, with shorter routes available for the latter. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which brings together running races at attractive locations near castles.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners pleasant natural terrain. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Mšec Municipality and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř–Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Runs in the Hills in Prague and Surrounding Areas series. The course is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
location: Mšec, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Krkonoše Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall winners are named for both men and women, along with winners in ten age categories for men and women.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the beauty of their settings. The organizers aim to promote running and offer participants a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run, and the Polish 10 km Championships.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle course race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It’s a challenge for the whole family, including children, offering unusual entertainment and the opportunity to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among the elite events of its kind in Poland and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
organizer: RUDA Śląska i MOSiR Ruda Śląska
description: The 9th Ruda Śląska Industrial Half Marathon will take place on August 1 at 9:00 p.m. in Ruda Śląska. The 10.5 km route runs through the central part of the city, showcasing the region’s industrial character and post-industrial landmarks such as Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, the Kaufhaus housing estate, and the blast furnace at Pokój Steelworks. In addition to the half marathon, an accompanying run of approximately 10 km is organized for those who do not feel up to running the full distance. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and organizational facilities.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer route through the municipality’s scenic surroundings. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: virtueller St.-Anna-Jedermannslauf
description: The virtual St. Anna Jedermannslauf in Amerdingen is a popular running event held annually in July. Participants can run the original courses of 10 km, 5.8 km jogging, 5.8 km walking, or 3.5 km for youth. The route leads from St. Anna Chapel through the forest south of Amerdingen, past historic sites such as the Celtic square enclosure and the Three Stones, as well as a small lake. Times are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to a leaderboard, making the event especially modern and accessible. The race is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups.
course_highlights: Start at St. Anna Chapel
Forest course south of Amerdingen, with historic sights such as the Celtic square enclosure and the Three Stones
Route marked with directional arrows, with app-supported timekeeping
additional: The race is virtual and takes place in July, allowing participants to complete their runs at a time that suits them. Multiple entries and a second free attempt are possible. Results are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to the leaderboard. There are different course distances for different age groups and ability levels. Virtual race, route towards the Celtic square enclosure, online registration, event period from 01.07. to 27.07.2025, start times between 06:00 and 20:00, participation from age 8, donations to preserve the chapel

name: Hirschbachschleiferl
location: 85414 Kirchdorf an der Amper, Bavaria, Germany

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 EUR bei Anmeldungen bis zum 15. Juni

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 17 EUR bei Anmeldung vom 16. Juni bis 27. Juli

description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on August 2, 2026, and offers a scenic course through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start at the stadium in Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a nearly 10-kilometer loop through picturesque parkland and villages. Several aid stations along the route provide refreshments for participants. The finish is back at the stadium, where spectators can cheer on the runners and enjoy a lovely time together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium in Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive castle park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, where enthusiastic neighbors cheer runners on
additional: Personal refreshments can be dropped off before the start (8:00–8:45 a.m.). Water stations are located at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is available until 8:00 a.m. for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with timing chips for electronic timekeeping will be issued and collected after the race, but participants may keep them as souvenirs. The course goes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish at the stadium in Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Live results are available. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern car park.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Rund um Wellen Fun Run will take place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen. It is one of Germany’s oldest marathon races and has a family-friendly atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: the marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km, some of which are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, including forest paths and surfaces of different types. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and is supported by many volunteers from the village.

name: Hilpoltsteiner Burgfestlauf
description: The Hilpoltstein Castle Festival Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the Hilpoltstein Castle Festival. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in August. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, fun and main races. A special highlight is the castle hill sprint in the main race, where the fastest runners can earn the title of Castle Hill King or Queen. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive course, with the start and finish on Marktstraße near the town hall.

name: Kapellenlauf Vorra
description: The Kapellenlauf Vorra is a traditional race held annually by DJK SC Vorra. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, a quarter marathon of 10.55 km, and a fun run and Nordic walking, newly added in 2025. The course passes through the rural surroundings of Abtsdorf and offers both competitive racing and a more leisurely running experience. The race also hosts the Upper Franconian Half Marathon Championships and attracts many participants from the region.

name: Olewiger Charity-Run
description: The Olewig Charity Run in Trier is a diverse running event that combines sporting commitment with social cohesion. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a main race, a youth race, a children’s race, and an inclusive race. 100% of all entry fees are donated to Demenzzentrum e.V. for the Trier region, underscoring the event’s charitable spirit. The races take place on August 2, 2026, offering a great opportunity to get active together for a good cause.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different destinations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km using a map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1,600 metres. The series is suitable for a wide range of people who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains in an active and sporting way.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five varied routes, ranging from 5 to 102 km and suited to different experience levels, from beginners to seasoned ultramarathoners. The routes pass through the beautiful Gorce Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours, underscoring the event’s challenging nature.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’s Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments, and bag storage. Every participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive certificates and medals.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The BWM Sommerlochlauf takes place on August 4, 2026, in Steinheim an der Murr. It is a 10 km race, especially suited to runners who love speed. The flat, fast course through Steinheim offers ideal conditions for setting personal bests. Its friendly organization and lively atmosphere make it a popular midweek event where sports enthusiasts can test their fitness together.

name: Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm
description: The 41st Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm is a challenging mountain race taking place on 5 August 2026 in Raubling. The course covers 7.5 kilometres with an elevation gain of around 678 metres. The race starts at 19:00 and offers runners a challenging mountain route. The event is aimed at mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
678 metres of elevation gain
Very challenging mountain terrain
additional: Start and finish are provided for all competitions; exact location details require RUNME Premium. Accommodation is available near the start and finish. The race starts in Großholzhausen, with parking, changing facilities and clothing transport. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere, with a raffle and commemorative gifts. Early registration is recommended.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels an opportunity to test themselves over a quarter-marathon distance in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.

name: Krčský lomcovák
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčský Lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km course starting by the Velký altán, open to both men and women, with separate start times. The event is part of a fun sports afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities, such as slacklining, sack racing and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news from Krčský Forest and its surroundings.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: 6. Bärenkopplauf
description: The Bärenkopplauf is a challenging mountain and trail run in the Rhine-Westerwald Nature Park. It follows the premium hiking route “WällerTour Bärenkopp” over approximately 11 km, with around 360 m of ascent and 260 m of descent. The run takes place on the first Friday in August from 18:00, with staggered wave starts. The course is divided into two halves: the first is technically challenging, with trails and steep climbs; the second is predominantly downhill and scenic. A mountain prize is awarded to the fastest man and woman at the Bärenkopp cross. The event is organised by VfL Waldbreitbach and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments and transponder timing.
course_highlights: 11 km course with +360/-260 m of elevation on the WällerTour Bärenkopp
The first half is a challenging trail and mountain run, with steep climbs and technical sections
The second half is a scenic run on a predominantly downhill course
additional: Staggered wave starts take place between 18:00 and 18:30, with 20 participants per wave. After registration closes, race numbers are assigned based on the submitted 10 km time: the fastest runners start first, and late registrants start in the final wave. There are two water stations at 3.3 km and 7 km. The course is permanently marked and includes steep, sometimes narrow trails with steps and wooden bridges; extra care is advised in wet conditions. Race-number collection and bag drop-off are at the schoolyard of the Realschule plus. Timing uses disposable transponders attached to race numbers. Finish refreshments include water, tea and energy drinks. Parking is available near the start and finish; if you park near the finish, you can jog approximately 1 km to the start as a warm-up. Online registration is open until 3 August 2026; late registration is available until 6 August 2026. No showers are available. The event also includes the Bärchenlauf and other activities.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer-evening running adventure at one of Europe’s most architecturally and historically valuable hilltop fortresses. The challenging 9.4-kilometre main course climbs 470 metres, with the final kilometres running across the fortress plateau and offering magnificent views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe. Alongside the main race, there is a 7.7 km course, as well as a mini run and an inclusive run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held at sunset in the fortress market square.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf takes place on 1 August 2026 in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest paths. It is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and by age group.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest paths
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are available for purchase on site. Trophies go to the fastest runners on each course (places 1–3 in each gender category), with awards for the top three in each age group. Team classification for the 10 km race, based on the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest paths, team classification, trophies for the fastest on each course, awards, registration until 29.07.2026

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 17 Euro pro Person bei online Anmeldung

description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: Güttersbacher Volkslauf 2026
description: The Güttersbach Volkslauf will take place for the 29th time on August 8, 2026, and is an established event on the running calendars of Hesse and the Odenwald. The event is known for excellent organization, a great atmosphere and a smooth-running day. The courses wind through the beautiful countryside around Mossautal and offer a challenge for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are in the village center at the community hall, where food and drink are also available for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in the village center at the community hall
Challenging courses set in the beautiful Odenwald countryside
Aid stations along the course and free use of the outdoor swimming pool for participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the start of the race. The first 200 pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt, as do the first 80 registered schoolchildren. The first-place finisher in each age group (except walking) receives a trophy, a non-cash prize and a certificate. Every finisher receives an exclusive finisher medal. Participants can use the Güttersbach outdoor swimming pool free of charge. Food and drink will be provided for runners and spectators. Participants receive medals, and T-shirts are available for early registrants. Parking is limited and road closures may be in effect. Families receive free admission to the outdoor swimming pool after the race.

name: Monschau-Marathon warm-up
description: The Monschau Marathon is a scenic race through the picturesque Eifel region, attracting runners from all over the world. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows and woodland, as well as challenging climbs that offer a sporting challenge. Its warm, welcoming atmosphere is shaped by dedicated volunteers and an international field of runners. Alongside the classic marathon, ultra distances and relay events are also offered, making this a special running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a gentle downhill section and an ideal warm-up loop
Monschau’s historic old town and natural scenery along the Rur
The legendary climb through the Holderbach Valley, gaining 160 metres
additional: Late entries are possible online and in person through and including 09.08.2026; a late-entry fee applies. There are 12 refreshment stations along the course. Medical services, doctors, a massage team and sports physiotherapists will be on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports field (10 € per day/person; children free). Showers and changing facilities are in the sports hall at Konzen Primary School. Pacemakers for various target times are available. A finisher’s medal is included; a technical shirt can be booked for an additional fee when registering online by 31 July. Several race distances are offered, including the marathon, ultra, relay and walking events. Participant services include refreshments, medals, finisher shirts, massage services and an after-run party. Registration is subject to deadlines, and personalised bibs are available.

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the “Summer in the City” festival in downtown Oettingen. The event offers races for children, teenagers and adults, with timing for the main race, the youth races and the walking event. The routes lead through the historic city centre and offer a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organised by TSV Oettingen, Running, Triathlon and Athletics Department, and is a popular local race with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic city centre of Oettingen
Children’s race: approx. 0.8 km, untimed
Main race and walking event: approx. 7 km, timed
additional: Children’s race is untimed; registration is available through the Oettingen holiday programme; late registration is possible on the event day for an additional fee; medals and drinks for the children’s and youth races; prizes for the first three boys and girls in the youth race; walking event and main race are timed; staggered start times from 16:00. The route is mostly flat, on asphalt and cobblestones; start and finish at the market square; open to all physically fit participants; city championship for Oettingen residents.

name: Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden
location: Innenstadt von Kirchheimbolanden, Kirchheimbolanden, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden is a traditional race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden. The event gives runners the opportunity to take part in a popular local sporting event in a beautiful urban setting. The route runs through the town centre and offers varied urban scenery. The event is organised by LLG Wonnegau, known for its dedicated running community.
course_highlights: Race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden
Varied urban running route
Traditional local sporting event
additional: Registration for the LLG Summer Runs 2026 is open. LLG Wonnegau also offers an end-of-year celebration for club members and non-members. The LLG Wonnegau office is located in Monsheim. Routes in the town-centre area; start and finish at the car park; free parking; showers and changing facilities in the school gym.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the geographical center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for young and old as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and run along paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there is an age-group classification as well as on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp, by Auesee. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. The organizer is ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized and pleasant race atmosphere.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It offers a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, which features a giant bouncy castle. The race is timed using chip timing, and after the run there is an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the primary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on recreational and competitive running, which the club organizes in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.

name: Slatinická sedmička
description: Slatinice Seven is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route surrounded by nature. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.

name: Vnorovská desítka
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km race held every year in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elite athletes and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at the elementary school. The atmosphere is lively, thanks to the large crowd and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudetes ultramarathon taking place on August 8, 2026, in Niedamirów, a picturesque village located at the crossroads of three cultures. Participants can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K, and 100K, which lead through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate, and the Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass through the region’s historical and natural attractions, with the start and finish in Niedamirów. It’s a unique opportunity to take on a Sudetes ultra amid the wilderness and local culture.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association to promote an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Śliwice and offers participants an attractive 10 km course. The race attracts both amateur and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and bringing the local community together.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, featuring significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the „SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race held in the scenic area around Bielsko-Biała, on routes around the summit of Klimczok. The race’s name refers to the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang that helped the poor and left traces behind in the form of a mountain shelter and a cave. The course is challenging, with significant elevation gain and technical climbs that test the runners’ character and endurance. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a race series that has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the scenic appeal and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 1st Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main courses: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with the option to compete individually or as part of a team. The event is limited to 500 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The race starts at 8:00 PM, highlighting the unique character of a nighttime run with a dog.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6th Złota Dycha is a road race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest city in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining the excitement of sport with the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—and participants can compete on the city’s picturesque streets. It is organized by Złotoryja City Hall and the Złotoryja Cultural Center, with support from the local running community.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses timing with a reusable chip. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is provided exclusively with the reusable race result chip, worn on the foot using a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Late entries are not possible. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and school students participate free of charge.

name: Karbener Stadtlauf
price_range: zwischen 2,00€ und 15,00€ je nach Lauf und Jahr
description: The Karben City Run is a traditional running event held every year in Karben at Günter-Reutzel-Weg. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied courses through the town and surrounding area. An accompanying program provides entertainment and a chance to socialize. The run is a popular event for the whole family and promotes local sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Course through the town of Karben
Finish at Günter-Reutzel-Weg
Varied running courses for different age groups
additional: An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is via the separate registration page. The event is organized by Karbener Sportverein. Various race disciplines; online registration is open until approximately 60 minutes before the start; late registration is available for a fee.

name: Monschau Marathon
description: The Monschau Marathon takes place from August 7 to 9, 2026, in the picturesque Eifel landscape and offers runners a challenging course with varied terrain. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes ultra distances (K56 and K70), a Genuss-Marathon, and relay races. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows, and forests, with impressive views, all in a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. The Monschau Marathon is an international running event offering great variety and a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers, and sponsors.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a slight downhill and a fast opening loop
Monschau’s historic old town and nature along the Rur
The legendary Holderbachtal climb, gaining 160 meters in elevation
additional: 12 aid stations along the marathon course. Relay exchange points in Widdau and Kalterherberg. Medical services, doctors, a massage team, and sports physiotherapists on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports field (10 euros per day/person; children free). Showers and changing rooms are available in the Konzen primary school gym. Late registrations are possible online and on site until 09.08.2026, with a late registration fee. Pacemakers for various target times. Finisher medal included; technical shirt available for an additional fee when registering online by July 31. Guided bike tour on Saturday with no entry fee. Multiple race distances, including the marathon, ultras (K56, K70), relay, and walking; event in the Eifel with aid stations, start and exchange zones; focus on community and experiencing nature.

name: Rother Kirchweihlauf
description: The Rother Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSG 08 Roth. The race takes place annually in Roth and offers runners a great opportunity to get active and experience a sense of community. Despite occasional weather-related challenges, the event is held with great dedication. It welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: A traditional race in Roth with regional significance
An outdoor event with a varied course
Part of the Middle Franconian 10 km Championships (when held)
additional: Certificates can be downloaded online after the race. The event is organized by TSG 08 Roth, which also offers other sports activities and classes. The event takes place on a flat, paved course, with various race categories for all ages and ability levels. Results and photos are available.

name: Stefan-Andres-Freundschaftslauf
organizer: Lauftreff Schweich e.V. / LLG Wustweiler e.V.
description: The Stefan-Andres Friendship Run is a challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich on the Moselle, held without a competitive element. The focus is on the joy of running and sharing the experience. Three distances are offered—12, 18 and 26 kilometres—each with several metres of elevation gain and well-marked routes. After the run, participants can get together over soft drinks at the Haus des Sports, which also has changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: Challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich
Three distances: 12 km (approx. 340 m elevation gain), 18 km (approx. 490 m), 26 km (approx. 720 m)
Refreshment stations on all routes, with traditional schnapps at the final station
additional: This is a non-competitive friendship run with no entry fees, held as a charity run in support of the “Region der Lebensretter” emergency responder app project. The start and finish are in Schweich: the start is at Niedeprümer Hof, and the finish is at the Haus des Sports, which has changing rooms and showers. At Schweicher Annaberg, at “Lagenliebe”, each participant is offered a glass of wine. After the run, participants can relax together over soft drinks. The run is usually held in August, when the weather is typically sunny and around 25°C. Refreshment stations offer wine and schnapps tastings, and after the run everyone celebrates together at the Haus des Sports. The event supports the “Region der Lebensretter” app, which alerts nearby first responders.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern transponder timing. Participants can conveniently view and download their results and certificates online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all ability levels.

name: Münzwaldlauf (36. Volkslauf)
description: The Münzwaldlauf is a traditional fun run in Lichtenau, Baden-Württemberg, and will take place for the 36th time in 2026. The event offers various distances, from 0.25 km for Bambini to the 10 km main race. The courses run mostly along forest and meadow trails and are known for their natural surroundings, making the event especially appealing to families and nature lovers. In addition to the short children’s races, there are more challenging sections, such as the 5.2 km trail run. The event is an established local race with a long history.

name: Oberpfalzmeisterschaft Waldlauf 2026
description: The Upper Palatinate Cross-Country Championships 2026 will take place on 9 August 2026 at the Jacob family brewery in Bodenwöhr. The event is hosted by the Upper Palatinate District and organised by TV Burglengenfeld. The cross-country race offers runners an attractive course in a natural setting and is part of the Hammerseelauf. The championships are open to various age groups, from youth to masters, and promise exciting competition in the Upper Palatinate region.

name: v-office-Europalauf
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on 9 August 2026 is an international race connecting the Baltic seaside resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin over the half-marathon distance. The course offers a wonderful view across Neustädter Bucht and returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half-marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini run. The event is a popular sporting occasion in the region and is organised by TSV Neustadt.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubický
description: Černovír Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its hilly courses combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is popular with local and visiting runners.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide gravel forest road to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The event is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively in beautiful surroundings.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on August 8–9, 2026, starting in Rajcza and finishing in Ujsoły. The courses are technically demanding, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the 80 km race serves as the Polish Mountain Running Championships over the ultra distance. The organizers provide professional race management and aid stations along the course, as well as the option to transfer a race entry.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious annual running event held in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This unique sporting event attracts both amateur and professional runners, offering races over various distances in the picturesque city centre, on a course that loops around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and creates an unforgettable atmosphere with thousands of spectators cheering on the runners and a rich programme of accompanying events. It is valued by local authorities and sponsors, underscoring its status and importance in Poland’s running calendar.

name: XI Bieg Lucka
description: The 11th Bieg Lucka is a memorial race honoring Lucjan Chorąży, held on August 9, 2026, in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event includes a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and a Nordic Walking event of approximately 5.2 km, as well as shorter races for children. The main race course leads to Mount Chełm, and after the events participants can gather for refreshments. The race has a family-friendly, mountain character and honors Lucjan, who was passionate about mountains and running.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Poland

name: Nettetal-Lauf
distance_verbose: 50 Meilen, Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter
description: The Nettetal Run is a traditional road race held annually in mid-August in Ochtendung, Germany. The 2026 event offers a varied selection of distances from 3 km to 10 km, with longer distances also possible in other years. The course is officially measured, allowing results to be recognized in the German rankings. The race is supported by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is listed in the laufen.de calendar.
course_highlights: Officially measured course
Road race in Ochtendung, Germany
A range of distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Typical August weather: around 25 °C during the day and 14 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The start is in Ochtendung. The race is part of the German athletics calendar, with an official measured course suitable for competitions.

name: Stezka mužů
description: Men’s Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on August 12, 2026, in Prague 4. This race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social program in the region. Come and race, and enjoy a day full of activity and fun.

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration opens at 17:00 and the run starts at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race follows a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines a passion for sport with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition, but also a community experience that attracts runners from different backgrounds. The event takes place on August 11–13, 2026, and is an important fixture on the region’s running calendar.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Children’s races with timing and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race “Frischlingsrennen” is untimed and open to children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while getting active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also available via RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant numbers are limited to 100; registration and results are available online; the event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated route with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km route also runs along the Elbe and crosses the Albert Bridge to the finish. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team competition for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Sommerlauf is a traditional race in the Harz Mountains, taking place for the 24th time on 8 August 2026. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners can enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course runs along paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, with personalised race numbers for those who register in advance. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalised race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Brohlbachtal-Lauf mit Halbmarathon und Walking
description: The 15th Brohlbachtal Run in Gamlen offers runners and walkers a varied sporting event on a flat course. The event includes races over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.0975 km), as well as walking and Nordic walking distances. Children’s and youth races are also offered. The finish is the same for all events; the exact finish address is shown with RUNME Premium.
course_highlights: Flat course
Events for running, walking and Nordic walking
Distances from 5 km to the half marathon
additional: The finish is the same for all events. Children’s and youth races are also part of the event. The exact finish address is only visible with RUNME Premium. The event takes place at the Gamlen community hall and is known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse running events for all age groups.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place on August 15, 2026, in Dülmen. The event gives runners and walkers the opportunity to participate in 5 km and 10 km races. It takes place at Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event offers a team competition in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. It is family-friendly and open to runners of all abilities.

name: Gederner Stadtlauf
