The Gassenlauf is part of the Westsachsen Laufcup and a meeting place for sport, community, and joie de vivre.

name: Gaisenheimer Rhein-Wein-Lauf
description: The Rhein-Wein-Lauf in Geisenheim is a traditional running event that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various distances, from children’s races to the 10.38 km main race, which takes runners through the picturesque Rheingau region. The races feature varied routes with short and long loops, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners. The event emphasizes a family-friendly atmosphere, with separate age-group rankings and prizes such as medals for children and bottles of wine for age-group winners.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event taking place for the fourth time on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic circuits through the city. The event is aimed both at ambitious runners and at everyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.

name: Lauf mit - Isingen 2026
description: Lauf mit! Isingen 2026 is a cross-country running event in the beautiful countryside around Isingen in the Swabian Alb. The event offers various disciplines, including the Crosslauf-Strong, covering 8.1 km with 200 metres of elevation gain; the Crosslauf-Light, covering 4.8 km with 100 metres of elevation gain; and the Molkekär-Kälble Kidsrun for children. The courses are well marked and take runners through scenic natural surroundings. All participants receive chip timing with an integrated transponder, access to refreshment stations and a certificate. All Kidsrun participants also receive a medal. The event also promotes team spirit with a group competition called the “euroTECH Team Battle”.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay event taking place on September 12, 2026, in Neubrandenburg. The event is hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to cover the marathon distance together as teams. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until approximately 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar and combines a sporting challenge with an experience of nature. Information about the race details and registration is published in good time before the event.

name: Run of Hope
description: The Run of Hope is an annual charity event in Kronach that brings together runners of all ages to fight cancer together. The event offers various distances, including Nordic walking and a fun run, and takes place on the LGS grounds in Kronach. Starting at 12:00, participants can enjoy a sporting yet supportive atmosphere made possible by generous sponsors and dedicated volunteers. The race combines athletic effort with social commitment and invites everyone to make a difference with every step.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. Omas on Tour organises the race as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf on September 12, 2026, in Halberstadt offers varied race distances for all ability levels. The 14 km course leads over the Gläserner Mönch and is a real challenge with its elevation gain and terrain. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km course through the Spiegelsberge is an inviting introduction to competitive running. The youngest participants can take part in a 400 m fun run. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition on September 12, 2026. The route follows some winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, passing clear streams, dark valleys and glistening mountain ridges. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SüHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. Finishers of the longer distances receive ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championship takes place on September 12, 2026, at Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the auspices of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrut Run is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes follow the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths and short climbs. Drinks, fruit and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is a running event organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and takes place on September 12, 2026, in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races run around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 meters to 18.5 kilometers. There are also walking and Nordic walking events over various distances. The start and finish are at the sports field in Niedermeiser, where race materials are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race through Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural trails. The course passes numerous landmarks, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person team relay categories, ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reform School gym, and transport for clothing to the finish is arranged.

name: Den Genfundne Bro Løbet - Cannonball Halvmaraton Løb
Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Run Around Kolovraty is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring municipalities of Uhříněves and Lipany, as well as part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The routes run mainly along tree-lined field, meadow, and forest paths, promising a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held near the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for recreational and elite runners alike to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.

name: Běh na Boží horu
description: The Run up Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to climb 109 steps to Boží hora. Runners set off individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Centre, which has a long tradition and the support of the city. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
description: Běh Kovohutěmi is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. The event features a 12 km main course as well as races for children and young people. It takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. Every year, it attracts many participants and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.

name: Strojařská desítka
location: Správa údržby silnic Zlínského kraje, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy crossroads, Salaš and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Zlín.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen Friendship Run is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko region. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for those who enjoy nature and trail running, while the race atmosphere encourages friendly gatherings among the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with elevation gains of 200 to 300 metres, along forest roads, trails and short stretches of asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Refreshments, baggage storage, toilets, and an awards ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. The field is limited to 500 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all seven mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn. The 9 km route, with 696 metres of elevation gain, runs mostly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. After the race, refreshments and a raffle are available, and public transport can be used to return from the finish.

name: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava
location: Dolní Vítkovice, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with meaningful support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on 12 September 2026, inviting participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskids, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit for completing the course is 19 hours, and aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
5 Aktywna Piątka
description: The 5th edition of the “Aktywna Piątka” run will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. This is a fast road race on a course exactly 5 km long, certified by the Polish Athletic Association, starting at 11:00. The event will also host the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km, and the participant limit is 600. An accompanying Family Run for children and young people up to age 15 will be held over three distances.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners from different regions together. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a long-standing tradition and passion that brings runners together year after year.

name: Bieg przez Most – Białołęcka Triada Biegowa
II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Leszczyński Festiwal Sportu – Półmaraton Leszczyński C&C Partners
Orawski Półmaraton Rysim Tropem
location: Lipnica Wielka, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Razem do Celu
location: Oleszka, Zdzieszowice Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Sieroszewice
location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenau Run in Borchen is a traditional running event organised by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. The race takes place annually and is part of the Hochstift Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also demonstrates social commitment: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an attractive platform.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
Traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake stall. Donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake and fundraising for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant opportunity to run in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approx. 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race offers two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in pleasant temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The ASV Köln Bridge Run Half Marathon is a long-standing 21.1-kilometre race that takes runners through the heart of Cologne, along the Rhine and across six of the city’s most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, with an uplifting atmosphere and music along the route. Alongside the half marathon, shorter distances are available: the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m), for beginners and children. The race combines a sporting challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is ideal for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of Cologne Cathedral
Cross six Cologne bridges, including the Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum forecourt, with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for record lists. The LVN South-East regional championships take place as part of the half marathon. Registration is online, with on-site late registration available on the day of the event. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and recreational runners; the Bambini Run is for children aged 3–6. The start and finish are both at the Chocolate Museum forecourt. The event features music, commentary and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race starts in the Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN South-East regional championships. Online registration is available, including a T-shirt for members. Entry fees vary by category.

name: Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf
description: The Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf is a long-standing running event that has been organised by the Kaltduscher in Erzhausen for almost 30 years. Its aim is to offer an affordable yet high-quality running experience for all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, careful organisation and iconic item of clothing as a souvenir. Despite modern timing and logistics, it retains its original spirit and strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 6.4 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and iconic item of clothing
Charity run and community activities
additional: The event offers an iconic item of clothing (KKK) as a finisher’s souvenir, redesigned each year. The organisers take inspiration from major city marathons while keeping entry fees low. Long-standing sponsors support the event and help ensure it is delivered to a high standard. Iconic item of clothing, medals, modern logistics, online registration

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering a range of running and walking distances for all age groups. The course follows paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt, passing the park’s ponds. The start and finish are beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte. Alongside the sporting competition, there are categories for Bambini, youth, the fun run and the 10 km Sparkasse Run, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly, and all participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark on paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt
Start and finish beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte
Course runs alongside the park’s ponds
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start. All Bambini race participants receive a medal. All participants can print their certificates online. Age-group categories are offered, with awards for the largest groups (schools and clubs) and the fastest Hattingen runners. Various running distances, online registration, supporters from the sports and business sectors.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT
location: Opernplatz, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
description: The LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT charity run is a well-established sporting and community event in Frankfurt am Main. Recreational runners, elite athletes and celebrities compete together on a circuit through downtown Frankfurt. Alongside the sporting competition, fundraising and the joy of working together for a good cause are central to the event. The run offers five different distances for all age groups, from the Bambini run to the 10-kilometer run, with the start and finish at Opernplatz.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Frankfurt
5-kilometer circuit; the 10-kilometer run covers two laps
Water stations along the course provided by Frankfurter Laufshop
additional: Race numbers with electronic timing. Race-number pickup at Opernplatz on 12.09.2026 from 13:00 to 16:00 and on race day at various times depending on the race. The races take place one after another, each with its own timing, starting signal and finish. Travel by U-Bahn to Alte Oper station or use the Alte Oper car park; parking is limited. Various race distances; registration until 01.09.2026; refreshments along the course; no showers; late registration available.

name: Maiwaldlauf
description: The Maiwaldlauf in Rheinau-Freistett is a traditional community race organized by SV Freistett. The event offers runners and walkers an attractive route through nature around the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion. The race is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie and is open to recreational athletes of all ages. Its friendly atmosphere and well-organized proceedings make the Maiwaldlauf a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the Maiwald forest and surrounding countryside
Start and finish at the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion
Part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie
additional: The Maiwaldlauf includes various distances, including a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and walking. Detailed course maps and information about each route are available on the website. The event is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie. It is organized by the Breitensport department of SV Freistett, with contacts including Alexander Dahlke and Regina Huber. The event takes place in September, when average temperatures are around 19°C, and offers Nordic walking and hiking as well as running events.

name: Nibelungenlauf
description: The Nibelungenlauf in Worms is a long-established running event held annually on the second Sunday in September. The event offers a varied programme of races over different distances, set within a cultural programme on the banks of the Rhine near the Hagen Monument and Kriemhild’s Rose Garden. Since 2004, more than 44,000 participants from many nations have taken part, underscoring the event’s popularity and international character. The race welcomes beginners and professionals alike and creates a special running experience in the Nibelungen city.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the newly developed Rhine promenade, close to the Hagen Monument and Kriemhild’s Rose Garden
Three out-and-back courses with clear course markings: half marathon (blue), 10 km (red) and 5 km (green)
Run through the historic Nibelungen city of Worms, with enthusiastic spectators and a cultural programme
additional: The event begins on Saturday with various activities and concludes on Sunday with the races and awards ceremony at the Hagen Monument. There is a team classification, and participants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Event shirts and hoodies can be ordered during registration. The event often sells out before the registration deadline. Online registration is available; the deadline is September 6, 2026. Team registration and event shirts are also available. The start and finish are at the Nibelungenlauf Arena on the Rhine.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Seewooglauf
description: The Seewooglauf in Ramstein-Miesenbach is organized by FV Olympia Ramstein and offers 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 5 km walking event. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Ramstein and offers a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km race courses
5 km walking course
Venue: Reichswaldsporthalle in Ramstein-Miesenbach
additional: Entry fees from €7, late registration available up to 30 minutes before the start, results online, small surprises for the children’s races

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run on 13 September 2026 in Zeitlarn is a community event combining running, celebration and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn’s farm and offers runs for all ages, along with a colourful festival featuring lots of attractions for children. Alongside the sporting experience, the event focuses on supporting the education project in Rabuor, Kenya. Food and drinks will be available, and there will be a range of entertainment, including a children’s train, face painting and vehicle displays.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children, including a children’s train and face painting
Vehicle displays by the Neutraubling Water Rescue Service, Laub Volunteer Fire Brigade and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased for €20 on race day after ordering through the online registration. Runs are available for different age groups and disciplines, including a 400 m toddlers’ farm run, a 1.5 km children’s run, a 5 km run, a 10 km run and 5 km Nordic walking. The event kicks off with a big party from 11:00 a.m. and offers a wide range of food and a colourful programme of activities. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children’s programme, vehicle display, donations to the education project in Kenya

name: TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. - Wuzzelauf Altenhain
description: The Wuzzelauf Altenhain is an annual charity run held since 2008 and organized by TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. It continues a local tradition in which residents of the Main-Taunus district referred to one another by nicknames, especially “Wuzze” for people from Altenhain. The race combines sporting commitment with regional history and a sense of community. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages to take part.
course_highlights: Traditional connection to the region’s nickname culture
Run through the community of Altenhain in the Main-Taunus district
Charity event with local ties
additional: The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in September. Proceeds benefit various charitable causes, including support for people with disabilities in the Rhine-Main region. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all age groups. The race runs through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. September weather is typically mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
1 km and 10 km distances
Natural setting and varied course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, where typical weather is around 19 °C with cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: Wehratallauf
price_range: Hauptlauf 15 €, Nordic Walking 10 €, Schülerlauf kostenlos, Kindertallauf kostenlos

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld 15,- €, davon 1,- € zugunsten der Kinderkrebshilfe und 0,50 € DLV-Verbandsabgabe

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld 10,- €, wird zu 100% an den Förderverein für Krebskranke Kinder gespendet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld 5,- €, davon 1,- € zugunsten der Kinderkrebshilfe und 0,50 € DLV-Verbandsabgabe

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kein Startgeld, nur mit Online-Anmeldung möglich, keine Nachmeldung

description: The Wehratallauf is a long-standing running event held every September in Wehr since 1990. It offers various races for all age groups, including a 10.2 km main race, 8.6 km Nordic walking, a 2.87 km schoolchildren’s race and a 750 m children’s race. The courses run directly past the Frankenmatt Stadium and through the surrounding area. The event has a particular charitable focus, with part of the entry fees donated to the Förderverein für krebskranke Kinder Freiburg e.V.
course_highlights: 10.2 km main race through the area around Frankenmatt Stadium
8.6 km Nordic walking course
2.87 km schoolchildren’s race and 750 m children’s race
additional: Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the respective start (except for the children’s race) for an additional fee of €5. Electronic timing uses transponders integrated into the bib numbers. Changing and shower facilities are available. There is a team competition and special prizes for clubs with the most participants. Parking is limited, particularly on Industriestraße. The event takes place on 13 September 2026, with online registration, transponder bib numbers, prizes for the fastest runners and course-record prizes. Donations are also collected for children with cancer.

name: Wemdinger Stadtlauf
description: The Wemding City Run invites runners of all ages to explore Wemding’s historic old town and the scenic countryside on the edge of the Ries. A special highlight is the panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, combining sporting challenges with impressive views. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. Timing is handled electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and an awards ceremony takes place on the stage at the market square.
course_highlights: Run through Wemding’s historic old town
Panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, with views across the Ries
Start and finish at the market square in the town centre
additional: Race-pack collection and late entries are available on the event day until 30 minutes before each start at the race office in the Geopark Information Centre at the market square. The children’s run has no timing or results list; all children’s and school races receive medals. Timing for the other races is handled using transponders in the race bibs. Parking is available at Johannisweiher, with access via Wolferstädter Straße. Various race distances, medals, non-cash prizes, group prizes, children’s and school races, group training before the event.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a varied sporting event with a family-festival atmosphere, taking place on September 13, 2026. Distances range from a marathon to short races for children, including a Flexi Marathon where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz, and alongside the race programme the event features a lively supporting programme with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and stalls. The event particularly encourages children and young people to take part through a school competition. Surrounding streets are closed during the races, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: The marathon course is completed four times, and the half-marathon course twice
Flexi Marathon with an individually chosen distance and a certificate for the distance completed
Start and finish area on Breteuilplatz; streets are closed during the races
additional: The marathon traditionally starts as the first event of the day. Free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center. Registration is open until September 10, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The varied supporting programme includes a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and sponsor stalls. The schools with the most participants receive awards. Registration is open until September 10. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz; free parking, changing rooms and showers are available. Support is provided for young runners and company relay teams.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in the north of Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for youth, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes pass around Spiegelsee and by sights such as the New Palace and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments for participants, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen takes place on September 13, 2026, and offers runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are on Bremen’s Market Square. The course passes well-known sights such as Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron-Park, the University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and ends with a run through Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK Half Marathon, a HIRSCH 10 km race and an AOK children’s race. The event is aimed at beginners and experienced runners alike and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg takes place on September 13, 2026, and offers a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports facility on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main 10-mile race, there are also 5 km races and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting provides ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.

name: Bitburger Stadtlauf
description: The Bitburger City Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bitburg and offers an inclusive running event where recreational runners, people with disabilities, and competitive athletes can take part together. The event grew out of a desire for a great running event in Bitburg and promotes sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere. The start and finish are at St. Martin School, Kölner Straße 14. The event is part of the CITY SPORT Trier event calendar and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Brachter Depotlauf
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided cross-country run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, with different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, 14 km, a 5 km beginner run, a children’s run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event emphasizes experiencing nature and social commitment: participation in the children’s run is free, and a starting donation will be collected on the day of the event. The runs are organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht and offer a varied route in a natural setting.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event that combines running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes pass through the Deisterhölle, including a continuous 200-meter elevation gain, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another, and offers aid stations, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony in addition to the sporting challenge.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
description: The Dübener Heide Run is a traditional forest race held at the scenic Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organized by SV Bad Düben and offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics structure for northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.

name: ebm-papst Marathon
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a long-standing running event taking place for the 29th time on September 12 and 13, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike and inline skating events, as well as children’s races and Nordic walking. The course winds through the region’s scenic landscape and offers a varied experience for runners of all ability levels. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied program of entertainment, childcare and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Community and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend an enjoyable day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to get active together.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good training run for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and excellent refreshments await participants after the race. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sport- und Kulturhalle Garbenteich.

name: Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf
description: The Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf is a challenging mountain race that runs from Sägwasenplatz in Bad Herrenalb to the Hahnenfalzhütte. The course covers 6 kilometers with an elevation gain of 519 meters and includes steep ramps and gravel paths. The race is a traditional event organized by Skizunft Bad Herrenalb and offers runners a challenging and scenic route in the heights above the source of the Alb. The event combines a sporting challenge with a sociable hut festival at the Hahnenfalzhütte.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a traditional race in the Holzland region near Hermsdorf, held every year on the second Saturday in September. Starting in 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), giving the courses international recognition and making runners’ performances visible worldwide. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 11 km and a half marathon, through the beautiful natural landscape of the Holzland. The race welcomes both ambitious trail runners and recreational runners and offers a special atmosphere in the region.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser
description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sand paths and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional competitions, including the Bezirksrangliste Dresden, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also offers an official walking competition recognized by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which encourages community and team spirit.

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
description: The Miltenberg District Running Day on September 13, 2026, offers a variety of races for different age and ability groups. The routes run through the Elsenfeld State Forest and along the former Spessart steam railway line, with scenic and mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are honored with prizes in kind. The event is ideal for runners looking for a well-organized race in a natural setting.

name: Run for life
description: Run for Life is a charity race established in 2001 in support of Münchner Aids-Hilfe e.V. The 26th edition of this DLV-approved public race will take place on September 13, 2026. The race starts at 2:00 p.m. on the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and follows a familiar route through the English Garden. The event is held under the patronage of Munich Mayor Dominik Krause and combines athletic commitment with social engagement.

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat 7.2-kilometer course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suitable for both intensive running training and a fast race. Participants can enjoy moving through the urban landscape and become part of a dynamic event.

name: Volkslauf TSV Adendorf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
description: The Zeuthen Jedermannslauf is a popular community run held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the forest promenade.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, along singletrack trails and forest roads, and across meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. The event also supports a good cause, with part of the entry fees donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.

name: Airborne Freedom Run
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km

name: Stratenloop Sevenum
location: Sevenum, Horst aan de Maas, Limburg, Netherlands

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, Jihočeský
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each edition supports the charity Centrum Bazalka, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, there is a varied program, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the inaugural edition of the half marathon, held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants can enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field paths and forest trails, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-funded by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest, and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and young people, who can enter for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal, and race photos. Registration opens at 9:00, and the start is scheduled by 9:45. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes participant safety and fitness to compete; runners take part at their own risk.

name: Králický Lískovec
description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec hill and its vicinity in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and prizes are awarded to winners in each category. Registration is available on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořín Cross is a trail race held amid the picturesque scenery of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, which pass through romantic ravines and by unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, which provides facilities including refreshments and a children’s corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.

name: Hostivařská 15°
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič River, with mostly forest trails and very little asphalt. There is no timing equipment at the start; the winner is the runner who estimates their time most accurately. The atmosphere is outdoorsy and brewery-themed, and the event is suitable for all ages, including children.

name: 4Drun
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two 5 km laps, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Center for Social Activity and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants can take part in competitive racing, training sessions, and qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at automotive enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-on-one training with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are charity races organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a variety of distances, from short routes for children to challenging mountain courses. Runners can enjoy scenic views of the Beskids, starting either in the center of Wisła or on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes pass notable landmarks such as Soszów Wielki, the Soszów Mountain Shelter, and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the character of the Beskids. This event is for mountain-running enthusiasts who value variety and the beauty of the natural landscape.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main thoroughfares, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of Ojców National Park. The race route follows scenic paths and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to enjoy a sense of adventure and the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and a range of activities, including games for children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Nowy Tomyśl County Grand Prix series of running events. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the Northern Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses that give the race its distinctive character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all abilities, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as a children’s race—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It is not only a sporting event, but also a journey through the beautiful corners of the coast and an opportunity to connect with nature.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, guaranteeing a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon course winds through picturesque fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also offers races for children and youth. The organizers look after participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on the scenic trails of the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing together the local running community. This event has a well-established tradition and attracts both amateur and experienced runners.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów on the Run is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, both running around the reservoir in multiple laps and finishing on the reservoir grounds. The event promotes physical activity, community, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The race is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race.

name: 32. Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Przewodniczącego Rady Miejskiej
Biegaj razem z nami

location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

XII Bieg Marchewkowy
