location: Łagiewniki, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bedburger Citylauf 2026
description: The GVG Citylauf Bedburg takes place on September 13, 2026, in the town center of Bedburg. The races run through the traffic-free town center, with the start and finish on the market square in front of the town hall. Various distances are offered, from a 300-meter children’s race to the 10 km main race, as well as relay events. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a great opportunity to experience Bedburg in motion.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in front of the town hall
Routes run through Bedburg’s traffic-free town center
The 10 km main race consists of five laps through the town center
additional: Late registration is possible on race day up to one hour before the respective start, with a €3.00 late-registration fee (except for the Bambini race, which is free to enter). Headphones, MP3 players, jogging strollers, and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Multiple race distances; registration online and on site up to one hour before the start; no dogs or headphones on the course.

name: Internationaler Hugenottenlauf
description: The 49th Hugenottenlauf in Neu-Isenburg takes place on September 20, 2026, and invites runners of all ages to enjoy a sporting and community experience. The event offers various distances through the city, suitable for different ability levels. Music, refreshments, and professional timing contribute to a pleasant atmosphere. The event is part of the Main-Lauf-Cup and offers age-group categories in accordance with DLO.
course_highlights: Various distances: 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 2.95 km schoolchildren’s race
Start and finish in Neu-Isenburg; course maps are available
Music along the course creates a lively atmosphere
additional: Age-group categories in accordance with DLO, timing, race number collection, changing rooms and showers, valuables deposit, awards ceremony, certificates and results lists, raffle, refreshments, medical services, photos, Main-Lauf-Cup, parking and public transport are organised. Various race distances, registration by direct debit authorisation, family entertainment programme, courses are well marked.

name: Stadtlauf Erding 2026
description: The Erding City Run is a long-standing running event for runners of all ages. A range of distances is offered, including children’s races, a 5 km run and a 10 km run through the beautiful town of Erding. The event embraces inclusion and features special classifications, for example for children from St. Nikolaus School. It is organised by the Trisport Erding club and is a popular sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate distances of approximately 0.8 km to 2.5 km
Stadtwerke Run over 5 km and 10 km through Erding city centre
Inclusive classification for children from St. Nikolaus School
additional: The Erding City Run offers special children’s races with different distances for each age group. There is a separate 0.8 km classification for children from St. Nikolaus School. The event emphasises inclusion and is open to runners of all ages. Running routes, registration, results, photos, road closures

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km, 10 km und Walking € 8,– bis zum 19.09.2026

description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event offering various distances. It starts and finishes in Aerzen. Events include 5 km and 10 km fun runs, a 5 km company and team run, a 1.8 km schoolchildren’s run, and a free children’s run. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony. The races are scored according to DLV rules, and participants can win prizes and enter a raffle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km fun runs, plus a 5 km company and team run
1.8 km schoolchildren’s run and free children’s run
additional: Late registration is available on September 20, 2026, from 9:00–9:45 a.m.; for the schoolchildren’s run, until 11:45 a.m. Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 1:30 p.m., with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit. Events for children and young people. Registration opens on August 1, 2026; late registration is available on the day of the event. Scoring according to DLV rules, prizes and certificates, company and team run, parking at the event venue.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on 20 September 2026 in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. laufen.de members can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” offer. The course is officially measured and suitable for record purposes.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C, with mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity initiative in sport and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are usually cloudy. Discounted registration is available through laufen.de; the event supports charitable causes. Ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: Herbstlauf und 29. Wandertag Fleckenberg
location: Sportplatz auf der Latroper Straße, Fleckenberg, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 39th Autumn Run and Hiking Day in Fleckenberg takes place on September 20, 2026, at the sports field on Latroper Straße. The event is a scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup and features a scenic 15 km loop with varied terrain. The route follows forest paths, a paved climb, and some rocky sections, making well-cushioned running shoes ideal. Changing rooms and showers are available, as are food and drink sales. After the race, an awards ceremony will be held, with certificates and trophies.
course_highlights: 15 km loop starting at the sports field, elevation 360 m
Varied route with a paved climb, firm forest paths, and some rocky terrain
The return route follows the final kilometres of the Rothaarsteig Marathon
additional: Indoor changing rooms and showers are available. A wide selection of food and drinks will be on sale. The awards ceremony begins at approximately 12 noon, with awards for the children’s and youth races. Every participant receives a certificate; the fastest runner receives a trophy. Scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup; start and finish at the sports field on Latroper Straße; indoor changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and certificates for all finishers.

name: Laacher See Naturlauf mit 21. VR Bank Cup
location: Maria Laach, Verbandsgemeinde Mendig, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany
description: The Laacher See Naturlauf with the 21st VR Bank Cup is a traditional fun run held annually in Maria Laach by the Laufgemeinschaft Laacher See e.V. The race takes place on 20 September 2026 and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the scenic route around Lake Laach. The event is part of an active club community that also offers running courses and training groups for beginners and those returning to running. LG Laacher See looks forward to welcoming runners for a sporting and community-minded experience.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Laach
Nature-rich course with panoramic views of the volcano
Suitable for beginners and experienced runners
additional: The club offers a running course, “From 0 to Around Lake Laach,” for beginners and those returning to running. It starts in spring and concludes with participation in the Laacher See Naturlauf in September. Regular group runs take place on various days of the week, with groups organised by ability level. Club membership is not required to take part in the running course. Distances: 200 m, 8.5 km; no aid station on the course; mindfulness exercises before the start; an environmentally friendly event subject to strict environmental requirements.

name: Lauf Rund um den Fühlinger See
location: Fühlinger See, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 15€ für 10 km und 5 km, 10€ für Jugend, Kinder kostenfrei, Nachmeldung 5€
description: The Rund um den Fühlinger See Run is a traditional road race in Cologne, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers a wide range of distances for runners of all ages: a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and a 1 km children’s run. The courses loop around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships and are measured by the DLV, allowing performances to qualify for rankings. The race is an ideal test ahead of the Generali Cologne Marathon and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, attractive medals, and non-cash prizes for age-group participants.
course_highlights: Course loops around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships
Courses measured by the DLV and accompanied by a course certificate
Road-race routes with little traffic in Cologne-Fühlingen
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the race number, included in the entry fee. Late entries are possible online up to 30 minutes before the start (adults: €5; children/youth: free). Race packets will be distributed on race day from 08:45 at the boathouse on Fühlinger See. Changing rooms and showers are available in the boathouse. Non-cash prizes are awarded to the first three in each age group, and attractive medals to the first three finishers in each race. Measured courses, DLV-measured courses, start times from 09:30, free parking, changing rooms and showers at the Fühlinger See boathouse, music and refreshments on site.

name: Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf = Mehr als eine Herausforderung
description: The 38th Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf, under the motto “More than a challenge,” takes place on September 20, 2026, in Möhnesee-Günne. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 30 km, and challenges participants with a demanding course. The race is known for its varied scenery and the special atmosphere at Möhnesee. Runners can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km and 30 km race distances
Venue in Möhnesee-Günne, surrounded by scenic countryside
Typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies
additional: The race takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026. Average temperatures are around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night. Approximately 45 mm of precipitation is expected, with mostly cloudy skies. The race is held in September, with typical temperatures around 19 °C; checking with the organizer for further details before registering is recommended.

name: Panoramalauf Kriegsheim
description: The Panoramalauf Kriegsheim is a running event in Kriegsheim organized by LLG Wonnegau. It is part of the club’s summer running calendar and offers runners an attractive route through the scenic surrounding area. LLG Wonnegau is an active club that organizes other running and sporting events in the region in addition to the Panoramalauf. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and promotes a sense of community in the sport.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque countryside around Kriegsheim
Part of LLG Wonnegau’s summer running calendar
Attractive route suitable for different ability levels
additional: LLG Wonnegau offers other running events and training sessions. The club office is at Silvanerstr. 4, Monsheim. The pages reviewed provide no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers, or registration for the Panoramalauf Kriegsheim. Start times: 9:45 a.m. for Bambini; 10:00 a.m. for the main race, 5 km, and walking. Late registration is possible on the event day until one hour before the start. The event is scheduled to take place in all weather; it may be canceled in the event of severe weather.

name: Seidenraupen Cross
location: Hülser Bruch, Krefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Seidenraupen Cross in Krefeld is one of the most interesting cross-country races in North Rhine-Westphalia, organised in a friendly, family atmosphere. Runners can look forward to challenging 6.5 km and 16 km courses through Krefeld’s largest nature reserve, the Hülser Bruch, with tough climbs, fast descents and beautiful natural scenery. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s races at the Hülser district sports complex. The event offers a varied, nature-filled running experience for beginners and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Run through the Hülser Bruch nature reserve, with three hills
Tough climbs and fast descents
Children’s races on a variety of surfaces (grass, sand pits and cinder track)
additional: The start for hikers, walkers and Nordic walkers is at 10 a.m. Registration is open until one hour before the race. The course distances are approximately 6.5 km and 16 km, and can also be covered on foot. The children’s races take place at the sports complex on Hölschen Dyk. The event supports social projects every year. Trail and cross-country sections; routes on forest and hiking trails; start and finish at the Hölschen Dyk sports ground; registration until one hour before the race.

name: Kassel Marathon
description: The Kassel Marathon is the largest sporting event in North Hesse and takes place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at the Auestadion Kassel. The event offers a variety of races, including a marathon, half marathon, power walking, relay, corporate run, and children’s races. The marathon course has 200 meters of elevation gain and runs through the city of Kassel. Participants receive a finisher’s medal and a free finisher shirt. Runners are supported by medical care from the German Red Cross and a post-race massage service.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon
description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event that takes runners through the Wandsbek district and as far north as Berne subway station. The course then heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records that underscore the race’s high quality and athletic demands. Participants can download the course GPX track to prepare optimally.

name: 21. Fun-Run
description: The 21st Maisel’s FunRun takes place on 10 May 2026 in Bayreuth and is a fixture on the regional running calendar. The event attracts over 4,000 running enthusiasts every year, from beginners to ambitious athletes. Various race distances are offered for adults, including a half marathon, quarter marathon and 5 km run, as well as several children’s races with no entry fee. The finish line leads directly onto the Maisel’s Weissbierfest festival grounds, where runners can celebrate with live music and freshly tapped Maisel’s Weisse. The varied, mostly flat course passes some of Bayreuth’s most beautiful spots and creates a great race-day atmosphere.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorf Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program of activities that includes face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple loops accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ’95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.

name: Gau-Algesheimer Alagastaluf
description: The Gau-Algesheim Alagastaluf is a traditional fun run that has been held in Gau-Algesheim since the 1980s. The event follows country paths and roads around Binger Straße and through the old town of Gau-Algesheim. It offers a sporting challenge in beautiful autumn surroundings and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. - Athletics Department and takes place every year in autumn.

name: Insellauf mit HM, 10km, 3x7km Staffel und Kinderläufen
description: The Reichenau Island Run is a traditional running event held annually in September on Reichenau Island. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 3 × 7 km relay, and children’s and youth races. The routes follow varied and scenic paths around the island. The Island Run attracts numerous runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of running options.

name: Karlsfelder Seelauf
description: The Karlsfeld Lake Run is a long-standing running event held at Lake Karlsfeld. The race offers an attractive route in a natural setting and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld and will take place for the 47th time in 2026. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf takes place on September 20, 2026, and takes runners through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural setting. The routes pass through fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe
description: The Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe on September 20, 2026, offers a varied running experience with a marathon, half marathon, team marathon, health run, inclusion run, and mini-marathon for children. The flat, fast course leads through the city center, past Karlsruhe Palace and through Citypark Ost, finishing with an atmospheric run into the Carl-Kaufmann-Stadion. A special feature is the option to be accompanied by Marathon Angels for the final 4 kilometers, making the race a shared experience. Attractive shorter distances for beginners and families put the fun of running first.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging fundraising run through Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course by running, Nordic walking, or hiking; it ends at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The run supports inclusive activities for children and young people in the Goslar district, combining a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can look forward to a festive after-race event with music, refreshments, and an awards ceremony.

name: CEB-Saarwiesenlauf
description: The CEB Saarwiesenlauf is a running event in Hilbringen near Merzig, organised by Christian Adult Education in Hilbringen together with Sparkasse Merzig-Wadern and Merzig Athletics Club. Despite difficult weather conditions, almost 500 runners and 16 relay teams took part in an earlier edition, reflecting strong community involvement. The race offers various distances and allows both individual and relay entries, making it appealing to runners of all abilities.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event taking place on September 20, 2026, in downtown Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km and 10 km races. The course follows closed circuit routes through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event includes individual and team competitions and takes place in all weather.

name: EDITH LÜCKE-Frauenlauf TRIER
description: The EDITH LÜCKE Women’s Run in Trier is a special event, holding its sixth edition on 20 September 2026. The 5-kilometre course is a sightseeing tour through Trier’s Roman history, starting in front of the Imperial Baths and finishing in style at the Amphitheatre. The run is open to women and girls aged 12 and over, with a focus on enjoying exercise together, regardless of ability level. After the run, all participants can celebrate the day with a glass of sparkling wine from a local winery.

name: Eltviller Familienlauf 2026
description: The Eltville Family Run on September 20, 2026, offers a variety of race distances for all age groups, from Bambini races to a 10 km run. The course is mainly on paved roads with flat cobblestones and includes a short, gently uphill section. The event is family-friendly and allows both individual and team registrations. Race packets can be collected the day before or on race day. Bag drop and toilets are available at the start and finish areas. Young people up to the age of 16 can take part in the paid races for free, but registration is required.

name: Fürst Carl Seenlandmarathon
description: The Fürst Carl Seenland Marathon takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026, in Pleinfeld on Lake Brombach. The event offers a range of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, fun run, schoolchildren’s run and children’s run, on paved and partly asphalted paths. The marathon and half-marathon distances are officially certified by the DLV. The event welcomes runners of all ages and offers a varied program with accompanying events and refreshments.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied routes for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish at the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turnaround point at Grebin Mill, which makes the course unique. Registration is via the Davengo platform.

name: Halbmarathon Altötting
description: The Altötting Half Marathon on 20 September 2026 is one of the fastest nature runs in the world and was awarded 5 stars by European Athletics. The course runs 80% on paved forest paths in the Altötting Forest and is flat, sheltered from the wind, and has little asphalt. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers a 6 km run and a fun run. Free childcare is available for children aged 5 and over, and numerous bands and music along the course create a lively atmosphere.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on September 20, 2026, in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs around Heidebad and offers varied surroundings. Registration is open until the day of the event.

name: Horster Löwenlauf
description: The 2nd Horster Löwenlauf takes place on September 20, 2026, around Schloss Horst in Gelsenkirchen. This sporting event offers a colorful, community atmosphere for all age groups, with refreshments and entertainment in the castle park. Following the great success of the inaugural event, the race is once again being organized as a sporting highlight for the Horst district. The event takes place on World Children’s Day, which is considered a particularly fitting coincidence.

name: Hörnle Berglauf Bad Kohlgrub
description: The Hörnle Berglauf in Bad Kohlgrub is a traditional mountain race held annually, taking runners up the local Hörnle mountain. The event features a challenging course with impressive views and a sporting test for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race takes place in September and attracts participants from both the region and beyond. The Bad Kohlgrub Ski Club organizes the event with great dedication and provides a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf
description: The IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf takes place annually in Bobingen and is a traditional running event along unique trails and enchanting paths in the forests west of Augsburg. Alongside the sporting competition, the event focuses on supporting a vocational training project at Bobingen Middle School, giving participation a social purpose as well. The event also features a career-orientation rally that offers young people exciting insights into regional vocational training opportunities. The race is part of a vibrant community of dedicated sponsors and volunteers and is always held on the third Sunday in September.

name: Kemmerner Kuckuckslauf
description: The Kemmern Cuckoo Run is a traditional running event in the center of Kemmern, taking place for the 16th time on September 20, 2026. Various races are offered for all age groups, including Bambini, school and youth races, as well as a 4 km fun and corporate run and a 10 km main race. The event is known for fair sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere with plenty of spectators. Food and refreshments for runners are available at the SC Kemmern clubhouse.

name: km von Röthenbach
description: The 10 km von Röthenbach is an event approved by the German Athletics Association, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Röthenbach a.d.Pegnitz. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, including a fast, flat circuit on a course measured by the German Athletics Association. Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race bib, and the event is family-friendly, with races for children and young people. Changing rooms, showers, and medical services are available on site, and the venue is easily accessible by public transport.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf near Hamburg is a long-standing race, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers a range of distances for different age groups and ability levels, including runs from 1.5 km to 9 km and a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Wentorfer Lohe conservation area and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On race day, there is a tent village, with the start and finish at the dog meadow, where participants can collect their race numbers and enjoy the event.

name: Memminger Altstadtlauf
description: The Memmingen Old Town Run is a traditional race through Memmingen’s historic old town. The course is a flat, paved circuit approximately 1 km long that winds through the picturesque old town. The event is open to club runners, professionals, and recreational runners, and features professional transponder timing. The start and finish are on the market square, where the awards ceremony also takes place. All participants receive a high-quality towel as a keepsake.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, OT Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organised by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run and youth and beginner courses to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker can find a suitable route. The routes are marked, with refreshment stations on routes of 8 km and longer. The event offers timing using a bib-chip transponder and medical support. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee-and-cake buffet.

name: Sonneberger Spielzeuglauf
description: The 6th Sonneberg Toy Run and 2nd Company Run will take place on September 20, 2026, in Sonneberg. The event offers several race distances, including the main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, schoolchildren’s race, and Bambini run. All races start at the same time and finish together. In addition to individual rankings, there is a special company ranking for the company with the most participants and the most creative company, as well as an award for the club with the most participants. The Nordic walking race is timed, but there is no awards ceremony. The event is family-friendly and organized by Leichtathletik Sonneberg e. V.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26
description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a long-standing race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km. The courses run through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Tübinger Erbe-Lauf
description: The Tübinger Erbe-Lauf is a varied running event in Tübingen’s historic Old Town, taking place on September 20, 2026. The main course covers 10 kilometers, split into four laps through the Old Town and the Umbrian-Provençal Market. In addition to the main race, other competitions include the 5K, Team Challenge, Junior Run, and BG Handbike Challenge. The event offers personal timing, an exclusive finisher medal, and a unique atmosphere in this picturesque city. The entry fee includes breathable running socks made from organic cotton for all participants.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including a section around the lake, and has a family-friendly atmosphere with plenty of volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organization and offers the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilsche FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually at the Wilsche sports field in Gifhorn since 2005. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing race over a 10 km distance. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is an established part of the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers routes of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program that includes face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and places great emphasis on a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

name: Trail Marathon Heidelberg
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Trail Marathon Heidelberg is one of Germany’s most extraordinary trail running events and takes place on September 20, 2026. Under the motto “HERRLICH.HÖHER.HÄRTER” (Wonderful. Higher. Harder.), the race offers challenging and varied courses with plenty of trails, steep climbs and impressive views. The event features three distances: the Base Trail (20 km), the Half Trail (30 km) and the Heart Core Trail (45 km), with more than 2,000 metres of elevation gain. The course passes, among other places, the Thingstätte, the Philosophenweg, the Heiligenberg and the Königstuhl, offering a unique atmosphere for trail runners of all abilities.

name: NN Dam tot Damloop 2026

price_tiers.distance: The Virtual 40th NN Dam tot Damloop

description: The NN Dam tot Damloop is the Netherlands’ biggest running festival, starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The 10 English Miles route takes you through the unique IJ Tunnel and past lively music and cheering crowds in Amsterdam-Noord. In 2026, the event celebrates its 40th edition with a festive programme and an unforgettable finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam. After the finish, you can enjoy the celebrations at the Dam tot Dam Park during the Finish Festival.
course_highlights: Start on Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam
Run through the IJ Tunnel between the city centre and Amsterdam-Noord
Finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam, with a street party on Zuiddijk
additional: Registration opens in stages: Le Champion members can register from 6 April through 17 April, after which general registration opens on 18 April. A Premium Business Package is available for teams. The Business Run is popular with companies, with more than 25,000 participants. A free BackStory race bib is available. After the finish, there is a Finish Festival at the Dam tot Dam Park. Participants can choose from several distances, virtual options and special anniversary activities. The event has a festive, supportive atmosphere, with music and merchandise available.

name: StoneCityRun
description: The DYKA StoneCityRun is an atmospheric running event in Steenwijk, taking place on 20 September 2026. Participants run along the historic ramparts, through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk, with plenty of spectators and entertainment along the course. There are various distances for all ages and abilities, including special events such as the G-Run for people with disabilities and a walking tour. The event celebrates inclusivity and a friendly atmosphere, with the start at Theater de Meenthe and the finish at the Markt.
course_highlights: Run along Steenwijk’s historic ramparts
Through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk
Finish at the atmospheric Markt in Steenwijk
additional: After registration closes, it is possible to collect a blank bib at the start location, De Meenthe, from 13:00 on 20 September, without timekeeping. Children under 6 must be accompanied, and those accompanying children or people with disabilities may participate for free. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start location, and parking is available. The rollator run is specifically for older people, and the G-Run is inclusive, with support and assistive aids permitted. Participants can choose from various distances, including 0.6 km, 1.5 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event also offers walks and special runs for people with disabilities, as well as parking, changing rooms and showers. Registration closes on 1 September 2026.

name: LOS Dokkum
distance_verbose: 50 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 13.4 km, 6.7 km
organizer: Stichting Promotie Dokkum en stichting Ik ben Wil
description: LOS Dokkum is a unique 12-hour running and walking event in Tolhuispark in Dokkum. Every hour, the starting signal sounds for a 6.7-kilometre running lap or a 3.9-kilometre walking lap. The challenge is to see how long you can keep going and answer the same question each time: shall I do one more lap? The event combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run
description: The Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run is an atmospheric running event in the green surroundings of the Gravenallee in Almelo. The event offers distances for both beginner and experienced runners, including a new 2-kilometre youth and beginners’ run. The start and finish are at the ice rink opposite the sports park, with a course along wide avenues through a popular, welcoming setting. It promises to be a sporty and enjoyable day for participants, supporters and visitors of all ages.

name: Freedom Run - Libertyloop
description: Freedom Run - Liberty Loop is a recreational race held in Geldrop to celebrate 80 years of liberation. The race offers four running distances named after well-known veterans, as well as a half marathon. There is also a free Kids Run for primary school children and various walking routes past war monuments and streets named after resistance fighters. The event emphasizes celebrating freedom together and offers a unique combination of sport and history.

name: Rondjes van Pijn
description: Rondjes van Pijn is an endurance run organized by IJsvereniging Pijnacker, held on Sunday, September 20, 2026, at the Tinteltent in Pijnacker. The race consists of repeated 4.2-kilometer laps, with a new lap starting every half hour and a maximum of ten laps. Participants can set their own pace, with a faster lap giving them more rest time before the next start. The event is aimed at both young people and adults and emphasizes endurance over speed.

name: Maasheggenloop
description: The Maasheggenloop, organised by Atletiek Vereniging Sporting Boxmeer, takes place on 20 September 2026 in the beautiful Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands. The event offers a suitable distance for every age and ability, from the Bambinoloop for the youngest participants to the Half Marathon for experienced runners. The routes pass through a unique, nature-rich setting. A cash prize is awarded for breaking the course record in the Half Marathon and 10-kilometre races. The atmosphere is sporting and welcoming, with fun keepsakes for all youth participants and trophies for the podium finishers.

name: Molenbroekloop
description: On Sunday 20 September 2026, GAC Gemert is organizing the annual Bouwgroep van Schijndel Molenbroekloop. The race consists of several 2.5-kilometre loops through the Molenbroek neighbourhood, with participants able to choose from distances of 1.1 km (youth), 2.5 km (juniors), 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 10 km. The start and finish are on the GAC Gemert athletics track. Awards will be presented to the top men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races, and to the top boys and girls in the youth races. The organizers support sustainability by using reusable race bibs, which must be returned after the event.

name: Rotterdam Half
description: The Rotterdam Half Marathon takes place on Sunday, 20 September 2026, and starts at 09:00 at the Maassilo in Rotterdam. The 21.1-kilometre route passes through authentic Rotterdam South and by iconic landmarks such as Katendrecht, the SS Rotterdam and the port area, finishing spectacularly inside Rotterdam Ahoy. The course is fast, flat and officially certified, making it ideal for runners looking to set a fast time. After the finish, there will be a festive after-party with a DJ and various facilities for participants and supporters.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: The Misty Lakes Trail is a challenging trail run taking place on Sunday, 20 September 2026, in Gerwen (Nuenen). The routes pass through beautiful forests with numerous small lakes and heathland, with more than 90% of the course on unpaved paths. The trail features short climbs, winding single tracks and an ascent of the ‘Roof of Brabant’, the Gulbergen. The different distances offer a great challenge for every level, with an atmospheric finish area where visitors can cheer on the runners.

name: Mierdentrail
description: The Mierdse Trail offers a unique trail-running experience across a network of scenic singletracks, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The course winds through the wooded area between Hooge Mierde, Lage Mierde and the Belgian town of Poppel, and is almost entirely off-road. It includes technical sections and natural obstacles, making every kilometre challenging and varied. The trail is part of the Brabantse Trailserie and is known for having the most singletrack metres in the series.

name: 1 v.d. 4 loop Zuiderpark
description: The 1 van de 4 circuit is a running race organised by the Hague Road Runners in Zuiderpark in The Hague. The event is part of a circuit featuring several races and celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. It offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for runners of different abilities and ages. The course runs through the beautiful Zuiderpark and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Halve en Kwart Marathon van Cranendonck
Rooise Crosslopen 1e
description: The Rooise Crosslopen 1st is a cross-country race taking place on Sunday, 20 September 2026, in Sint-Oedenrode. The event offers several events for different age groups, including pupils, juniors and seniors, with distances of up to 7.9 km. Pre-registration is available until 19 September 2026. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and abilities and takes place in a natural setting in Brabant.

name: Vooruitgangloop
description: The Vooruitgangloop is a running event held in the beautiful Oude Veerdam recreation area near Zuidland. The first edition is organised by IJsclub Vooruitgang and offers an atmospheric run through a green, natural area. The start and finish are at the ice rink, which is easily accessible by bicycle and public transport. The event is suitable for all ages, with a kids’ run and a 10 km race, and includes a warm-up and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Nispen 'Borteldonk'
description: The BWF Tour of ‘Peet’s Flower Shop’ Borteldonk is a cycling race held on a 4.4-kilometre course in Nispen and Borteldonk. The course consists entirely of paved roads and runs via Zonnelandstraat, Oude Turfvaartsestraat, Vierhoevenstraat and Nispenseweg, with riders going counterclockwise. The start and finish are at Zonnelandstraat 6. The event is organised by Stichting Sportfrinten, and more information is available on its website.

name: Trail Český ráj
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular trail half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves and sandstone cliffs. This race continues the popular ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ, now in its eleventh edition, and offers what is probably the most beautiful trail half-marathon course in the Czech Republic. The start is by Komárov Pond, and the finish is a reward for every runner. The race also offers runners a wide range of services, including refreshments, changing rooms and medical assistance.

name: PoHodová devítka
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held in September after the local festival. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, while children can compete on shorter courses. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, with categories for children and youths. About one third of the route is on asphalt and two thirds on unpaved roads. The race takes place amid normal road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: The Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that runs mostly along forest trails, with one longer climb. The race takes place in the picturesque Capartice area near Plzeň and is part of the Běžec Chodska series. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a natural setting on a more challenging course. It is suitable for runners seeking a trail challenge and the atmosphere of a traditional race.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oaks Avenue Half Marathon is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and welcoming to runners, and the course runs along the scenic Red Oaks Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and excellent race-day conditions.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wrocław. The flat route is on asphalt with sections of compacted gravel and follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a 3-hour time limit and provides hydration points and a recovery meal after the finish.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route. The event is charitable in nature and is coordinated by the Active People Association “Biegnij Oławo” and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the scenic land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. Races take place on September 18–20, 2026, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with demanding climbs and technical descents.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: Prószkowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prószkowie
description: The Piotr Blachucik Prószków Street Race is one of the region’s most atmospheric running events, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Prószków. The race offers a dynamic course and sporting excitement, while children’s races are also held before the main event to promote physical activity from an early age. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners aiming for a result and for anyone looking to spend time actively.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.

location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

location: Jodłów, Międzylesie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

description: De Tien van 't Aogje is a running event in Princenhage, Breda, taking place on 20 September 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, with a fun family run as an additional event. Race numbers are sent in advance by email, and there is an awards ceremony immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. The event attracts many participants and has a maximum capacity for each distance.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races through Princenhage
Awards ceremony immediately after the race at the Haagsemarkt
Fun family run as an additional event
additional: Race numbers are sent by email with additional information. There are two times to collect race numbers. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. There is a maximum number of participants for each distance. Registration for 2025 is closed; advance registration for 2026 is available until 13 September 2026. The event takes place in Princenhage, Breda, and includes several race distances, with awards ceremonies after each race.

name: AOK Firmenlauf in Haslach im Kinzigtal
description: The AOK Haslach im Kinzigtal Company Run is a team event taking place on September 22, 2026, and is part of the BW Running series. The event promotes exercise, team spirit and shared experiences in the workplace. The main race is approximately 5 km long, and there is also a 2 km “Run for Everyone.” After the run, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish, and there are special meeting points for teams to enjoy race day together.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race has a long history and is part of the KRB Chrudim club’s running calendar. It offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test yourself on an interesting course in beautiful surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Balingen
description: The AOK Balingen Company Run is a popular team event taking place on September 24, 2026, at the Marktplatz in Balingen. The course is approximately 5.9 kilometers long and consists of two laps of about 2.9 km each. The run promotes exercise for everyone and inclusion, allowing people with and without disabilities to participate together. After the run, participants can enjoy free refreshments at the finish and a lively awards ceremony with music. The event is a great opportunity to experience team spirit and add physical activity to the working day.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Zlín
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Zlín is a charity running event held on September 24, 2026, at náměstí Míru. The start is at 8:00 p.m., and participants can choose a route to suit them or walk it. Entry packages are available in two options—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Part of the entry fee goes toward helping people with severe visual impairments, underscoring the event’s charitable nature. There is also an accompanying program for all participants.

name: Běh okolo Campusu
organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.
description: The Run Around Campus is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice district. The race features a 5.6 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category. The program also includes a children’s race for children of any age, with the loop length determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering a chance to discover interesting places in Brno.

name: ENTEGA Nightrun
location: Radgelände des Darmstädter Velodroms, Darmstadt, Hesse, Germany
description: The ENTEGA Nightrun on September 25, 2026, is a unique running event on the cycling grounds of the Velodrom in Darmstadt. The course is fully illuminated and offers a varied mix of grass, asphalt, gravel, and hard-packed surfaces. With distances of 1.6 km (students’ run), 2.5 km, 5 km, and 7.5 km, there is something for runners of all ages and ability levels. The special atmosphere at dusk and the energetic presence of fellow runners make this an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Illuminated circuit around the cycling track grounds
Varied surfaces: grass, asphalt, gravel, and hard-packed ground
Atmospheric run at dusk with dazzling lights
additional: Race-number collection on the day of the event from 17:30 in the hall. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Shoes with spikes are not allowed. Water and regional products from Alnatura will be provided. Medical services will be available on the course and at the finish. Parking is available on the tennis grounds next to the event site. Valuables can be handed in at the hall for a fee of €1. No showers are provided. Course on grass, asphalt, and gravel; shoes with spikes not allowed; parking at the TGB tennis grounds; no showers; medical services available.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Students’ Run is a long-standing annual running competition that brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate categories for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place. Registration is through the schools, and late entries are possible on the day of the event. The run takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and encourages young athletes in the region.

name: Zombies are Coming 180km
description: Zombies are Coming is a unique 180-kilometre ultrarun from Amsterdam to Groningen, where participants must maintain a constant speed of 7.5 km/h to finish within 24 hours. Participants carry all their own gear and run without a crew, while being pursued by a ‘zombie horde’ that eliminates them if they fall behind the pace. It is not a race against other runners, but a personal challenge to reach the finish and stay ahead of the zombies.

name: Martini Marathon
description: The Martini Marathon in Groningen is a unique marathon on the athletics track, organised by Groningen Atletiek. The race takes place on Friday evening, 25 September 2026, and offers both a solo marathon of 42,195 metres and a relay for teams of 3 to 5 runners. The relay consists of a 2,195-metre leg and four 10,000-metre legs, guaranteeing a challenging and fast running experience. The atmosphere is friendly, with refreshments along the route and afterwards, and all participants receive a medal. The winners receive the prestigious Martini Trophy.

name: Nedmag Moonlightwalk
description: The Nedmag Moonlightwalk in Veendam is an atmospheric evening walk of approximately 6 kilometers held by moonlight. The event is not a race, but a relaxed walk where participants can enjoy various performances and special experiences along the route. The route is accessible to almost everyone, including wheelchair users, and offers a unique way to experience Veendam. Proceeds from the walk go to charity; this year, the beneficiary is the Margarethe Hardenberg Cultural Centre.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a 5 km night race held in the early evening at the VOLT brewery grounds in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route runs around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women and young people aged 16 and over, as well as children up to 15 years old. The race offers a sporting atmosphere, chip timing and valuable gifts for the first participants to register. The start and finish are at the brewery grounds, where race numbers can also be collected.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
description: The Březinou Run in Polná is a traditional running race organized by Běžecký tým Polná and Běžec Vysočiny z.s. and held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for different age categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 9.5 km race following field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River. The race starts at 17:00, and participants can expect a pleasant atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the top finishers in each category. The race has a long tradition, with more than 39 editions since 1992.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place on 19 September 2026 at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and making a statement for integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, children’s activities and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on fun and community. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children’s activities, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf on September 26, 2026, is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering distances for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural scenery. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses, eligible for rankings
Water stations every 2.5 km
Start and finish area with changing and shower facilities at the sports center
additional: Race packets can be collected at the sports center from 13:00 on race day. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female finishers in the 5 km and 10 km races will receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races will receive a medal. Nordic walking is untimed, with no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-bib collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln. The courses are officially measured. Online registration is open until 24.09.2026; late registration is available on site for a fee. Race packets can be collected from 13:00 on race day. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: Hofheimer Volkslauf
description: The Hofheim Volkslauf is a long-standing running event taking place on September 26, 2026, at Sportpark Hofheim in Lampertheim-Hofheim. It is organized by Turnverein 1896 Hofheim im Ried e.V. and offers runners of all ages a friendly, family atmosphere. The event is known for its good organization and the opportunity to enjoy sport and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Various distances (1 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Running, walking, and Nordic walking events
Venue at Sportpark Hofheim with a flat course
additional: Registration is by submitting a form downloaded as a Word document. Esther Heilmann and Verena Salomon are the contacts for questions; their telephone numbers and email addresses are provided. The website has a contact form for further inquiries. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children’s and youth events. Start times are 15:15 and 15:30. Further details, registration, and the race information are available on the website.

name: Rodheimer Volkslauf

late_fee.price: Nachmeldung möglich am Veranstaltungstag bis 30 Minuten vor Start

description: The Rodheim Fun Run is a family-friendly running event and part of the popular Main-Lauf-Cup series. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports center on the main playing field, creating an appealing stadium atmosphere for sports enthusiasts. The event offers a range of competitions, from a children’s race to a half marathon and 10 km race, suitable for children, fitness enthusiasts, and ambitious runners alike. The awards ceremony is lively, and the event attracts a good turnout.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on the main playing field, with a stadium atmosphere
A variety of distances, from the 0.15 km children’s race to the half marathon and 10 km race
Part of the Main-Lauf-Cup, with scoring races for various age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start. The event includes scoring races in the Main-Lauf-Cup and BBF-Junior Main-Lauf-Cup. The office is open at specific times on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Scenic run, family event, inclusive options, various race distances, on-site registration

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte takes place on September 26, 2026, and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the historic town center, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the 10,000-meter main race, there are other events, including a 5,000-meter race, walking, children’s and Bambini races, and an untimed fun run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main race through the historic town center, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-meter race with a water station halfway along the course
Varied routes featuring asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available at the old double gymnasium at the school center, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The course is varied, with asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video recordings will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school center sports field; registration is online; changing facilities are at the Old Double Gymnasium; children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze relay race has been held in Weeze in mid-September each year since 1985 and has become a popular relay event, with up to 250 teams taking part. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school, and regular relays, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail
Relay event with Bambini, school, and regular relay categories
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: The 40th Weeze relay race will take place on 26 September 2026. The race announcement and registration will follow at the end of July. The event has attracted up to 250 relay teams. The 38th Weeze relay race in 2024 had 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 regular relay teams cross the finish line. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl is a challenging trail-running event in the Chiemgau Alps, with five different distances ranging from 11 to 73 kilometers. The routes pass through impressive mountain scenery, with highlights including ski jumps, the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge, alpine pastures, and Dürrnbachhorn, with breathtaking views all the way to the Wilder Kaiser. The event welcomes trail runners from beginners to professionals, although the longer distances are suitable only for experienced runners. Special routes are available for hikers, and dogs are also welcome on the shorter routes. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with an expo, Kids’ Trail, Community Trail, and a pasta party on the evening before the race.

name: Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a family-friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course starts again every full hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mostly along forest and field paths with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel Ilshofen City Run is a long-standing running event held annually in Ilshofen. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on a varied route through the city. The course is well marked and passes through attractive parts of the city, making the race appealing to both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event on the regional running calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The 49th Ötigheim Autumn Run on September 26, 2026, warmly welcomes running enthusiasts of all ability levels. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, the focus is on enjoying exercise. Children’s and school races are offered, along with officially measured main races over 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km course follows two laps through Ötigheim Forest and promises a beautiful autumn running atmosphere.

name: Benin Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Benin Charity Run is a scenic running event in Hirzweiler, taking place for the 19th time on September 26, 2026. The route offers panoramic views across the Ill Valley and runs mostly along paved farm tracks. The event supports aid projects in Benin, with the proceeds and entry fees going to AG Benin. In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a generous cake buffet, grilled sausages and drinks at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler, followed by the awards ceremony.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on a range of courses of up to 24 km and up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring on September 26, 2026, offers a varied event for different age groups and performance levels. The event includes a 7.5 km main race and a 700 m children’s course. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organized by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on September 26, 2026, and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini run, where fun takes center stage. The event is family-friendly and offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.

name: Durlacher Turmberglauf
description: The Durlach Turmberg Run is a flat, fast 10-kilometer race through the historic old town of Durlach, along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen and back. The race has become a fixture for running enthusiasts from the region and offers an appealing course for ambitious runners. A children’s race also takes place in Durlach Palace Gardens. The event combines athletic competition with social engagement by collecting donations for charitable causes.

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmerting Herbstfest Run takes place at the sports field in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is aimed at children, adults, club runners, recreational runners, and walkers. There are various distances, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5- and 10-kilometer runs, and Nordic walking routes. Its family-friendly, festive atmosphere makes the run a popular meeting place for the local running community.

name: Friedrichshaller Runde
description: The Friedrichshaller Runde is a long-standing running event in Bad Friedrichshall, taking place on September 26, 2026. It is part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup and offers runners an appealing route through the region’s scenic landscape. The event welcomes running enthusiasts of all ability levels and combines a sporting challenge with scenic highlights. It is organized by Stadtmarketing Bad Friedrichshall, also known for other tourism offerings in the region.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied routes for all age groups. The shorter races run through the town center, while the main race follows the scenic Vorbach Valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. A range of race categories, from the mini run to the relay, means there is something for everyone.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course crosses the Montgolfiade grounds and the ski slope, and passes through the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides, and foam. The event features an exciting start show and a unique atmosphere, and has promoted team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, part of a fun-loving group, or with your family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a varied running event with routes for all ages and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which passes through the Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and handicap routes, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event stands out for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, supported by the City of Gera.

name: Kreismeisterschaften Waldlauf (Kreis Ludwigsburg)
