description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race in the beautiful Hochdorf Forest, taking place for the sixth time in 2026. The event offers exciting routes and an unforgettable sporting experience for runners of all ages. The SGV Hochdorf organizing team is also preparing fresh forest-run shirts and informative flyers to support participants. The race takes place on September 26, 2026, and warmly welcomes everyone who loves sport.

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The König Ludwig Lauf - Summer Edition is Bavaria’s most scenic panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. The event offers varied courses from 6 km to 21 km through the picturesque landscape of the Ammergau Alps Nature Park. A free shuttle bus takes participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. Its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized arrangements make the run a special experience.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
description: The Rund um den Grengel Run is a traditional fun run in Engelskirchen, held annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Athletics & Triathlon Department. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, schoolchildren’s races, a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat and runs over a sports field, roads and forest paths; it has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). Its family-friendly atmosphere and inclusion of children and young people make the run a special event for all age groups.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that passes through Oldersum’s picturesque parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the apple park, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also taking place and refreshments are available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking route and 800 m children’s races for various age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Final 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can compare their 5 km times. The final in Berlin is part of a series of three races, with times added together to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. Alongside the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp grants are available for the top participants. The event supports young athletes and offers a thrilling platform for emerging running talent.

name: Remsecker Waldlauf
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest in Remseck. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults, taking runners through varied woodland terrain with muddy, uneven ground and narrow paths. The race combines sporting ambition with a nature experience and a sense of community, and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and will be held for the sixth time in 2026.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain run in Dillenburg, held annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course passes through varied terrain with steep climbs, offering runners an athletic challenge in a natural setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The Forest and Hill Run in Groß-Umstadt is a long-standing race that starts and finishes at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion on September 26, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km course and the half marathon distance of 21.1 km. The race is part of the Langlauf Cup Jugenheim and is sanctioned by the DLV. The route runs through forests and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the “Mountain of Truth.” Refreshments are available along the course, and after the race there is an awards ceremony, with showers and changing rooms on site.

name: Int. Pronsfelder Volks- und Straßenlauf
description: The 38th International Pronsfeld Fun Run and Road Race offers a varied running experience in the heart of the Eifel for all ages and ability levels. From Bambini and children’s races to the fun run and half marathon, there’s something for everyone. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, attractive prizes, and excellent refreshments in the finish area. The start and finish are at Autohaus Mais-Glandien in Pronsfeld, and the race is a sporting highlight with a strong tradition and community spirit.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Lundby Krat Trail
Tour de Fredensborgs efterårsløb i Nivå 2026
42e Halve van Katwijk
location: Duinplein, Katwijk aan Zee, Katwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The 42nd edition of the Halve van Katwijk takes place on September 26, 2026, and is a popular running and walking festival along the coast. The event is known for its sporty, welcoming atmosphere and beautiful course, which starts and finishes at Duinplein in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard. The Halve van Katwijk offers several distances for runners, walkers and children, and attracts many participants each year who enjoy the unique surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The organizers are continually working to improve the event and give everyone an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Duinplein, right in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard
Refreshment stations at Vriezenwei, Panbos and Wassenaarse Slag
Various courses with GPX files available, including special Kidsrun routes
additional: Start and Finish Village at Duinplein with changing facilities, toilets, activities and massage. No on-the-day registration is available. Parking garage on the Boulevard and alternative parking garages nearby. No supervised bicycle parking is available. Business Run with its own start pen, group photo, souvenir and networking drinks afterwards. GPX files for all routes are available. The event also includes a Kidsrun and Business Run; registration is popular and often closes early due to high demand.

name: Thaisner DörpsRun
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

name: De 5 van Bavel
description: The 5 van Bavel is an annual running event in ’t Klooster, Bavel, celebrating its 10th anniversary edition in 2026. The event offers a fun and sporty day for all ages, with several distances, including a 5 km race, a 10 km recreational run and a kids’ run. The start and finish are centrally located on Kloosterstraat, by Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. The 5 van Bavel also supports a good cause: research into neuroendocrine tumours (NETs).

name: Run for Hope
description: Run for Hope is an inspiring running event taking place on 26 September 2026 in the Dordtse Biesbosch. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 21.1 kilometres and run to raise money for clients of De Hoop, who receive support in building a new life. The run celebrates hope and solidarity, with runners cheered on by supporters as they come together to contribute to a good cause. The event combines sporting spirit with a meaningful commitment to helping others.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
description: The Spanderswoud Trail Run is a relaxed trail run through the beautiful Spanderswoud and surrounding nature reserves in the Gooi region. The 10, 20 and 30 km routes take you along winding forest paths, singletracks and open heathland, with no competition or time pressure. The start and finish are at the Natuurmonumenten visitor centre on Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. There are aid stations along the way, and afterwards you can enjoy food and drinks at Café-Restaurant Brambergen.

name: Crob Run
description: The Crob Run is a running event in Haaften taking place on 26 September 2026. It offers a beautiful run along the dikes around Haaften and through the nature along the Waal, suitable for all ages. There are various distances, including kids’ runs for children aged 5 to 12, and 5 km and 10 km runs for adults. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with music, food outlets and a bar, and part of the proceeds goes to charity.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
description: Hill Repeat Madness is a challenging 4-hour trail-running challenge held at Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. This trail run challenges runners to test their endurance and speed on a varied course in a natural setting. It is organised by Trailrunners Brabant, known for their passion for trail running and for creating a sporty, friendly atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail runners who enjoy an intense and dynamic running experience.

name: BEAT Running Festival
description: The BEAT Running Festival on 26 September 2026 in Amsterdamse Bos is a unique knockout running event in which participants run successive 1 km laps at an increasing pace. The race is about keeping up with an official pacer; anyone who falls behind is eliminated, until one man and one woman remain. Alongside the exciting race, there is a festival featuring food, drinks, challenges and a community zone, making the event more than just a running race. The winners receive a sports trip worth €2,000.

name: Mission Run
description: MissionRun 2026 takes place on Saturday 26 September in Scherpenzeel and offers running and walking routes of 5, 10 and 20 km, including a half marathon for participants aged 18 and over. The course runs through the nature-rich countryside around Scherpenzeel, along forest trails and quiet country roads, and is suitable for experienced runners, recreational participants and walkers alike. All proceeds from the event go to International Justice Mission, in support of Anne & Dianne’s Muskathlon. The start and finish are at Oud Willaer 74, with MyLaps timing for the running distances.

name: Zevenheuvelentrail & NK Trailrunning
distance_verbose: 56 km, Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7 km
description: The Zevenheuvelentrail & Dutch National Trail Running Championships take place in the wooded, hilly surroundings of Nijmegen. The trails feature challenging routes with steep climbs, tough descents and unpaved paths through natural areas such as the Nijmeegse Heuvelrug and Landgoed van Jurgens. The Dutch National Trail Running Championships comprise a short 28-kilometre trail and a long 56-kilometre trail, where athletes with an Atletiekunie licence compete for the Dutch title. The organisers provide an atmospheric event with aid stations and a professional approach.

name: Roldertoren Run
description: The Roldertorenrun is a running event in and around Rolde, with three distances: a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. The half marathon takes you through the beautiful Drenthe countryside, with heathland, burial mounds, streams and old cart tracks, and finishes at the Jacobus Church. The 10 km is suitable for experienced runners and runs partly across the Balloërveld and along the Wandelspoor. The 5 km is a fast, fully paved route with views of the Balloërveld and a single track back to the finish at the tower. The start and finish are at the Roldertoren.

name: Schoklandloop
description: The Schokland Run is a unique running race organized by AV NOP in cooperation with Het Flevo-landschap and Museum Schokland. The race takes place on the beautiful World Heritage Site of Schokland and combines nature, culture and sport on a challenging course. The 10 km route covers the entire island of Schokland, while the 5 km route runs across the southern island. The start and finish are at Middelbuurt 2, Schokland. Participants receive a souvenir, timekeeping and a refreshment at Restaurant Schokland.

name: Gelderse Poort Ultra
description: The Gelderse Poort Ultra is a challenging 50-kilometre trail that brings the Dutch Ultra Series to a fitting close. The route takes you through the beautiful floodplains around Nijmegen, the forests towards Berg en Dal, and the distinctive farmland in between. With between 700 and 1,000 metres of elevation gain, technical trails and varied scenery including clogs paths, heathland and forests, this ultra offers a special nature experience. The start is at Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, where participants can enjoy a delicious dinner afterwards and, if they wish, stay overnight.

name: Groot Boeschoten Trail
distance_verbose: 35 km, 23 km, 13 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km
description: The Groot Boeschoten Trail takes place on Saturday, 26 September 2026, in Voorthuizen, starting and finishing at Camping De Zanderij. The routes have been completely revamped and offer a varied course across the Veluwe, with forests, heathland, sandy paths and historic estates. The course passes open heathland, fields and forests towards Speuld, Huinen and Garderen, with historic sheepfolds serving as a landmark and refreshment point. The routes are approximately 99% off-road and clearly marked, with premium refreshment stations along the way. Children can take part in a special Kids Trail, with a medal and access to the swimming pool.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historic and natural attractions in the surrounding area. After the finish, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a large prize draw. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The event is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymov Five is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of various ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, ensuring a high-quality sporting experience.

name: Běh Bohutínem
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín and held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the Zlín Region Day celebrations, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural programme, regional cuisine and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a fun-filled day featuring crafts and regional products. The event is organised by the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions.

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are held. The race starts at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and its atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful surrounding countryside and rock formations. The race is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardio Run is Plzeň’s largest cross-country race, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place at the Horečky amphitheatre in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Historical Centre of Šumperk, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city race through the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition offers races for the general public, including the main 10 km race, a 3.33 km race, three-person relay teams, and children’s races of various lengths. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied program of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – the Krčmaň Run over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated pitch of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and lighting effects. The course winds through the city, with cheering points featuring music and fire shows creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new edition of the well-known half-marathon companion race has been moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Challenge is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time in the city’s green spaces. The run is open to experienced runners and anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the run starting at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km routes through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active break. It is organised by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Race is the biggest sporting celebration in Mikołów and takes place annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sporting competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant climb, combining sport with the opportunity to learn about the history of the Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can explore historic fortifications and sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and historical education. The organizers are members of the Adventure Association, who have been involved in organizing sporting and adventure events for years.
course_highlights: Cross-country course along paths and forest tracks
One substantial climb on the course
Visit to historic sites of the Kraków Fortress after the race
additional: After the race, participants and accompanying persons can visit historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The race routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Guided visits to sites of the former Kraków Fortress are available after the race. Information about the distances, course, and location comes from previous editions; details of the edition on 25.09.2027 have not been confirmed.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: 7-MEILEN-TRAIL
description: The 7-Mile Trail in Kaiserslautern offers two challenging courses: a short 4-mile course for running and Nordic walking, and a long 7-mile course for runners only. The routes pass through varied terrain with a high proportion of singletrack and are completely unpaved. The start and finish are opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. The event is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a scenic, challenging route.
course_highlights: 4-mile course: approx. 6.4 km with 130 m of elevation gain
7-mile course: approx. 11.3 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Courses are 40–60% singletrack and completely unpaved
additional: Start and finish opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. Aid stations: 4-mile course, once in the finish area; 7-mile course, twice (after 6 km at the TSG fountain and in the finish area). The long course is for runners only; the short course is also open to Nordic walkers. Trail running, event date: 2026-09-27, location: Kaiserslautern, course distance approx. 11 km, elevation gain approx. 340 m

name: Altkönig-Lauf
price_range: 10 km 16,00 Euro, Halbmarathon 18,00 Euro, Schülerläufe 5,00 Euro, Walking 14,00 Euro
description: The Altkönig Run, organized by MTV Kronberg, is a traditional public race approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), taking place on September 27, 2026. Events include a half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km races, children’s races, a toddlers’ race, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the scenic Taunus landscape, with around 350 metres of elevation gain in the half marathon. The race is part of the Taunus Running Challenge and offers every finisher a medal, as well as trophies and cash prizes for the top runners. The start and finish are at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg
Part of the Taunus Running Challenge, which has three scoring races
additional: Every finisher receives a medal. The 10 km walking and Nordic walking events start at 9:40 a.m. and are not timed. Children’s races start from 12:00 p.m., with distances of 350 m and 1,000 m. There is a refreshment station on the course. Participants are asked to bring reusable cups or their own mugs to help protect the environment. The awards ceremony is planned for around 1:00 p.m., with finisher trophies for all participants who are present and cash prizes for the top runners. The courses run along forest paths through the Taunus. Elevation gain: 150 m for 10 km and 350 m for the half marathon. Start and finish at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg. Registration is available online and on race day. Environmentally conscious behaviour is encouraged at the refreshment station.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Kraichgaulauf
description: The Kraichgaulauf in Sinsheim-Rohrbach is a traditional race on September 27, 2026, offering runners of all ability levels varied routes through the scenic Kraichgau countryside. From the short 5 km course and the popular 10 km race to the challenging half marathon and demanding 42.2 km hill marathon, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through natural surroundings and offer stunning views, including of the landmark Steinsberg Castle. The event is ideal for anyone looking to combine endurance, nature, and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Hill marathon with varied elevation profiles and stunning views
10 km course featuring paved roads, surfaced farm tracks, and idyllic woodland sections
5 km course with panoramic views of Kraichgaublick and Steinsberg Castle
additional: Race-bib distribution until 30 minutes before the start at Kreuzgrundhalle. Changing rooms and showers at Kreuzgrundhalle and at the sports grounds. Parking available around the hall and in the sports field area. Bag storage in the start/finish area (Rohrbach Primary School). Refreshments including drinks, fruit, and snacks at several stations, depending on the course. Medal for all finishers. Timing with a disposable timing chip integrated into the race bib. Late registration possible until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability. Limited to 1000 participants. Various distances; registration opens April 15, 2026; focus on nature and experience.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns and an inspiring atmosphere along the course. The route is a circuit through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections on paved farm roads and through historic town centres. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites runners to make a strong final push. Whether you are a beginner or an ambitious runner, you’ll find your own personal running experience here.
course_highlights: Circuit through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns including Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim, ideal for an exciting final push
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups take place in Steinheim on the last Sunday of each month. Summer-break runs are held every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays and include a 10 km long run. The Year-End Run is a 10 km run with punch and mulled wine at the end of the year. Registration is through Datasport. Late entries and changes of registration are possible until shortly before the race. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and running events for all age groups; it takes place in June 2026 to give runners the opportunity to prepare optimally.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21-kilometer races pass idyllic streams, run along ridges with magnificent views and through smaller settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children’s and youth races, plus a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking, as well as affordable accommodation at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are offered after the finish. Childcare is available for “running parents.” The start and finish are just 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10-kilometer race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00. The 10-kilometer race and the children’s and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: Cochem Zeller Crosslauf Serie
description: The 39th edition of the Cochem Zeller Cross-Country Series takes place on 27 September 2026 in Ulmen, Germany. The event offers two distances, 400 metres and 8 kilometres, on courses that are often suitable for record times. As part of the solidarity system in sport and running culture, Laufen.de members benefit from reduced entry fees. The race is known for its varied cross-country courses in the Eifel region.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses suitable for record times
Distances: 400 m and 8 km
Scenic surroundings in Ulmen, Eifel
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, 45 mm average precipitation, mostly cloudy. September weather around 19°C, cloudy; several venues in the region; certificates and trophies for winners

name: GVG Citylauf Erftstadt
description: The GVG Citylauf Erftstadt is the region’s largest running event and takes place every September. It offers a special atmosphere for everyone who loves running, from children and recreational runners to elite athletes. The 10 km main race takes runners four times through the medieval old town and Lechenich Castle Park, with numerous spectators lining the route. Shorter races for schoolchildren, families, and companies are also available; they start and finish at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with four laps through the medieval old town and the castle park
Loop course starting and finishing at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich
Officially measured, fast course with few turns
additional: The 10 km main race is also available as a relay. All finishers in the 5 km, 10 km, or relay races are entered into a draw to win a hot-air balloon ride for two. The course is designed so that runners pass the market square several times and can be cheered on by spectators. The youngest runners have a 750 m loop; schoolchildren run 2.5 km, and the family and company race is 5 km (2 laps). The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and follows its guidelines. Running event in the medieval old town and castle park, open to all ages and ability levels, including Laufcup 2026

name: Internationaler Hochfelln-Berglauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nenngeld 40.- € inklusive Nudelparty, Talfahrt mit der Hochfellnseilbahn, Parkplatz, Verpflegungsbuffet, Duschen, Gepäcktransport

description: The International Hochfelln Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race in Bergen, Germany, held annually. The course starts in the valley at the Hochfelln cable car station at an altitude of 600 metres and finishes at the summit of the Hochfelln at 1,671 metres. It is 7.8 km long, with 1,071 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix and offers runners a challenging, scenic mountain-running experience. In addition to the race, the event includes a pasta party and a wide range of refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: 7.8 km course with 1,071 m of elevation gain
Start at the valley station of the Hochfelln cable car (600 m), finish at the Hochfelln summit (1,671 m)
Part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix, with challenging mountain terrain
additional: The €40 entry fee includes Saturday's pasta party, the downhill ride on the Hochfelln cable car, parking, a generous refreshment buffet, showers and luggage transport. Race bibs can be collected on the evening before the race and on race day. Welcome party with pasta dinner on Saturday evening. Mountain trail terrain, registration required, historic race with multiple editions.

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on 27 September 2026 in Hamburg and offers runners an appealing natural route along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from the half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as fun runs for children. The route stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburg Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical care.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the largest and most prestigious marathon events in the world and is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat terrain and takes runners past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers a 5-kilometer race, inline skating races, and various ways to take part through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is distinguished by its unique energy and international running community.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The event is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. It takes place on September 27, 2026, and includes various race routes through the city.

name: Aindlinger Kleeblattmarsch
description: The Aindling Cloverleaf March is a unique 24-hour march in which participants can cover up to 100 kilometers over four 25-kilometer loops. The route is not marked and there are no road closures, requiring considerable determination and a good sense of direction. The route passes through varied, hilly landscapes around Aindling, including woodland and open countryside as well as picturesque villages. The march supports social projects, combining athletic effort with a good cause.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a charitable running event benefiting various organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Center in Aurich and offer competitions for all age groups, from a children’s race to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V. and held annually on the last Sunday in September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. The fastest runners receive trophies, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, that passes through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to take on a special challenge. The course consists of four cloverleaf loops of 25 miles each, run consecutively. The event places emphasis on professional organization, with timing, live tracking, and aid stations.

name: Kurparklauf 2026
description: The Kurparklauf in Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe takes place annually, turning the Kurpark into an attractive running course. The event offers two distances: a 10 km fun run for experienced runners and a 5 km run open to everyone who prefers a shorter, more accessible course. Both races start and finish on Brunnenallee and follow a 2.5 km loop through the green Kurpark, passing meadows, trees and garden paths without crossing heavily trafficked roads. The race is an established event and celebrates its 30th edition in 2026.

name: Lions - Dietzenbacher Stadtlauf 2026
description: The Lions - Dietzenbach City Run is an established running event in Hessentagspark Dietzenbach that combines sporting activity with social commitment. Every year, numerous runners of all ages take part, accompanied by families and spectators. The event offers a 4 km fun run, a competition for businesses and clubs, and a 10 km main race. The city run stands for community, exercise, and responsibility for the city of Dietzenbach.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Cabbage Day Run is a long-standing race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarscher Company Cup. The event offers a range of distances, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for adults. The courses are traffic-free, clearly marked, and have markers at every kilometre. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish, and timing is provided professionally using a chip attached to the race number. The event takes place in almost any weather and offers changing and shower facilities at the Marne swimming pool.

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional scenic race for running and Nordic walking enthusiasts, taking place on September 26 and 27, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The route follows forest, meadow, and field paths, passing numerous carp ponds, and includes approximately 150 meters of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic walking events and various youth and children’s races. The event offers a varied, nature-rich setting for participants of all ages.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a long-standing running competition in Kleinmachnow, taking place on September 27, 2026, at Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School. The event offers various competitions for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants can enjoy drinks and refreshments in the finish area and receive medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends of Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Rheinhöhenlauf - RUN50
description: The Rheinhöhenlauf RUN50 is a three-day running event featuring three varied stages covering a total of 50 kilometers and around 1,000 meters of elevation gain. The event combines a sporting challenge with a friendly, personal atmosphere, making it ideal for running enthusiasts who want to combine their sport with a short break. It is organized by a dedicated team from TV Linz, BBC Linz and VfB Linz, and offers an attractive program alongside the race, including refreshments, luggage transport, a finisher’s medal, a technical shirt, a finger-food buffet and a ride on a historic railbus. Proceeds benefit the organizing clubs and the support association of Franziskus Hospital Linz.

name: Ruhstorfer Geländelauf
description: The Ruhstorf Cross-Country Run is an approximately 7.5-kilometer trail run around Ruhstorf an der Rott, taking in beautiful scenery and several climbs. The route is roughly half asphalt and half farm and meadow paths. Its attractive natural setting makes the run suitable for both ambitious runners and beginners. It takes place annually and is part of the 2024 Grenzland Running Cup. The event is organized by SVG Ruhstorf e.V. and offers a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Rund um den Kellerskopf
description: Rund um den Kellerskopf is a road race event in Wiesbaden-Rambach, Hesse, where TuS Rambach has organized running events since 1960. The event offers various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as children’s and youth races on the same morning. The course is hilly rather than a flat city route, making it an appealing challenge for both serious runners and families. The start and finish are at the sports field on Trompeterstraße. The event combines the charm of a local club race with a range of participation options.

name: Saaraltarmlauf
description: The Saaraltarm Run is a long-standing running event in Saarlouis that attracts runners from the region and beyond every year. The event offers a well-organized race atmosphere, with the start and finish in Saarlouis. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Saaraltarm and offers an appealing challenge for both competitive and recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization by LSG Saarlouis.

name: Sechs Stunden Urwaldlauf
location: Urwald vor den Toren der Stadt, Saarbrücken, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Urwald Run in Saarbrücken is a unique running event where participants can run as many laps as possible within six hours on a 1.85 km loop through the forest on the outskirts of the city. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic single-track trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great importance on mutual respect among runners and environmental protection, supported by a sustainable refreshment concept and the offsetting of CO2 emissions. The start is flexible from 10:00, and the finish is at 16:00, allowing everyone to set their own pace and breaks.

name: SPORT IN Reisberglauf
description: The 29th SPORT IN Reisberglauf takes place on September 27, 2026, in Lippertshofen. The race is recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV), which means results can be officially included in athletics rankings. Two distances are offered: a short 400-meter run and a longer 13.8-kilometer run. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete in an official, recognized race.

name: Theodor-Heuss-Lauf
description: The Theodor Heuss Run is a traditional city race in Brackenheim, held annually at Wiesental Stadium and in the surrounding picturesque countryside. It offers a range of distances for all age groups, from Bambini and kindergarten runs to school races and the main 5 km and 10 km races. The course follows the cycle path along Austraße, passes through the “am Blasenberg” development and the villages of Meimsheim and Dürrenzimmern, then returns to the stadium. Alongside sporting ambition, fun and community are also at the heart of the event, with local partners providing attractive prizes and gifts for all participants.

name: Topiblütenlauf Staffort
description: The Topiblütenlauf Staffort is a running event held as part of the Stutensee CUP in the beautiful surroundings of Staffort. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, with the 10 km race counting as the third race in the Stutensee CUP. The races start at the SV Staffort sports facility, and the event welcomes runners of various age groups. Bib pickup begins at 8:30 a.m. The 10 km race starts at 10:00 a.m. and the 5 km race at 10:15 a.m.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers runners and walkers various race distances in the great outdoors around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to medium-sized hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: Bondorflauf
description: The Bondorflauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bondorf. It gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and fitness in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The event is part of SV Bondorf’s varied sports program and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place on September 27, 2026, and is a fixture in the regional running calendar.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. Events include a bambinilauf, school races, unicycle races, a 5 km run and walking event, and the 10 km main race. The routes pass through Lübeck’s city center, with current construction work taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, including those who are not members of a club, and offers team rankings and a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking event in Birkenwerder takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, and is organised by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances are offered, ranging from 400 m to 8.6 km, as well as a Nordic walking competition, in which the use of poles is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors. All participants receive a printable certificate, and medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online, with a limit of 500 entries; late registration is possible through the day of the event.

name: Diezer Stadtlauf mit 10 km (Regionsmeisterschaft)
description: The Diez City Run is a 10 km road race starting at the market square in Diez, Germany, and taking place in late September. This edition also serves as the regional championships, adding extra competitive significance to the race. In addition to the 10 km race, shorter distances are available, including a 400 m race for children and 5 km races for various age groups. The event is organised by SV Diez-Freiendiez and offers competitions for children, young people, open runners and masters, with separate classifications for men and women up to the older age groups.

name: Einstein-Marathon
description: The Ulm Einstein Marathon is one of the largest running events in southern Germany and takes place on September 27, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the classic marathon, half marathon, relay races, and other running and walking formats. The course runs through the city of Ulm, starting at the exhibition grounds and finishing at Münsterplatz. More than 15,000 runners are expected for the 22nd edition, which will feature a varied program and a special Einstein collection.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop runs mainly along paved roads through the city centre. In addition to the main races over 5 and 10 kilometres, children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV State Championships and offers a lively atmosphere with refreshments and a supporting programme at Rathausplatz.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Eper Michaelislauf is a long-standing, family-friendly race held around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognised as a DLV race and offers low entry fees and affordable refreshments. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere, appealing to both competitive and recreational runners. Due to possible runoff elections, the race is held on Saturday in some years.

name: Esslinger Schurwaldlauf
description: The Esslingen Schurwald Run is a traditional running event taking place on 27 September 2026 in Esslingen, on the Schurwald heights. The start and finish are at Georgii-Waldstadion, set in a scenic location between the Neckar and Rems valleys. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to compete in various races, including the Esslingen City Championships over 10 km. The course passes through the beautiful natural scenery of the Schurwald and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorf Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf, organized by DJK Herdorf and listed in the official German running calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 meters and 10 kilometers, and is aimed primarily at the local community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional partnerships, making the race a down-to-earth, community-focused event. Official DLV rankings may be maintained for some races.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herner St. Martini City Run takes place on September 27, 2026, on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from approx. 400 m to 5 km. The courses are officially measured and held under official supervision. Timing is electronic via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.

name: Tilburg Ten Miles
description: The Tilburg Ten Miles is the most convivial running festival in Central Brabant and has been held annually since 1988. The event attracts thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes, who run through Tilburg’s decorated streets, cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and live music. With distances of 16.1 km, 10 km and 5 km, there is a suitable challenge for every runner. The atmosphere is festive, and the route offers a lovely mix of urban surroundings and distinctive local spots.
course_highlights: Run through Tilburg’s decorated streets with enthusiastic spectators
A varied course through the heart of Tilburg, with wide streets and distinctive local spots
Live music and a festive atmosphere along the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected in advance at the Koepelhal on Saturday or Sunday. Registration by 23 August 2026 includes a race number with your name, medal engraving and a limited-edition running shirt. There is a Run Against Cancer campaign where participants can create a fundraising page and receive a special shirt when donations reach €500 or more. Multiple distances are available, including walking events and children’s races; participation is possible until 16 August; special race numbers and merchandise are available; the event supports charities such as KWF.

name: Rijk Zwaan Loop
price_range: twee tarieven voor alle afstanden, vroegboekkorting tot 8 september 2026
description: The Rijk Zwaan Loop is a running race and recreational run in 's-Gravenzande, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The day starts with the Kids Run at 13:00, followed by various distances, including a revamped 5 km and 10 km course. This year also features a new walking event with distances of 7, 14 and 21 kilometres, with proceeds going to Team Westland. The organisers invite runners of all levels to take part in this festive and sporting day.
course_highlights: Revamped 5 km and 10 km course, starting on Langestraat
Water stations along the route and post-finish refreshments including fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water
Walking event with route directions and a coffee stop; proceeds go to Team Westland
additional: The Kids Run starts at 13:00 and is limited to 450 participants. Race numbers are distributed in advance for those who register early. SAW chips are used for timing the 5 km and 10 km. Changing facilities are available at ISW College, at your own risk. Post-finish refreshments include fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water. The Kids Run has separate categories by primary school year group and age. The walking event is at participants' own risk and includes a coffee stop along the route. The Kids Run starts at 13:00, with a maximum of 450 children; location near Sand-Ambachtstraat and ISW College; no on-site registration.

name: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voorinschrijving is mogelijk tot zaterdag 26 september 2026, 18:00 uur

description: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer is an annual running event taking place for the 22nd time on Sunday, September 27, 2026. It is Zoetermeer’s largest running race, with distances ranging from a half mile to a half marathon. The start and finish are at Pilatusdam in Zoetermeer’s historic center. The courses pass through both Old and New Zoetermeer, including the former Floriade site and Balijbos. There are also Geuzen walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometers, organized by Road Runners Zoetermeer and Sportief Wandelgroep Zoetermeer.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Pilatusdam in Zoetermeer’s old center
Courses pass through Old Zoetermeer, New Zoetermeer, the former Floriade site, and Balijbos
Walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometers through natural areas with historical significance
additional: Geuzenloop is inclusive and accessible: buddies accompanying visually impaired runners and walkers can participate for free after registering. All running routes and the 6 km walking tour are wheelchair accessible. Each distance has a cut-off time to ensure the course remains clear. Finishers receive a unique medal made from a tree trunk slice by people distanced from the labor market. The finish closes at 15:00. Registration opens on May 1, 2026; medal made from pruned wood; option to change distance; closing run and after-party on September 30; no medal option for all participants.

name: Earth Race
distance_verbose: 128.8 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: Earth Race Forest Edition is a multi-themed endurance event held in the beautiful Amsterdam Forest near Amstelveen. The race offers distances from 5 km up to an ultra 128.8 km, winding through woodland trails, ponds, and open meadows with scenic views of this urban nature reserve. The event combines sport with environmental impact, supporting rainforest protection and local nature projects. Participants enjoy a festival atmosphere with hydration stations, medical support, and a unique afterparty experience.

name: 42 ste Joustermerkeloop
distance_verbose: 16.2 km, 10 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Jasperloop
description: The Jasperloop is a monthly running race held in the beautiful woodland near Keelven in Someren. The event is open to everyone, young and old, and features a 2.5 km loop on partly paved paths and sandy trails. Participants can decide how many laps to run, up to a maximum of six. The race starts at 10:00, and registration is available at the start location from 9:30. The Jasperloop is a friendly, accessible event that has been held for many years.

name: Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop op zondag 27 september 2026
description: The Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop is a running race organized by AV Sparta in Voorburg, held on Sunday, 27 September 2026. The race offers several distances, including youth races of 1 and 2.5 km and adult races of 5 and 10 km. The start is on the athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet. The course passes through varied surroundings, with routes along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, a cycle bridge, the ADO stadium and cycle tunnels. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps. The organizers invite both members and non-members to take part and get to know the club.

name: Runway Run for KiKa - Twente Airport
organizer: Stichting Runway Run voor Run for KiKa
description: The Runway Run for KiKa at Twente Airport is a unique running event held on the runway of a former airbase. Participants experience a special combination of sport, atmosphere and meaning as they run along the tarmac, surrounded by aircraft and music. The event offers several distances, including a Kids Run, 5 km and 10 km, and is a great opportunity to take action together against childhood cancer. The flat courses are ideal for both beginner and experienced runners looking to push their limits.

name: Marathonblokken - Run Your City
description: Marathonblokken is a series of running training sessions organised by Hardloopnetwerk in collaboration with PUMA, designed to prepare runners for their marathon. The sessions take place in several cities, including Amsterdam, Soest and Utrecht, where participants run together at marathon and half-marathon pace. During the sessions, participants can test PUMA shoes and try sports nutrition. The event offers an energetic, social atmosphere, ideal for both beginner and experienced marathon runners looking to improve their performance.

name: Bavoloop Rijsbergen 2026
description: The Bavoloop in Rijsbergen is a popular village race with a rich tradition, celebrating its 37th edition in 2026. The event takes place annually on the third Sunday in June and combines a route through the village centre with sections in the surrounding countryside. The varied programme features three main distances, a team relay, a kids’ race with a medal, and a walking-frame race. Live entertainment and spectators along the course create a festive atmosphere.

name: duurlopen met hazen
description: Duurlopen met hazen is a running event in Amstelveen where participants can train in a relaxed atmosphere with pacers and enjoy water stations. The laps vary in distance and take place at scenic locations such as the Amstel area and Amsterdamse Bos, often on the Amsterdam Marathon course. The start is usually at 10:00 a.m., but in warm weather the event starts earlier to protect participants. Facilities such as ice water and sponges help runners cool down during the run.

name: Heyu VathorstRun
description: The Heyu VathorstRun takes place on Sunday 27 September 2026 in Hooglanderveen. The event offers three distances: 5 kilometres for beginners, the classic 10 kilometres sponsored by MONI, and a new distance of 10 miles (16.1 km). The route runs through Vathorst, a beautiful area for running and enjoying sport and camaraderie together. The organisers invite everyone to take part and offer a special discount through Heyu.

name: 12e Halve van Alphen
organizer: Alphen a/d Run en CAS Alphen
description: De Halve van Alphen is an atmospheric autumn classic taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, in Alphen aan den Rijn. The 21.1 km half marathon takes you along green edges, parks and nature reserves in the Groene Hart on a nearly car-free course. Besides running, you can also take part in relay teams, skate, cycle, walk or even bring a leashed dog. The start and finish are at Sunset Beach Bar by the Zegerplas, where a convivial atmosphere and an after-party await participants and spectators.

name: Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt
description: The Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, a running event in the beautiful floodplains of Nederasselt. Participants can choose from three distances: 1.5 km, 5 km and 10 km. The routes include the Maasdijk, nature areas and the lock. The start and finish are at the Nederasselt Community Centre, which has facilities including toilets and a catering venue. The atmosphere is sporty and welcoming, suitable for all ages and abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. Professional timekeeping is provided, with prizes for the fastest runners in each distance.

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km
description: The Vechtstreek in Beweging Run is a friendly, well-organised running series in the Utrecht region, organised by athletics club OSM’75 Atletiek & Recreatiesport Maarssen. The races take place in the wooded recreational area of the Maarsseveense Plassen, on a fully paved, car-free course around the large lake. Participants can choose their own distance and pace, making the event suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Pacers are available at various speeds to support everyone.

name: HooilandRun
description: The HooilandRUN is a friendly running race in and around the ’t Hooiland neighbourhood in Lichtenvoorde, suitable for beginner and experienced runners, children and adults. The course combines semi-paved walking paths and paved surfaces, with rolling paths and two short climbs. The race offers several distances, including 1 km and 2 km for children, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. The organisers provide chip timing, water stations and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: MaatGarant Run Bke Marathon
description: The MaatGarant Run Bike Marathon is an accessible, sporty event where teams of 2 to 4 participants cover a marathon distance of 42.195 km together. Each team member runs about 10 kilometres while the others cycle, making it ideal for anyone with a reasonable level of fitness. Organised by AV Spirit in Oud-Beijerland, the event is all about achieving something together, having fun and team building, rather than focusing on winning. The marathon takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, and offers a friendly, personal atmosphere, similar to the RopaRun but on a smaller scale and closer to home.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km
description: The Dobbeloop is a monthly recreational running race organized by the Nootdorp Ice Club, held in the nature area around Dobbeplas between Pijnacker and Nootdorp. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and paved with asphalt, with guidance from cyclists, arrows, and staffed checkpoints. The start is at the Nootdorp Ice Club’s clubhouse at Oudeweg 74 in Nootdorp. There are several distances for children and adults, with on-site registration and a friendly atmosphere in the clubhouse.

name: HeteRUN
description: HeteRUN is Heteren’s running event, taking place on Sunday, September 27, 2026. The event offers a range of distances for all ages, including 500- and 1,000-metre kids’ runs and challenging 5 km and 10 km running routes. The routes are suitable for both experienced and advanced runners and take place in the heart of Heteren. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and good facilities, including changing rooms and on-site first aid.

name: Euromast Trappenloop
description: The Euromast Stair Climb is a unique sporting challenge in which participants climb the 589 steps of the iconic Euromast in Rotterdam. This second edition, on 27 September 2026, offers an unforgettable experience with official timing, an exclusive medal and spectacular views over the city. The race is suitable both for athletes aiming for a personal best and for anyone ready to take on the challenge. Afterwards, participants can relax in the Brasserie, and friends and family can also enjoy the Euromast with a discount code.

name: Raamvallei Duomarathon
description: The Raamvallei Duo Marathon is a unique team event in which pairs of two cover the marathon course of over 42 kilometres together on one bicycle. One partner runs while the other cycles, and they can switch whenever they like. The route passes through the beautiful Land van Cuijk, alongside the Raam and by various distinctive locations, including Landgoed de Barendonk, woodlands, meadows and historic windmills. The event is all about teamwork, fun and enjoyment, with no timing or race rankings. Along the way, participants can enjoy local snacks and drinks and live music, followed by a festive finish with a red carpet and a traditional Brabant sausage roll.

name: Broekstaclerun
description: The Broekstaclerun is a challenging and fun obstacle run event in Broekland, featuring a unique mix of running, mud, and obstacles. The run has a cosy, down-to-earth character, with a varied course through nature where effort and enjoyment go hand in hand. The event is accessible and sustainably organised, and is suitable for participants of different ages and ability levels. The atmosphere is always festive, and the run is supported by enthusiastic volunteers and local landowners.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest unbroken tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championships and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that will test every runner. The exceptional atmosphere is complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among residents of their district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every start earns points in the competition to determine Prague’s most sporting district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a challenging mountain run held in Rybnik, attracting fans of extreme running challenges. The race takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers professional timing using RFID technology. The event is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing participants with smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes on September 17, 2026, at 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The 1st Ostrzeszów Half Marathon – Along the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills 2026 is a unique half-marathon taking place in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The course leads over two hills and past two springs, offering participants one-of-a-kind views and terrain challenges. It’s a great opportunity to experience the natural beauty of Wielkopolska and enjoy a sporting adventure in a friendly atmosphere. We invite all runners to take on the challenge and join the event.
course_highlights: Course over two hills
Route passes two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Memorial Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque setting of Lake Paprocany in Tychy. The race commemorates the achievements of outstanding runner Paweł Lorens, a multiple Polish Championship medalist and promoter of athletics in the region. The course is flat and fast, following compacted paths along the pedestrian promenade and a paved sidewalk. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available on the day of the event.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: The X TOYOTA Cross Half Marathon is a cross-country race held in Jelcz-Laskowice on September 27, 2026. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice, and the race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30 at the Nad Stawem center. Participants can compete in the 21.1 km and 10.5 km races, or take part in the 10.5 km Nordic Walking event. The event is supported by local institutions and partners, and timing is electronic, using modern equipment.

name: XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 100 Bruggenloop
description: The 100 Bridges Run in Leiden is a unique walking and running event in which participants cross 100 bridges, ranging from centuries-old stone arch bridges to modern bridges in Singelpark. The route follows rivers, canals, tow canals and waterways, passing some of the most beautiful places in the historic city centre, including the Netherlands’ oldest university, Hortus Botanicus and various monuments. The walking event takes place on Saturday 26 September 2026, and the running event on Sunday 27 September 2026. Several distances are available, so both recreational walkers and runners can take part.
course_highlights: Cross 100 bridges over rivers, canals, tow canals and waterways
Pass historic sights such as the oldest university and Hortus Botanicus
Route through Singelpark, harbours, city gates and distinctive architecture
additional: Walkers start on Saturday between 08:00 and 11:00 from Van der Werfpark. Runners start on Sunday from 08:00 at Stadhuisplein/Vismarkt. The walking time limit is 16:15 and the running time limit is 11:15. Support is available along the route, with checkpoint stations, first aid and a commemorative medal. Dogs are allowed on a leash, except in Hortus Botanicus. Children under 12 may participate only when accompanied. The city is not closed to traffic; the route runs along pavements and pedestrian areas. Late registration is possible on the day, with a €2.00 surcharge. The event provides practical information about registration, times and facilities. The route includes a variety of surfaces, such as gravel, shell paths, brick, cobblestones, wood, concrete and asphalt, and is accessible to people with reduced mobility.
