Quarter marathon of 10.5 km and half marathon of 21.1 km
Water stations at 5 and 16 km for the half marathon and at 5 km for the quarter marathon
additional: Race numbers will not be sent out; details will be communicated by email on 2 October. Kieviten youth members can take part in the Kids Run and quarter marathon for free, provided they register as a Kievit. Time limits: 1 hour 30 minutes for the quarter marathon and 2 hours 40 minutes for the half marathon. Every participant who finishes will receive a medal. No late registration is possible. Water stations are available along the course. If you need extra water, bringing your own hydration belt is recommended. Terrain: route through Bleiswijk, water stations available, chip timing, medal at the finish.

name: TREK Singelloop Utrecht
price_range: €27 voor het limited edition hardloopshirt, inschrijfgeld niet expliciet vermeld
description: The TREK Singelloop Utrecht is the oldest road race in the Netherlands and an annual running celebration in the beautiful city of Utrecht. The race offers a fast, fully traffic-free route along Utrecht’s canals and through Wilhelminapark, where thousands of runners enjoy the course from start to finish. In addition to the 10 km and 5 km, there are also Kids Runs, Business Runs and a half marathon. The organisers support KWF Cancer Control and encourage participants to raise funds for this good cause.
course_highlights: Flat, paved and fully traffic-free roads
Route along Utrecht’s canals and through Wilhelminapark
Officially measured courses for the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
additional: Start waves are used to ensure a smooth and safe start, with waves approximately 15 minutes apart for the 5 km and 20 minutes apart for the 10 km. Race bibs can be sent to your home for €4.50 if you register before 31 August; otherwise, they must be collected at the event grounds. A unique limited-edition running shirt can be ordered for €27. Refreshments are available along the course and after the finish. The organisers encourage participants to raise funds for KWF Cancer Control through their own fundraising page. Participants can register via the official website, with options to fundraise for KWF Cancer Control and take part in different distances.

name: Kustmarathon Zeeland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname a € 55,- is mogelijk vanaf 18 jaar.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven is mogelijk vanaf 1 januari. Bij de inschrijving á € 7,- zit inbegrepen: Startnummer op naam en met chip; Tasje met inhoud; Medaille; Drinken bij de finish.

description: Kustmarathon Zeeland is one of the largest and toughest marathons in the Netherlands, known for its challenging course through dunes and over the beach, with a constant sea breeze. The event takes place on the first weekend of October and attracts more than 13,000 athletes from the Netherlands and abroad. The marathon offers a unique experience, with beautiful views of the beach and sea and a heroes’ welcome at the finish in Zoutelande. Alongside the marathon, there are various other races and activities for all ages, making it a sporty and atmospheric weekend.
course_highlights: Course through the dunes, over the beach and along the sea
Uphills and downhills with the wind in your hair
A heroes’ welcome at the finish on Zoutelande’s Via Gladiola
additional: Race numbers are sent out in mid-September or can be collected in advance in Zoutelande or Burgh Haamstede. Chip timing records net time via timing gates along the course. The marathon time limit is 18:00, with intermediate cutoffs at 10, 20, 30 and 36 km. The Orsted Minimarathon starts at 12:30 and has several age categories. Race numbers can still be purchased on the day if the limit has not been reached. Several race events are offered, including the marathon, trail run, MTB tour, canitrail, beach challenge and youth races; events are spread over three days, with different start and finish locations.

name: Trappenmarathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 16.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Staircase Marathon on the Wilhelminaberg in Landgraaf is the toughest marathon in the Netherlands. It has been organised by Stichting Foras Events since 2014. The course, approximately 1,050 to 1,100 metres long, features a unique challenge: 507 steps spanning an elevation gain of 75 metres. In addition to the marathon, several distances are available, including a Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and Last Man Standing, where participants climb the stairs as many times as possible. Participants receive a chip to measure their lap times and distance, making for a challenging and interactive running experience.
course_highlights: Course of approximately 1,050 to 1,100 metres with a unique elevation gain
507 steps beside SnowWorld with a 75-metre elevation gain
Distances range from the Kids Run to Last Man Standing
additional: The chip participants receive must be attached to or placed inside their shoes to measure lap times and distance. During the event, participants can view their elapsed time and distance at the top. Those who order a staircase marathon shirt can collect it when picking up their race number and chip. Various distances include climbs up 507 steps on the Wilhelminaberg course, a Last Man Standing challenge, registration including a race number and chip, and running distances for all levels.

name: Halve Marathon Roosendaal
location: Nieuwe Markt, Roosendaal, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Roosendaal Half Marathon takes place on Sunday, 4 October 2026, starting at Nieuwe Markt in Roosendaal. The race offers several distances, including the 21.1 km half marathon, a quarter marathon, an eighth marathon, and various running and walking options for all ages and levels. The day promises a friendly, sporting atmosphere, with a musical warm-up and a varied programme. The organisers provide a well-organised and accessible running experience for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nieuwe Markt in the centre of Roosendaal
Varied routes over 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5.25 km
Special programme with a warm-up and runs for children and walkers
additional: Race numbers will be mailed to participants who register by 18 May 2026; those who register later must collect theirs in person. Race numbers can be collected on 1 and 3 October at THORhonk, and on 4 October from 7:30 at C-Cinema. Same-day registration is not possible for running events, but is available for walking events for an additional fee. There will be a musical warm-up for the Kidsrun at 13:15. THOR members receive a 10% discount when registering online by 20 September 2026. Registration opens on 1 August, with adjusted start times and participant numbers. The event also offers shorter distances and walking routes to make it accessible to more people.

name: Breda Run Fest 2026
description: Breda Run Fest 2026 is an atmospheric running event in Breda taking place on Sunday, October 4, with a varied program and a Business Run on Saturday, October 3. Participants can register for various distances, including a 5,000-meter race open to athletes aged 13 and over. The event promotes sportsmanship and camaraderie by grouping participants according to their expected finish times. A special T-shirt is also available, and a free running clinic will be held to help participants prepare.

name: Prevox Startbaan-loop
description: The Prevox Startbaanloop is a monthly running race held on the athletics track at AV Startbaan in Amstelveen. The race offers distances of 1, 3 and 5 kilometres, with the 1-kilometre race also open to young runners. Electronic timing accurately records lap times and finish times. The 55th edition of this popular race takes place on Sunday, 4 October 2026. Advance registration is available via Inschrijven.nl.

name: Hema Volksloop 4 oktober
description: The HEMA IJzeren Man Volksloop is an accessible and relaxed running event held on the first Sunday of every month in Weert. Runners of all ages and levels run together along a beautiful route beside the water and through the green landscape of the IJzeren Man. The Volksloop focuses on being active and enjoying the experience, with everyone able to take part at their own pace. Several distances are available, including special youth distances and a time limit for seniors. The start is at the small beach in front of the Hertenkamp on Geurtsvenweg.

name: Trailrun Den Bosch
description: Trailrun Den Bosch is a running event in 's-Hertogenbosch with two distances: 8 km and 16 km. The race offers an accessible trail running experience for runners who want to enjoy a challenging course in beautiful surroundings. The organizers invite runners to share their experiences and prepare well with training plans from partners. The event is part of the WeTri platform, which supports triathletes and runners with comprehensive race information and training opportunities.

name: 0522 RUN – Urban City Run Meppel
description: The 0522 RUN - Urban City Run Meppel is a unique 5.22 km discovery run through Meppel’s city centre, organised by JCI Meppel-Reestmond. It is not a race, but an experience in which participants discover Meppel’s finest streets, businesses, squares and sights, with surprising entertainment along the way. There is no timekeeping or pressure to perform; the focus is on having fun and experiencing the city. After the finish, there is a lively afterparty in the heart of Meppel. Proceeds from the event go to Stichting De (W)arme Kant van Meppel, which provides practical support to fellow residents facing financial difficulties.

name: Bridge2Bridge Run
description: The Bridge2Bridge Run 2026 is the 19th edition of this annual running race organized by Orion Venlo. The race takes place in Blerick, Venlo, and offers distances of 5 km and 10 km, as well as children’s runs of 500 m and 1,000 m. The event has a sporty, recreational atmosphere, and race numbers can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m. The Bridge2Bridge Run is a great opportunity for both beginner and experienced runners to test their fitness and enjoy a well-organized event.

name: Hoge Veluwe Loop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 12 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 1.2 km, 0.9 km
description: The Hoge Veluwe Run is an atmospheric running race in the heart of De Hoge Veluwe National Park, with routes over unpaved paths of 5.5 km, 12.5 km and 20 km. The 20 km trail run offers a challenging course with more than 200 metres of elevation gain and natural aid stations, making it ideal for experienced runners. Beginners can take part in the 5.5 km Forest Run, which features scenic paths and an option for a more challenging alternative. Children can join the Moeffie Run in one of three age categories. The start and finish are at the Park Pavilion in the centre of the park, which also has various facilities.

name: Kanonsloop
description: Kanonsloop Groenlo is a lively running event taking place for the 38th time on Sunday, 4 October 2026. The race features a renewed 10 km course past well-known places in and around Groenlo, including Bommelwereld, Camping Marveld, the Groenlose moat and De Grolse Weiden city park. Alongside the 10 km, there is also the familiar 5 km distance, as well as a special corporate race with a convivial get-together at Brouwernös Proeflokaal. The start and finish are at the Muziekkoepel on Maliebaan / Wheme in Groenlo. The organizers ensure a safe and sporting atmosphere, with traffic marshals and timing by Race Result.

name: Klaverblad van Noordenveld
description: The Klaverblad van Noordenveld is a welcoming walking event taking place on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Ronostrand in Een. The routes range from 4 to 30 kilometres and lead through nature areas on a mix of paved and unpaved paths. Uniquely, all distances except the Beleefroute pass by the sand extraction site, an area normally closed to the public that is being opened especially for this anniversary edition. Children can enjoy a special 4 km Beleefroute full of games and adventure. The start and finish are centrally located at Ronostrand, creating a friendly and accessible atmosphere for all walkers.

name: Coevorder Crossloop
description: The Coevorden Cross Run takes place on 4 October 2026 around Klinkenvlierse Plas in Coevorden. The start and finish are on the ice rink grounds. Participants can choose from distances of 1.5 km (youth), 3 km, 6 km and 9 km. The course consists of challenging 3 km laps and offers a great opportunity to train with other runners and enjoy the natural surroundings of the lake.

name: MSV Family loop
description: The MSV Spijkenisse Family Run is a friendly, accessible running event for all ages, with special attention to young runners. The 1-mile (1.6 km) Family Run is ideal for children up to and including 13 years old, who may be accompanied by an adult. There are also challenging distances, including the 5 km run and the quarter marathon, which pass through beautiful natural areas and by familiar landmarks such as the white church in Simonshaven. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and support for its charity, the Goofy Team of Erasmus MC Sophia Children’s Hospital.

name: AV Spirit Wintercup
description: The AV Spirit Wintercup is an accessible recreational running and walking event in Lelystad, held on the first Sunday of every month from October through March. Everyone can take part, young or old, running or walking. The 2026–2027 season starts on 4 October with new 5 and 10 kilometre routes. There is a 5 and 10 kilometre ranking in which the best four of five results count, as well as special KidsRuns with themes and medals. The Wintercup combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, including non-members.

name: Marathon sw mannen en Halve vrouwen
Kustmarathon Zeeland WandelMarathon
description: The Zeeland Walking Marathon is a popular event that brings together thousands of walkers each year for a beautiful 42.195-kilometre journey from Burgh-Haamstede to Zoutelande. The route passes through the dunes and along the beach, offering a unique combination of nature and sport. The Coastal Marathon itself is known as the most beautiful and toughest marathon in the Netherlands, with challenging climbs, wind and stunning sea views. The Ladies Run offers an accessible running experience for women, with 5- and 10-kilometre distances starting and finishing in Zoutelande. The event is a sporting highlight in Zeeland, with a festive atmosphere and a heroes’ welcome at the finish.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
description: OLFINCAR Hradec Králové Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia and has been held since 2013. The race offers certified courses, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, 10 km race, and children’s races. The course is one of the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most scenic urban courses. In 2026, the event will also host the Czech Masters Half Marathon Championships and the Czech Championships for emergency and security services in the half marathon. The facilities at the new football arena in the city center provide runners with comfortable services.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run – Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race run mainly along forest roads, covering 13.6 km with 430 m of elevation gain. It is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. The challenging route through the beautiful countryside of the Moravian-Silesian Region is ideal for fans of mountain running and endurance events. The race takes place in Stará Ves near Rýmařov and is suitable for experienced runners looking for a trail challenge.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Run Around Panorama is a traditional cross-country race through challenging mountain terrain around Jáchymov’s football stadium. The race is open to all age groups and is being held for the 33rd year. The event is organised by Tělovýchovná jednota Jáchymov and offers a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering routes through meadows and along local roads over hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners receive medals, prizes and cash awards. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the school, and the main race begins in the morning.

name: Slatinský kros
description: Slatinský Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country running race held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and features a grassy course with rolling terrain, putting runners to the test in a pleasant natural setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can look forward to trophies, medals, and valuable prizes.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain, except for some June and August races, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.

name: Roštejnské stráně
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country race organized by Orel Telč and part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ranč u Lipek in Telč and offers various categories, including family relays and a fun run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship. Winners will receive medals, certificates, and prizes, with special awards also presented to the youngest and oldest runners.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
description: The Run Around the Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers runners of all ages a unique opportunity to enjoy the beautiful countryside and sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has a long-standing commitment to athletics and running races, with an emphasis on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children alike.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huť u Jablonce nad Nisou, Liberecký
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held every year on the first Sunday in October in Huť near Jablonec nad Nisou. Established in 1972, the event offers a 10 km main race and shorter distances for different age groups. The route passes through scenic countryside, with a grassy sports field serving as the start and finish area. The race welcomes runners of all ages, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 mil, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The JuraRun Running Festival is a unique sporting event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, combining a passion for running, competition, and the satisfaction of pushing your own limits. In 2026, the festival will feature as many as 9 different running events, with distances ranging from 5 km to over 100 km, as well as Nordic walking and a night run. The routes pass through picturesque landscapes, limestone rocks, forests, and Jurassic hills, offering both technical challenges and beautiful views. The festival is open to runners of all abilities and includes a varied program of accompanying events and attractive race packages.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, and in 2026 it will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, and 10 km and 5 km races. The finish line is at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique touch to the event. It’s not just a competition, but also an unforgettable experience and a celebration of the running community.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Maciej Frankiewicz Poznań Marathon is the jubilee 25th edition of the classic 42.195 km distance, taking place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. For a quarter of a century, the race has brought together thousands of runners and spectators, offering a new, attractive course that starts and finishes at the Poznań International Fairgrounds. The organizers provide professional medical support, timekeeping, and a generous race pack. It is a unique sporting celebration, backed by enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: The 2nd Radom Oncology Run is a running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The event aims to promote physical activity and support people affected by cancer. The run takes place in Radom and is part of the association’s calendar of running events, which engage the local community in a variety of sporting activities. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The mixed-surface course includes asphalt, paving blocks, compacted gravel paths, and forest trails, making it an attractive and varied route for runners. The event also features 5 km races and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide at least two refreshment stations along the route and professional race office service. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.

name: Wild Run
organizer: Fundacja Zoo Wrocław – DODO i Zoo Wrocław Sp. z o.o.
description: Wild Run is a charity race held in Wrocław, with a course running through Wrocław Zoo. The event aims to support the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on any route. The main race consists of two laps of approximately 5 km each, and races for children and young people are also held. All participants receive commemorative medals, while the top finishers receive prizes from sponsors.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
Halve Marathon Oldenzaal

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voorinschrijving 1 mei tot 1 september 2026: € 23,00 (startbewijs wordt thuisgestuurd)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Inschrijving 2 september tot en met 4 oktober 2026, 10.00 uur: € 28,00 (startbewijs ophalen in het Twents Carmel College)

description: The Oldenzaal Half Marathon is a popular running race held in the rolling Twente countryside. The half-marathon route passes several highlights, including Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg and Paasberg. It is mostly paved, with drink stations every 5 kilometers. The race is suitable for both individual runners and corporate teams, and has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, a corporate race and school races, making the event accessible to a wide audience.
course_highlights: Route through the rolling Twente countryside, with highlights including Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg and Paasberg
Mostly paved course with drink stations every 5 kilometers
Time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes for the half marathon
additional: The half marathon has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. If you arrive at the Bisschopstraat/Oostwal intersection after 13:55, you will be directed off the course. Race bibs for pre-registered participants are sent to their homes; those registering later must collect theirs at Twents Carmel College. There are also several other distances and a corporate race. Young participants have separate start times for the 1 km and 2 km school races. Information about course changes, start times, registration tips and safety. The event is popular with local and recreational runners.

name: 43e Tata Steel Marquetteloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 14 km, 7 km, 3.3 km, 1.3 km
price_range: tegen verhoogd tarief op de dag van het evenement
description: The Tata Steel Marquetteloop is an annual road running event in Heemskerk, organized for the 43rd time in 2026. The race offers several distances, including 3.3 km, 7 km, 14 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km, making it suitable for recreational and more experienced runners alike. The event takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and is organized by AV Dem. The atmosphere is sporty and challenging, with a playful theme that lets participants compete to become the “ruler of Heemskerk.”
course_highlights: Road race in Heemskerk, starting and finishing on Marquettelaan
Distances ranging from 3.3 km to a half marathon (21.1 km)
Includes a kids’ run for young runners
additional: There are currently no race entries available. The event is organized by AV Dem. It has a playful “Speel Run Risk” theme, with participants competing for the title of “ruler of Heemskerk.” Distances for all ages, running clinics, a schools championship, volunteer opportunities, family-friendly event

name: 8 van Drachten
description: De 8 van Drachten is an annual running event in the heart of Friesland, suitable for all ages. With various distances, including an 8 km race, a KidsRun and a Business Run, the event offers a suitable challenge for every runner. The scenic course and sporting community make this a festive and professionally organised running experience in Drachten. The 22nd edition takes place on Sunday, 4 October 2026.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the heart of Drachten
Distances for all ages, including the KidsRun and Business Run
Sporting community and professional organisation
additional: Registration closes on 12 September 2026 at 12:00 and is available online only. Late registration is not possible. Race numbers can be transferred via a resale platform. The prize-giving takes place immediately after the race events. The KidsRun starts at 14:00, and the 8 km and Business Run start at 15:00. Registration is available via the website, and the event is supported by an active online community on Instagram.

name: Rondje Bergen
price_range: early bird korting vanaf mei 2026, exacte prijzen niet vermeld
description: Rondje Bergen is a friendly running event held annually on the first Sunday of October in Bergen (NH). The event offers several distances, including a 1 km junior run and races of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. It is known for its enthusiastic atmosphere and is organised entirely by volunteers. Participants receive a commemorative medal, and prizes are awarded to the best runners in various categories.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 1 km junior run to 10 English miles
The junior run starts in age groups at 1-minute intervals
Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance next to the finish
additional: Individual registration closes on 30 September 2026 at 23:59. Registration on the day of the event is not possible. Race bibs can be resold through the official platform until 20 September 2026. The junior run is for children up to and including 13 years old and starts in age groups at 1-minute intervals. All participants receive a commemorative medal. Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance next to the finish. Registration opens on 8 May 2026; prizes for top runners; medals for all participants; volunteers wanted

name: 57e Langs de Gouweloop
description: The 57th Langs de Gouweloop takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in Waddinxveen, with the start and finish at Gouweplein by the shopping centre. This annual family running event, organised by Sportclub Antilope, offers something for everyone: a 1.3 km Kids Run for children up to 12 years old and 5 km and 10 km races for runners aged 12 and over. The route is a 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting achievements, and welcomes both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km
Start and finish at Gouweplein at Winkelcentrum Waddinxveen
Suitable for all ages, with a Kids Run and races
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sporthal De Dreef, opposite the shopping centre. On-the-day registration is available until half an hour before the start. There is no electronic timekeeping; times can be read from a clock at the start and finish. Parking is available at Sporthal De Dreef and in the car park beneath the shopping centre, with the first two hours free. Course along Gouweplein, discounted registration, family-friendly event

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
description: The Berounka - Tetín Running Series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route crosses hills and offers beautiful views of the Bohemian Karst and the surrounding countryside, including a climb to the Beroun lookout point. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that encourage runners of all levels to stay active outdoors in a friendly atmosphere, with support from local pubs. Refreshments, bag storage, and prizes for the top finishers in each category are available on site.

name: Mrdická mašina
description: Mrdická mašina is a fast 2.0 km run across the meadows of Mrdice in Heřmanův Městec. The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, which includes ten athletics and cycling events around the Mrdice fortress site. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun sporting challenge for all runners. It is organized by the Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec, which supports running and sporting activities in the region.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place on October 7, 2026, in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is also offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; exact location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October, weather permitting.

name: Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The Biberach Autumn Forest Run is a small autumn race in Biberach an der Riß that starts at the Burrenwald parking lot. The event is organized by TG Biberach 1847 e.V. and offers runners a choice of 5 km or 10 km. It is a relaxed running event with no advance registration; participants can register on-site on race day. The route passes through the autumnal Burrenwald area and offers a nature-rich running experience. The entry fee is just 4 euros and includes refreshments at the finish and a certificate, which can be collected later or sent by email.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running rather than long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults and various age groups.

name: Herbstcross des Saalfelder LV
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: NightRun Borne
description: The first edition of NightRun Borne takes place on Friday, October 9, 2026: an atmospheric evening run through the centre of Borne. Participants run or walk a route of approximately 7 kilometres, with a 5-kilometre option, passing through shops and distinctive buildings that open their doors especially for the event. NightRun Borne is not a race; there is no timing, and everyone is a winner. The event is all about the experience, having fun and enjoying the evening together in a magical atmosphere full of light and energy.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Běh Roštejnskou oborou is a friendly race for the general public, held amid the picturesque forests near Růžená in the Vysočina Region. The course follows forest trails and is suitable for all ages from 4 years upwards, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 8,900 metres. The event is part of the Běžec Vysočiny cup and offers a unique experience of running in nature, with the chance to observe local wildlife. It is organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts looking to combine sport with nature.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural scenery and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route winds through Prague’s forested, hilly landscape and passes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It also offers stunning views of the city and the surrounding countryside. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is intended for runners looking to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, creating an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: BKK Walking at Lake Baldeney is part of the Westenergie Marathon weekend in Essen and offers a varied program for walkers, Nordic walkers and runners. The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney, with an additional turnaround section, and features a flat profile and fast cycle paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany’s oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with the support of numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat course around Lake Baldeney
Two laps, with an additional turnaround section on the first lap
Fast cycle paths and early autumn weather
additional: The number of participants is limited to 3,000 because of bottlenecks on the course. The walking program offers routes of up to 14 km. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from volunteers. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; participant limit of 3,000; October weather around 14°C, cloudy; registration with the organizer recommended.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfeld City Run takes place on October 10, 2026, in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in sport. The city run combines recreational, competitive, health and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available via the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic town center
A variety of race distances for all age and ability groups
Attractive prizes, certificates and trophies for top runners and teams
additional: The organizer’s office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31 and on public holidays. The website credits photos to photobello and provides entry lists for the individual races. Road/cross-country run, registration open, various race distances, start and finish in Coesfeld town center, age categories for children, recreational runners, club members and older participants

name: Damscheider Kuckucks-Trail
price_range: Early-Kuckuck 14,00 Euro, Kuckuckspreis 18,00 Euro (9,5 km); Early-Kuckuck 21,00 Euro, Kuckuckspreis 25,00 Euro (21 km)
description: The Damscheider Kuckucks-Trail on October 10, 2026, offers a varied trail-running experience across three distances in the picturesque landscape of the Rhine Heights near Damscheid. The 21 km Extended course runs through Damscheid Forest, over natural meadows and vineyards, and along the Schwede-Bure-Weg to the valley at Oberwesel and back, with around 700 metres of elevation gain. The 9.5 km Best of Trails course offers a classic trail feel with varied terrain and 240 metres of elevation gain. Children can take part in an approximately 1 km Kidsrun around the sports field. The event combines a sporting challenge with enjoyment of nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21 km Extended with approx. 700 metres of elevation gain through forest, meadows, vineyards and the valley
9.5 km Best of Trails with varied terrain and 240 metres of elevation gain
Approx. 1 km Kidsrun at the edge of the forest and around the sports field, designed to be child-friendly and fun
additional: Bib collection from 11:00 a.m. at Damscheid sports field. Personalised bibs with timing transponders for the main races. Aid stations along the courses, drinks at the start and finish, and a barbecue stand and cakes at the sports field. Showers and changing rooms available on site. Dogs are not permitted during the competition. Trail running on hiking paths; course distances of 9.5 km and 21 km; children's race planned; registration opens on May 16, 2026; timing by Race Result; personalised bibs with transponders.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
description: The Lindenseelaufserie is a long-standing running event in Rüsselsheim at the Lindensee, held annually. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on varied routes around the lake. The series is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. Participants can look forward to a scenic course and a friendly running community.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Lindensee in Rüsselsheim
Varied routes for different age and ability levels
Scenic and well-marked running paths
additional: Races in November and January; no series ranking for the 5 km race; start and finish area moved to a field path; moderate entry fees; awards for top finishers and age groups

name: Loßburger Waldlauf
description: The Loßburg Forest Run is a traditional autumn forest run in Loßburg, Germany, organized by Skiclub Loßburg. The event is being held for the 30th time and offers runners a varied route on roads and forest paths, with no laps on a track. There are several distances, including a 400 m run for children and young people and a challenging 10 km run for adults with a hilly profile. The races start in the evening, with the 10 km run beginning at 19:00.
course_highlights: Forest and road run in October
Hilly profile for the 10 km run
Children’s and youth events over a 400 m distance
additional: The 10 km run starts at 19:00; the shorter run (6.7 km) starts earlier in the evening. The event takes place at the school center in Loßburg. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Registration is open until October 9, 2026. The event also includes children’s and youth races at various distances, including a 400 m run for the youngest participants.

name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional fun run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition on October 10, 2026. It is the oldest fun run in the region and offers a range of distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow varied routes along paved agricultural roads and gravel forest paths. Every participant receives a certificate, and children also receive bumper-car tokens. The event takes place as part of the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured distances of 500 m, 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Varied routes featuring paved roads and gravel forest paths
Run held as part of the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the relevant start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Forum multipurpose hall, 2 km away; basic changing facilities without showers are available at the start area. The awards ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle at the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and the start/finish area; heavy traffic may cause delays. Races over 500 m, 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m; online registration until one day before the race; late registration available on race day; race bibs distributed at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available
additional: A start-number deposit of 2.00 EUR is collected by SEPA direct debit when registering online and refunded in cash on the event day when the start number with chip is returned. The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The Harz Mountain Run warm-up is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. The event starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, and offers distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km, and 22 km. At the finish, participants are welcomed with tea and bread with lard. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hannover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Each participation earns a stamp in the running pass, which is available both digitally and in a traditional format. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.

name: Abt-Degen-Lauf
description: The Abt-Degen Run organized by TV 1884 Zeil is a traditional running event taking place for the 30th time on October 10, 2026. Various distances are offered, including an 11 km main race, 1,600 m and 800 m races for students, and a children’s race. The event provides a well-organized course, timing, race-number pickup, showers and changing rooms, refreshments, and an awards ceremony. The race welcomes runners of all ages and promotes a sense of sporting community in Zeil am Main.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
description: The Brakelsiek fun run “At the Foot of the Mörth” is a classic local running, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports field, and the route runs around the village sports field, with a gently rolling rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The 2026 Autumn Run takes place on October 10 at the Waldstadion Schutterwald. The course covers 10 kilometers of flat forest and field paths, measured and marked in accordance with DLV specifications. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers an appealing running opportunity in a natural setting. Registration is online via my.raceresult.com, and the organizer is happy to answer questions by email.

name: IKK Südwest Freundschaftslauf
description: The IKK Südwest Friendship Run is a traditional timed run in Marpingen, offering various running distances as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is not a competition; it focuses on community and the joy of running. Routes range from 5.5 km to 11 km, as well as hiking routes with no timekeeping. The run is organized by the Saarland Athletics Federation and takes place on October 10, 2026.

name: Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf
description: The Kuppingen Mooncatcher Run is a special run into the night that has replaced the well-known Zigeunerberglauf since 2009. It features illuminated sections of the course that create a unique running atmosphere. As the sixth and final race in the Schönbuch Cup series, it traditionally takes place on the second Saturday in October. The event is firmly rooted in the region and appeals to runners who appreciate a special atmosphere while running.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners in the region the opportunity to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, continuing through woods and natural surroundings with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the run, the organizer provides food and refreshments, and football matches are often held at the sports ground, making for a lovely day of sport for participants and their companions.

name: Pegnitztallauf 2026
description: The Pegnitztallauf is an afternoon event in Vorra, Germany, featuring a flat, single-lap course with no repeated laps. Events include 5 km races for adults and youth, a 10 km race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking for adults. Children’s and youth races round out the program, making this a local, club-oriented running event. The finish is at the tennis facility in 91247 Vorra, and the start is at 3:00 p.m.

name: Ramsthaler Wein-Berg-Lauf
description: The Ramsthal Wine Mountain Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ramsthal. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to schoolchildren, teenagers, and adults. The routes pass through Ramsthal’s picturesque vineyards and offer varied scenery. In addition to the running events, there is also a walking route that lets participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race starts at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. It is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, so it is not an easy, flat city course. It is aimed primarily at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and refreshments at the finish.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with Walking around AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.

name: Lysfald Løbet 3. oktober i Fårup Sommerland 2026
Janlouterloop
description: The Janlouterloop is an annual running event in Vlaardingen’s Broekpolder, held in memory of Jan Louter, a passionate runner and coach who died of pancreatic cancer in 2024. Participants can choose from three running distances (5, 10 and 15 kilometres) or a 10-kilometre walking route. The event is organised by AV Fortuna and supports the charity ‘Support Casper’, part of the Stichting Overleven met Alvleesklierkanker. The Janlouterloop combines sport, togetherness and an experience of nature in a unique polder setting.

name: 1 MIJL IN LINE
description: The 7th edition of the Mijl in Line is organised by Atletiekvereniging Cromstrijen on Saturday, 10 October 2026. It is a unique race over 1,609 metres in a straight line on Lange Biesakkersweg, halfway between Klaaswaal and Numansdorp. Participants can enjoy a fast, straight course, with a fun trophy for every participant and prizes for the winners. Registration is open until 9 October via inschrijven.nl, with late registration available on the day from 16:00.

name: 10e Oosterhoutse Trail
description: The Oosterhout Trail celebrates its 10th anniversary edition on Saturday, 10 October 2026. For ten years, this unique trail-running event has offered beautiful routes and challenging unpaved paths in a friendly atmosphere. Participants can choose from three different distances to suit a range of abilities. For this anniversary edition, the first 100 registrants will receive an exclusive anniversary shirt. After the race, everyone will celebrate the anniversary together at a festive closing event.

name: DECAloop Utrecht
description: The DECAloop Utrecht is a challenging running race taking place in Utrecht on 10 October 2026. The race covers a distance of 67 kilometres and starts at 08:00. It offers long-distance runners a unique opportunity to test their endurance in an atmospheric setting. Registration is easy via an online form, and the price is very attractive for this distance.

name: Mijn City Run Ede
description: Mijn City Run Ede is a unique running event taking place in the centre of Ede on 10 October 2026. The race features a fast and spectacular 1-kilometre route through the city centre, with an accessible programme for all ages, including kids’ races, a family run and a business run. The day concludes with a final in which the fastest recreational runners compete against national and international elite athletes. The event combines sporting spirit with a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, including athletes with disabilities.

name: LoveLife Run Amsterdam
description: LoveLife Run Amsterdam is a special running event held on October 10 at the Olympic Stadium. Courageous current and former cancer patients run 5 or 10 kilometers alongside their loved ones and healthcare providers to raise money for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to take part or support the participants, even if they have never had cancer themselves. The event combines an athletic challenge with a powerful message of hope and solidarity.

name: Hernense Stratenloop
description: The Hernense Stratenloop is a small-scale recreational running race held in the picturesque village of Hernen. The 17th edition takes place on Saturday, 10 October 2026, with four distances: 600 metres, 1,200 metres, 5 kilometres and 10 kilometres. The routes run through the village and the beautiful surrounding countryside, passing the medieval castle, the grain mill, Hernense Forest and rural Leur. The event is suitable for all ages and offers a sporty, sociable afternoon with a warm atmosphere and plenty of spectators along the route.

name: Noordduinloop
description: The Duinloop Circuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, with varied courses combining challenging dune trails and fast beach sections. The Noordduinloop, held on 10 October 2026, offers a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from kids’ runs to 10 km. The circuit encourages participation through a ranking based on each runner’s best four results.

name: PrattenburgRun
description: The PrattenburgRun is a running race held at Landgoed Prattenburg in Veenendaal. The 11th edition takes place on Saturday, 10 October 2026, and attracts a broad audience of running enthusiasts. There are three distances: marked 5 km and 10 km routes, and a challenging 15 km trail run with approximately 178 metres of elevation gain. Participants receive a GPX file for navigation. Proceeds from the entry fees go towards protecting young deciduous trees on the estate.

name: Venoseloop
description: The Venoseloop is an annual running race held on the second Saturday of October in Vollenhove. The race offers distances of 5 and 10 kilometres and starts at 11:00 from the 't Akkertien holiday park. The route passes through the beautiful countryside around Vollenhove, allowing participants to enjoy the surroundings as they run. The Venoseloop is known for its welcoming atmosphere and good organisation, with facilities including changing rooms and showers, first aid, and timekeeping using the IPICO chip system.

name: Run2Day Vlinderloop
description: The Run2Day Vlinderloop in Houten is a monthly running event held on the second Saturday of each month from September through May. The route passes through the countryside around Houten, including Kasteel Heemstede and the Amsterdam–Rhine Canal, offering a lovely mix of nature and culture. Distances range from 5.2 km to a half marathon, with events suitable for both young people and adults. The start is at Korfbal Vereniging Victum. The atmosphere is friendly and sporty, with an emphasis on running together and having fun.

name: AVW 3bossentrail
description: The AVW 3Bossentrail takes place on 10 October 2026 in Wieringerwerf and runs through three forests in the Wieringermeer. The routes range from 14 to 28 kilometres and follow walking trails, single tracks and boardwalks, with the course mostly off-road. There is also a 14 km canitrail, with dogs required to be on a lead. The trail run focuses on enjoying nature rather than competition, and staggered start groups help ensure a calm start in the forest.

name: Cena Metuje
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
description: Cena Metuje is a traditional 10 km road race held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also offers races for young athletes in various age categories. The route follows an asphalt road through the Metuje River valley to Peklo and back, providing an enjoyable yet challenging running experience. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, parents, and grandparents, who can earn points in the series. Winners are awarded in both the children’s categories and the main race, with cash and non-cash prizes.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around the Brno Reservoir, held on October 10, 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, approximately one-third of a marathon. The course is gently undulating, mostly on asphalt with some rocky sections, and offers beautiful views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle, and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in the steamboat relay, four-person teams, companies, and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: The Borský Park Run is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň, with a history dating back to 1970. The race is open to everyone, from beginner recreational runners to experienced athletes of all ages. It offers the excitement of the starting line, the thrill of the race atmosphere, and the joy of crossing the finish line. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment and homemade refreshments for all participants.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
description: Běhej lesy Lednice is part of a popular running series offering races in some of the Czech Republic’s most beautiful natural settings. The Lednice race takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, where runners pass through the château park, around ponds, and by iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and the Apollo Temple. The routes suit runners of different ability levels and include the shorter Nova 14 km and the longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The event also features competitions on speed sections and an exciting finish straight, providing extra motivation for participants.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
description: Hradčanské Vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main distances: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The race focuses on off-road running, mostly on forest and field paths, making for an attractive and challenging course. The event also includes children’s categories with various distances. Runners can enjoy refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities, including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced trail runners.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
location: Stromovka Park, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run of Olymp is a traditional running race organized by the Olymp Prague Police Sports Club. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant urban park. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. The organizers welcome all participants and provide support during registration and throughout the race.

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and 10K through the Jizera Region is a traditional running race set in the picturesque village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers half-marathon and 10-kilometre routes through the beautiful countryside of the Jizera Region, with varied terrain. It is organised by TJ Benešov u Semil, which provides a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for runners and their supporters. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and is part of the village’s sporting activities.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Běh Bukovem is an annual running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place entirely on meadows, forest roads, and trails, offering runners an enjoyable experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from the youngest children to veterans. It is organized by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farma Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.

name: Kašavský kros
description: Kašava Cross-Country Run is a traditional trail race in the Kašava area, offering two main routes for runners aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races. The event takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its established course with hills and a pleasant atmosphere. It is organized by the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association in cooperation with the local municipality and school. The children’s races take place after the main races and are divided into several age categories, with different course lengths.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultra-trail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surrounding area. The race is designed for experienced runners seeking a challenging course in beautiful countryside along marked hiking trails. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality event support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to welcoming you to the next edition on October 10, 2026.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybí Challenge is a road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice in cooperation with the Municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race is 7 km long with 135 metres of elevation gain and is open to various age categories for both men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch, and runners can use the provided changing rooms and showers. Refreshments are available at the finish, along with prizes for the top runners in each category, including an award for the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
description: The Run for Kleofáš is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from short children’s races to a 12-kilometre run around Svět Pond. Less experienced runners can enjoy a pleasant four-kilometre route, and there is also a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a varied programme of activities for children and is part of Hospice Week.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad Špindlerův Mlýn, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna is the traditional 34th edition of a mountain race held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and features a challenging 14 km course with 901 metres of elevation gain. It is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts looking to test themselves in the beautiful mountain setting of the Krkonoše.

name: Červený okruh
description: The Červený okruh in Doksy is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, taking place on 10 October 2026. The race gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the natural surroundings of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a regional running race series and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. The organizers provide a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the reservoir in Baška, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and supporting sporting activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in beautiful natural surroundings. Both experienced runners and recreational athletes are welcome to register and take part.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
description: The St. Wenceslas Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race held on October 10 in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports people with multiple sclerosis through proceeds from entry fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The first ten people to register will receive a discount on Tyreto tire purchases.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The 30th Commando Knife Cross-Country Race is a prestigious running event held under the honorary patronage of the Polish Military Bishop, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is intended for soldiers and uniformed services personnel, who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to determine the uniformed services cross-country champions, promote mass-participation running, and bring together uniformed services communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium, finishing on the stadium track. The women’s race starts at 12:00 and the men’s at 12:27.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, community, and the joy of movement, welcoming runners of different ages and abilities. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross events, and entry to the Grand Prix is free.

name: 2 Maraton od Źródeł do Ujścia Grabiszynki
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The events combine recreation and sport, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race numbers and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is 60 zł. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the participant’s main location, subject to prior notification by email. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born in 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00. The stated date of October 9, 2027, is not confirmed by the available season dates.

LIII Maraton Pieszy w Puszczy Kampinoskiej
VIII Półmaraton Lasy nad Utratą
location: Michałowice, Michałowice Municipality, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

XIV Cross Centaura
location: Biały Bór, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

location: Zębowice, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Maraton Sztafetowy Miast i Gmin
Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Berglauf
location: Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The mountain run organized by the Schneelaufverein Geislingen is a long-standing event held annually in Geislingen an der Steige. The route climbs uphill and offers runners a challenging course in a scenic setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere. Registration is handled through MY RACE RESULT, with the deadline falling shortly before the race.
course_highlights: Uphill route with a challenging elevation profile
Scenic surroundings in Geislingen an der Steige
Start and finish at the SVG ski hut, Dorfstr. 70
additional: Registration and results are handled through MY RACE RESULT. The registration deadline is 12:00 noon on the Saturday before the race. The start and finish are at the SVG ski hut in Geislingen an der Steige (Weiler o. H. district). The event takes place on October 11, 2026; route and elevation profiles are available; registration is through Race Result; the venue is SVG Dorfstr. 70, Geislingen an der Steige.

name: Citylauf Schwabach 2026
description: The RIBE Citylauf Schwabach on 11 October 2026 offers a varied running programme for all age groups and ability levels. Events include a half marathon, relay, main race, fun run, walking and children’s races. The races start and finish at Königsplatz in Schwabach, and participants can expect a well-organised event with a family-friendly atmosphere. The route leads through the city and offers a special running experience in Schwabach, the City of Gold Leaf.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approx. 21.1 km
Start and finish at Königsplatz next to the town hall
A variety of race distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are possible only on race weekend, subject to availability. Places are limited, and on-site late entries are not available for sold-out events. Participants in the main races must be at least 16 years old; the maximum time is 3 hours. Relay legs are approx. 7 km each. The start and finish are at Königsplatz next to the town hall and at Fürstenherberge, respectively. Registration is open until 4 October 2026. A variety of categories are available for different age groups and ability levels. Refreshments are provided at several points along the route.

name: Geilenkirchener Volkslauf und 34. Halbmarathon
description: The Geilenkirchen Volkslauf and Half Marathon is a long-standing running event in Geilenkirchen-Gillrath, organized by DJK-Gillrath e. V. The event offers a flat 21.1 km half-marathon course as well as several other distances, including a 10 km run, 10 km walking and Nordic walking, a 4 km run, youth races and a Bambini run. All races finish at the Gillrath sports ground, where race materials are also distributed. The event caters to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a five-year series ranking as well as the RAC ranking.
course_highlights: Flat, technically straightforward half-marathon course
4 km course is wheelchair-accessible
Events for people with disabilities in the 2.5 km and 4 km races
additional: Start and finish at the Gillrath sports ground; race-number pickup on site at the race office; the half marathon and 10 km run count toward the five-year series ranking and the RAC ranking; October weather is typically around 14 °C (daily high), with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Several events for adults and children/young people; accessible course sections; participation in series and RAC rankings; on-site registration at the Gillrath sports ground.

name: Salzachbrückenlauf
description: The Salzach Bridge Run starts and finishes at Burghausen town square, below Burghausen Castle, the longest castle complex in the world. The route follows the Salzach, which forms the border between Germany and Austria, and includes several border crossings. Various distances are offered, including a 505-metre parent-child run, a 3.2 km fun run, a 5.5 km walk and the 8.8 km main race. More than 1,000 participants take part each year, from children and recreational runners to club runners and fast athletes. The run is a charity event organised by nine volunteers, with proceeds supporting local people in need.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Burghausen town square below the castle
The route crosses the Salzach and the German-Austrian border
The 8.8 km route includes four border crossings and sections on gravel paths by the bathing lake
additional: The run takes place annually under the patronage of Bürgerinsel Burghausen. The 8.8 km route includes a second lap and passes a bathing lake and a rowing lake. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple distances, including a 505 m route; charity event; scenic surroundings around Burghausen; open to children, recreational runners and competitive runners.

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, the road race has welcomed children, young people, active adults, and masters since 2016. Distances offered are 10 km, 5 km, and an 800 m children’s run, which takes place in the tree park near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course completes the loop twice
800 m children’s run in the tree park directly by Schloss Erbhof
additional: The 5 km course is also suitable for Nordic walking. October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s run, “Löwenlauf,” is designed specifically for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s run in the tree park; October weather with temperatures around 14°C low and 6°C high, 40 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the lakeshore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is very well organized and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: A run around the Baldeneysee with picturesque lakeside scenery
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area
additional: The start and finish are at Seaside Beach on the Baldeneysee. Late registration on the event day is paperless and uses a QR code. Children can take part in a 1.1 km mini-marathon, with a prize and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes include various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area. The marathon is Germany’s oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, several race disciplines, and support for the region. Results and certificates are available online.
