description: The Ottenstein Wottellauf is a long-standing running event held annually in Ottenstein near Ahaus. The event offers various races for children and adults, including 10 km, 5 km, and several shorter children’s races. The races start at Sportplatz 1, 48683 Ahaus-Ottenstein, and are known for their friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. All participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies, making the race especially appealing to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportplatz 1 in Ahaus-Ottenstein
A range of distances from 200 m to 10 km
Friendly atmosphere with awards for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the venue. An unattended bag drop is available. Certificates are provided online. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3 in the 5 km and 10 km races. Every child receives a medal. Prizes are awarded to the largest group. Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press and social media. Registration until 23.10.2025, start times from 11:05, showers and changing rooms available, photos and videos during the event

name: Starzachlauf
description: The Starzach Run is a long-standing running event in Wachendorf, offering various distances for all age groups. The routes pass through the beautiful countryside around Starzach and offer a varied experience for both recreational and competitive runners. In addition to the main race, there are children’s and youth races, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and known for its welcoming atmosphere and good organisation.
course_highlights: 10.7 km main race through the Starzach countryside
5.2 km recreational run
Children’s and youth races over distances of approximately 400 m to 1,300 m
additional: Race number collection from 8:00 a.m. at the Starzach Wachendorf multipurpose hall. Electronic timing with a transponder (provided with the race documents). Awards ceremony at approximately 12:00 p.m. at the multipurpose hall. Prizes for overall winners and age-group winners; medals for children’s race participants. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the start, with a €3 late-entry fee. Distances: 10.7 km, 5.2 km, children’s and youth races; registration until 22 October 2026; prizes for winners and children’s groups; refreshments available on site.

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt Volkswaldlauf takes place on 25 October 2026 in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground
Event as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports ground is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground; October weather: approx. 14°C, 6°C low, 40mm of precipitation, cloudy

name: Mönchsdegginger Lauf zum Plossen - 1. Lauf Jedermannlaufserie
35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat races for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini race for the youngest participants and a 1 km students’ race, allowing families and club runners to take part together, with participants grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Races for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are grouped by distance and age category. There is a 400 m Bambini race and a 1 km students’ race. All races finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of events, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbst Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, starting and finishing at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course is a flat 5-kilometer loop on paved and mixed surfaces that also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on paved and mixed surfaces
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run with medals and certificates.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on 25 October 2026. The event offers a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for rankings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age categories and overall standings.
course_highlights: DLV-measured half-marathon course to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional events
Awards for places 1–6 in the overall standings
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timekeeper’s website, www.timeteam-jung.de. Awards ceremonies will take place in the tent as soon as possible after the races. Parking is available at Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. DJK Gütersloh accepts no liability for accidents, theft or other damage. Measurement to DLV/IAAF/AIMS standards, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, disclaimer of liability, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de

name: BW Forstsportlauf im Naturpark Schönbuch
description: The BW Forest Sports Run in Schönbuch Nature Park is an exciting running event set in the park’s picturesque surroundings. Organized by Forstsportverein Baden-Württemberg e.V., the event gives runners of all levels the opportunity to experience nature and the forest in a sporting atmosphere. The race features varied terrain in the forest and invites both recreational and competitive runners to discover the beauty of Schönbuch. Further details about registration and the event schedule are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: Run through Schönbuch Nature Park in Tübingen
Varied forest terrain
Event for runners of all levels
additional: Several events in the forest sports calendar, with registration and accommodation information available. Scheduled for October 2026.

name: Friedrichstaler Waldlauf
description: The Friedrichstal Forest Run is part of the Stutensee Cup and will be held for the 11th time in 2026. The event comprises four scoring races over 10 km. Runners are automatically included in the standings if they take part in at least three races. The course offers an attractive running opportunity in autumnal Friedrichstal and welcomes runners of all ability levels. The five fastest runners will be honored after the final race on October 25, 2026. The event is organized by TV Friedrichstal 1899 e.V., the largest club in Stutensee.
course_highlights: Four scoring races over 10 km
Run through the autumnal Friedrichstal Forest
Take part in at least three races to qualify for the Stutensee Cup standings
additional: The five fastest runners will be honored after the Friedrichstal Forest Run on 25.10.2026. Registration opens in September. Runners are automatically included in the Stutensee Cup standings after taking part in at least three of the four 10 km races. If they take part in all four races, their three fastest times count. Registration opens in September, nature experience, community event

name: FSV-Lauf

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km Staffel 7 € pro Teilnehmer:in -> inkl. 2 € Spende an die Erlanger Tafel

description: The FSV Run takes place on October 25, 2026, in the Brucker Lache in Erlangen and offers races for all age groups, from Bambinis to adults. The course is a relatively flat 5 km loop, which runners complete twice for the 10 km race. Alongside the sporting experience, social engagement is also a focus: €2 per participant is donated to the Förderverein Erlanger Tafel. Children can enjoy medals and face painting, and free fruit, tea and non-alcoholic wheat beer are available in the finish area. The event also prioritizes environmental protection, for example by allowing participants to label and store their own bottles.
course_highlights: Relatively flat 5 km loop in the Brucker Lache
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Course suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the starts, for a €2 late-registration fee. The Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are free. There is face painting, medals for children, changing facilities at the primary school, and free refreshments in the finish area, including fruit, tea and non-alcoholic wheat beer. The event supports the Förderverein Erlanger Tafel with donations per participant. Races over 0.4 km, 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus relay races; registration online and on the day of the event; eco-friendly travel by bicycle or bus; children’s activities and refreshments on site; donations to the Erlanger Tafel

name: Lauf um den Eisbrunn - 1. Lauf der Jedermannserie
location: Sportgelände des SV Mauren, Harburg, Donau-Ries, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Lauf um den Eisbrunn kicks off the LG Donau-Ries everyone’s running series in late autumn. The road race takes place in Harburg, with the start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds. Events include a main race of approximately 10 km, a 3 km short race, and a 7 km walking route. The event welcomes all running enthusiasts, from children to club runners, and offers a friendly atmosphere for individual entrants and series runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds in Harburg
Main race of approx. 10 km, plus a 3 km short race and a 7 km walking route
Local late-autumn road race with typical October weather around 14 °C
additional: Race numbers with transponders are distributed on site before the start. The main race starts in the morning, followed by the shorter events. The series concludes with a final in Nördlingen on the third Sunday of Advent. A local race for all age groups, including children, teenagers, adults, and walkers. The series finale in Nördlingen offers community runners a good opportunity to prepare for winter.

name: Ohmbachsee Halbmarathon
location: Turn- und Festhalle Brücken, Brücken, Kusel, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Ohmbachsee Half Marathon is a long-standing race held annually at the picturesque Ohmbachsee in Brücken. The course passes through varied landscapes and offers runners an appealing mix of nature and sporting challenge. The event is organized by Laufgemeinschaft Ohmbachsee e.V. and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race starts at the Turn- und Festhalle Brücken, which also serves as the central meeting point.
course_highlights: Run along the picturesque Ohmbachsee
Varied natural course with forest and lakeside sections
Start and finish at the Turn- und Festhalle Brücken
additional: The race takes place on 25 October 2026, starting at 10:00 a.m. at the Turn- und Festhalle Brücken. The course is approximately 21 km long and runs from Dellstraße to the Ohmbachsee. Registration is available online and on site. The event is scheduled to take place in all weather conditions and has an established place in the regional running scene.

name: Pfinztallauf
description: The Pfinztal Run is a traditional event held annually at Hopfenberg Stadium in Pfinztal. The course runs through the idyllic countryside along the Pfinz, passing Söllingen and Kleinsteinbach, with a turnaround point in Kleinsteinbach. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to 10 km runs. After finishing in the stadium, participants can enjoy a warm atmosphere with an awards ceremony, trophies, medals, and a large cake buffet in the TSV hall.
course_highlights: The route runs through Pfinztal and along a scenic section of the Pfinz
Turnaround point at the Kleinsteinbach festival grounds
Finish at Hopfenberg Stadium, with a stadium announcer
additional: Start times: 09:30 for the 3 km school team race and 5 km run, 10:00 for the 10 km run, and from 11:15 for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races. The course partly follows cycle paths and roads, including railway underpasses. After the race, there is a large cake buffet and an awards ceremony with trophies, medals, and certificates in the TSV hall. The event offers a range of distances, including school and youth competitions, with refreshments and an awards ceremony at Hopfenberg Stadium.

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: Thüngersheimer Bocksbeutellauf 2026
description: The Thüngersheim Bocksbeutel Run is a traditional race held annually in Thüngersheim. The event offers runners of all ages a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, with a generous runners’ buffet, a large cake and coffee bar, and a medal and bottle of wine for every finisher. Children receive a small gift. The race is a celebration of the local running community, combining sporting ambition with a sociable gathering.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque wine region around Thüngersheim
Generous runners’ buffet and large cake and coffee bar
A bottle of wine for every finisher, or a gift for children
additional: Every finisher receives a medal and a bottle of wine; children receive a small gift. A generous runners’ buffet and a large cake and coffee bar are available. Registration is open until 14.09.2026 to benefit from lower fees. Distances: 600 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; date: 25 October 2026; local race, family- and club-friendly

Diepe Hel Holterbergloop 2026

name: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE
description: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE is a social running clinic held on the last Sunday of October, starting and finishing at Out Of Office Coffee in Westergas, Amsterdam. The event begins at 11:00 with running drills focusing on technique and speed, followed by a group run accompanied by music. This event celebrates the final day of 30 years of the Amsterdam Dance Event, combining sport and music in a unique and enjoyable way.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Out Of Office Coffee, Westergas
Includes running drills focusing on technique and speed
Group run with music accompaniment
additional: The event is a running clinic open to everyone, emphasizing social participation and enjoyment. It is part of the Amsterdam Dance Event festival program and celebrates the event's 30th anniversary. The venue Out Of Office Coffee is open Fri - Sun 10 - 17 and Tue - Thu 09 - 16. Participants can enjoy a relaxed run combined with music and a convivial atmosphere, perfect for both recreational runners and fans of the dance festival.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km

name: Duinentrail Schoorl
description: The DYNAFIT Duinentrail Schoorl 2026 is a challenging trail run through the beautiful dune area around Schoorl, Bergen, Hargen and Camperduin, featuring the highest dune peaks in the Netherlands. The trails range from 12 km to 50 km and include a swim trail and various kids’ trails. All routes start and finish at Laguna Beach. The combination of dunes and coast makes for a unique and varied running experience, with October weather conditions adding an extra challenge. This 14th edition offers a perfect location for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Trail through the highest dune area in the Netherlands
Varied terrain with hills, narrow paths and mud
Start and finish at Laguna Beach, right on the beach
additional: There is a test run/course preview on 17 September. The start and finish location is ideal for runners and supporters. Participants should have experience with off-road terrain and be in good physical condition. Participation is at your own risk. Trail, Swim Trail, beach activities, two-day programme, various distances, start and finish at Laguna Beach Schoorl

name: Parkcross Hoorn
location: De Blauwe Berg, Hoorn, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Parkcross in Hoorn, organized by A.V. Hollandia, is an annual cross-country race held at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit and attracts both youth and senior runners. The Parkcross offers a challenging course in a park-like setting, suitable for runners of different levels. The organizers are known for their hospitality and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a park-like setting
Challenging terrain with natural features
Suitable for youth, juniors, seniors, and masters
additional: Registration is via Atletiek.nu. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit. The event takes place at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex in Hoorn. The cross-country race is held in Risdammerhout neighborhood park; registration is available on the day. The course features mud and hills, and the location is near Sportpark de Blauwe Berg.

name: Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl
description: The Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl is a unique running event held annually in October, and in 2026 it will celebrate its fourteenth edition. The main distance is 4 nautical miles (7.408 km), taking runners past green spaces, the sea, the harbour, the beach and historic sites in Delfzijl. The race starts at the athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in the town centre. In addition to the individual 4 Zeemijlenloop, there is a corporate run and a kids’ run, making the event suitable for a range of participants. The race has a strong regional character but attracts participants from across the Netherlands. The course is wide, varied and distinctive because its distance is measured in nautical miles.
course_highlights: 7.408 km route past the sea, harbour, beach and green spaces
Starts at the Burgemeester Boeremalaan athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in central Delfzijl
Passes historic sites such as the statue of Maigret and the Damsterdiep
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday evening and Sunday morning at the AV Fivelstreek clubhouse and in central Delfzijl. Late registration is not available for the 4 Zeemijlenloop. The prize-giving takes place after the races. There is a party tent and a post-race gathering after the corporate run. The event takes place in October, with start and registration points at the athletics track and in central Delfzijl, and includes various race categories.

name: Jan de Vos Najaarscross
location: Kralingse Bos, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Jan de Vos Autumn Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in Kralingse Bos in Rotterdam. It is organised by PAC Rotterdam, the oldest athletics club in the Netherlands. The course runs along natural paths with hills, bushes and tree trunks, making for a varied and demanding running experience. The cross is suitable for participants of all ages and attracts many enthusiastic runners each year.
course_highlights: Start at the Beachhouse by the beach in Kralingse Bos
Includes a hill behind the petting zoo
Natural obstacles such as bushes, tree trunks and slippery paths
additional: The cross consists of two laps of approximately 4 kilometres. The race is suitable for participants aged 17 to 70 and over. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and an opportunity to chat over a drink. The aim for next year is to also offer a shorter distance of approximately 4 km for younger athletes. The event takes place in the Kralingse Bos area, a popular location for running races in Rotterdam.

name: Het Achtje van Atledo
description: The Achtje van Atledo is a running event organised by Atletiek- en Trimvereniging Atledo in Dongen. Atledo is a large and active club with a modern athletics track and a wide range of training sessions for all ages and levels. The event takes place in a green sports area alongside the canal and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for both competitive and recreational runners. The club is known for its expert guidance and focus on injury prevention.
course_highlights: Modern athletics track with good grip and cushioning
Located in a green sports area alongside the canal
Facilities for various athletics disciplines in addition to running
additional: Atledo offers training for all levels and ages, including a 'Run for Fun' programme for beginner runners and an 'Older Adults in Motion' programme. The club has a clubhouse with a sports café and extensive facilities for technical athletics events. Running or walking, date 25 October 2026, starts from 10:00.

name: Strand TIEN cross
description: The Strand TIEN Cross on Sunday, October 25, 2026, is the first race in the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition 2026–2027, a series of six small-scale, accessible running races on unpaved courses in and around Oss. The cross offers both a long distance of approximately 10 km and a short distance of approximately 5 km, as well as special youth cross races over shorter distances. The races are suitable for runners of all levels and ages, giving participants the chance to measure themselves against others, pursue personal goals, and enjoy running in nature. Anyone who takes part in at least four races has a chance to place in the overall standings.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km
Special youth cross races over shorter distances
additional: The cross competition consists of six races. Taking part in at least four races in the same category qualifies participants for a place in the overall standings. The races take place on Sunday mornings and are small-scale and accessible. There is a youth race for younger runners. You can get in touch via WhatsApp or SMS at 06 37 30 12 02. The race is part of a series of six small-scale, accessible running races in Oss, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl.

name: Craft x Luyckx Sport Oercross
location: Former US Military Terrain, Havelterberg, Netherlands
description: The Craft x Luyckx Sport OER Cross is a challenging cross-country race, organised for the seventh time by AV De Sprinter on 25 October 2026. The race takes place on the wooded, hilly training grounds of the former American base in Havelterberg. The OER Cross is part of the prestigious Athletics Union Cross Country Series and serves as a qualifying race for the European Cross Country Championships. There are various distances for youth and adults, divided by age category.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly training grounds of the Ministry of Defence’s Havelte-West site
Located at the former American base in Havelterberg
Part of the Cross Country Series and a European Cross Country Championships qualifying race
additional: Parking is permitted only at the car park of Darper Football and Sports Association; parking on the Ministry of Defence training grounds is prohibited. Flying a drone during the event is strictly prohibited. Test runs are organised in collaboration with Craft and Luyckx Sport to try out the course and new shoes. The OER Cross is one of four top races that count towards the national cross-country ranking. The event takes place at the former American base in Havelterberg, with registration via Inschrijven.nl. The site is known for its challenging, hilly and wooded setting. Parking is available at the grounds of Darper Football and Sports Association. Drone use is not permitted during the event.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and offers a chance to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. Each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition to find Prague’s most athletic district. Original medals are prepared for runners as keepsakes from each edition.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
A series of races held across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ scores. Special medals are prepared for each category as unique keepsakes from the race. The official website lists a previous edition in Ladronka Park; the date 24 October 2027 is not confirmed by the available sources.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon course runs through wooded and rural areas, offering runners peace and contact with nature, with a distinctive point on the loop at Napoleon’s Stone. The race has a friendly, informal character, without competitive pressure or crowds, creating a welcoming atmosphere for logging miles together. The organizers, including local runner Arek Tołłoczko, take care of course markings and participants’ comfort. In 2024, a series of four marathons on this course is planned, taking place at different times of the year.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course through forests and picturesque fields
A loop featuring the distinctive Napoleon’s Stone as a landmark
Every kilometre marked, with the start/finish on Polna Street
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club from Jelcz-Laskowice; convenient parking; no crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without competitive pressure; a planned series of four marathons in 2024, taking place in winter, spring, summer and autumn. Sources describe a 42.195 km marathon course; there is no confirmed information about the entry fee or registration for the 2027 edition.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan is a marathon held around Lake Paprocany in Tychy on a 7 km loop. Participants can choose any distance by running multiples of the loop, up to a full marathon. The event is recreational and intended for training, with no need to declare a distance in advance. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizers emphasize that the atmosphere and sense of community among runners matter more than competition. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Lake Paprocany
Paved sections (over 50%), along with compacted paths and forest trails
A station with drinks, fruit, and sweets after each loop
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Irysy restaurant by Lake Paprocany in Tychy (ul. Parkowa 17) on October 23, 2026, from 14:00 to 17:00; October 24, 2026, from 10:00 to 15:00; and on race day from 8:00 to 9:30. A third party may collect a race number with written authorization. Participants under 18 must have consent from a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in the storage area, marked with the race number.

24. Röntgenlauf
description: The Röntgenlauf in Remscheid is a traditional cross-country race with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon and ultramarathon. The half marathon is especially popular, attracting up to 1,500 participants, and is considered one of Germany’s largest cross-country races. The routes pass through varied natural scenery, with forest trails and paved sections; the half marathon covers about one third of the Röntgenweg. A shuttle service takes half marathon participants from the finish back to the start. The event also places emphasis on environmental protection by recommending reusable drinking cups.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races on a loop between Hackenberg and Wuppersperre, with approximately 95 m and 190 m of elevation gain, respectively
Half marathon with approximately 405 m of ascent and 560 m of descent; part of the ultramarathon route
Route along forest trails and paved sections; not suitable for spiked shoes
additional: The half marathon has a minimum age of 16; the marathon and ultramarathon have a minimum age of 18. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. There is a clothing transport service from the start to the finish and a bus transfer from the finish back to the start. Participants are asked to bring their own reusable drinking cups to help protect the environment. The entry fee includes a race bib, finisher’s medal and refreshments. Distances range from 5 km to the ultramarathon (63.3 km), including children’s races and cross-country races; registration is open until 25 October 2026.

name: 41e BAX Halve Marathon van Doetinchem
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, Halve marathon, 15 km, 7.5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: Heemstedeloop
location: Sportparklaan and Landgoed Groenendaal, Heemstede, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Heemstede Loop takes place on 25 October 2026 in Heemstede and offers an atmospheric running experience through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and lively Heemstede. Participants are cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and entertained along the way by live music from bands and DJs, creating a festive atmosphere. Several distances are available, including a 1 km FamilyRun for children, a 5 km, and a 10 km route that covers the 5 km loop twice. Organiser SportSupport Kennemerland ensures a well-organised and enjoyable event, with timing and unique medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Route through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and lively Heemstede
The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km loop
Live music from bands and DJs along the course
additional: The Les Petits 1 km FamilyRun is suitable for children aged 4 and up, with two start groups: groups 1–4 start at 10:00 and groups 5–8 at 10:30. One parent or guardian may run for free with children in groups 1–4. Timing is provided by Chronorace. Registration includes a unique medal, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and changing facilities. Registration is via a digital module. Race numbers are sent by post or handed out on the day. Facilities include changing and shower rooms and a supervised cloakroom.

name: Smaltovaný bažant
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is the final race in the Ruler of Mrdice series, held in the picturesque pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. This traditional 1,500-metre race offers an opportunity to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. The Heřmanův Městec Running Club organizes a range of sporting activities and group training sessions throughout the year, complementing the racing season. The Enamelled Pheasant is an ideal event for runners who want to end the season with joy and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A 1,500-metre race in the pheasantry
Part of the Ruler of Mrdice series
A traditional race in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice series, which includes classic races as well as open, timed group training sessions. The running club holds regular group runs every Tuesday in a friendly atmosphere. A course map and results from previous editions are available. The race is the final round of the Mrdice League. In 2026, the first category was scheduled to start at 18:00; the 2027 race date had not been confirmed in the available materials.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Cycling path near Kempinku, Braník, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race held in Prague 4-Braník on the cycle path by Kempink. The route follows a beautiful, flat and fast path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back, often enabling runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to experience a high-quality half marathon in pleasant surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Vltava on a cycle path
A flat and fast course
Route from Braník to Vrané and back
additional: The race takes place on a flat cycle path that is suitable for fast times and personal bests. It is organized by VAŠE LIGA; Petra Lundák can be contacted. A relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
location: Sokolovna Nepomuk, Nepomuk, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children and run mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, where participants can collect their race pack and receive a beautiful medal shaped like the Republic after finishing. Sports activities are set up for children, and refreshments are available at the finish. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the gym’s parking lot.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk
The route passes St. John of Nepomuk Church and crosses the Mihovka stream
The finish is at the Sokol gym, with a slight uphill section
additional: No finishing times are recorded, and no results list with rankings is produced. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Sports activities for children are available at the event grounds. There is a place to leave belongings and refreshments. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the gym’s parking lot.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic

description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov near Zlín. It offers three distances of 5, 11 and 21 kilometres, running mainly along field and forest paths. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in shorter age-based races free of charge. It is organised by UnArt Provodov, p.s., and takes place regardless of the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play. The start and registration are at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch.
course_highlights: Trail race mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km, with varying levels of difficulty
Free children’s races, with distances from 30 to 750 metres depending on age
additional: Race registration opens at 9:00 at Areál mládí. The race number must be clearly displayed on the chest. First aid is provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may cause it to be postponed or cancelled. The organiser reserves the right to change the programme and rules without prior notice.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no competition, held on October 28. The routes follow the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys, mostly on asphalt and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. Everyone can look forward to a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish and a race pack with gifts. The run takes place on the boundary of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve, in a private area with open restrooms.
course_highlights: The route follows the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys on asphalt and forest paths
A challenging route with rugged terrain and a steep descent on the 6.2 km course
A run on the boundary of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve
additional: No finish times are recorded, and no results list with rankings is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children. The race pack contains a race number and gifts. A republic-shaped medal is awarded at the finish. Open restrooms are available. The route includes asphalt and unpaved forest paths, including a challenging section with a steep descent on the 6.2 km course.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main race route is 5 km long and winds through the picturesque town, past the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the flat Elbe embankment, finishing by crossing Tyršův Bridge back to Smetanovo nábřeží. Children can choose between two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, both following a similar route to the adults’ race. The event offers professional timing, a race pack, and a medal shaped like the country for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Flat stretch along the Elbe embankment and crossing Tyršův Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the country at the finish. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Online registration closed on 25 October.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a main 8.9 km route through the countryside, with moderate elevation changes and a combination of asphalt and hard-packed farm roads. Children can choose flat 1.4 km routes based on their age categories. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Facilities with refreshments, changing rooms, and parking are available for runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Main race route: 8.9 km with 112 m of elevation gain
A combination of asphalt and hard-packed farm roads
Children’s 1.4 km routes on a flat asphalt road
additional: Start and finish by the Sokol Hall in Dolní Újezd. Facilities include changing rooms, refreshments, and parking. Registered participants receive a race pack and medal. No timing system is used, but results and a winners’ ceremony are provided. On-site registration beyond the race capacity does not guarantee a medal or race pack.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Oleška, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, organized on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. In Kutná Hora, the run will take place for the first time, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to meet people with a connection to Sokol. The main race route is just under six kilometers long, with the start and finish at the Sokol gym, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The event is suitable for families and individuals, with an emphasis on safety and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol gym, with full facilities
Main race of just under 6 km in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora
Children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: The race capacity is set at approximately 155 runners to ensure quality organization and timekeeping. A team of volunteers is ready to help with course navigation and event organization. Facilities at the Sokol gym include changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds so children do not have to cross roads.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place on 28 October. The 5.6 km main race starts from the square and passes through the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St Mary Magdalene stands. The route combines paved sections with field and forest trails. At the finish, participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic, and main-race entrants can enter a raffle. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and is timed professionally.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved roads, field paths and forest trails
additional: The start and finish are on the square in Louňovice pod Blaníkem, in front of the chateau. A raffle for main-race entrants is held after the winners’ awards ceremony. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. All races are timed professionally. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
location: Lužice, Hodonín District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race celebrating the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 27 October 2027. Runners follow paved paths and roads through a beautiful new park created after a tornado, past orchards and vineyards. Shorter routes for children are set up in the Sokol Hall grounds, which also provide changing rooms, showers and refreshments. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the country and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through a new park created after a tornado
The route goes past orchards and vineyards around Strání
Paved paths and roads in Lužice
additional: The race is held without chip timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments are available in the Sokol Hall grounds. Sports equipment and games are provided for children. Parking is available by the Sokol Hall and the Sports Hall.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia. It takes place on October 28. The race starts by the state chateau and runs through the picturesque surroundings, including Sokol Hall on Vrška, ponds, and the U Káji Maříka Inn. There are various race distances for adults and children, with predominantly asphalt surfaces and easy courses. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and a race pack with a race number and gifts is provided. The start area has tents for registration and changing, toilets, refreshments, and benches.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the state chateau in Mníšek pod Brdy
The route passes Sokol Hall on Vrška and ponds
The course is asphalt; children's loops are on a grassy area
additional: The event is held in RACE format without timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Parking, a bag drop, and a rest area are available at the start.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové District, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on October 28 in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The event offers routes for adults and children. The main adult race is 4.8 km long and runs partly through the town and partly along dirt roads, crossing two bridges over the Cidlina River. Shorter children’s races take place on the athletics track at the Sportring complex. At the finish, all participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of the republic and a goody bag. The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers and volunteers stationed at intersections, and is suitable for runners of all categories.
course_highlights: 4.8 km route with 30% asphalt and 70% dirt roads
Cross the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the uphill climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers at intersections and volunteers along the route. The lead runner is guided by a cyclist. Children’s races take place on the athletics track; times are not recorded, and placings are indicative. A goody bag and medal are included in the race. In bad weather, goody bags are handed out in the lobby of the Sokol hall; otherwise, distribution takes place outdoors by the clay court.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Uherský Brod, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia, taking place on October 28. The race offers several routes for different age groups, including 5 km and 8 km races for adults and shorter races for children. The routes pass through the town center, residential neighborhoods, around a pond, and past allotment gardens. Timekeeping is professionally managed, and the fastest runners receive awards. Every participant receives a race pack and an original medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. Registration is also available on site.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the town center, residential neighborhoods, and around a pond
The 8 km route continues further into the countryside, passing a spring and an observatory
The start and finish are at the Sokol stadium, with professional timekeeping
additional: Race times are recorded by professional timekeepers. At the race facilities, every participant can collect a race pack containing a race number and gifts. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits everyone at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. Registration is also available on site.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. It draws inspiration from the historic 1919 relay race, “Rozestavný běh,” and has become a modern tradition that grows every year, connecting dozens of locations in Czechia and abroad. The race offers runners of all ages, including children, an opportunity to celebrate the founding of the republic through movement. The routes vary and often pass through both urban and natural areas, allowing participants to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of each location.
course_highlights: The route in Děčín passes through the castle gardens, Mariánská louka, the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and the flat Elbe riverbank
Children’s races have shorter routes, some of which follow the same route as the adult race
The routes are mostly flat, with varied sections and iconic landmarks in each city
additional: Registration is available online only and is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Children aged 15 to 18 may take part only in the main race. A race T-shirt can be purchased during registration and must be ordered by October 15. On-site registration is available only while capacity remains and does not include a race pack or a medal for late entrants. Races are divided into the BĚH, ZÁVOD, and VELKÝ ZÁVOD levels, each with different rules. In Děčín, times are recorded using professional timing, and participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Milovice
location: Milovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Milovice is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers an easy 5.8 km trail suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with a partly paved and road surface. Children can enjoy simple oval courses around Haken Stadium, with distances varying by age. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: An easy 5.8 km trail with a partly paved and road surface
Children’s courses around Haken Stadium with an oval gravel surface
A course suitable for beginner and experienced runners; trail shoes are recommended
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring #SBR graphics, Halls Ice Team & Cola (adults only), and an original medal at the finish. On-site registration takes place at Haken Stadium, which also has changing facilities and restrooms. Parking is available near the stadium. For refreshments, you can visit the RKDM restaurant and Clock Cafe next to the stadium.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Písek is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults, and is part of the broader tradition of runs organised by the Czech Sokol Community. The route passes through the picturesque Palacký Gardens, across the Stone Bridge and along the river, with professional timing and awards for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original republic-shaped medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Start in Palacký Gardens by the music pavilion
Across the Stone Bridge and along the Otava River
The route crosses the footbridge to the right bank and returns to the Ševčík Pavilion
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring SBR graphics, a medal at the finish, and the option to order an official Alpine Pro T-shirt for an additional fee. The main race is limited to 180 runners. Registration and race-pack collection close at 11:45 for the children's routes and at 13:30 for the main race. If capacity is not reached, on-site registration is available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Prostějov
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Prostějov, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Prostějov is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers different distances for adults and children, all running through the city centre on paved roads, with a 2.5 km loop. The start and finish are on T.G.M. Square, where participants can expect professional timekeeping, a race pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. Music, sports demonstrations and refreshments for runners and spectators add to the atmosphere. The route is flat, wide enough and safe, with no parked cars, making for a comfortable run through the historic centre of Prostějov.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city centre on paved roads
A 2.5 km loop, completed once, twice or four times depending on the race distance
A flat, sufficiently wide course with no parked cars
additional: Start and finish on T.G.M. Square. The clock on the town hall building starts at 14:00. Facilities include changing rooms for women and men, and storage for valuables and backpacks. Apple Pay or Google Wallet accepted. A commemorative ceremony at the statue of T. G. Masaryk and the results announcement. Music and sports demonstrations. Traffic is diverted away from the route, and the municipal police manage parking in the city centre.

name: 26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The DRESDEN-MARATHON has been held regularly in late October since 1999. It offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital, passing its famous sights. The route goes through the historic Old Town, including Brühl’s Terrace, the Semper Opera House and other Baroque buildings, as well as the lively Neustadt district. More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon runs through the Blasewitz district, with views of the palaces on the Loschwitz Elbe slope and the villas along Goetheallee, before returning to the Old Town along the Elbe.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden’s historic Old Town and Neustadt district
Illuminated Waldschlößchen Tunnel and bridge, and the Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by more than 300 musicians and bands along the course
additional: More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create an atmosphere along the course. There is a marathon expo, race-pack collection and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medal engraving, a photo service, showers, changing rooms and toilets, as well as award ceremonies, are available. The evening before the race, an anniversary party takes place in the marquee behind Heinz Steyer Stadium (€25 admission; limited capacity). Several race distances, online registration, health questionnaire, event on 24 and 25 October 2026

name: Frankenwaldlauf um den Preis der Kulmbacher Brauerei
description: The Frankenwald Run for the Kulmbacher Brewery Prize is a relaxed running event in the beautiful Franconian Forest village of Ludwigschorgast, organised by runners for runners. Featuring a 1.5-kilometre singletrack trail as an exciting alternative to the paved section, the event welcomes both ambitious runners and recreational athletes, with a fun run and Nordic walking. Alongside sporting ambition, the focus is on having fun amid the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery. The overall male and female winners of the main race receive prize money, and the club with the most participants receives a financial award.
course_highlights: A 1.5 km singletrack trail replaces the paved section from Wirsberg to the Goldener Adler Hut
Run through the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery
A variety of events: main race, fun run (5 km) and Nordic walking (8.4 km)
additional: Late registration is available on the event day at the FC Ludwigschorgast sports hall from 12:30 to 13:30, for an additional fee of 5 euros. All participants receive a small gift from Kulmbacher when they hand in their race number at the finish. Tea, non-alcoholic drinks, biscuits, pretzel sticks and gummy bears are available at the finish. The race number must be worn clearly visible on the front of the body; otherwise, participants will be disqualified. There is a team competition in the main race, with non-cash prizes and a challenge trophy for the fastest men’s team. Courses in the Franconian Forest region; registration opens on 18 September; late registration at the start for a fee; refreshments at the finish; start at 9:00; awards ceremony at 11:30.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: The 34th Mündener Altstadtlauf takes place on October 31, 2026, in Hann. Münden and offers suitable distances for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as 5 km and 10 km races for recreational and competitive runners. The course is measured by the Lower Saxony Athletics Association and is therefore eligible for record times. In addition to individual rankings, there are group and team rankings, making the race particularly appealing to teams. The organizing team places great importance on professional delivery and continually improving the event.
course_highlights: Course measured by the athletics association and eligible for record times
500 m Bambini course and 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race for young runners
5 km course with a group ranking and 10 km course with a team ranking (at least one woman per team)
additional: The 5 km course offers a so-called combined ranking for groups. The 10 km course has a team ranking for teams of three, including at least one woman. Around 40 volunteers help with setup and dismantling and secure the race routes. Various local institutions, including the fire department, police, and city administration, are involved. Commentator Frank Neumann hosts the event. Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, 5 km, and 10 km; team and group rankings; courses measured to be eligible for record times

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 at Werdersee in Bremen and offers runners a spooky running experience with various distances from 1 km to the marathon. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as a spectacular fireworks display to close the event. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels, and includes relay races and a children’s run.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km to the marathon (42.195 km) in a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, with fireworks from 18:00
additional: Relay races for men’s, women’s and mixed teams with RFID bibs. Costumes are expressly encouraged, but regular sportswear is also allowed. The award ceremony takes place immediately after the Spooky Run and later for the other distances. Fireworks from 18:00 bring the event to a close. The start and finish area is between the Finnbahn at Werdersee and the Grillwiese/DLRG lifeguard station. Several running distances, including the marathon, take place on measured loops; costumes are encouraged; the event concludes with fireworks.

name: Bredstedt-Cross
description: The 39th Bredstedt Cross takes place on 31 October 2026 at Sportpark Bredstedt and is hosted by Bredstedter TSV. The event offers cross-country races for a wide range of ages, from children and young people to senior competitors and numerous masters categories. There are short and long cross-country races for men and women, as well as separate age categories from M6/W6 to M75/W75, including youth and U18/U20. The event is listed as category 6.5.1, an event held away from a stadium, and offers a varied competition format for all age groups.
course_highlights: Cross-country races for children, youth, senior competitors and masters
Short and long cross-country races for men and women
Age categories from M6/W6 to M75/W75, as well as youth and U18/U20
additional: The entry deadline is 28 October 2026; online registration is open until 23:59. The event is listed as category 6.5.1, an event held away from a stadium. No detailed course distances or other practical information are provided on the page. The entry deadline is 28 October 2026; October weather is typically around 14°C with about 40 mm of precipitation, making the cross-country race a challenging, nature-oriented experience.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The District Championships and 3rd Halloween Cross-Country Run in the Örtzetal in Munster is a cross-country event taking place on October 31, 2026, at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the District Cross-Country Championships with the third Halloween Cross-Country Run and is open to children, young people, open categories and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, offering a local, club-oriented atmosphere rather than the feel of a major city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability categories
Event at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the District Championships into the Halloween Cross-Country Run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event uses a cross-country race format, has a local character, is open to children, young people, adults and masters, and takes place on Halloween with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Köstritzer Parklauf
location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Parklauf is a cross-country race held in late October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs through and around Köstritzer Park, away from the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and young people, as well as longer distances for adults and masters, from 500 m to the 12 km main race. It attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for its strong regional turnout.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with views of dahlias in bloom in autumn
A range of distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: around 14 °C maximum and 6 °C minimum, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes races for children and young people, as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place in late October, with various race distances and categories for children, young people, active runners, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.

name: TEAG – Legend of Cross
price_range: 30 € (Fun- und Nachwuchsläufe), 15 € (JUNIOR), Preise für Hauptrennen nicht explizit genannt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: SUPERSPRINT (4 km, ab 15 Jahre, Start: 14:00 Uhr, 30 €)

description: The TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS is Thuringia’s toughest and warmest-hearted cross-country race, taking place on 31 October and 1 November 2026 in Mühlberg at the Drei Gleichen. The event features challenging trails, more than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, and a unique setting with three castles. Whether running solo or as part of a team, recreational runners can become legends in a strong community. The event offers various distances and levels of difficulty suitable for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Three courses of different lengths, each with its own obstacles and difficulty level
More than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, including water obstacles at the Wechmar Reservoir
Start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, set against the historic backdrop of the Drei Gleichen
additional: The Fun and junior races start on Saturday, and the main races take place on Sunday. There are individual and team rankings. The 4 km SPECIAL CROSS is available for Special Olympics athletes with intellectual disabilities. Changes and late registrations are free until mid-October; after that, a €5 fee applies. Double-start offer for both LEGEND OF CROSS events in 2026 for €99. Several course distances, obstacles, junior races, team rankings, start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, water obstacle on the 30 km course.

name: Sparkasse Trier Euro Cross 2026, Regionsmeisterschaften Trier Cross-Lauf
Spendenlauf für die Villa Kunterbunt Trier
Sandflugtsløbet 2026
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 15 km, 14 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 2 km

name: 11strandentocht
description: The 11strandentocht is a walking event taking place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, along the Dutch coast. Participants can choose from four distances: 50 km, 25 km, 12.5 km and 5 km. Each route passes different beaches, with the sea on the left. The finish is always in the centre of Zandvoort. The event supports the Dutch Heart Foundation in its fight against cardiovascular disease and combines a sporting challenge with a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes run entirely over sand and unpaved paths along 11 beaches
The 50 km distance starts early in the morning (06:30 and 07:00), with a light to help participants before sunrise
There are checkpoint posts, rest stops and medical assistance along the way, including first aid and an AED
additional: Each distance has a different starting location, but the finish is always in the heart of Zandvoort. The 50 km route starts at Deltaplein, The Hague, and is a loop over the beach and boulevard. The 5 km Heroes Route is suitable for walkers setting their own pace. There are 11 checkpoint posts along the way for the long distance and 5 checkpoint posts for the 12.5 km route. The number of entry tickets is limited to ensure personal attention and safety. Distances range from 5 km to 50 km; starting locations vary; the event supports a good cause; the beach route has the sea on the left.

name: Backyard Ultra de Langstraat
description: The Backyard Ultra de Langstraat takes place in Waalwijk on Saturday, October 31, 2026. The race consists of a distance of 7 kilometers and offers runners a challenging and unique running experience in the Brabant region. This ultramarathon is ideal for runners who want to test their endurance in a friendly and sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: 7 kilometers per lap
Location in Waalwijk, Brabant
Unique Backyard Ultra format
additional: The race is held in a friendly and sporty atmosphere, with a focus on endurance and perseverance.

name: Dalli-run
description: Athletics club De Gemzen organizes the Dalli-Run every autumn, one of the most beautiful running events of the year, on October 31, 2026. The race takes place in Heerde on the Veluwe and offers a beautiful undulating course past some of the area’s loveliest spots. The Dalli-Run is popular in the region and offers several distances, from short youth races to 15 kilometers for adults. The routes follow paved roads and cycle paths, with starts between 10:00 and 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful undulating course past some of Heerde’s loveliest spots
Paved roads and cycle paths
Several distances: 700m, 1400m, 5km, 10km and 15km
additional: Start times between 10:00 and 11:00. Youth distances: 700 and 1400 meters; adult distances: 5, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course follows paved roads and cycle paths. Organized by Athletics club De Gemzen. The Dalli-Run is an event for runners of all levels, with activities for children and adults. It is organized by a local athletics club and attracts many participants from the region each year.

name: Haarlerbergtrail
description: The Haarlerbergtrail takes place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, and offers challenging trail runs over distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 kilometres. The routes pass through a large part of Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park, where runners can enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The organisers aim to make the event climate-neutral and ask participants to bring their own drinking cup. There is no prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Varied terrain, with some paths closed during the bird-breeding season
Beautiful scenery and challenging trail distances
additional: Maximum of 349 participants. Online registration only. Start times: 30 km and 22 km at 12:00, 16 km at 12:15, and 11 km at 12:30. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory; a reusable cup is available to buy for €4. No prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal. Start and finish at Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel. No on-the-day registration. Registration closes on 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if the event is full. The organisers may cancel the event up to 30 October at 20:00. Cycling alongside participants on the course is not permitted. Trail through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park; organised as a climate-neutral event. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory. Maximum of 349 participants; online registration. Race numbers can be collected at De Veldkamp. Limited shower facilities.

name: Moerschanscross
description: The Moerschanscross is an individual cross-country race held in Hulst on 31 October 2026. This is the 40th edition of the event and it is part of the AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie. The race features various age groups and categories, from pupils to M/V 55+, and offers a challenging course for all participants. Registration is open until 29 October at 18:00, with limited late registration available at double the entry fee.
course_highlights: Individual cross-country race with various age groups
Participants range from pupils to M/V 55+
Part of the AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie
additional: Late registration is temporarily available until Friday at 12:00 at double the entry fee; after that, registration is no longer possible. The AERS Groep Crosscompetitie 2026-2027 regulations and the Atletiekunie competition regulations apply. Any images may be published publicly. Registration closes on 29 October at 18:00, with late registration available until Friday at 12:00. The event is supported by Zeeuwse Atletiek and is a fixture of the Zeeland cross-country season.
